fields.title: Amayinja g'Okulinnyirako
fields.subtitle: Okutambula lwa Kukkiriza
fields.description: Gareth Evans afumiitiriza ku myaka egisukka mu ataano gy'amaze ng'atambula ne Mukama, ng'ayoleka engeri Katonda gye yaluŋŋamyamu ekkubo lye ng'ayita mu kusomesa, omulimu gw'obuminsani, n'obuweereza. Ng'ayita mu byafaayo ebisikiriza, Evans ayoleka amaanyi amangi ag'okukkiriza, obuwulize, n'okutaasa kwa Katonda, ng'akubiriza abasomi okutegeera n'okwesiga enteekateeka Katonda gy'alina ku bulamu bwabwe. Ebirimu: Amayinja g'Okulinnyirako—Olugendo Lutandika—Nnaakukulembera—Eyinjaanyo ye Buvanjuba—Emikisa Mingi—Yerova Yire – Omugabi Waffe—Ebbaluwa ey'Ekifo—Okusaba—Ekigambo Kyange Tekiridda Bwereere—Okukkiriza – Ekirabo Ekiva eri Katonda—Ekibiina kya Hazel Glen—Omutima gwa Katonda Ogumenyese—Okuyitibwa mu Afrika—Okukwata ku Mirandira Gyaffe—Okuggulawo Enzigi.

fields.title: Ebyafaayo by'Obulamu bwa Gareth Evans
fields.body_html:
Gareth Evans musumba/muyigiriza atambulatambula era muwandiisi, alina omutima ogw'okuweereza Ekkanisa erimu ennaku ng'ayita mu mukutu gwe ogw'obuweereza, Gareth Evans Ministries.

Yazaalibwa mu kibuga eky'e Wales ekiyitibwa Merthyr Tydfil, mu 1938, ng'azaalibwa Cyril Evans, eyali omuserikale wa RAF mu Ssematalo ow'Okubiri, ne Ethel Evans, omukubi wa pinno omukugu eyeewaayo okuba maama w'amaka omwagalanyi.

Gareth yeeyunga mu Cowbridge Grammar School n'anoonyereza ennyo mu kubala okulongoofu (pure mathematics), okubala okukozesebwa (applied mathematics), ne physics ku mutendera gwa Advanced Level. Yeeyongera okunoonya okumanya n'ayingira amasomero ag'oku ntikko mu University of Swansea (ekitundu kya Brynmill), gye yafunira diguli ey'ekitiibwa (Honours) mu Physics.

Yayigiriza mu Kenfig Comprehensive School, Windsor Boys School mu Bugirimaani, British Army Education Corp mu Hong Kong, Ogmore Grammar School mu Wales, Toronto French School, ne The Toronto Hebrew Academy.

Bw'eyeeyogerako ng'omusinza, Gareth ayolesa enkolagana ye eya nnamaddala n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu era okuva olwo abunyisizza ekigambo kya Katonda mu ngeri ez'enjawulo. Awandiise ebitabo bingi eby'okwesiimisa, ebitabo eby'Ekikristaayo, n'ennyimba, ateese okuyigiriza kwa Baibuli ku mukutu gwe era aweerezza ng'omusumba mu bibuga ne ku ssemazinga ez'enjawulo.

Gareth yawasa Anne era balina abaana aba buwala basatu: Corinne, Andrea, ne Lynette, abazzukulu 8, n'abazzukulu ab'oku bazzukulu 9.

Okumanya ebisingawo ku byafaayo by'obulamu bwe, kebera ekitundu ky'ebyafaayo ku mukutu gwaffe.

fields.title: Amayinja ag'Okulinnyako
fields.body_html:
Ekkanisa enkulu eya Notre Dame mu kibuga eky'edda ekya Quebec City erabye emikolo mingi egy'ebyafaayo. Ku ssaawa eno ey'olweggulo olw'omusana mu Juuni 1979, nnali njiraba ogundi omulala. Nnali mu mulyango omukulu nga ntunuulira munda mu kkanisa eyali ejjudde ekizikiza, awo nga waliwo omuvubuka eyayimirira mu maaso g'ennyiriri bbiri ez'abaana b'essomero, nga bawerekeddwako omusomesa omusajja. Omuvubuka yali akutte Baibuli mu mukono gwe, era ng'asonga buli emu ku 'bifo eby'omusaalaba' ezaali ku bisenge by'ekkanisa, yali ayigiriza abayizi ku kubonaabona kwa Yesu. Baawuliriza n'obwegendereza bungi. Newaakubadde nga bonna baali ba myaka kkumi na mukaaga oba kkumi na musanvu obukulu, era nga bamanyi bulungi ennono ya Canada n'ebyafaayo bya Quebec, okuyigiriza kuno kwali kupya gye bali. Bwe wandyongedde okwetegereza, wandirabye nga abavubuka bonna baali bambadde kippah ku mitwe gyabwe - akabonero nga bali Bayudaaya.

Natunuulira nga nneewuunya era nga nzijjudde essanyu ery'enjawulo ng'omu ku abo abaali bazze, kubanga abayizi bano baali bavudde mu ssomero lyaffe e Toronto okumala wikendi ey'okuyiga mu Quebec ey'ebyafaayo. Toronto Hebrew Academy ssomero lya Bayudaaya erimanyiddwa era eritambulira ku nnono ya Bayudaaya ab'edda, era nnali nfunye omukisa okusomerezaayo emyaka ebiri egiyise. Abayizi bano amakumi ana baali ekibiina kyaffe ekya grade 11, era nze ne munnange, Ari Barchi, twali tusabiddwa okukulembera olugendo luno olw'enjawulo. Tewali n'omu ku bayizi bano eyamanya nti nnali nakawa obubaka nti nnali nzija kuva mu ssomero ku nkomerero y'omulundi guno, okukwata ku 'kuyitibwa' okupya - okuba omusumba ow'ekiseera kyonna. Okuva lwe nnasalawo ekyo, Katonda yali antutte mu bumanyirivu obw'ekitalo, era wikendi eno yali eraga omukisa gwe ogutasalako.

Bwe nnali ntunuulira ebisenge eby'ekitalo, eby'edda eby'ekkanisa, wamu n'ebifo ekkumi n'ennya, abakkiriza we baafukamiranga mu kusaba nga bajjukira ekkubo Yesu lye yatambulira okuva e Gesusemane okutuuka e Kalvari, ebirowoozo byange byazzibwa emabega eri ebifo eby'omu bulamu bwange Katonda gye yali antuseeko. Natunuulira emabega okusukka emyaka amakumi abiri ne ndaba amazima agaayogerwa Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli.

“Amakubo g'omuntu ganywezebwa Mukama, bw'asanyukira ekkubo lye; ne bw'agwa, taasuulibwe wansi, kubanga Mukama amukwatirira omukono gwe” (Zabbuli 37:23-24).

Ndaba ebifo bingi nnyo oba 'amayinja ag'okulinnyako' mu bulamu bwange ebyantuusa mu bumanyirivu obw'omunda ennyo eri Mukama, era awatali byo, sandibadde na lugero lwe njagala okubuulira. Buli jjinja ery'okulinnyako lyantuusa eri eriddirira, nga buli limu lye kutabaala kwa Mukama okw'atereevu mu nteekateeka zange. Olw'okutunuulira emabega kyokka kwe nsobola okulabako ku bigendererwa bye yalina okuva ku lubereberye. Kaakano nsobola okutegeera ensonga lwaki 'yaggala oluggi luli,' bwe nnali ndowooza nti lwandibadde luggule. Kaakano nsobola okulaba engeri gye yakoleramu mu bulamu bw'abalala, ne mu abo abatakkiriza, okutuukiriza enteekateeka ze ez'olwange. Kaakano nsobola okwogera nti mmanyi nti ebyo ebinnennyamiza emirundi mingi bye Mukama by'ateekateeka. Kaakano, nsobola okumwesiga mu buli kitundu ky'ebiseera byange eby'omu maaso kubanga yeeraze mu biseera byange ebyayita. Mmanyi nti amayinja ag'okulinnyako galiwo newaakubadde nga sinnagalaba. Oba ebyayita bisseewo enkola ku by'omu maaso, siigalabe nga sinnabifuna.

Ntuuse okutegeera nti 'okutambula mu kukkiriza' tekwesigamira ku 'kukkiriza' kwange okunene, wabula ku kwewaayo kwange ng'akyusa ekkubo ery'obulamu bwange olw'okutabaala kwe okw'atereevu. 'Okukkiriza' okwo kukwatagana nnyo n'obuwulize okusinga bwe kukwatagana n'okukkiriza. Obuwulize buzaalibwa mu kwesiga. Singa okukkiriza kwange kupimibwa okusinziira ku ngeri abamu 'abayigiriza b'okukkiriza' ab'omu biro bino gye bakozesa, nandigudde nnyo. Gye bali, okukkiriza kintu kye nsobola okwekulaakulanyizaamu, olwo bwe mbeera nakwo okumala, ne nsobola okukakaska Katonda okukola kye njagala. Bwe mbeera omulwadde, kiba nti sirina 'kukkiriza' okumala, era bwe mbeera mu bwetaavu, kiba nti sirina 'kukkiriza' okumala. Naye, bwe nsoma ebyawandiikibwa, binjigiriza nti sisobola kwezaalira kukkiriza wadde okukwongeza mu nze kennyini. Ogwo mulimu gwa Mukama ye nannyini buyinza, era akola omulimu ogwo nga neewaayo eri okukulembera kwe ne nfuula Ekigambo kye omusingi gw'obulamu bwange. Bwe nsoma essuula enkulu ey'okukkiriza mu Abaebbulaniya 11, sirabamu basajja na bakazi ab'ekitalo abatenderezebwa ng'ab'amaanyi olw'okukkiriza kwabwe, wabula ndaba ebyafaayo eby'okutabaala kwa Katonda n'okukulembera mu bulamu bw'abantu aba bulijjo, olw'okutuyigiriza amazima amakulu n'emisingi gy'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, naye eby'okuyiga ku Katonda bimala kaakano! Tuddeko olugero!

fields.title: Olugendo Lutandika
fields.body_html:
Okusinza kwali kuwedde mu kapella akatono, ne ekibinja ekitono eky'abavubuka ne kikuŋŋaana okwetooloola omubuulizi omuvubuka. Twali tugenze akawungeezi ako okumugumya kubanga yali muggya mu mulimu gw'okubuulira ng'omuntu obuntu atali musumba mulonde, omulimu ogw'omugaso ennyo eri obukapella obutono obungi obw'omu Wales. Obubaka bwe yawa bumaze ebbanga wewuunyiddwa, naye emboozi eyaddirira teerabiddwa. Twanyumya ku ssomero lyange, Cowbridge Grammar, gye yali ayizze emyaka ebiri emabega, oluvannyuma Aneurin n'abuuza ekibuuzo ekyakyusa obulamu bwange.

“Mbuulira, Gareth,” n'agamba, “onookola ki ku Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo?”

Wabuliddewo wiiki ttaano zokka nga sinnaba kuyingira mu maka ga Vince ne Betty Bishop. Baali bakuba enkuŋŋaana z'abavubuka, mwannyinaze Barbara ze yali agenda buli Lwakutaano akawungeezi. Eyo baali bayimba ennyimba enzijudde essanyu, ne bakuba ebibuuzo bya Baibuli, era oluusi baabanga n'omwogezi eyali akyalidde. Nnali ngenda mu Ssomero lya Ssande okutuusa maama we bwe yafa nga nnina emyaka kkumi n'ena, naye kaakano nnali sikyafaayo nnyo ku by'omwoyo. Wabula, Barbara bwe yanjita, ne nneesanga nga ntudde ku ntebe ennungi ey'oku nsonda mu kisenge eky'okusinzirako aba Bishop, era kyennina okukkiriza nti nnali neesanyusa. Ojja kutegeera nti ekyo kyali kyangu nnyo, kubanga nze nnali omulenzi omu yekka awamu n'abawala kkumi n'abataano! Nnalowooza nti ekyo kye kyaviirako Betty okunyita mu ffumbiro ku nkomerero y'akawungeezi ng'ebyokunywa ebinnyogovu ne kuki biteekebwateekebwa.

Nga bwe kiri, yali asuubira nze okusitula essowaani enzito ey'ebyokunywa okugireeta munda.

Saasuubira ky'oyo yayogera bwe yankyukira. “Mbuulira, Gareth,” n'agamba, “onookola ki ku Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo?”

Mu kavuyo k'effumbiro eryo, okwewala ekibuuzo kyali kyangu, naye tekyayinzika kukiggya mu birowoozo byange okutuusa omubuulizi omuvubuka bwe yaddamu okunsomooza. Mu kiseera ekyo, nnali ntuuse okutegeera nti Obukristaayo tebulangirira kufa kwa Yesu ku musaalaba kwokka wabula n'okuzuukira kwe okuva mu bafu. Ne ntandika okulowooza nti obanga ddala azuukidde okuva mu bafu, mulamu; kale nga kisoboka okumumanya nga kennyini. Buli wiiki nnali nsobodde okwewala okubeera ne Betty nzekka, kubanga nnamanya nti yali ajja kuddamu okubuuza ekibuuzo kye nnali sirina kye nziramu, naye kaakano ekibuuzo ekyo kyali kintuuseeko. Abalala nga batambula ne Aneurin okutuuka ku sitegi ya bbaasi, nze ne nnyweza olusozi okwolekera eka. Bwe nnayingira mu kisenge kyange eky'okwebakiramu, ne nfukamira ku mabbali g'ekitanda ne nsaba okusaba okwangu.

“Mukama Yesu, obanga oli wa mazima, nkusaba yingira mu bulamu bwange, ggyawo ekibi kyange onfuule owuwo.” Saamanya kirala kya kwogera, kyennava nneeyongera n'ebigambo by'oluyimba olwangu lwe nnali nnaakayiga. “Mu mutima gwange, mu mutima gwange, yingira mu mutima gwange, Mukama Yesu. Yingira leero, yingira obeere, yingira mu mutima gwange, Mukama Yesu. Amiina.” Saategeera nti nnali nnaakatandika olugendo olusanyusa olw'okukkiriza.

Abamu bayinza okugamba nti kyali kya kubeerawo buulijjo nti Aneurin abuuze ekibuuzo kye kimu kye nnali nneewala, naye ntuuse okulaba ebyokulabirako bingi eby'engeri Katonda gy'atambuliramu mu bulamu bwange mu ngeri ez'‘okubeerawo buulijjo’ ezifaanana, ne kaakano mbitegeera ng'ensisinkano za Katonda; amayinja g'okulinnyako mu kutambula kwange okw'okukkiriza. Ekigendererwa kyange mu kitabo kino kwe kukwanyisa Katonda afaayo okukulembera buli omu ku ffe okutuuka mu kutambula okw'oluganda naye. Aggulawo enzigi era n'azissaawo; akulembera okuyita mu biwonvu ne waggulu ku nsozi; addira okumalwa essuubi kwaffe n'akufuula ensisinkano ze.

“Katonda bw'ayagala okutendeka omuntu...

n'okumusanyusa omuntu...

n'okumuwa obukugu; Katonda bw'ayagala okubumba omuntu okukola omulimu ogusinga obukulu; bw'ayaayaanira n'omutima gwe gwonna okutonda omuntu omukulu era omuvumu ennyo ensi yonna gy'erisamaalirira, Tunuulira enkola ze! Tunuulira amakubo ge!

Engeri gy'atuukirizaamu awatali kusaasira - abo b'alonda mu kitiibwa; engeri gy'amukubiramu ennyondo n'amulumya, n'okukuba okw'amaanyi n'amufuula ebitole by'ebbumba ebigezesebwa Katonda yekka by'ategeera!

Ng'omutima gwe ogubonyaabonyezebwa gukaaba n'ayimusa emikono egyeegayirira!

Engeri gy'akutamya, naye n'atamenya abo b'akolera obulungi; engeri gy'akozesa abo b'alonda, era n'ekigendererwa eky'okwagala n'abagatta, ng'ayita mu mwoyo omuzitoowereddwa n'amuleetera okugezesa obugagga bwa Katonda.

Katonda amanyi ky'akola!”

-Atamanyiddwa Mu myezi egyaddirira okusaba kwange okwangu, nnali nkuze nnyo mu kutegeera kwange amazima ag'omusingi aga Baibuli. Nnaweebwa omukisa okuba n'abasomesa abalungi abaayagala Mukama n'Ekigambo kye. Nnali nneegasse mu kkanisa era nga nkola nnyo mu kibiina kyabwe eky'abavubuka ekiyitibwa, “The Crusaders.” Nnali ntandika okuvumbula obugagga bw'obusika bwaffe mu Kristo - ebibala by'Omwoyo we. Mazima, “Eggulu waggulu lya bbululu erisembeza, ensi etwetoolodde nnamuddo asinga okuwoomerera. Waliwo ekiramu mu buli langi abalina amaaso agatalina Kristo bye batalabangako” (G Wade Robinson). Ago gaali biseera bwe twali twoleka obweesigwa bwaffe nga twambala 'obupeesa’ obw'oku kkooti. Obumu bwalanga okuwagira ekibiina ky'omupiira eky'ekitundu, obulala nga bulanga 'omuzannyi’ ow'ettutumu asembayo. Obwange bwagamba butereevu nti, “Elim Crusader.” Tebwali bunkubiriza nnyo, naye bwali bwa makulu nnyo.

Mu ttoggo eryaddirira, nnali nnyimiridde nga ntunuulira ekibiina kya kuliketi eky'essomero lyaffe nga kizannya n'omu ku bavuganya baabwe abasinga amaanyi - essomero lya girama ery'e Swansea. Abagenyi baali ku kukuba nga balafuubana n'abasuula baffe, nange nnali nneenyigidde nnyo mu muzannyo.

“Ndaba nga oli wa Elim Crusaders,” eddoboozi eryali okumpi bwe lyagamba. “Ndowooza omanyi Mukama.”

Ne nkyuka ne ndaba nti omuntu eyali ayogera nange yali muzannyi wa mu kibiina ekyali kizze okukyalira. Yalabika ng'omuzannyi omulungi mu ‘ngoye ze enjeru eza kuliketi,’ era omusseki gwe ogusikiriza gwayita obwannywani.

“Ye-e,” ne njogera nga nneesittala, kubanga nnali sinnaba kusisinkana muntu yenna eyali ayolesa okukkiriza kwe mu ngeri ya lwatu bwe kityo. “Yee, mmumanyi.”

Mu bwangu ne tutandika okutambulatambula okwetooloola ekisaawe kya kuliketi. Ne twemanyisa era ne twogera ku bwannywani bwaffe obuggya mu Kristo. Bwe twali twakatuuka ku mulyango oguyingira mu bisaawe by'essomero eby'okuzannyiramu, omusomesa wange ow'edda ow'Olulattini, omukozesa omukambwe eyali era ne selekta w'ekibiina kya kuliketi eky'abalenzi ab'amasomero g'e Wales, n'ayingira. Munnange omuggya yali alowoozebwako okuweebwa ekifo mu kibiina ky'e Wales, bw'atyo omusomesa wange yali amumanyi ddala. Nange nnali mmanyiddwa, si lwa bukugu bwange ku kisaawe kya kuliketi, wabula olw'obutamanya bwange mu kibiina ky'Olulattini! Yali amanyi era nti amannya gaffe ag'ekika gaali gamu - Evans.

“Otyanno, Don! Otyanno Gareth!” n'agamba, oluvannyuma n'ayongerako, “Mmwe mwembi muli baganda?”

Ekibuuzo ekyo kyawulikika nga kya busirusiru nnyo kubanga twali tuyawukanako obanga mayilo amakumi asatu, kyennava neewuunya okuwulira Don ng'addamu nti, “Yee ssebo! Baganda mu Mukama!”

Ogwo gwe gwali omulundi ogusooka okuwulira omuntu ng'ayogera ku kukkiriza kwe n'obuvumu, era nnakwatibwa ensonyi nnyo.

Ekintu ekisikiriza eky'okwongerako wano; oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi nnali njja kukyalira ekkanisa e Cardiff nga nkiikirira Anastasis. Eyo, omukadde w'ekkanisa eyo yamanya nti nnayigirizibwa mu Cowbridge Grammar School, n'ambuuza obanga nnamanya Sid Harris, omusomesa w'Olulattini. Ne ntegeera nti Sid yali yakafa, ng'amaze emyaka mingi ng'omukadde omwesigwa mu kkanisa eyo. Neebuuza, obanga obujulirwa bwa Don ku lunaku olwo bwaliko kye bwakola ku Sid oluvannyuma okufuuka omukkiriza?
fields.body_text: Okusinza kwali kuwedde mu kapella akatono, ne ekibinja ekitono eky'abavubuka ne kikuŋŋaana okwetooloola omubuulizi omuvubuka. Twali tugenze akawungeezi ako okumugumya kubanga yali muggya mu mulimu gw'okubuulira ng'omuntu obuntu atali musumba mulonde, omulimu ogw'omugaso ennyo eri obukapella obutono obungi obw'omu Wales. Obubaka bwe yawa bumaze ebbanga wewuunyiddwa, naye emboozi eyaddirira teerabiddwa. Twanyumya ku ssomero lyange, Cowbridge Grammar, gye yali ayizze emyaka ebiri emabega, oluvannyuma Aneurin n'abuuza ekibuuzo ekyakyusa obulamu bwange. “Mbuulira, Gareth,” n'agamba, “onookola ki ku Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo?” Wabuliddewo wiiki ttaano zokka nga sinnaba kuyingira mu maka ga Vince ne Betty Bishop. Baali bakuba enkuŋŋaana z'abavubuka, mwannyinaze Barbara ze yali agenda buli Lwakutaano akawungeezi. Eyo baali bayimba ennyimba enzijudde essanyu, ne bakuba ebibuuzo bya Baibuli, era oluusi baabanga n'omwogezi eyali akyalidde. Nnali ngenda mu Ssomero lya Ssande okutuusa maama we bwe yafa nga nnina emyaka kkumi n'ena, naye kaakano nnali sikyafaayo nnyo ku by'omwoyo. Wabula, Barbara bwe yanjita, ne nneesanga nga ntudde ku ntebe ennungi ey'oku nsonda mu kisenge eky'okusinzirako aba Bishop, era kyennina okukkiriza nti nnali neesanyusa. Ojja kutegeera nti ekyo kyali kyangu nnyo, kubanga nze nnali omulenzi omu yekka awamu n'abawala kkumi n'abataano! Nnalowooza nti ekyo kye kyaviirako Betty okunyita mu ffumbiro ku nkomerero y'akawungeezi ng'ebyokunywa ebinnyogovu ne kuki biteekebwateekebwa. Nga bwe kiri, yali asuubira nze okusitula essowaani enzito ey'ebyokunywa okugireeta munda. Saasuubira ky'oyo yayogera bwe yankyukira. “Mbuulira, Gareth,” n'agamba, “onookola ki ku Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo?” Mu kavuyo k'effumbiro eryo, okwewala ekibuuzo kyali kyangu, naye tekyayinzika kukiggya mu birowoozo byange okutuusa omubuulizi omuvubuka bwe yaddamu okunsomooza. Mu kiseera ekyo, nnali ntuuse okutegeera nti Obukristaayo tebulangirira kufa kwa Yesu ku musaalaba kwokka wabula n'okuzuukira kwe okuva mu bafu. Ne ntandika okulowooza nti obanga ddala azuukidde okuva mu bafu, mulamu; kale nga kisoboka okumumanya nga kennyini. Buli wiiki nnali nsobodde okwewala okubeera ne Betty nzekka, kubanga nnamanya nti yali ajja kuddamu okubuuza ekibuuzo kye nnali sirina kye nziramu, naye kaakano ekibuuzo ekyo kyali kintuuseeko. Abalala nga batambula ne Aneurin okutuuka ku sitegi ya bbaasi, nze ne nnyweza olusozi okwolekera eka. Bwe nnayingira mu kisenge kyange eky'okwebakiramu, ne nfukamira ku mabbali g'ekitanda ne nsaba okusaba okwangu. “Mukama Yesu, obanga oli wa mazima, nkusaba yingira mu bulamu bwange, ggyawo ekibi kyange onfuule owuwo.” Saamanya kirala kya kwogera, kyennava nneeyongera n'ebigambo by'oluyimba olwangu lwe nnali nnaakayiga. “Mu mutima gwange, mu mutima gwange, yingira mu mutima gwange, Mukama Yesu. Yingira leero, yingira obeere, yingira mu mutima gwange, Mukama Yesu. Amiina.” Saategeera nti nnali nnaakatandika olugendo olusanyusa olw'okukkiriza. Abamu bayinza okugamba nti kyali kya kubeerawo buulijjo nti Aneurin abuuze ekibuuzo kye kimu kye nnali nneewala, naye ntuuse okulaba ebyokulabirako bingi eby'engeri Katonda gy'atambuliramu mu bulamu bwange mu ngeri ez'‘okubeerawo buulijjo’ ezifaanana, ne kaakano mbitegeera ng'ensisinkano za Katonda; amayinja g'okulinnyako mu kutambula kwange okw'okukkiriza. Ekigendererwa kyange mu kitabo kino kwe kukwanyisa Katonda afaayo okukulembera buli omu ku ffe okutuuka mu kutambula okw'oluganda naye. Aggulawo enzigi era n'azissaawo; akulembera okuyita mu biwonvu ne waggulu ku nsozi; addira okumalwa essuubi kwaffe n'akufuula ensisinkano ze. “Katonda bw'ayagala okutendeka omuntu... n'okumusanyusa omuntu... n'okumuwa obukugu; Katonda bw'ayagala okubumba omuntu okukola omulimu ogusinga obukulu; bw'ayaayaanira n'omutima gwe gwonna okutonda omuntu omukulu era omuvumu ennyo ensi yonna gy'erisamaalirira, Tunuulira enkola ze! Tunuulira amakubo ge! Engeri gy'atuukirizaamu awatali kusaasira - abo b'alonda mu kitiibwa; engeri gy'amukubiramu ennyondo n'amulumya, n'okukuba okw'amaanyi n'amufuula ebitole by'ebbumba ebigezesebwa Katonda yekka by'ategeera! Ng'omutima gwe ogubonyaabonyezebwa gukaaba n'ayimusa emikono egyeegayirira! fields.title: Nnaakukulembera
fields.body_html:
Nnasanyukira olunaku olwo ne Don Evans, era emyezi egyaddirira nnamulowoozangako emirundi mingi, nga sirina n'akatono kye nnali mmanyi engeri amakubo gaffe gye gandiddemu okusisinkana.

Nneeyongera n'okusoma kwange mu kubala ne fizikisi, nga nsuubira okuyingira yunivasite mu mwaka ogwaddirira. Okuyingira yunivasite kyali kyetaagisa okulonda amasomero ga koleji ana, okugategeka nga bwe gaakusanyusanga, n'oweereza olukalala olwo eri ekitongole ekikulu. Olwo baalikutegeezezza omutindo gw'obuyivu bwe wandyetaaze okutuukako mu buli somo, buli somero ku ago ag'oku ddaala ery'awaggulu rybe lirinnyeko okukukkiriza ng'omuyizi. Birmingham kyali kitwalibwa ng'ekirina abasomesa abasinga obulungi mu kubala — ekitundu kye nnayivamu ennyo — kyekyo ne kikulembera ku lukalala lwange, nga kiddirirwa Cardiff, Swansea, ne Aberystwyth.

Essaawa nnyingi ez'okwesomesa n'amaanyi ze zaakulembera wiiki bbiri ez'entiisa ez'ebibuuzo eby'oku mutendera ogwa waggulu mu masomo gange asatu: okubala okutuufu (pure mathematics), okubala okukozesebwa (applied mathematics), ne fizikisi. Kyali n'essanyu lingi (era n'okwewuunya katono), bwe nnawulira nga wayiseewo wiiki nti mpisizza mu masomo gonna, era n'amapoyinti agamala okutuukiriza emitindo gyonna egyetaagisa. Okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo nnali sirina kubuusabuusa nti Birmingham ye kigendererwa kyange, naye kaakano ebirowoozo ebirala ne bitandika okuvaayo. Ekifo ekipya kyali kijja mu birowoozo. Birmingham yali “erimu amakolero mangi nnyo,” Cardiff yali “eri kumpi nnyo,” ne Swansea yali efuuka “esinga obulungi.”

Bwe ntyo ne mpandiikira omusumba w'Ekkanisa ya Elim mu Swansea nga mmusaba anyambe okunoonya we nnandisuze ng'omuyizi omuggya mu yunivasite. Nnalowooza mu bujjajja nti omusumba yalina obudde bw'okunoonya amayumba ag'okupangisa, bwe kityo nnali nkyali awatali ndagiriro ng'ebbaluwa etuuka, eyankanya ne nkola amangu.

“Tunakuwala okukutegeeza nti tetujja kusobola kukuweereza nsimbi za buyambi ku bisale by'okusoma, eby'ebitabo, n'eby'okusula mu mwaka ogujja, bw'onooba tosobola kutuwa ndagiriro yo mu Swansea. Ekiseera eky'enkomerero eky'okuwaayo amawulire ago kwe…” Olunaku lwali Lwakusatu olwaddirira, nga zisigadde ennaku ttaano!

Wadde nga Swansea yali mayilo 30 zokka okuva ewaffe, nnali ntuuseeyo omulundi gumu gwokka mu bulamu bwange, nga ndi ne kojjange ku kikya nga tugenze okulaba omuzannyo gwa cricket. Ku lunaku ebbaluwa lwe yatuuka nnali nkyali mu lugendo nate, nga nsuubira okuzuula Ekkanisa ya Elim n'omusumba waayo. Nnava mu bbaasi mu masekkati g'ekibuga ne nnyingira mu kayumba ka ssimu nga nsuubira okuzuula endagiriro n'ennamba ya ssimu ey'ofiisi y'Ekkanisa ya Elim. Newaakubadde nga nnanoonya bulungi mu makubo gonna agaali gasoboka, saazuula Kkanisa ya Elim yonna mu kitabo ky'endagiriro. Abawala babiri abato abaali bayimiridde ebweru w'akayumba baalaba okweraliikirira kwange ne banyisiza obuyambi bwabwe. Nnabuusabuusa nti bandinnyambye bwe nnabategeeza ekizibu kyange; wabula, mu ngeri ey'okwewuunya, tebaamanya bwokka we wali ennyumba y'omusumba n'ebbaasi gye nnandyetaaze okutwala okutuukayo, naye era baasobola n'okunzizaamu amaanyi, kubanga bombi baali bakkiriza! Nnajjukira nga Bayibuli bwe yayogera ku ky'okuyinza ‘okusembeza bamalayika nga tetumanyi.’

Omusumba bwe yategeera ekigendererwa ky'okukyala kwange, yasaba nnyo ekyejo kubanga yali yeerabidde okugoberera okusaba kwange. Ekikombe kya caayi tekyaakendeeza ku kweraliikirira kwe nnali ntandika okuwulira ng'anoonyaanoonya mu mmeeza ye ng'anoonya olukalala lw'abakyala abaali basobola okupangisa. Yali ateeseteese olukalala luno ebbaluwa yange bwe yatuuka wiiki ntono emabega, naye emirimu emingi egy'ofiisi y'obusumba ne gimwetooloola, n'okusaba kwange ne kumuvaako mu birowoozo. Oluvannyuma lw'edakiika ntono, ng'akutte olukalala mu mukono gwe, twayingira mu mmotoka ye ne tusimbula okugenda mu mayumba omunaana omwo mwe yalowooza nti nnandisobodde okusula. Bwe twali tuyita ku Singleton Park, yunivasite w'eri, amangu ago n'assa amabbulo n'akyuka mu kkubo akafunda akaliraanye paaka.

“Wano waliwo omukyala alina abaana abalongo aboobulenzi,” bwe yagamba. “Omu ku bo agenda mu Bible College, ne munne ajja kutandika yunivasite naawe. Erinnya lye teriri ku lukalala lwange, naye tusobola okutandikira okunoonya kwaffe nga tumubuuza, kubanga tuyita kumpi nnyo n'ennyumba ye.””

Ne ndowooza, “Nga kya busirusiru! Tewali maama anaakkiriza munnaggwanga kudda mu kifo ky'omu ku baana be abalongo!”

Nga nnaddiridde, nnatuula mu mmotoka omusumba ng'ayogera n'omukyala mu nnyumba. Bwe yakomawo teyalabika ng'alina ssuubi lingi. Nze nnawulira nga sirina ssuubi n'okusingawo.

“Yingira. Ayagala kukusisinkana,” bwe yagamba awatali ssanyu linene.

Nnayingira mu nnyumba ne mpuliriza ng'omukyala w'ennyumba ayogera okubuusabuusa kwe nti abaana be tebandikkirizza akkirize munnaggwanga okupangisa ekisenge kyabwe; wabula, yali agenda kubabuuza n'andaga. Mazima ddala, ekyo tekyali kya mugaso munene gye ndi kubanga nnali ntuuse ku lunaku olw'enkomerero olw'okumalirira ekifo kyange eky'okusula nga ndi ku yunivasite. Ng'addamu ekibuuzo ky'omusumba ku baana be gye baali, yagamba nti, “Russell ali ku yunivasite ne Don ali waggulu ku luguudo mu dduuka ery'omu kitundu.”

“Don?” ne ŋŋamba, ebirowoozo byange nga bidda emabega ku muzannyo gwa cricket ogwali gumaze ng'omwaka, “Ogambye Don? Ye yali kapiteeni w'ekibiina kya cricket ekya Swansea Grammar School omwaka oguwedde?”

“Yee!” bwe kwaddibwamu ng'omuntu gwe nnali mmanyi ayingira mu mulyango ogw'omu maaso. Ku lunaku olwo yali tayambadde ngoye nnjeru za cricket, naye ekyenyi kye kyalina akamwenyumwenyu akalungi ke kaakamu ke nnali njjukira.

“Maama, ono ye Gareth. Ye mulenzi gwe nnasisinkana e Cowbridge. Oyo gwe nnakubuulirako. Omukristaayo omuggya!”

Nnamugamba nti nnali nnoonya we nnandisuze mu kiseera kyange e Swansea University, era n'anywegera n'agamba n'obunyiikivu nti, “Maama, asobola okutwala ekisenge kyange!”

Okuyita ku kibegabega kya Don, nnalaba maama we ng'angololera emikono gye, ng'annyaniriza mu maka ago ag'ekitalo. Nnali nzuuze amaka amaggya n'ab'omu maka abaali bagenda okumbeera ab'oku lusegere nga bwe bandibadde ab'oluganda lwennyini.

Ne ntandika okwebuuza nti, “Katonda yali ku muzannyo ogwo ogwa cricket? Yali dda ateekateeka ekifo kino eky'okusula?”

Nkakasa nti yali waali! Nga bwe nnali nteekateeka okuyingira Birmingham University, Ye yali antegekera awaka e Swansea, era kaakano yali ankulembedde okuntuusa ku muntu omu yekka gwe nnali mmanyi mu kibuga ekyo kyonna — ekibuga eky'abantu abasukka mu 100,000!

Okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo nnali sirina kubuusabuusa nti Birmingham ye kigendererwa kyange, naye kaakano ebirowoozo ebirala ne bitandika okuvaayo. Ekifo ekipya kyali kijja mu birowoozo. Birmingham yali “erimu amakolero mangi nnyo,” Cardiff yali “eri kumpi nnyo,” ne Swansea yali efuuka “esinga obulungi.” Bwe ntyo ne mpandiikira omusumba w'Ekkanisa ya Elim mu Swansea nga mmusaba anyambe okunoonya we nnandisuze ng'omuyizi omuggya mu yunivasite. Nnalowooza mu bujjajja nti omusumba yalina obudde bw'okunoonya amayumba ag'okupangisa, bwe kityo nnali nkyali awatali ndagiriro ng'ebbaluwa etuuka, eyankanya ne nkola amangu. “Tunakuwala okukutegeeza nti tetujja kusobola kukuweereza nsimbi za buyambi ku bisale by'okusoma, eby'ebitabo, n'eby'okusula mu mwaka ogujja, bw'onooba tosobola kutuwa ndagiriro yo mu Swansea. Ekiseera eky'enkomerero eky'okuwaayo amawulire ago kwe…” Olunaku lwali Lwakusatu olwaddirira, nga zisigadde ennaku ttaano! Wadde nga Swansea yali mayilo 30 zokka okuva ewaffe, nnali ntuuseeyo omulundi gumu gwokka mu bulamu bwange, nga ndi ne kojjange ku kikya nga tugenze okulaba omuzannyo gwa cricket. Ku lunaku ebbaluwa lwe yatuuka nnali nkyali mu lugendo nate, nga nsuubira okuzuula Ekkanisa ya Elim n'omusumba waayo. Nnava mu bbaasi mu masekkati g'ekibuga ne nnyingira mu kayumba ka ssimu nga nsuubira okuzuula endagiriro n'ennamba ya ssimu ey'ofiisi y'Ekkanisa ya Elim. Newaakubadde nga nnanoonya bulungi mu makubo gonna agaali gasoboka, saazuula Kkanisa ya Elim yonna mu kitabo ky'endagiriro. Abawala babiri abato abaali bayimiridde ebweru w'akayumba baalaba okweraliikirira kwange ne banyisiza obuyambi bwabwe. Nnabuusabuusa nti bandinnyambye bwe nnabategeeza ekizibu kyange; wabula, mu ngeri ey'okwewuunya, tebaamanya bwokka we wali ennyumba y'omusumba n'ebbaasi gye nnandyetaaze okutwala okutuukayo, naye era baasobola n'okunzizaamu amaanyi, kubanga bombi baali bakkiriza! Nnajjukira nga Bayibuli bwe yayogera ku ky'okuyinza ‘okusembeza bamalayika nga tetumanyi.’ Omusumba bwe yategeera ekigendererwa ky'okukyala kwange, yasaba nnyo ekyejo kubanga yali yeerabidde okugoberera okusaba kwange. Ekikombe kya caayi tekyaakendeeza ku kweraliikirira kwe nnali ntandika okuwulira ng'anoonyaanoonya mu mmeeza ye ng'anoonya olukalala lw'abakyala abaali basobola okupangisa. Yali ateeseteese olukalala luno ebbaluwa yange bwe yatuuka wiiki ntono emabega, naye emirimu emingi egy'ofiisi y'obusumba ne gimwetooloola, n'okusaba kwange ne kumuvaako mu birowoozo. Oluvannyuma lw'edakiika ntono, ng'akutte olukalala mu mukono gwe, twayingira mu mmotoka ye ne tusimbula okugenda mu mayumba omunaana omwo mwe yalowooza nti nnandisobodde okusula. Bwe twali tuyita ku Singleton Park, yunivasite w'eri, amangu ago n'assa amabbulo n'akyuka mu kkubo akafunda akaliraanye paaka. “Wano waliwo omukyala alina abaana abalongo aboobulenzi,” bwe yagamba. “Omu ku bo agenda mu Bible College, ne munne ajja kutandika yunivasite naawe. Erinnya lye teriri ku lukalala lwange, naye tusobola okutandikira okunoonya kwaffe nga tumubuuza, kubanga tuyita kumpi nnyo n'ennyumba ye.”” Ne ndowooza, “Nga kya busirusiru! Tewali maama anaakkiriza munnaggwanga kudda mu kifo ky'omu ku baana be abalongo!” Nga nnaddiridde, nnatuula mu mmotoka omusumba ng'ayogera n'omukyala mu nnyumba. Bwe yakomawo teyalabika ng'alina ssuubi lingi. Nze nnawulira nga sirina ssuubi n'okusingawo. “Yingira. Ayagala kukusisinkana,” bwe yagamba awatali ssanyu linene. Nnayingira mu nnyumba ne mpuliriza ng'omukyala w'ennyumba ayogera okubuusabuusa kwe nti abaana be tebandikkirizza akkirize munnaggwanga okupangisa ekisenge kyabwe; wabula, yali agenda kubabuuza n'andaga. Mazima ddala, ekyo tekyali kya mugaso munene gye ndi kubanga nnali ntuuse ku lunaku olw'enkomerero olw'okumalirira ekifo kyange eky'okusula nga ndi ku yunivasite. Ng'addamu ekibuuzo ky'omusumba ku baana be gye baali, yagamba nti, “Russell ali ku yunivasite ne Don ali waggulu ku luguudo mu dduuka ery'omu kitundu.” “Don?” ne ŋŋamba, ebirowoozo byange nga bidda emabega ku muzannyo gwa cricket ogwali gumaze ng'omwaka, “Ogambye Don? Ye yali kapiteeni w'ekibiina kya cricket ekya Swansea Grammar School omwaka oguwedde?” “Yee!” bwe kwaddibwamu ng'omuntu gwe nnali mmanyi ayingira mu mulyango ogw'omu maaso. Ku lunaku olwo yali tayambadde ngoye nnjeru za cricket, naye ekyenyi kye kyalina akamwenyumwenyu akalungi ke kaakamu ke nnali njjukira. “Maama, ono ye Gareth. Ye mulenzi gwe nnasisinkana e Cowbridge. Oyo gwe nnakubuulirako. Omukristaayo omuggya!” Nnamugamba nti nnali nnoonya we nnandisuze mu kiseera kyange e Swansea University, era n'anywegera n'agamba n'obunyiikivu nti, “Maama, asobola okutwala ekisenge kyange!” Okuyita ku kibegabega kya Don, nnalaba maama we ng'angololera emikono gye, ng'annyaniriza mu maka ago ag'ekitalo. Nnali nzuuze amaka amaggya n'ab'omu maka abaali bagenda okumbeera ab'oku lusegere nga bwe bandibadde ab'oluganda lwennyini. Ne ntandika okwebuuza nti, “Katonda yali ku muzannyo ogwo ogwa cricket? Yali dda ateekateeka ekifo kino eky'okusula?” Nkakasa nti yali waali! Nga bwe nnali nteekateeka okuyingira Birmingham University, Ye yali antegekera awaka e Swansea, era kaakano yali ankulembedde okuntuusa ku muntu omu yekka gwe nnali mmanyi mu kibuga ekyo kyonna — ekibuga eky'abantu abasukka mu 100,000!

fields.title: Genda, Omuvubuka!
fields.body_html:
Emyaka ena gye nnamala mu kifo ekirungi ennyo ekya yunivasite mu Brynmill, Swansea gyalimu emiganyulo mingi. Wadde nga nnayingira yunivasite okusoma ebya kubala (mathematics), mu mwaka gwange ogwokubiri nnakyusa ne ndaga mu kitongole ekya fizikisi, kubanga nnakiraba nga kimpisaamu okwagala okugenda kweyongera. (Bwe ndaba emabega, kino nakyo kiyinza okulabibwa ng’okuluŋŋamya kwa Mukama.) Ku lubereberye nnali nteekedde okugenda e Birmingham kubanga yunivasite eyo yali emanyiddwa olw’ekitongole kyayo ekya kubala. Kaakano nnali nsoma fizikisi e Swansea, essomero eryamanyibwa olw’ekitongole kyalyo ekya fizikisi! Nnafuna diguli ennungi mu fizikisi okusinga bonna bwe baali basuubira, ne mu mwaka gwange ogwasembayo, nnafuna dipoloma mu by’okuyigiriza. Bwe nnava mu yunivasite nnatandika omulimu gwange ogwasooka nga nnyigiriza fizikisi era nga Omukulu w’Ekitongole mu ssomero ery’amaddembe eppya.

Amaka g’ab’e Evans gaafuuka ekifo eky’enjawulo we nnayisibwanga ng’omu ku b’omu maka; ddala, ne leero luno bakyali ba luganda gye ndi. Twagenda mu kkanisa y’emu, era nnegatta ku Swansea Gospel Male Voice Choir, Mary Evans gwe yali omukubi wa piyano ate nga Aubrey Evans ye musuubuzi w’ebitabo. Mary yakakasanga nti ndya bulungi ennyo ate omwami we, Aubrey, wadde nga yali muntu atasoma, yampa amagezi mangi ag’omuwendo agansigadde okumala emyaka gyonna.

Lumu, bwe nnali nnyiize katono olw’obutaba na kunyiikira mu bavubuka b’ekkanisa, yanzimusa ku bbali, n’aŋŋamba nti, “Jjukira mwana wange, nti abo abagoberera nga bali ewala, bakyasobola okulaba Mukama, naye abo abakulembera Omusana gw’ensi ekigere kimu, tebakyamulaba. Beesanga nga batambulira mu kisiikirize kyabwe bo.”

Russell yasoma ebikwata ku byuma (metallurgy) mu yunivasite era oluvannyuma n’afuuka omusomesa omukulu mu kitongole ekyo kimu. Yali muyizi mulungi, era yannyamba nnyo bwe nnali nnyigganya mu masomo gange ag’ekitiibwa mu fizikisi ey’obwomunyeeko (nuclear physics).

Don Evans yagenda mu Ssomero lya Baibuli, n’aluŋŋamya ekkanisa okumala emyaka mitono, oluvannyuma n’ayingira Swansea University College okusoma Filosofiya. Kaakano abeera mu Dunedin, New Zealand ng’omusomesa omukulu eyo, era omu ku bayivu abakulembera mu nsi yonna mu by’Empisa mu by’Obujjanjabi (Medical Ethics). Atambudde mu bifo bingi, mu bitundu eby’obuyivu ne ng’omwogezi mu kibiina eky’okuzzibwa obuggya kwa Mwoyo (charismatic renewal movement).

Mu myaka egyo egy’ekitalo mu Swansea mwe nnasisinkanira Anne, munnamawulire eyali agenda mu kkanisa y’emu naffe. Kitaawe yali Munnorway era yali abadde omuweereza omwesigwa ow’Enjiri wadde nga obulamu bwe bwali bunafu okumala emyaka mingi. Yampa okutegeera kungi ku bintu eby’obuziba ebya Katonda, era nkyakuuma n’obwegendereza ebitabo eby’okusinza bye yampa. Maama we yali akuzibbwa mu kkanisa Evan Roberts mwe yali omukulembeze w’abavubuka mu kiseera eky’okubalukuka kw’okuzuukuka kwa Wales mu 1904.

Yamanya bangi ku ‘batukuvu’ ab’omu kiseera ekyo era oluvannyuma yali omu ku “Rees Howells’ Prayer Band.” N’obusika obutya Katonda obwenkana awo, si kya kwewuunya nti Anne alaze empisa za Kikristaayo enzikkirivu ze nnayiga okusiima mu ye.

Twayogeraganya ku lunaku lwe nnaggukira (graduation) era ne tuwasa ng’emyaka gumu giweddeko, dipoloma yange ey’okuyigiriza nga nnagimaliriza. Twagenda mu maka gaffe agaasooka mu budde nga nga tetunnatandika kuyigiriza kwange ku Cynffig Comprehensive School. Sitegeera bwe nnafuna ekifo ekyo – kyateekwa okuba nga gwe mulimu Mukama gwe yateekateeka, kubanga gwali mukisa gwe siimirira n’akatono.

Omu ku basomesa bange yansemberera mu yunivasite lumu ng’ambuuza oba nnali mmaze okufuna omulimu. Nnaddamu nti nedda, naye awatali kweraliikirira, kubanga waaliwo ekiseera nga yunivasite tennaggwa. N’ansuubiza nti mpandiike ku ndagiriro, gye yali anwandiikidde, era mbuuze ku mirimu gyonna egiriwo. Nga wayiseewo akaseera katono, nnayitibwa ku kwebuuza olw’ekifo e Cynffig. Nga bwe nsobola okutegeera, nze nnokka nnabuuzibwa era oluvannyuma nnaweebwa omulimu ogw’okuyigiriza fizikisi okutuuka ku ddaala ery’engulu ennyo.

Mu mwaka gwange ogwokusatu mu ssomero eryo eryasooka, nnayitibwa okuyigiriza n’Amagye g’Abangereza mu Bugirimaani. Amagye g’Abangereza aga Rhine (British Army of the Rhine) gaalina amasomero mangi abaana b’abaserikale mwe baayigirizibwanga era nnali nnyigirize ku Windsor Boys School, eryali, ng’essomero lyalyo ery’abawala bwe lyali, amaka g’abayizi ab’amasomero ag’okugendako abasukka mu 500.

Nnali musomesa asinga obuto eyali akozeddwa Ekitongole ky’Eby’okwerinda (Ministry of Defense) mu kiseera ekyo, nga sikoze “National Service,” wadde emyaka etaano egy’obumanyirivu mu kuyigiriza egyali gyetaagisa.

Nnali sitegedde bisaanyizo ebyo bwe nnasooka, n’obwegendereza, okusaba okuyigiriza n’aba B.O.A.R. bwe kityo nnali nnyiize katono bwe nnafuna okugaanibwa kwabwe okwasooka. Nnali nvuddeko ku ndowooza yonna ey’omulimu ogw’okuyigiriza ogufaanana ng’ogwo, naye, nga wayiseewo emyezi mitono, ebbaluwa endala n’etuuka nga eŋŋamba nti waaliwo ekifo eky’okuyigiriza mu Hamm, mu West Germany. Kirabika, omusomesa wa fizikisi mu ssomero eryo yali agulumizibbwa ne mu kifo ky’Omumyuka w’Omukulu w’Essomero, era nze mmwokka nnali musomesa wa fizikisi eyalina ebisaanyizo ebituufu bye baali balina ku bitabo byabwe. Katonda ayinza n’okusukka amateeka g’amagye!

Egyo gyali myaka mirungi eri Anne nange. Katonda yali atuwadde omukisa dda ne tufuna omuwala omu Corinne, eyazaalibwa mu Wales, ne kaakano n’atuwa abalala babiri: Andrea ne Lynette okumaliriza amaka gaffe. Twafuna mikwano mingi Abadaaki era ne twesiima okubeera awamu n’obuwangwa obw’enjawulo.

Ku Ssande, twagendanga ku kifo ekya magye ag’Abakanada ekiriraanye Amagye g’Obulokozi (Salvation Army) gye baakubiriranga okusinza okw’akawungeezi. Bwe twali tussa ekimu awamu, omutima gwange gwabuguma eri abantu bano ab’ekisa abaava mu nsi ya Bindugwa (Indians) n’Abainuit, ‘Mounties’ n’abayizzi, obadaadaa n’empungu, ne pizza ne salmon. Bwe kityo, nga bakubiriza, ne tutandika okunoonyereza ku bwe kisoboka okuyigiriza mu Canada.

Amangu ago nnafuna ebbaluwa nga engamba nti nkkiriziddwa okuyigiriza fizikisi ku ssomero ery’ebyekikugu erimanyiddwa mu Toronto, Canada. Nnali nteekwa okubaweereza ekoppi z’ebiwandiiko bya diguli ne dipoloma zange okukakasa ebisaanyizo byange, era baali ba kuntegeeza ku nteekateeka z’olugendo lw’ennyonyi mu nsi enkulu ey’obukiikakkono.

Ebiwandiiko byaffe byaweerezebwa e Bloor Street, Toronto, era mangu ago okuddamu ne kuntegeeza nti kirabika nnali nsaanira “Type-A Specialist Diploma.” Okwekebejjebwa okw’eddagala ok w’obwegendereza kwaddirira, viza ne zifunibwa, okuwummula kwange ne kuweebwa mu ssomero, era ne tulinda… Ebbaluwa ey’okubiri teyali nnungi bwe ityo! Ensobi yali ekoleddwa! Omukulu w’Eby’enjigiriza ow’omu kitundu yali alonze omusomesa okujjuza ekifo kyange nga tamanyi nti Omukulu w’Ekibiina eky’Amasomero yali amaze okunkkiriza! Basomesa basatu baali balondeddwa okujjuza ebifo bibiri, era olw’okuba nga nnava ebweru w’eggwanga, nze nnali eyeeteekwa okuswazibwa.

Ensonyi zaali nnyingi bwe twabuulira mikwano gyaffe amawulire agasembyeyo. Twali tuwadde obujulizi obw’ekitalo ku bulungi bwa Katonda gye tuli ne kaakano ne kirabika nga bigambo bya bwereere bwokka. Twali tetulina mulimu gw’omwaka omuggya ogw’essomero era twali tuteekwa okuddayo e Wales okunoonya omulimu gulala okumala waakiri ekiseera kimu. Okusaba kwaffe kwali kujjudde okwebuuza, nga tetutegeera nti Mukama yamanya bulungi ky’akola!

Nga wayiseewo ennaku ssatu ebbaluwa endala n’etuuka. Eno yali eva mu Magye g’Abangereza nga gagamba bwe genakulwa olw’okuwummula kwange era nga gankubiriza okuddamu okulowooza. Baawandiika nti, “Tulina ekifo ekirala ekiriwo eky’omusomesa wa fizikisi mu Hong Kong. Osaba olowoozeeko ku kifo ekyo era otutegeeze ku kisalawo kyo mangu bw’osoboka?”

Olw’okuba nga mikwano gyaffe egy’oku lusegere nabo baali bagenda e Hong Kong, okusalawo kwali kwangu okukola. Twali tugenda okuzuula nate nti Mukama yali atukulembeddemu ebigere bitono.

Katonda ayinza n’okusukka amateeka g’amagye! Egyo gyali myaka mirungi eri Anne nange. Katonda yali atuwadde omukisa dda ne tufuna omuwala omu Corinne, eyazaalibwa mu Wales, ne kaakano n’atuwa abalala babiri: Andrea ne Lynette okumaliriza amaka gaffe. Twafuna mikwano mingi Abadaaki era ne twesiima okubeera awamu n’obuwangwa obw’enjawulo. Ku Ssande, twagendanga ku kifo ekya magye ag’Abakanada ekiriraanye Amagye g’Obulokozi (Salvation Army) gye baakubiriranga okusinza okw’akawungeezi. Bwe twali tussa ekimu awamu, omutima gwange gwabuguma eri abantu bano ab’ekisa abaava mu nsi ya Bindugwa (Indians) n’Abainuit, ‘Mounties’ n’abayizzi, obadaadaa n’empungu, ne pizza ne salmon. Bwe kityo, nga bakubiriza, ne tutandika okunoonyereza ku bwe kisoboka okuyigiriza mu Canada. Amangu ago nnafuna ebbaluwa nga engamba nti nkkiriziddwa okuyigiriza fizikisi ku ssomero ery’ebyekikugu erimanyiddwa mu Toronto, Canada. Nnali nteekwa okubaweereza ekoppi z’ebiwandiiko bya diguli ne dipoloma zange okukakasa ebisaanyizo byange, era baali ba kuntegeeza ku nteekateeka z’olugendo lw’ennyonyi mu nsi enkulu ey’obukiikakkono. Ebiwandiiko byaffe byaweerezebwa e Bloor Street, Toronto, era mangu ago okuddamu ne kuntegeeza nti kirabika nnali nsaanira “Type-A Specialist Diploma.” Okwekebejjebwa okw’eddagala ok w’obwegendereza kwaddirira, viza ne zifunibwa, okuwummula kwange ne kuweebwa mu ssomero, era ne tulinda… Ebbaluwa ey’okubiri teyali nnungi bwe ityo! Ensobi yali ekoleddwa! Omukulu w’Eby’enjigiriza ow’omu kitundu yali alonze omusomesa okujjuza ekifo kyange nga tamanyi nti Omukulu w’Ekibiina eky’Amasomero yali amaze okunkkiriza! Basomesa basatu baali balondeddwa okujjuza ebifo bibiri, era olw’okuba nga nnava ebweru w’eggwanga, nze nnali eyeeteekwa okuswazibwa. Ensonyi zaali nnyingi bwe twabuulira mikwano gyaffe amawulire agasembyeyo. Twali tuwadde obujulizi obw’ekitalo ku bulungi bwa Katonda gye tuli ne kaakano ne kirabika nga bigambo bya bwereere bwokka. Twali tetulina mulimu gw’omwaka omuggya ogw’essomero era twali tuteekwa okuddayo e Wales okunoonya omulimu gulala okumala waakiri ekiseera kimu. Okusaba kwaffe kwali kujjudde okwebuuza, nga tetutegeera nti Mukama yamanya bulungi ky’akola! Nga wayiseewo ennaku ssatu ebbaluwa endala n’etuuka. Eno yali eva mu Magye g’Abangereza nga gagamba bwe genakulwa olw’okuwummula kwange era nga gankubiriza okuddamu okulowooza. Baawandiika nti, “Tulina ekifo ekirala ekiriwo eky’omusomesa wa fizikisi mu Hong Kong. Osaba olowoozeeko ku kifo ekyo era otutegeeze ku kisalawo kyo mangu bw’osoboka?” Olw’okuba nga mikwano gyaffe egy’oku lusegere nabo baali bagenda e Hong Kong, okusalawo kwali kwangu okukola. Twali tugenda okuzuula nate nti Mukama yali atukulembeddemu ebigere bitono.

fields.title: Oluulu lw’Ebuvanjuba
fields.body_html:
Hong Kong, “Oluulu lw’Ebuvanjuba,” yatuukiriza erinnya lyayo. Okuva ku kaseera we twatuukira ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ekya KaiTak, twagwa mu kwagala olw’amabala gaayo, akawoowo kaayo, oluyoogaano lwayo, n’abantu baayo. Anne yagulira mu butale bw’oku nguudo, emirundi mingi ekiro, nga takyawulira kutya, ate nze ne nsanyukira ebifo byayo eby’emizannyo nga nzannya tennis emirundi ebiri buli wiiki era nga nwuga mu Forces Club.

Mu bwangu ne tweraba nga twenyigidde mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’ekitundu ekyo. Nnafuna omukisa ogw’omukwano ne Jackie Pullinger mu kiseera lwe yali yaakatandika omulimu ogwaleeta enkyukakyuka ennene mu baddu b’ebiragalalagala ab’e Hong Kong. Yali naye lwe nnayingira mu ‘kibuga ekiriko bbugwe’ ekya Kowloon, ne mpalana n’essomo lya Bayibuli mu ‘mpuku y’ejjoka.’

Buli mwezi, Anne nange twatambulanga olugendo oluwanvu okuyita mu byalo okutuuka mu ka y’abaana abamulekwa, gye twabuuliranga emboozi ezikwata ku Yesu, oluvannyuma ne tulya supu y’ekigere ky’enkoko n’omuceere omufumbe. Nnayimbanga mu kwaya ey’Abachina, era ne nguma okuyimba nzekka ebitundu ebimu mu luyimba lwa Pasika… mu Lucantonese!

John Bechtel yali muminsani mu Hong Kong okuva ng’Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olwokubiri terunnaba na kutandika. Yali atandiseewo ofiisi y’okukuba ebitabo era nga yali aliisizza Ekkanisa ya Waterloo Road Alliance. Kaakati yali awummudde, ne mutabani we John Jr. nga y’alabirira omulimu awamu n’amasomero agawerako agaali ku busolya bw’ennyumba.

Bechtel omukulu yali tannawummula ku kuweereza Mukama, kubanga buli wiiki ekisenge kye eky’okusembeza kyasembezanga okutuuka ku basirikale b’e Bungereza 30 olw’okusoma Bayibuli. Mu bano mwabangamu abasirikale b’e Nepal nga kkumi na babiri oba okusingako - Gurkhas - abaamanyibwanga olw’obuvumu bwabwe, era abaassibwanga nnyo ekitiibwa bannaabwe. Kyali mukisa gwange buli wiiki okuyigiriza essomo lino, oluusi nga nkyukira ne mukyala omukadde omwagalwa eyali aweerezza Mukama mu China nga Abajapani tebannalumba.

Saategeera nti okubeera mu Hong Kong, n’okuba omu ku b’ekibiina kino eky’okusoma Bayibuli, kyandireese enkyukakyuka enkulu ennyo ku bulamu bwaffe obw’omu maaso - nga eno yali endala ku nteekateeka za Katonda eziva mu ggulu!

Mu kiseera kino, twaddamu okusaba viza okuyingira Canada, wadde ng’emirimu gy’okusomesa gyali tekikyalangirirwa bweru w’eggwanga. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, nnafuna ebbaluwa okuva eri Omukulu w’Amasomero mu San Francisco. Omwana wa muganda we yali akyalidde mu maka gaffe mu Hong Kong nga ali ku kiwummulo okuva ku lutalo mu Vietnam, era bwe yadda ewuwe, n’asaba kojja we okunnyita nsomese mu California. Yawandiika nti singa tuutuuka mu San Francisco, yandifubye kyonna okunfunira omulimu.

N’olwekyo, mu biseera by’ebbugumu mu 1969, twali twetegese bulungi okubuuka okutuuka ku lubalama olw’ebugwanjuba obw’Amerika, naye enkyukakyuka mu nteekateeka za gavumenti mu bifo eby’obuyinza e Westminster ne bikyusa ebyo byonna. Yali nteekateeka nti abasirikale bonna ab’e Bungereza basobola okusasulirwa ensimbi zonna ez’okwenoonyeza ekkubo lyabwe eddayo ‘ewaabwe’ okuva mu ggwanga ery’amawanga lyonna, ekitegeeza nti twali tusobola okutambula okutuuka wonna ne tusasulirwa Obwakabaka Obugatte.

Mu ngeri eno, ensimbi zaffe zonna ez’okutuuka mu San Francisco oba Canada zaali zijja kusasulwa. Mu Maayi 1969, olw’ensaasaanya y’eby’obuserikale okweyongera, enteekateeka yakyusibwa ne kiba nti abantu bonna baali basaana okuzzibwa mu maka gaabwe nga bayita mu nnyonyi z’eby’obuserikale, awatali kusasulwa nsimbi. Olw’okuba twali tetulina nsimbi za kutambula lugendo lwa kugezaako okulaga California oba Canada ey’ebugwanjuba, nga tetulina mulimu gwa kakasa, enteekateeka zaffe ne ziyimirira nate. Oluggi olulala ne luggalwa! Obunnyiike obulala!

Mu bwangu ne nsaba emirimu gy’okusomesa mu Bungereza, nga mmanyi nti singa mfuna obukakafu obw’‘okugaanibwa’ emirundi esatu, Eggye ery’e Bungereza lyandinsasudde omusaala gwange olw’ekiseera ky’ekyanda kimu (okutuuka ku mwaka omuggya). Okugaanibwa ne kujja, ne tuddayo mu Wales eri ab’eŋŋanda zaffe.

Ekyanda ky’essomero ekiggya bwe kyatandika, twali tusula mu maka ga bazadde ba Anne, ng’ennyumba yaffe eyaffe eri mu kuvaamu abapangisa abaali basuddemu bwe twali tuli emitala w’amayanja.

Bwe twali tugezaako okufunira bawala baffe amasomero mwe banaayiga, omukyala eyali mu ofiisi z’Akakiiko k’Ebyenjigiriza aka Glamorgan yaddamu ebibuuzo byange mu ngeri ennyangu.

“Yee, kijja kuba kirungi bawala bo okusigala nga tebali ku ssomero okumala wiiki bbiri ezinaamalibwa okudda mu maka gammwe.”

“Nedda, tekyetaagisa kubawandiisa eyo ne kiryoka kibalagira okuwalulwa nga wiiki bbiri ziyiseewo.”

Nnali nnaatera okuwanika essimu, n’ampuuza ekibuuzo ekyewuunyisa, “Onsonyiwe, ssebo. Kiyinzika okuba nti erinnya lyo ye Mr. Evans, Gareth Evans eyava e Hong Kong?”

Bwe namuddamu, nga nkyewuunya engeri gye yali amanyiddemu erinnya lyange, n’aŋŋamba nti singa ŋŋenda ku Ogmore Grammar School, waaliwo omulimu ogwali gunnindiridde.

Ogmore Grammar kyali ssomero ekyassibwamu nnyo ekitiibwa, nga kiri ku ntikko y’ekimu ku biwonvu ebyava mu maka gaffe nga bidda mu bukiikakkono. Omwana waakyo eyamanyibwa ennyo yali Lynn “The Leap” Davies. Oyo eyali akwatidde omupiira gw’ensi yonna ogw’okubuuka okuwanvu, okutuusa Bob Beamer lwe yamenya ompiigano gwe mu mizannyo gya Olimpiki egy’e Mexico City egya 1968. Enguudo z’abatambuze mu Nantymoel, akyalo ka Lynn, zaali zisiigiddwa amabala ag’enjawulo, nga buli limu lipima obuwanvu obutuufu obw’okubuuka kwe okwawangula.

Kyandintwalidde ddakiika 15 zokka okuvuga okutuuka eyo buli lunaku, nga tumaze okudda ‘ewaffe’ mu kayumba akatono akaali ke twagula nga twaakamala embaga yaffe ey’obugole.

Bwe nnasisinkana omukulu w’essomero ku lunaku lwange olw’olubereberye, ne mubuuza akaseera meka ky’ayagala nsomeseeko eyo, kubanga nnali nkakasibbwa omusaala gw’emyezi ena awatali mulimu! Nnabuuza oba omusomesa eyaliwo yali mulwadde oba nga yali mu kiwummulo olw’ensonga endala, kubanga nnali nsabye omulimu guno nga ndi mu Hong Kong ne ndowooza nti gwali gujjuziddwa kubanga nnali sifunye ku ddamu. Yaŋŋamba nti Akakiiko k’Abakulembeze kaali kaagala okunnonda, naye ne katasobola kubanga kaali kalina enteekateeka etakkiriza kulonda muntu ava mu mawanga amalala. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, baali bagambye abasaba abalala bonna nti omulimu gwali gujjuziddwa, era nga basuubira nti mu ngeri emu nnandibatuukiridde nga nzeeddeyo mu Wales – nga bwe nnali nkoze!

fields.title: Emirimu Mingi! Mingi! Mingi!
fields.body_html:
Amangu ago, ebirowoozo byonna ebikwata ku Canada byatuvaako, bwe nnatandika omulimu gwange omupya nga Omukulu w’Ekitongole ky’Ebyafisiki. Nnali era mpandiika olupapula lw’amawulire olw’essomero, nga nkulira ekibiina ky’Abakristaayo, era nga nkulembera enkuŋŋaana z’essomero. Nnatandika akabinja k’obwesige ak’abavubuka mu maka gaffe, ne ndaba Katonda ng’akakuza ne kafuuka omulimu munene ogwabuna amakanisa musanvu era nga gwetooloola ekitundu kinene okumpi n’ekibuga kyaffe. Nnakola olupapula lw’amawulire olw’abavubuka olwayunga emirimu gy’abavubuka egy’omu kitundu, era ne nkola akakuŋŋaaniro k’abayimbi amakumi ataano abaayimbanga ennyimba za Pasika ne Ssekukkulu mu mbuga, mu makanisa amatono, ne mu makomera. Twakolanga ensiisira mu biseera by’ekyeya n’emikolo gy’abavubuka egy’ekiro ku nkomerero za wiiki.

Olumu akawungeezi nnafuna essimu okuva mu YMCA ey’omu kitundu, ekibiina eky’emizannyo ekinene era eky’amaanyi; eyampita yaŋŋamba nti baali banoonya abavubuka abaggya ku Poddo yaabwe (Board), n’abuuza obanga nnandibadde weetegese, kubanga nnali mpitiddwa olw’omulimu gwange mu bavubuka b’omu kitundu. Nnaddamu nti nnandikkirizza, era nga wayiseewo akaseera katono ne nzija mu Lukiiko lwange olusooka olwa Poddo, gye nnayanirizibwa nnyo. Bwe nnali nga ntudde awo, nnamagamaga mu bifo bino ebigazi ebitaakozesebwanga ku Ssande (nga bino biseera emizannyo gy’oku Ssande nga tegunnatandika). Nnabuuza nti okuwola ebifo bino kyandintwaliddeko ssente meka.

Baŋŋamba nti, “Tewali kya kusasula! Kaakano oli mumemba wa Poddo, noolwekyo olina obuyinza okuweebwa ekisumuluzo. Bugambe omuwandiisi nti oyagala kimu era ky’okyagalira, era tewaabeewo buzibu bwonna.”

Bwe kityo, ku makungeezi ga Ssande nnalina obuyinza obwa bwereere okuyingira mu YMCA ey’omu kitundu, ne mu wooteeri yaayo entono ne mu kizimbe eky’okuwummulirangamu, era nga wayiseewo akaseera katono, abavubuka bangi okuva mu makanisa ag’omu kitundu ne bajjanga ku kukuŋŋaana okw’essaawa bbiri ez’akawungeezi. Ago gaali nnaku za njawulo ez’omukisa gwa Mukama, bangi gye bajjira eri Mukama. Abakadde b’ekkanisa yange baampa obuyinza obujjuvu okukulembera omulimu gw’abavubuka n’abavubuka abaakula ogw’ekkanisa, era amakanisa amalala mangi ne gandaba ng’omukozi waago ow’abavubuka. Mu mazima nnali musumba-mulabirizi w’abavubuka, nga nnina abantu bangi abalungi abaakoleranga wamu nange nga tuddukanya ensiisira, okwokya ennyama, okubuulira, entegeka za YMCA, n’ebirala bingi! Okuyita mu buweereza buno, bangi baali bakulemberwa eri Mukama!

Nnali nnina emirimu mingi, mingi, mingi! Mazima ddala: emirimu mingi ennyo!

Nnali ntandika okudduka nga nkulembera Ekitangaala!

Ku nkomerero, embiro zange ezitali za mirembe ne zinsanga, ne ntandika ekiseera ekiwanvu eky’obutebaka. Nnali ntambula essaawa nnyingi nga ngezaako okwekooya nsobole okwebaka, naye oluvannyuma ne ngalamira ne nsooma ekiro kyonna nga nziramu byonna ebyabaawo ku lunaku olwo. Olulala, nnalabika nga njijukira buli mutambulo gw’omupiira mu mizannyo gya raggubi egy’ensi yonna gye nnali ndabye ku lunaku olwo ku leediyo. Omusawo wange yali ampadde eddagala, era omu ku mikwano gyange yajjanga bulijjo, ku makungeezi, okunsekerera nga nseeseetuka mu kisenge nga ndaga okwebaka. Ani ayagala emikwano egy’engeri eyo?! Mu ssomero, abayizi bange baali bagambiddwa obutantawaanya bwe nnaba sivudde mu kisenge ekiddugavu ekyali kigattiddwa ku laabu yange ey’ebyafisiki ku nkomerero y’ekiwummulo.

Baali bamanyi nti ngalamidde okuwummula, era baali bateekwa okuyita omukulu w’essomero eyandinnyingiridde! Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi mukaaga, otulo twange ne tudda mu buntu, naye nnali nkomizza emirimu gyange gyonna okuggyako okulabirira omulimu gw’abavubuka.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka etaano mu Ogmore Grammar School, nnali nsanyukira omulimu gwange n’omukwano gwa bakozi bannange. Naye ssaali neetegese ku ky’eddako ekyali kigenda okubaawo. Enteekateeka empya eya gavumenti yalagira nti essomero lyaffe lyali liteekwa okwegatta ku Nantymoel Secondary School okukola essomero eppya erya Comprehensive, eryandibadde n’ekizimbe ekyazimbibwa okusinziira ku byetaago ku ntobo y’ekiwonvu, okumpi n’amaka gaffe amaggya mu Bridgend. Nga omulimu gw’abavubuka bwe gwali gukuze, twali tutunze akayumba kaffe akatono ne tujjukira mu kibuga kino eky’omu byalo, wakati mu kiwonvu ekirungi eky’e Glamorgan. Okugatta amasomero kyali kitegeeza okukola Ekibiina Ekiggya eky’Abakozi n’oluvannyuma okulonda omubaka okubaweereza ku Poddo y’Abafuzi (Board of Governors).

Mu kiseera ekyo, tewaali musomesa eyakkirizibwanga okuweereza nga omufuzi w’essomero, noolwekyo okulonda omubaka kyali kiteekeddwa okukolebwa n’obwegendereza. Nnagenda mu lukiiko lw’abakozi olw’awamu nga nnina ebirowoozo ku oyo gwe nnandiwagidde. Mazima ddala ssaalina kirowoozo nti nze nnandirowoozeddwaako. Ssaali muntu eyakwananga na bakozi bannange emirundi mingi, era ssaali maze bbanga ddene mu masomero g’omu kiwonvu ekyo nga bangi ku bannange bwe baali bamaze. Oluvannyuma lw’essaawa bbiri, nnava mu lukiiko olwo nga nnyeenya omutwe olw’okwewuunya. Nnali nnondeddwa, nga bonna bakkiriziganya, nga pulezidenti w’Ekibiina Ekiggya eky’Abakozi era nga omubaka waakyo ku Poddo y’Abafuzi!

Nnakyukira Alan, omusomesa waffe owa jjografiya, eyali atambula ku ludda lwange. Nnagamba nti, “Sikkiriza kino.” N’anziramu nti, “Lwaki nedda? Ffenna tumanyi nti ggwe wekka ayogera amazima bulijjo,” ne mpuluma essaala mu kasirise.

“Weebale, Mukama, ekitiibwa kyonna kibe kikyo!” Oluvannyuma ne nkyuka nate eri Alan ne nnyongerako nti, “Lindako okutuuka eka nga ntegeeza Anne! Naye naye tajja kukikkiriza!”
fields.body_text: Amangu ago, ebirowoozo byonna ebikwata ku Canada byatuvaako, bwe nnatandika omulimu gwange omupya nga Omukulu w’Ekitongole ky’Ebyafisiki. Nnali era mpandiika olupapula lw’amawulire olw’essomero, nga nkulira ekibiina ky’Abakristaayo, era nga nkulembera enkuŋŋaana z’essomero. fields.title: Emikisa Gijjudde
fields.body_html:
Omwaka ogwaddirira gwali gwa njawulo nnyo! Enteekateeka z’essomero eppya zaali zitandise, era ffenna twali twetegereza n’obwegendereza okulaba nga abazimbi bakwata ebiteeso byaffe n’obunywevu nga bakola ebifaananyi byabwe. Ffe abaali mu Grammar School twali tweraliikirivu olw’okufiirwa ebimu ku bikolwa eby’amagezi bye twalina, ne biddira mu bifo by’ebikolwa ebyagenderera abayizi bonna awamu. Nkakasa nti abasomesa ab’omu ssomero ery’edda nabo baali beeraliikirivu nti abayizi baabwe bandiyisibwa nga ‘ab’omutindo ogwa kubiri.’ Kyali kya buvunaanyizibwa bwange okukiikirira ebibinja byombi.

Nayitibwa okwegatta ku kibinja ekitono eky’abasomesa ba fizikisi mu ttiimu ey’omulimu ogw’enjawulo, okukola curriculum empya ku lw’abayizi ab’omutindo ogwa waggulu: abo abeetegekera okuyingira yunivasite. Twali tusisinkana buli wiiki mu Cardiff University okukola n’okugezesa ebyuma bya elekitulooniki era n’okwogera ku curriculum. Transistors zaali kya kuzuula kiggya, era nga bwe muyinza okuteebereza, ffenna twali ‘abayizi abaggya’ mu by’elekitulooniki nga tuzannya n’ebyuma ebiggya. Emyaka 15 gyokka emabega nga nnali mmaze okuva mu ssomero erya sekondule, naye ssaayansi ya elekitulooniki yali emaze okuba n’obuyinza obunene, ne mu by’enjigiriza.

Ng’omwaka gw’essomero gunaatera okuggwaako, nnaweebwa omukisa okusaba okugenda mu kkooso ya elekitulooniki eya bbudde bwonna mu yunivasite - okwo okumalirira nga ndifuna diguli eya Master of Science.

Kino kyansikiriza nnyo kubanga nnasanga omulamwa nga gunsanyusa era ne ngutwala nga kkooso eyandyongedde ku bukugu bwange mu kusomesa.

Nnali nnina ekiruubirirwa okufuula essomero lyaffe erikulembera mu kusomesa fizikisi. Ate era, bulijjo nnali nnina okwejjusa okutono nti ssaakkiriza gumu ku mikisa ebiri gye nnaweebwa okusoma okutuuka ku diguli ya dokita mu fizikisi. Bwe nnamaliriza, nnayitibwa okusigala mu Swansea University okukola okunoonyereza, ate era nnayitibwa okwegatta ku ttiimu y’okunoonyereza eya British Geographical Society mu Antarctica okumala emyaka esatu ng’oluvannyuma diguli ya dokita ‘ekakasibwa’ mu Oxford University; naye kyokka nnali Muwelusi wa bulijjo, nga nnina engeri ey’eggwanga ey’okwetwala nga siwa mugaso, nga sikkiriza nti ddala nnali nsobola okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa kya diguli ya dokita. Ate era, nnali nsanze Anne - era nnali mu kwagala!

Nnalowooza ku mukisa guno omuggya n’obwegendereza. Nnateekateeka omusomesa omusigirwa n’oluvannyuma ne nsaba akakisa ak’ekiwummulo (sabbatical) okwongera okusoma kwange. Mr. Price, headmaster wange, yawagira okusaba kwange, era ne kutwalibwa mu Board of Governors. Olukiiko lwaffe olw’omu maaso olwa Board lwali lukyali wiiki bbiri ekiseera, bwe ntyo ne nneewuunya bwe nnabuulirwa headmaster nga wayiseewo ennaku ntono nti Board eyaagaanidde okusaba kwange. Bwe nnawenkanyisa okwongera, nnazuula nti sipiika yekka ye yali asazeewo ekyo awatali kwebuuza ku balala, bwe ntyo ne mbuulira Mr. Price obutamatira bwange. Ebikolwa nga bino byali bya bulijjo mu ba School Boards abaali bamanyiddwa olw’obutasaasira basomesa be baali bakoze.

Kino kyali kimu ku nsonga lwaki Minisitule y’Ebyenjigiriza yali enywerera nti omusomesa akyakola alondebwe ku buli Board of Governors. Ndowooza nti sipiika teyategeera nti omusomesa eyali asabye akakisa ak’ekiwummulo ye yali omuntu omu eyali atudde mu lukiiko lwa Board!

Headmaster yang’amba obutaggwaamu maanyi nnyo kubanga yalina ekiteeso ekisingako obulungi. “Gareth, nnoonya omukulembeze wa middle school, era ndowooza nti ggwe wandibadde omusajja ow’ekifo ekyo, era okudda mu yunivasite kiyinza okulemesa omukisa ogwo.”

Ebintu byali bifuuka bya njawulo nnyo! Kyali kyetaagisa okusalawo naye nnali sitegeerera ddala kya kusalawo ki kye nnandikoze. Nnandinyigirizza Board of Governors okundeka ne ngenda ku kkooso ya diguli ya Master? Nnandiggyeewo okusaba okwo ne nneesiga nti headmaster yandigobereranga ku kiteeso kye? Ddala nnali njagala okuleka okusomesa fizikisi olw’ekifo eky’obuddukanya? Ku bino byonna kwaliko okwongerwako omulimu omulala ogw’okukulaakulanya Staff Association, essemateeka lyayo, n’enkolagana yaayo ne Board of Governors.

Nze ne Anne twakubaganya ebirowoozo ku ebyo ebyali bisoboka ne tusaba naye nga tetulaba bulagirizi bwonna bunnyonnyofu. Twali tutategeera nti Mukama yali amaze okwenyigira nnyo mu buli kyali kigenda mu maaso. Ate era, okwennyamira kwange olw’okugaanibwa akakisa ak’ekiwummulo, oluvannyuma kwali kw’okulabika ng’okuteekateeka kwe okw’ekintu ekinene era ekirungi okusingako.

fields.title: Nsindiikako, Mukama!
fields.body_html:
Bwe bwali obudde obulungi obw'enkya ku Ssande, ng'enjuba eyaka, era nnali maze wiiki ssatu nga ndi mu ‘kusanyuka okw'omwoyo.’ Newaakubadde nga waaliwo ebisalwawo bye nnalina okukola, okutambula kwange ne Mukama kwali kwa njawulo nnyo. Omulimu gw'abavubuka gwali gukulaakulana ddala; obulamu bw'abantu bangi bwali bukyusibwa, abantu abaggya bajja buli wiiki, n'amakanisa amalala nago gaali gatandise okwegatta naffe, naye olunaku luno lwali lwa njawulo!

Ku ntandikwa y'okusinza okw'enkya, nnawulira nnyo obumu bwa Mukama, n'eddoboozi lye ery'omunda eritono ne lyogera eri omwoyo gwange.

“Kaakati kiseera ky'okuddayo eka,” bw'atyo bwe yayogera.

“Sisobola kugolokoka ne mvaawo kaakati,” bwe nnalowooza. “Ekibiina kirirowooza ki? Balirowooza nti okusinza tekunsanyusa!”

Eddoboozi ery'omunda ne lyeyongera okutuusa, oluvannyuma ng'ekitundu ky'essaawa, we nnagolokokera mpola okuva mu ntebe yange ne nfuluma mu kkanisa. Waali nga maili emu okutuuka eka, era bwe nnali ntambula mpola nga nnaga eyo, nnayogera ne Mukama. Omuntu yenna eyandiyise yandirowooze nti nneyogeragako, naye obumu bw'Omwoyo bwali bwa mazima ddala nga mfuka gy'ali obweraliikirivu bwange.

Bwe nnali mpita ku Brewery Field - awaka wa Bridgend Rugby Club, amalala g'abo bonna abaagala emizannyo mu kitundu - nnasanga omulenzi omuto ng'atawaana n'akagaali ke ak'amanaggwa asatu. Nnamuziga be babiri baali ku luguudo olw'abatambuze, naye nnamuziga eyasembayo yali akyali mu luguudo, era yali agezaako n'amaanyi ge gonna amatono okulinnyisa akagaali ku luguudo olw'abatambuze. Bwe yandaba nga nsemberera, n'ayimusa amaaso ge agaali gajjudde amaziga n'ayogera nti, “Nsindiikako, ssebo.”

Nnagolola omukono gwange, ne nkwata emabega w'akagaali, era n'okufuba okutono ne nsindiika omwana ng'agenda mu kkubo lye ng'asanyuse. Bwe yakyusa ku nkulungo, n'akebuka emabega n'awuuba omukono nga nange mu kiseera kye kimu ngamba munnange atalabika nti, “Nkusaba, nsindiikako, Mukama.”

Nange nnali mpulira nga bwe yali omwana oyo. Ekkubo eryali eggule olutata mu maaso ge, naye ng'atawaana okumanya engeri y'okweyongerayo. Bwe nnali nga nnyeeyongera okutambula, okusaba okwazaalibwa Omwoyo ne kutandika okuva ku mimwa gyange. Okuva ku lunaku olwo neddiŋŋanye okusaba kuno emirundi mingi nnyo ne nkumanya kigambo ku kigambo nga bwe nnakwogera omulundi ogusooka. Sikyakwogerera waggulu okusaba kuno kubanga kufuuse kimu ku nze ne kifuuka kaakati mu mazima okusaba okw'omutima.

Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera nnasoma ku kitabo ekiyitibwa, “Desert Fathers.” Abantu bano baabeerawo mu kyasa eky'okuna oluvannyuma nga Rooma emaze okussa ekitiibwa ku Bukristaayo, era abakkiriza nga tebakyattibwa lwa kukkiriza. Kale nno, baali baakusitula batya ‘omusaalaba gwabwe’ ne ‘okufa eri bo bennyini?’

Abantu bano ne basalawo nti obulamu obw'obwannamunigina mu Ddungu ly'e Misiri - nga bali ewala n'ebisikiriza byonna eby'ebitaliimu bya nsi eno - bwe bwandibadde nga ‘kufiira Katonda’ okwo. Baalowooza ku bintu bingi, naddala okusaba, n'engeri omuntu gy'asaanidde “okusaba awatali kulekeraawo” (1 Basessaloniika 5:17).

Mu njigiriza ezakwata ku birowoozo byange kwaliko eno: nti omuntu bw'addiŋŋana okusaba emirundi emingi ekimala, kuva ku mimwa, ne kufuuka ‘okusaba okw'omutima.’ Bwe kityo, wadde ng'omuntu takyayogera, omutima gwe gweyongera okukaabirira Katonda mu ‘kusaba okutakoma.’ Okusaba kuno kufuuse ekyo gye ndi.

“Mukama, njagala nnyo okutambulira mu kwagala kwo. Sisaba kirala wabula nti, bwe nnaatuuka ku nkomerero y'olugendo lwange, mpulire ng'oŋŋamba nti, ‘Weebale, omuddu omulungi era omwesigwa.’ Mmanyi nti ndi musiru era oluusi n'okubulwa amagezi, era nti nnaava mu kwagala kwo, naye nkuwa olukusa olwa 110% okunkuba onzizeeyo mu kkubo ettuufu. Sisaba kumanya kwagala kwo bwe kuli wadde okulaba ekkubo eriri mu maaso wabula, kyokka nti onkuume mu kwagala kwo.”

Engeri Katonda gy'addamu okusaba okwo ebumbye okutegeera kwange okw'“okutambula mu kukkiriza” era enyambye okutegeera ebimu ku bizibu ebiri mu Abaebbulaniya 11 - essuula enkulu ekwata ku “basajja abazira ab'okukkiriza.” Nnaannyonnyola oluvannyuma nga bwe kigenda kweyoleka engeri Mukama gy'ankulembeddemu mu kwagala kwe.

fields.title: Canada Etuyita
fields.body_html:
Enkeera ku makya nasaba Anne agule “Times Educational Supplement.” Empapula eno yafulumanga buli Lwakubiri, era yalagangamu emikisa gyonna egy’okusomesa mu Bungereza yonna, awamu n’ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku nkola y’okusomesa. Nnali ndowoozezza nti kyandibadde kirungi okufuna endabika enzijjuvu ey’enkulaakulana mu by’enjigiriza, ndyoke ndabe embeera ey’omu kitundu obulungi. Akawungeezi ako, bwe nnabikkula ku lupapula olusooka okusoma, ne neewuunya nnyo okulaba nti, “Waliwo omusomesa wa Physics gwe beetaaga mu ssomero mu Toronto, Canada.”

Kino kye kyali ekirango eky’olusooka nga bwe kityo mu myaka mingi ekyafunibwa mu magaziini yonna ey’e Bungereza, kubanga amasomero ag’omu Canada gaali gakyaziyiziddwa okulanga ebweru w’eggwanga lyabwe; naye ate nannyini ssomero lino ery’obwannannyini yalina ofiisi mu New York, era nga bwe nnavumbula oluvannyuma, tewaali Mucanada n’omu eyandikoze ku musaala omutono ogwali guweebwa!

Ekiwandiiko ekyo kyeyongera okugamba nti omutandisi, Mr. Giles, yali wa kubeera mu London wiiki eyaddirira, okwogera n’abasomesa abaali baagala okufuna omulimu guno, n’abalala abaali balangiddwa mu ngeri y’emu. Kino kyampalira nnyo kubanga ekibiina National Association of Schoolmasters — ekibiina kyange eky’abakozi — kyali kiyise okukola omukolo gw’okulekera emirimu olw’olunaku lumu, omulundi ogusooka, ku Lwakusatu olwaddirira. Bwe kityo, oluvannyuma lw’okwogeraganya okw’akaseera katono, ne mpeebwa omulimu okuba Omukulu w’Ekitongole kya Physics ku Toronto French School, Canada.

Omusaala gwali gwa kuba $11,000 ng’ogasseeko n’ensimbi ez’okusenguka. Guno gwali gusingako ku musaala gwange ogw’ekiseera ekyo waakiri $2,000, nga gwe musaala omusinga obunene ogwasasulwanga mu Wales. Naye tekyandituuse okutuusa lwe twatuuka mu Canada lwe nnavumbula nga bwe kyali ekitasoboka okukuza abaana basatu n’omusaala ogwo mu Toronto!

Ku lukuŋŋaana n’a Mr. Giles saasalawo kintu kyonna, wabula nadda e Wales n’endagaano okugiteekako omukono. Bwe nnatuuka eka, nasanga tulina abagenyi, Martin ne Sharon Loyley. Baali mikwano gyaffe egy’abaminsani be twamanya mu Hong Kong, era baali mu Wales ku kiwummulo, nga bakyalidde ab’eŋŋanda za Martin mu Bungereza. Baasanyuka nnyo okuwulira ku kwogeraganya kwange, era baatugumya n’obunyiikivu kubanga Sharon yali ava mu Toronto era nga amanyi ssomero eryo obulungi nnyo!

Yagamba nti, “Kibagwanira okubeera ne maama wange. Abeera yekka era anaasanyuka nnyo okubalaba mwenna nga muli awamu naye.”

Katonda yali amaze okututegekera ekkubo mu maaso gaffe.

Oluvannyuma lw’okwogeraganya n’okusaba, nze ne Anne ne tusalawo okukkiriza omulimu ogwaweebwa, era endagaano n’eteekebwako omukono nga bwe kisaanidde n’eddizibwa Mr. Giles.

Enkeera nagenda okulaba omukulu w’essomero nga nkutte ebbaluwa yange ey’okuwummula ku mulimu. Bwe nnayingira mu ofiisi ye, Mr. Price yannamusa n’ekisa n’‘amawulire amalungi’ nti Akakiiko k’Abakulembeze kaali kakyusizza endowooza yaako era nga nnina eddembe okugenda ku musomo ogw’omu yunivasite.

Mazima ddala, amawulire gange gaamwewuunyisa nnyo, naye n’akkiriza n’ekisa ensonga zange. Twalina emyezi esatu okwetegeka; lipoota z’ebyobulamu ne viza ne bifunibwa, ennyumba n’etundibwa, omulimu gw’abavubuka ne guweebwa omulala, era ebigambo bingi ‘eby’okusiibula’ ne byogerwa, kyokka twali tetugenda bwomu. Omukwano gwange omulungi yali yeeyagalidde okusalawo kwange era n’akozesa omukisa okukyalira Mr. Giles yennyini. Keith yali alondeddwa okuba Omukulu w’Ekitongole kya Mathematics mu ssomero lye limu nga nange. Bwe kityo, mu Agusiti 1975 twapakira ebintu byaffe byonna mu kontena ey’okusaabaza ku nnyanja eya fuuti 24 obuwanvu, ne tuwuluka okugenda e Toronto, Canada — ensi ey’ekisuubizo era ey’ebifo ebigazi ebyeggule.

fields.title: Jehovah Jireh - Omugabi Waffe
fields.body_html:
Okwanirizibwa kwaffe mu Canada tekwali kwa mukisa. Okusooka, ennyonyi yaffe yalina okuddayo emabega okuyita ku Iceland olw'okuteebereza nti waaliwo obuzibu mu yingini, oluvannyuma lw'okulinda essaawa nnya mu kisenge eky'okusimbulamu e Heathrow, twaddamu ne tusimbula mu ttumbi mu nnyonyi y'emu - naye n'abakozi abalala!

Okulwawo kwaffe kwatuleetera okutuuka mu Toronto essaawa musanvu ez'ekiro (1:00) ng'obudde bwe buli eyo, era mangu ne kirabika nti abamu ku bakungu b'emisolo tebaasanyuka kukozesebwa mu ssaawa embi bwe zityo. Ebyatutuukako byali bibi nnyo ne kitutuusa n'okwegomba nga singa twasigala eka mu Wales, naye bwe twamala okuyita, omukungu ow'abasenguse yatwaniriza n'atukakasa nti “si Bannakanada bonna bafaanana nga oyo.”

Twatunula okwetooloola nga tunoonya omuntu ayinza okutwaniriza, kubanga twali tuweerezza obubaka (telegram) eri Hazel Weech, nnyina wa Sharon, wiiki emu emabega, obwamumanyisa ebikwata ku lugendo lwaffe olw'ennyonyi, naye tewaali muntu ng'oyo, era mangu ne twesanga twekka mu kisenge eky'okutuukirako ekyali kkalu. Twenna twali tukooye nnyo era abaana baasobola okwebaka ku ntebe ez'omu kisenge, naye nze ne Anne twasigala tuli meeru, nga tukuuma emigugu era nga tulindirira Hazel. Essaawa kkumi na bbiri n'ekitundu (6:30) ez'oku makya nasalawo okumukubira essimu ne nzuula nti teyafuna bubaka bwaffe era yali anaatera okugenda ku mulimu.

“Mwetwalire takisi,” bw'atyo bwe yayogera, ng'ampa endagiriro omuvuzi w'emmotoka gy'ateekwa okututwaala. Bwe kityo, essaawa amakumi asatu (30) oluvannyuma lw'okuva e Heathrow omulundi ogusooka, twali twebase mu bulili obw'ebbugumu obulungi, nga twebase katulututtu.

Omwezi gwaffe ogusooka mu Toronto gwali gwa ssanyu nnyo. Twakuba embuga z'amaduuka (shopping malls), ne tugenda mu People’s Church okuwuliriza Dr. Oswald Smith ne Nicki Cruz, eyawandiika ekitabo “The Cross and the Switchblade,” ne tunyumirwa okuwuliriza Dr. John Wesley White ng'ayogera mu kkanisa ey'ekitundu eya United Church of Canada, era ne tugula n'ennyumba!

Eno yali nnyumba ntono, enkyafu, eyaddaala amanju gamu (bungalow) mu kitundu ekiriraanye Toronto, eyali ebadde njereere okumala emyaka ebiri. Amabala gaayo gaali matono: kikungu ne kiragala ekiddugavu. Ku lunaku olusooka, natandika olukalala oluwanvu olw'okuddaabiriza nga nkuba n'ennyondo akasozi akanene mu makkati g'oluggya lw'ekisenge eky'okusuliramu, kye nnalina okukozesa omusumaali ogw'obuwanvu bwa sentimita kkumi (four-inch spike) okugukwatirira wansi, ate ne nsiiga langi enjeru ku ffuleemu z'amadirisa. Oluvannyuma lw'olunaku oluwanvu olw'okukola ku mirimu egyo, nagenda okunaaba mu ssawa okuddamu amaanyi; naye bwe nnagenda okukyusa ku mazzi, natya nnyo amayinja ag'ekippu (tiles) mangi bwe gaava ku bisenge by'olwazi lw'awo we banaabira ne gagwa mu bbenseni. Gaali gakwatiddwa wamu ne Scotch Tape (akateepu)!

Oboolyawo weebuuza lwaki twagula ennyumba ng'eyo, era nkukakasa nti yokka gye twasobola okugula kubanga ebbeeyi mu Toronto zaali ziyitiridde nga kumpi emirundi esatu okusinga mu Wales, ate n'okupangisa kwandiggweeddemu amasente amatono ge twali tuterese. Kaakati ne tutegeera engeri omusaala gwange bwe gwali mutono nnyo bwe gugeraageranyizibwa n'obungi bw'ensimbi ze kyagula okubeera mu Canada.

Omwaka gwaffe ogusooka gwali gwa kulwanirira nnyo mu by'ensimbi naye twazuula nga Mukama atuumibwa erinnya lye ery'amazima, Jehovah Jireh, Omugabi waffe (Olubereberye 22:14).

Emirundi esatu mu mwaka ogwo ogw'essomero twabeeranga awatali ssente wadde ebyokulya nga wakati mu mwezi. Tetwabuuliranga muntu yenna naye bulijjo twewuunyanga engeri Mukama gye yatuwangamu bye twali twetaaga.

Ku lulala, omukyala mu kkanisa yaffe yatuwa ekirabo ekitono newankubadde nga teyamanya bye twali twetaaga. “Nsuubira temunyiize,” bw'atyo bwe yagamba, “naye Mukama y'antegeezezza okubawa kino.” Ku mulundi omulala, bazadde b'abamu ku bayizi bange baatuwa ssente; naye ekirabo ekyasinga okwewuunyisa kyajja ku ntandikwa y'omwaka gwaffe. Ebintu byali binywevu bwe waatuuka ebbaluwa eyaleetebwa mu ngalo okuva mu Minisitule y'Abasenguse ng'enyanjuza okukyalira ofiisi yaabwe. Nnali neeraliikirivu. Waaliwo ekintu ekyali kikyamu ku bapepa baffe? Twanditwalibbwa emabega eka? Ku ofiisi, nawebwa bbaasa, munda yaayo ne muba ebbaluwa etwaniriza mu Canada n'ekyeke ekya doola 1,000. Kino kyali, ng'ekirabo okuva mu Gavumenti ya Canada eri buli omu agula ennyumba ye ensooka mu Canada. Ne wagobererako ebyeke ebirala bibiri ebya doola 250.

Kyali nga wayiseewo omwaka gumu nga tekannazuulibwa nti waaliwo ensobi eyakolebwa era nti tetwali basaanira kufuna kirabo kino kubanga twali tubaddewo n'ennyumba mu Wales. Gavumenti yayagala okuddizibwa ssente zaabwe, naye olw'okuba ensobi yali yaabwe, baakkiriza nti tuzisasule, awatali magoba, mu myaka esatu. Ani omulala ayinza okwenyumiririza mu kufuna ensimbi ng'ezo okuva mu gavumenti awatali magoba? Kirabika bulungi nti Jehovah Jireh afuga n'ebitongole by'ensimbi ebya gavumenti!

Mu myezi gy'ekyeya (summer), saafuna musaala, naye twalina ekisuubizo kye twalina okutuukiriza. John ne Eileen Weibe baali mikwano gyaffe emirungi mu Germany, gye yaweerezanga mu magye ga Canada (Canadian Forces). Kaakati baali bakolera mu bukiikakkono bwa Manitoba wamu ne Church Army, era bwe baawulira nga tutuuse mu Canada, baatwegayirira tujje tubakyalire. Twali twasooka okukkiriza, naye bwe twalaba ng'ensimbi zaffe nntono, Anne yalina okubawandiikira emirundi ebiri ng'ababuulira nti twali tulina okulwawo okujja. Buli lwe yabanga anaatera okusindika ebbaluwa, ebbaluwa yajjanga okuva ewa Eileen ng'etubuulira nga bwe baali baagala nnyo okutulabako nate, ekyatuziyiza okubasindikira ebbaluwa ezo.

Bwe kityo, mu Julaayi, Anne yatwaala abawala ku lugendo oluwanvu okulaga e Dauphin, Manitoba, ate nze ne nsigala mu Toronto nga nsomera satifikeeti ey'abasomesa abakugu (specialist teachers’ certificate), naye ogwo mugero mulala.

Okukyala kwali kwa kitalo naye okutambula okugenda n'okudda bintu Anne by'andyagadde okwerabira. Ekitundu eky'ekyewuunyo mu lugero luno kwe kuti Anne bwe yakola ku by'ensimbi zaffe, ssente ze twasigaza ku nkomerero y'omwezi zaali za nnamba y'emu nga bwe zaali ziteekwa okubeera singa olugendo olwo terwatambulwa!

Nate, Mukama ateekwa okuba nga y'atuwadde.
fields.body_text: Okwanirizibwa kwaffe mu Canada tekwali kwa mukisa. Okusooka, ennyonyi yaffe yalina okuddayo emabega okuyita ku Iceland olw'okuteebereza nti waaliwo obuzibu mu yingini, oluvannyuma lw'okulinda essaawa nnya mu kisenge eky'okusimbulamu e Heathrow, twaddamu ne tusimbula mu ttumbi mu nnyonyi y'emu - naye n'abakozi abalala! Okulwawo kwaffe kwatuleetera okutuuka mu Toronto essaawa musanvu ez'ekiro (1:00) ng'obudde bwe buli eyo, era mangu ne kirabika nti abamu ku bakungu b'emisolo tebaasanyuka kukozesebwa mu ssaawa embi bwe zityo. Ebyatutuukako byali bibi nnyo ne kitutuusa n'okwegomba nga singa twasigala eka mu Wales, naye bwe twamala okuyita, omukungu ow'abasenguse yatwaniriza n'atukakasa nti “si Bannakanada bonna bafaanana nga oyo.” Twatunula okwetooloola nga tunoonya omuntu ayinza okutwaniriza, kubanga twali tuweerezza obubaka (telegram) eri Hazel Weech, nnyina wa Sharon, wiiki emu emabega, obwamumanyisa ebikwata ku lugendo lwaffe olw'ennyonyi, naye tewaali muntu ng'oyo, era mangu ne twesanga twekka mu kisenge eky'okutuukirako ekyali kkalu. Twenna twali tukooye nnyo era abaana baasobola okwebaka ku ntebe ez'omu kisenge, naye nze ne Anne twasigala tuli meeru, nga tukuuma emigugu era nga tulindirira Hazel. Essaawa kkumi na bbiri n'ekitundu (6:30) ez'oku makya nasalawo okumukubira essimu ne nzuula nti teyafuna bubaka bwaffe era yali anaatera okugenda ku mulimu. “Mwetwalire takisi,” bw'atyo bwe yayogera, ng'ampa endagiriro omuvuzi w'emmotoka gy'ateekwa okututwaala. Bwe kityo, essaawa amakumi asatu (30) oluvannyuma lw'okuva e Heathrow omulundi ogusooka, twali twebase mu bulili obw'ebbugumu obulungi, nga twebase katulututtu. Omwezi gwaffe ogusooka mu Toronto gwali gwa ssanyu nnyo. Twakuba embuga z'amaduuka (shopping malls), ne tugenda mu People’s Church okuwuliriza Dr. Oswald Smith ne Nicki Cruz, eyawandiika ekitabo “The Cross and the Switchblade,” ne tunyumirwa okuwuliriza Dr. John Wesley White ng'ayogera mu kkanisa ey'ekitundu eya United Church of Canada, era ne tugula n'ennyumba! Eno yali nnyumba ntono, enkyafu, eyaddaala amanju gamu (bungalow) mu kitundu ekiriraanye Toronto, eyali ebadde njereere okumala emyaka ebiri. Amabala gaayo gaali matono: kikungu ne kiragala ekiddugavu. Ku lunaku olusooka, natandika olukalala oluwanvu olw'okuddaabiriza nga nkuba n'ennyondo akasozi akanene mu makkati g'oluggya lw'ekisenge eky'okusuliramu, kye nnalina okukozesa omusumaali ogw'obuwanvu bwa sentimita kkumi (four-inch spike) okugukwatirira wansi, ate ne nsiiga langi enjeru ku ffuleemu z'amadirisa.
