fields.title: Ebbaluwa ey'Obukakafu
fields.body_html:
Mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka nga tuli mu Toronto, ebintu ebisingayo okwewuunyisa mu bulamu bwaffe byatandika okukwatagana, newankubadde nga kyalabika lwatuuka nti Mukama yali abikoledde enteekateeka emyaka mingi emabega, era nga alina n’ekigendererwa ekyayita n’ekiseera ekyo.

Amangu ago ne ntegeera nti sirina ssuubi lya maanyi ku Ssomero ly’Olufaransa, gye n’essuubi ery’okufuna omusaala ogunaanyweza obulamu lyali ttono. Kyokka, okusobola okusomesa mu nkola ya Canada, nnali neetaaga ebiwandiiko byange eby’obuyigirize eby’e Bungereza okukkirizibwa nsobole okusaba satifikeeti y’okusomesa eya “Type-B”. Okusooka, nnali neetaaga okufuna Ebbaluwa ey’Obukakafu, naye nnandikikoze ntya?

Tewali n’omu ku ssomero eyalabika ng’amanyi, naye nnajjukira nti emyaka kkumi emabega, bwe nnali nsaba omulimu ku Danforth Technical College, nnali mpeerezza kkopi za diguli yange ne satifikeeti zange ez’okusomesa mu ofiisi eyali ku Bloor Street, Toronto.

“Waliwo amanyi ofiisi y’ebyenjigiriza eri ku Bloor Street?” bwe ntyo ne mbuuza bakozi bannange.

“Kale, ekitongole ky’ebyenjigiriza ekya yunivasite kiri eyo,” omuntu omu bwe yagamba.

Bwe ntyo, nga essomero ery’olweggulo liweddemu, ne ntwala emmotoka wakati mu kibuga ku Bloor Street, ne nzuula ekifo eky’okuyimiriza emmotoka okumala akaseera katono, ne nnyingira ekizimbe ekyalimu Ekitongole ky’Ebyenjigiriza ekya Yunivasite.

Olubu olw’ansi lwali lwereere era nga lwa kizikiza okuggyako ekisenge kimu ku nkomerero y’akakubo akawanvu. Omuvubuka yali ayimiridde ku luggi, ng’ayogera n’omusajja omukadde eyali ayimuka okuva ku ntebe ye nga ntuuka ku muryango. Amangu ago ne ntegeera nti ofiisi yali ya muvubuka, ate ng’omukadde yali mugenyi ow’ekitiibwa.

Bwe nnannyonnyola ensonga lwaki nnali nzize, omuvubuka yaŋŋamba nti nnali nsaanidde okuba ku Mowat Building ku Bay Street, ebbanga eritali lya wala. Ne mwebaza ne mba nga ŋŋenda okuvaayo omusajja omukadde n’anziyiza n’ekibuuzo.

“Lwaki wajja wano?”

Ne nnyonnyola nti emyaka kkumi emabega, nga nsaba omulimu omulala, nnali neetaaze okuweereza ebiwandiiko byange mu ofiisi eyali ku Bloor Street, era nnalowooza nti eno y’eyo.

“Oboolyawo wawandiikira ofiisi yange,” bwe yagamba, n’akwata ku mukono gwange, n’atandika okunkulembera nga tuddayo mu kakubo aka kizikiza okwolekera omulyango.

Nnayagala okuva mu bwangu ŋŋende ku Mowat Building, naye ssaasobola kumuvaako kubanga yali alabika ng’anafuye nnyo, ayinza okugwa nga simuwanirira! Yankulembera n’atufulumya mu kizimbe, n’atuyisa mu luguudo olunene olw’amakubo ana olujjudde emmotoka, ne twambuka amadaala agawerako okuyingira mu kizimbe ekyali kumpi. Ne neebuuza omusajja ono ye ani, kubanga twalamusibwa omukuumi w’oku muryango era ne buli omu n’atussaamu ekitiibwa nga tetunnayingira mu ‘kifo eky’omunda ennyo’ eky’ekizimbe ekyo.

“Tuula wano,” bwe yagamba, ng’andaga entebe engazi ey’obwananansi okumpi n’emmeeza, “nga ŋŋenze okunoonya ebbaluwa yo!”

Yamala akaseera akatono nnyo nga tannaddayo n’akomawo n’essanyu ng’aleese ebbaluwa yange ey’ennono ng’agifundikako kkopi y’okuddamu kwe. Ne nzikirizibwa ekyewuunyo! Nnali mu kizimbe ekitali kituufu era nga nakulemberwa mu ofiisi etali ntuufu okusobola okutuukiriza ‘okusisinkana okwa Katonda’ kwe yali ateeseteese emyaka kkumi emabega.

N’oluvannyuma n’aŋŋamba nate ebiragiro omuvubuka bye yali ampadde dda, ng’awandiika ku katabo nga bw’ayogera.

“Bw’otuukayo saba Don Anderson, era omuwe kino,” bwe yagamba, ng’ampa akapapula ako.

Ne mwebaza ne nva mu kisenge, nga nkimanyi nti ekiseera kyali kigenda era nga ofiisi zaali zinaatera okuggalwa. Nga nzirukira emmotoka yange – eyali emaze ekiseera ky’okuyimirira – ne ngezaako okusoma bye yali awandiikidde Don Anderson.

“Owoomukwano Don,” bwe kyagamba, “nkusaba onnabireko Mr. Evans. Kirabika asaanira okufuna Type-A Specialist Teachers’ Certificate.”

Akapapula ako kaali kalina omutwe ogugamba nti, “Prof. Carlisle, Chief Education Officer, Ministry of Education, Toronto.” Ono ye yali Omukulembeze w’Ebyenjigiriza eyali asazeemu okulondebwa kwange emyaka munaana emabega!

Lowooza obulungi! Nnali ntuuse mu kizimbe ‘ekitali kituufu’ mu kiseera ekituukirivu okusisinkana omusajja omu eyali asobola okunkolera ekintu eky’enjawulo – mu kibuga eky’abantu abasukka obukadde buna!

Ebyewuunyo byange olw’olunaku luno byali tebinnaggwa. Nnatuuka ku Mowat Block ku Bay Street mu kiseera kye baali baggalawo enzigi. Ne nyanguwa okwambuka ku lubu, okusinziira ku mukuumi w’oku muryango, we baali bakolera ebisaba ebbaluwa z’obukakafu. Bwe nnayingira, amangu ago ne nnyimirira nga nkeŋŋentedde: waaliwo kkawunta eyali ng’obuwanvu bwa fiiti amakumi ataano ng’abantu basimbye olukiika mu maaso gaayo, nga bali basatu-satu. Nnali ntandika okulowooza nti kyandituuse ttumbi nga sinnava awo, amangu ago omusajja eyali afuluma kabuyonjo ku ludda lwange olwa ddyo n’antomera. Yansaba ekiganyi n’agattako nti, “Waliwo kye nnyinza okukukolera?”

Ne mmugamba nti nnali njagala okulaba Mr. Don Anderson.

“Nze Don Anderson,” bwe yaddamu.

Ne mmuwa akapapula ako ne ankulembera okuyingira mu ofiisi ye. Yandaga sekulita we, omuwala Omuwelisi, ng’amuwa ebiragiro nti, “onnabireko Mr. Evans.”

Nnatuuka eka mu kiseera eky’ekyeggulo eky’amangu, nga nsanyuka olw’engeri ez’ekitalo Katonda gye yankulemberamu ku lunaku olwo.

Bwe nnayingira, amangu ago ne nnyimirira nga nkeŋŋentedde: waaliwo kkawunta eyali ng’obuwanvu bwa fiiti amakumi ataano ng’abantu basimbye olukiika mu maaso gaayo, nga bali basatu-satu. Nnali ntandika okulowooza nti kyandituuse ttumbi nga sinnava awo, amangu ago omusajja eyali afuluma kabuyonjo ku ludda lwange olwa ddyo n’antomera. Yansaba ekiganyi n’agattako nti, “Waliwo kye nnyinza okukukolera?” Ne mmugamba nti nnali njagala okulaba Mr. Don Anderson. “Nze Don Anderson,” bwe yaddamu. Ne mmuwa akapapula ako ne ankulembera okuyingira mu ofiisi ye. Yandaga sekulita we, omuwala Omuwelisi, ng’amuwa ebiragiro nti, “onnabireko Mr. Evans.” Nnatuuka eka mu kiseera eky’ekyeggulo eky’amangu, nga nsanyuka olw’engeri ez’ekitalo Katonda gye yankulemberamu ku lunaku olwo.

fields.title: Type-A Specialist
fields.body_html:
Oluvannyuma lw'ennaku ntono, ebbaluwa yange ey'okukakasa nga tennatuuka, nafuna omugenyi mu kibiina kyange. Yayingira nga tategeezezza era n'atuula emabega. Olw'okuba nga French School kyali ssomero lya bantu ba kyama, era abasomesa abasinga baali bavubuka abaali tebannaba kufuna bumanyirivu nga bava mu France, bangi ku bo nga baali banoonya okwewala okuweereza mu magye eka nga bakolera mu Canada, abazadde abamu baalowooza nti kyali kya buyinza bwabwe, oba obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe, okukebera ekyali kiyigirizibwa batabani baabwe ne bawala baabwe. Abasomesa tebaayagala kuwakanya olw'okutya okuzzibwayo mu France; naye nze saalina kutya okufaanana. Bwe ntyo, nga ndowooza nti ono yali muzadde atayitiddwa, nayimiriza essomo lye nnali nsomesa, nawa abayizi omulimu okweyongera, ne nsemberera omugenyi. Yasaba ekitalo olw'okuyingira nga tayitiddwa naye yali alowoozezza nti nnali mmanyi nti ajja. Yategeeza nga aseka nti teyali muzadde, wabula yali mukebezi eyava mu Ministry of Education. Nate, namutegeeza nti olw'okuba nga saategeezeddwa nti ajja, saali neetegese kumusomeseza. Yaseka n'agamba nti, “Mr. Evans, sizze kukukebera, wabula kulaba ng'ebyokusoma bya Ontario bisomesebwa mu bwesigwa mu ssomero lino.” Ne nteeka omutima gy'ali era mu bwangu ne tutandika okunyumya bulungi ng'atunuulira akatabo k'omuyizi omu. Twanyumya ku ‘eka’ kubanga yali yasenguka emyaka egiyise ng'ava mu Scotland.

“Osabye ebbaluwa ey'okukakasa embeera yo?” bw'atyo n'abuuza. Namutegeeza nti nnali ngisabye.

“Bw'eneetuuka,” bw'atyo n'agamba, “ompite era nnaajja nkukebere osobole okufuna satifikeeti y'abasomesa eya Type-B.” Yalwawo katono. “Ekisinga obulungi, ebbaluwa yo ey'okukakasa bw'eneetuuka, weereza kkopi ku ofiisi yange, nange nnaakuweereza satifikeeti yo. Kirabika kaati okuva ku ngeri gy'okwata nayo ekibiina kino nti oli musomesa mukugu!”

Omwaka gw'essomero bwe gwali gusembera ku nkomerero, Anne yeeteekateeka okutwala abaana baffe abawala olugendo e Manitoba okulaba ba Wiebe, naye nze nnali ndowooza ku kkubo eddala erya nze; nnali ndabye omusomo gw'ekyeya oguwera wiiki mukaaga nga gulangiriddwa eri abo abaagala era abasaanira okufuna satifikeeti y'okusomesa eya Type-A Specialist.

Bonna abaagala okuba Omukulu w'Ekitongole mu ssomero lya sekenduli mu Ontario basaanidde okuba ne satifikeeti eno, wadde nga bangi tebagirina.

Mu kiseera ekyo nnali nnina mukwano gwange eyali akoze emisomo egy'ekyeya okumala emyaka mingi asobole butuufu okutuuka ku musomo guno. Prof. Carlisle yali andaze nti nnandisaanidde okufuna satifikeeti eno, bwe ntyo ne mpandiika nga nsaba foomu y'okusaba. Bwe yatuuka, najjuza ebikwatibwako ebyetaagisa ne nkuŋŋaanya ebiwandiiko byonna ebyetaagisa - okuggyako kimu. Satifikeeti yange eya Type-B yali tennatuuka wadde ng'omukebezi yankakasa nti yali “mu kompyuta.” Ku lunaku olw'ekkomo ery'okusaba, nakuba essimu eri yunivasite nga nnyinnyonnyola nti satifikeeti yange eya Type-B yali egenda kutuuka “buli lunaku kati,” ne mbuuza obanga okusaba kwange kwandisobodde okulwisibwako akaseera.

Omuwandiisi yampuliriza n'ekisa, n'agamba nti yali munakuwavu naye, “ennaku ez'ekkomo nnaku za kkomo.” Bwe nnali nga nnaatera okuwaayo essimu, nga nnakuwadde olw'okuba nnali kumpi nnyo okufuna Type-A mu mwaka gumu okuva lwe natuuka mu Canada, yaddamu okwogera. “Onsonyiwe, ssebo. Kiyinzika erinnya lyo okuba nti Mr. Evans?” Najjukira nga nakiwulirako edda okuva mu muwandiisi omulala! Deja Vu? N'alyoka antegeeza nti erinnya lyange lyali dda liwandiise okwenyigira mu musomo! Nagamba nti ekyo tekiyinzika kubanga nnali sinnasaba. Yantegeeza nti Prof. Carlisle ye yali awandiise erinnya lyange! (Oboolyawo yakwatibwa ensonyi kubanga emyaka egyayita yali yandeetera obunakuwavu bungi.)

Kaakati nnali ntandise ddala okutegeera ensonga lwaki Mukama yaali aggalidde oluggi luli mu Germany, emyaka mingi egyayita.

Nasanyukira nnyo ekyeya ekyo eky'emirimu, nga mpungudwa nga Type-A Specialist mu physics. Ekyo kye kiseera Anne lwe yakomawo eka okuva mu wiiki nnya ez'ekitalo mu Dauphin, Manitoba ne ba Wiebe. Ye n'abawala abasatu baali batambudde emayiro ezisukka mu 2,000, era baali bagudde omugabo gwabwe ogw'ebyokulya, naye kyokka twasanga nti akkawunti yaffe eya bbanka ku nkomerero y'omwezi teyali ya njawulo ne bwe baali abatagenze n'akatono!

Nate, Mukama ateekwa okuba nga ye yagaba!

fields.title: Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Omwaka gwange ogwokubiri mu Toronto French School gwali mulungi. Omusaala gwange gwayongezebwa okutuuka ku $17,000, ogwali kaakati gumala okuwangaala, kubanga ensaasaanya ennene ez'omwaka ogwasooka mu nsi empya zaali ziyiseewo. Naye ate awamu n'okwongera kuno, nnali nsuubirwa okubeera ku ssomero okutuuka ku ssaawa 7:00 ez'ekiro emirundi ebiri buli wiiki nsobole okuyamba abayizi abaali beetaaga obuyambi obw'enkukunala mu kubala ne fizikisi. Kaakati nnali era nvunaanyizibwa okutegeka emirimu gyonna egy'ebweru w'essomero egy'abayizi, nga mwe muli: empaka z'ennyimba n'amazina, empaka za chess, empaka z'emmotoka, n'ebirala.

Omwaka gw'essomero bwe gwali gunaatera okuggwaako, natandika okusoma empapula z'amawulire nsobole okulaba ebifo by'okusomesa ebyali bilangibwa mu nkola y'amasomero ga gavumenti mu Canada. Waaliwo bibiri ebyakwata omutima gwange: Upper Canada College ne The Toronto Hebrew Academy. Upper Canada College ye ssomero ery'obwannannyini ery'ebyafaayo eriri wakati mu Toronto nga lirina ebyafaayo ebirungi ennyo eby'okuwangula mu by'okuyiga ne mu by'emizannyo; baali banoonya omusomesa omukulu wa fizikisi. The Toronto Hebrew Academy baali banoonya omuntu okuba Omukulu w'Ekitongole kya Ssaayansi, wadde ekifo kino kyali kyetaagisa satifikeeti ya Type-A ey'omukugu.

Omuntu bw'aba asaba ebifo ebiggya, kikulu okusaba byonna ebiba bilangiddwa. Mu ngeri eno, erinnya lyo lifuuka erimanyiddwa, era emirundi mingi amannya n'obusobozi bw'abo abateewangula biweebwa amasomero amalala.

Kale, nnaweereza okusaba kwange eri buli ssomero. Nnateekebwa ku lukalala olw'abo abaasembera okufuna ekifo mu Upper Canada College, ekyansanyusa, naye era nnayitibwa okubuuzibwa mu Hebrew Academy. Kino kyanneewuunyisa kubanga kyali kyeyoleka bulungi okuva mu kusaba kwange nti saali Muyudaaya.

Okubuuzibwa kwali kuteekeddwa okubeera ku Lwokubalaza n'omukulu w'essomero ne Rabbi waabwe omukulu. Bambuuza okumala essaawa emu ne balyoka bambuuza oba nnalina ebibuuzo byonna. Mu kiseera ekyo saalina kya kubuuza, naye nabagamba nti, “Mumanyi nti siri Muyudaaya? Mu butuufu, ndi Mukristaayo ‘eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri’! Mazima ddala, nzija kusomesa fizikisi yokka mu laabu yange, naye omuyizi bw'anaambuuza enzikiriza yange ku nsonga ezimu, kinaba kizibu gye ndi obutaddamu.”

Nnalowooza nti tekyandireetera kabi kugamba kino kubanga saalina ssuubi lyonna lya kufuna kifo wadde nga abasajja baali bafaayo ku kusaba kwange! Omukulu w'essomero, Gary Diamond, yaddamu nti, “Yee, tutegeera. Tulowooza nti kiyinza okuba ekirungi eri abayizi baffe okusoomoozebwa omuntu ow'eddiini endala!”

Nnavuga emyendo 20 okudda eka nga nsala ekibuga nga ndi mu kwewuunya okungi. Kyali kisoboka nti nnandisomesezza mu ssomero ery'Abayudaaya ab'enkalakkalira? Bulijjo nnayagalanga Abayudaaya okuva mu kiseera kitaawe wa Anne lwe yannyanjula ku “Shepherd of Israel” - akatabo ke yafunanga bulijjo okuva Amerika. Nnayogeranga nti “Singa saali Muwelisi, nnandyagadde okuzaalibwa nga Muyudaaya!”

Ku Lwakutaano olwaddirira mu ttuntu, Keith yampita mu ofiisi ye okuntegeeza nti Hebrew Academy baali bafaayo nnyo ku kusaba kwange era baali bakubye essimu okukebera oba satifikeeti zange zaali za mazima. Ndowooza nti kya kwetegereza nti omuntu yekka mu Toronto eyali amanyi ddala - naddala ku nsonga ebbiri ezisembayo ku curriculum vitae yange - “Pulezidenti wa Staff Association; Munnakibiina ky'Abakungu Abafuzi” - yali Keith yennyini! Akawungeezi ako nnafuna essimu. Yali eva eri Mr. Diamond ng'ampita okutwala ekifo mu The Toronto Hebrew Academy nga ntandika mu Ssebutemba n'omusaala gwa $33,000! Nnayogera mu ddoboozi ery'omu kamwa nga nkkiriza, era oluvannyuma lw'edakiika ntono ez'okwogera okwa bulijjo, amangwago nnakubira Anne essimu okumutegeeza amawulire!

Twali tuwuniikiridde nnyo. Bwe twadda mu ntegeera zaffe, twatandika okutendereza Mukama olw'engeri ze ez'ekitalo. Eno yali y'ensonga lwaki yaggalawo oluggi mu Germany edda ennyo, alyoke yeeraga gye ndi ng'atuleeta mu Canada? Yali awadde satifikeeti ya Type-A mu kiseera eky'ekyewuunyo eky'omwaka gumu, ne kaakati, aggulawo oluggi eri abantu be abalonde! Kiki kye nnali nkoze ekyansaanyiza kino okuggyako okusaba awamu ku Brewery Field mu Bridgend?

Oluvannyuma nnazuula nti abalala musanvu baali basabye ekifo kye kimu mu The Toronto Hebrew Academy, nga buli omu ku bo alina dipuloma ez'obukugu era nga Bayudaaya. Mazima ddala, babiri ku bo baali bali dda ku ssomero, bombi nga balina Type-A mu masomo abiri! Kya kubasiima nti Andy ne Marty bombi baafuuka mikwano gyange emirungi nga neetereeza mu bulamu mu kitundu ky'Abayudaaya.

Waaliwo abasomesa 50 ku ssomero, nga ffe babiri bokka be tutaali Bayudaaya, naye baafuba nnyo okukakasa nti mmanyi nti nnali wa mu kibiina.

fields.title: Toronto Hebrew Academy
fields.body_html:
Emyaka ebiri gye namala mu Hebrew Academy gyali gya ssanyu nnyo, kubanga abayizi eyo baalina omutima ogunyiikivu era baakola nnyo ku by'okusoma kwabwe. Ate era, okwato ku mulimu gwange ogw'ekitongole, natendeka ekibiina ky'omupiira ogw'ekigere ekya ssomero okutuuka we kyawangulira omwaka gwakyo ogwasooka mu ligi y'ekitundu. Omulundi ogwasooka mu bulamu bwange obw'okusomesa, nnali mpeebwa omusaala omulungi (oboolyawo ogusinga obulungi mu Toronto yonna, kubanga Hebrew Academy yali yeewaddeyo okusasula abasomesa baayo 'okusingira awo' ku ekyo amasomero ga gavumenti kye gaali gasasula). Bawala baffe baali boogera ku maka amaggya ge twali tugenda okugula — nga galina n'ekidiba eky'okuwuga, mazima ddala! Naye waaliwo ekintu kimu ekyali kikyamu! Mu masomero gange gonna amalala, nnali wa ddembe okusooka okwogera n'abayizi bange ku kukkiriza kwange. Mu buli limu ku go, nnasobola okutandikawo Christian Union oba enkuŋŋaana ezifaanana ku zo ku lw'abayizi, abogezi abamanyiddwa mwe baajjanga oba nze ne nkulembera okwogera. Naye mazima ddala, kino tekyasoboka mu Hebrew Academy.

Bwe kityo, ne nsemberera District Superintendent ow'ekkanisa amaka gaffe gye gaali gasinza, okunoonya omukisa ogw'okubuulira ng'omuntu ow'obulijjo atali musumba. Yaŋŋamba nti mu Canada tekyali kya bulijjo abantu abatali basumba okubuulira, naye bwe yawulira ku bumanyirivu bwange obw'okubuulira mu Wales, n'ambuuza lwaki saalowooza ku kuyingira obuweereza obw'obusumba.

Ne mmugamba nti tewali kintu kye nnandyagadde okusinga okuba omusumba, naye saali nsobola kumala myaka esatu nga nsoma mu ssomero ery'okutendekera obusumba; ate era, nnandyetaaze okuyitibwa okw'olwatu okuva eri Mukama nga sinnaava mu kusomesa okufuuka omusumba ow'ekiseera kyonna. (Nkizuula nti waliwo abasajja bangi nnyo mu buweereza abatalaga kabonero konna ak'okufukibwako amafuta okuva eri Katonda; basajja balungi, naye abataayitibwa kuba basumba.) Yanziramu nti teyandindetseeko kusoma mu ssomero ery'obusumba, kubanga yali amanyi omulimu gwange nga ndi mukadde mu kkanisa y'ekitundu. Ku by'‘okuyitibwa,’ yagamba nti yandinoonyezza ‘Obujulizi bw'Abooluganda.’

Nga wayiseewo wiiki ntono, omusumba waffe n'ava mu kifo kye okukwata obuweereza obw'okuyimba nga atambulatambula, era nga nze mukadde yekka eyalina obumanyirivu obw'okubuulira, ne nyitibwa okwogera ku 'kusiibula' kwe. Oluvannyuma lw'okusinza, abasajja babiri ab'omu kkanisa, bombi nga basumba baakadde, ne bansemberera (nga tebamanyi ku lukuŋŋaana lwange ne District Superintendent) nga baŋŋamba nti, 'Tosaanidde kusomesa: osaanidde kuba mu buweereza!'

Kino kyali ‘Obujulizi bw'Abooluganda?’ Ekyo kyaggulawo ekkubo eppya ddala mu bulamu bwange. Ekyavaamu kwe kuti, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ebiri egy'okusomesa mu Toronto Hebrew Academy, ne mpa okumanyisa nti nzija kuva mu ssomero, kubanga nnali nzija kufuuka omusumba wa Christian and Missionary Alliance, naye ogwo lugero lulala.

Waali wasigadde wiiki nnya okutuuka ku nkomerero y'omuwendo gwa ssomero ogwa spring eri abayizi baffe aba grade 13, abaali baakumaliriza omuwendo gwabwe ogusembayo mu kibbutz mu Israel. Nnali mu kisenge ky'abakozi Ari Barchi bwe yansemberera.

Ari yali afunye ekitiibwa ky'ebyenjigiriza okuva mu University of Jerusalem, era yali mu Toronto okusomesa ebyokusoma eby'Olwebbulaniya, ebyalimu n'okusomesako ku kugeraageranya eddiini ez'enjawulo.

'Gareth,' n'agamba, 'Nnaatera okusomesa essomo ku Bukristaayo, ne ndowooza nti kyandibadde kya busirusiru gye ndi okukikola nga ggwe omanyi ku Bukristaayo okusinga nze nnyo! Wandyagadde okujja mu ssomo lyange wamu nange?'

Nga bwe kyandisuubiddwa, ne ŋŋamba nti nandisanyuse nnyo, bwe kityo, enkeera mu makya ne ŋŋenda naye mu kibiina kya grade 13 eky'‘eddiini.’ Abayizi 25, abaali n'emyaka gy'obukulu 17 okutuuka ku 19, tebaalaga kwagala kunene bwe twayingira. Kubanga baali bammanyi — baandabanga bulijjo mu laabu y'ebyafizikisi. Ari yayogera mu Lwebbulaniya, oluvannyuma n'agamba nti, 'Mr. Evans kaakati ajja kubawa okuyigiriza ku Bukristaayo!'

Ne mmira amalusu! Nnali ndowooza nti nnali wo ng'omuntu ow'okuyamba yekka okuddamu ebibuuzo byonna. Ssaali nsuubira kusomesa ssomo.

'Oboolyawo nsaanidde okubabuulira Obukristaayo kye butali.' Bwe ntyo ne ntandika, nga nfuba nnyo okulowooza kye nnaayogera. 'Si Northern Ireland n'entalo zaayo ez'amadiini. Si Crusades n'okuyiwa omusaayi kwazo. Era si by'obufuzi bya bungi bw'ensi ey'ebugwanjuba. Wabula, kwe kukkiriza nti Yesu ye Masiya wa Katonda, ajja okuggyawo ebibi by'abantu. Ka mbabuulire nga bwe nnafuuka Omukristaayo. Oluvannyuma ndibabuulira nga bwe nnafuuka Omuyudaaya!' Buli omu n'azuukuka! 'Oluvannyuma ndiddamu ebibuuzo byonna.'

Nawa obujulizi bwange mu bumpi (nga bwe kyawandiikibwa mu ssuula ey'okubiri), oluvannyuma ne mbayigiriza engeri gye bwamfuulamu omwana wa Katonda. Nti olw'okukkiriza, nga Ibulayimu okukkiriza kwe bwe kwamufuula omutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda (Olubereberye 15) era 'kitaawe w'abakkiriza,' kaakati nnali nsinza Katonda w'Abayudaaya, nga 'nfuuliddwa omwana' mu maka ge. Nayogera nga eddakiika kkumi, oluvannyuma ne mbuuza nti, 'Waliwo ebibuuzo?'

Buli mukono mu kisenge ne guyimusibwa waggulu. Nzijukira nga ntandikira ku mulenzi eyali mu nsonda ey'emabega ku ludda olwa ddyo ey'ekisenge. Yabuuza engeri Yesu gye yandibadde Masiya, ate nga buli omu yali amanyi nti Masiya yandireese emirembe ku nsi, so nga ku kujja kwa Yesu kwaddirira ntalo zokka. Nnaddamu nga ndaga obunnabbi obw'omu Ndagaano Enkadde obwogera ku Masiya alibonaabona awamu n'oyo aliwangula. Entalo ziva ku muntu okugaana okukkiriza amaanyi g'ekiweebwayo kye yawaayo e Kalivali; naye, alikomawo, ku mulundi guno ng'ali Kabaka, okussaawo 'emirembe gye ku nsi.'

Ebibuuzo bingi ne biddirira, abayizi nga bawuuba emikono era nga baleekaana basobole okuwulirwa ebibuuzo byabwe.

'Nkwegayiridde, ssebo! Nkwegayiridde ssebo! Nze nzija oluddako, ssebo!'

Omuwala omu n'abuuza nti, 'Okkiriza nti Masiya alijja nga tukyali balamu?' Nnaddamu nti weewaawo, nga nnyongerako nti nnasuubira nti twandibadde wamu bw'alijja. Bwe yambuuza nti, 'Lwaki?' Nnaddamu nti, 'Kubanga olwo nnaasobola okukulaga obubonero bw'emisumaali mu ngalo ze ne mu bigere bye!'

Essomo ne lyeyongera bwe lityo okumala eddakiika 40 nga tewannaba kuvuga ngoma ya ssomero okulaga nti kaakati kye kiseera eky'okugenda mu ssomo eddda; naye, abayizi bano tebaali baagala kunneka ŋŋende, kubanga baali balina ebibuuzo bingi ebitaali biddwamu bye baali baagala nnyo okubuuza. Mu bwangu ne ntegeera nti ekiseera kingi kyali kiyiseewo, era nti tekyandibadde na mugaso nze okugenda mu ssomo eddda. Ku kiseera kino, abayizi bange baali baaviiddewo mu laabu y'ebyafizikisi era nga batereera okusomera mu tterekero ly'ebitabo. Kino kye kyali enkola eya bulijjo omusomesa bwe yatatuukanga ku ssomo ku kiseera. Bwe kityo, ne nneyongera okuddamu ebibuuzo okutuusa ekiseera ekirala bwe kyayitawo. Ku mulundi guno, kyali kya nnaku nti nnali nsaanidde okugenda, naye oluvannyuma lw'okusuubiza nti nnandikomyewo omusomesa waabwe singa yali ayagadde.

Bwe nnali nvuga nga nzirayo eka akawungeezi ako, nnali nsanyuse nnyo olw'omukisa gwe nnali mfunye okwogera ku kukkiriza kwange n'abavubuka bano ab'enjawulo. Saali ndoowoza nti kino kyandisobose, era ssaali nsobola kuggwaawo kwewuunya ngeri za Katonda ezeewuunyisa. Nnasaba nti ebigambo bye nnali njogedde byandibaze ebibala ebimu mu bulamu bw'abayizi abo, nga nkakasa nti Mukama tasiga nsigo ze bwereere.

Enkeera mu makya, ebbaluwa yali endindiridde mu kasanduuko kange ak'ebbaluwa ku ssomero. Yali egamba nti, 'Mr. Evans, nkusaba ojje ondabe mu office yange ku ssaawa nnya ez'enkya leero. - Rabbi S.' Omutima gwange ne gukka. Kyali kya lwatu nti Rabbi omukulu yali awulidde ku kiseera kye nnali mmaze n'abayizi aba grade 13, era nnali nnaatera okunenyezebwa. Oboolyawo nnandisabiddwa n'okuva mu ssomero!

Nnawulira nga ndi mu bulabe bungi, naye ne neezizaamu amaanyi nga nzijukira nti nnali mbalabudde ku lukuŋŋaana lwange olw'okwebuuza, nti kino kiyinza okubaawo. Bwe nnali nsemberera office ey'ebisenge eby'endabirwamu, nnasobola okulaba Ari Barchi ng'atudde munda, ng'ayogera ne Rabbi.

'Ah, Gareth, yingira!' Rabbi S. n'agamba. 'Nze ne Ari tubadde twogera ku ssomo lye wabadde n'abayizi aba grade 13 jjo.' N'ayongerako nti, 'Nga bw'omanyi, essomero lino lyatandikibwawo okuwa abaana baffe Abayudaaya okuyigirizibwa okulungi ennyo, era ekitundu ekikulu nnyo mu ekyo kwe kubassaamu okwagala ebintu byonna eby'Ekiyudaaya, bwe tutyo tubayigiriza ebyafaayo byaffe, ebitontome byaffe, obuwangwa bwaffe, n'eddiini yaffe. Mmaze emyaka mingi nga nsomeseza wano era nteekwa okukkiriza nti ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okunkwenyeese kwe kuti abatono ennyo be batuuka ku kukkiriza okwennyini mu Katonda; naye, bwe nnayingira mu kibiina kyange mu makya gano, ne mbasanga bonna nga baagala okwogera ku kukkiriza ne ku Katonda. Gareth, sirabangako nga basanyuse bwe batyo! Ekizibu kyokka kiri nti byonna biri mu mitwe gyabwe so si mu mitima gyabwe. Twabadde tweebuuza obanga oyinza okutuyamba okuteeka okukkiriza okufaanana bwe kityo mu mitima gyabwe!'

'Ekkubo lyokka lye mmanyi kwe kukkiriza nti Yesu ye Masiya,' ne njogera, ng'omutwe gwange gutandika okuzunga.

'Ekyo nkitegeera,' Rabbi n'agamba, 'naye otegeera nti tuteekwa okukkiriziganya nti tetukkiriziganya, naye... twabadde tweebuuza obanga wandyagadde okujja mu bibiina ebirala okusomesa abayizi baffe.

Beewuunya okusanga omusajja ow'ebyasayansi ate nga era musajja wa kukkiriza. Naddala omuntu amanyi ebyawandiikibwa byabwe nga bw'obimanyi. Nkusaba, ojja kujja?'

Amangwago ne ndaga nga bwe nnali mwetegefu, era ne wateekebwateekebwa nze okujja mu ssomo lya grade 13 ku lunaku olwaddirira. Ndowooza nnandisobodde okwewuubaala nga 'ndi wa mwoyo' ne ŋŋamba nti, 'Ka nsooke nsabireko ku kino,' naye ndowooza nti Mukama yansonyiwa olw'obwangu bwange obutalina kulowooza!

N'ayongerako nti, 'Nga bw'omanyi, essomero lino lyatandikibwawo okuwa abaana baffe Abayudaaya okuyigirizibwa okulungi ennyo, era ekitundu ekikulu nnyo mu ekyo kwe kubassaamu okwagala ebintu byonna eby'Ekiyudaaya, bwe tutyo tubayigiriza ebyafaayo byaffe, ebitontome byaffe, obuwangwa bwaffe, n'eddiini yaffe. Mmaze emyaka mingi nga nsomeseza wano era nteekwa okukkiriza nti ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okunkwenyeese kwe kuti abatono ennyo be batuuka ku kukkiriza okwennyini mu Katonda; naye, bwe nnayingira mu kibiina kyange mu makya gano, ne mbasanga bonna nga baagala okwogera ku kukkiriza ne ku Katonda. Gareth, sirabangako nga basanyuse bwe batyo! Ekizibu kyokka kiri nti byonna biri mu mitwe gyabwe so si mu mitima gyabwe. Twabadde tweebuuza obanga oyinza okutuyamba okuteeka okukkiriza okufaanana bwe kityo mu mitima gyabwe!' 'Ekkubo lyokka lye mmanyi kwe kukkiriza nti Yesu ye Masiya,' ne njogera, ng'omutwe gwange gutandika okuzunga. 'Ekyo nkitegeera,' Rabbi n'agamba, 'naye otegeera nti tuteekwa okukkiriziganya nti tetukkiriziganya, naye... twabadde tweebuuza obanga wandyagadde okujja mu bibiina ebirala okusomesa abayizi baffe. Beewuunya okusanga omusajja ow'ebyasayansi ate nga era musajja wa kukkiriza. Naddala omuntu amanyi ebyawandiikibwa byabwe nga bw'obimanyi. Nkusaba, ojja kujja?' Amangwago ne ndaga nga bwe nnali mwetegefu, era ne wateekebwateekebwa nze okujja mu ssomo lya grade 13 ku lunaku olwaddirira. Ndowooza nnandisobodde okwewuubaala nga 'ndi wa mwoyo' ne ŋŋamba nti, 'Ka nsooke nsabireko ku kino,' naye ndowooza nti Mukama yansonyiwa olw'obwangu bwange obutalina kulowooza!

fields.title: Kale Bwe Kityo bwe Kitegeeza!
fields.body_html:
Enkeera ku makya, ffe abasatu twayingira mu kibiina. Kyali kijjudde essanyu, Ari bwe yatuula mu nsonda, ne Rabbi S. n’atandika okwogera mu Lwebbulaniya. Nnatunuulira mu kibiina kyonna ne ntegeera nti bano si be bayizi be nnalabako emabega. Waaliwo abayizi 50 mu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’esatu, era bano baali ‘ekitundu ekirala’ eky’ekibinja ekyo. Rabbi n’ayogera nabo okumala akaseera katono mu Lwebbulaniya, oluvannyuma n’akyukira gye ndi n’ansaba nti njogere. N’atuula mu maaso gange ddala — nga ali kumpi nnyo, olwo singa nnaba n’obuzibu mu kwogera, amalusu gandimutuuseeko!

“Olw’okuba nga muli kibinja kya njawulo ku abo be nnayogezako emabega, ka mbabuulire kye nnabagamba,” bwe nnatandika. Omuyizi n’ansalamu.

“Nsaba ssebo, ffenna tuwulidde Omukristaayo ky’atali, engeri gye wafuukiramu Omukristaayo, n’engeri gye wafuukiramu Omuyudaaya. Ekyo kyokka kye tubadde twogerako mu nnaku zino ebbiri ezayise. Onootukkiriza tukubuuze ebibuuzo?”

Abayizi baali baagala nnyo okumanya nga bali ab’ekibiina ekirala — newankubadde nga bano baali beeteeseteese obulungi. Ebibuuzo ebitono byali biteekeddwa okunteega, naye ebisinga byalaga okwagala okw’ennyini. Omuwala omuto n’abuuza engeri nze, omunnansayansi, gye nnayinza okukkiriza okuzaalibwa okw’embeerera. Bwe nnayogera nga nziramu nti omu ku bannabbi baabwe yali alagudde ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo, n’ansaba nnyo mmulage awo we kyawandiikibwa. Rabbi ye yakyukira gy’ali n’amuwa amagezi asome Isaaya essuula 7.

Awo Rabbi S. n’agamba nti, “Nsobola okukubuuza ekibuuzo?”

Nnawulira enviiri ez’oku nsingo yange nga ziyimuka. Kino kye kyali! Guno gwe gwali omulundi omukulu ogw’okunnyoleka! Buli muyizi mu kibiina n’awetama mu maaso okuwulira buli kigambo ekyandyogeddwa, ‘omulwanirizi’ waabwe bwe yali agenda okulaga Omunnamawanga bwe yali omusirusiru olw’okukkiriza olugero olwo olw’Ekikristaayo. Omuntu yandisobola okukakasa nti buli kigambo kyali kigenda kuddibwamu ku mmeeza z’eky’ekiro 25 akawungeezi ako.

“Ssebo Evans,” bwe yatandika, “Nsomye Endagaano yo Empya emirundi mingi. Era nze, wamu n’Abayudaaya abalala bangi, tukkiriza nti omuntu asinga obukulu eyali atambulidde ku nsi kuno ye Yesu ow’e Nazaaleesi. Nzeenyumiririza nti yali Muyudaaya. Ye n’abagoberezi be baali basajja batuukirivu, nga bayita abantu eri obutukuvu n’enzikiriza entuufu. Baali beesigwa mu kusinza kwabwe era nga bakuza embaga zonna n’ennaku entukuvu. Mu butuufu, Bayibuli yo engamba nti ‘yatuukiriza Amateeka mu byonna bye gaalagira’ (Matayo 5:17). Kye sitegeera kye kino: bw’oba nga weeyita omugoberezi we, lwaki naawe toofuuke Muyudaaya?”

Nnewuunya nnyo okwatula kwe mu maaso g’abayizi bano, nga ntandika okuddamu.

“Nange nsomye ebyawandiikibwa byammwe, Endagaano yaffe Enkadde, ne ndaba engeri Katonda gye yagamba Musa nti buli ngeri ya butali bulongoofu mu bantu, waaliwo eddagala limu — okuwaayo ekiweebwayo eky’omusaayi. Kyandibadde omusaayi gw’embuzi oba omwana gw’endiga oba ennyonyi, naye mu byonna, omusaayi gwe gwali gwetaagisa. Nasoma era nti omulundi gumu mu mwaka ku lunaku olw’Okutangirira, Yom Kippur, omwana gw’endiga omulenzi, ogw’omwaka gumu era nga teguliiko kamogo, gwali gulina okutwalibwa ne guttibwa.

Omusaayi gwagwo gwali gulina okutwalibwa Kabona Asinga Obukulu okuyingira mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu mu yeekaalu, era eyo gumansirwe ku Ntebe ey’Okusaasira Katonda gye yabeeranga.”

Rabbi n’akkiriza n’omutwe gwe.

Ne nneeyongera nti, “Ku lunaku olwo, tewaali n’omu eyakola mulimu mu Isirayiri yonna, nga balindirira nga bakutte omukka, okulaba obanga Katonda anaakkiriza ekiweebwayo kino ng’ekibikka ku bibi byabwe okumala omwaka omulala. Buli omu yajaguza Kabona Asinga Obukulu bwe yakomawo okuva mu maaso ga Katonda. Ekiweebwayo kyakkirizibwa! Ebibi byabwe byabikkibwako okumala omwaka omulala! Noolwekyo, kyandiyogeddwa mu butuufu nti ‘awataali kuyiwa musaayi, tewaali kubikka ku kibi.’”

Ate era, Rabbi n’akkiriza n’omutwe gwe n’agamba nti, “Ba Rabbi baffe ab’edda bombi, Hillel ne Shimei, baakkiriziganya nti Amateeka gonna gayinza okufunziibwa mu boogero obwo.”

Kati kyali kiseera kyange okukkiriza n’omutwe gwange.

“Ssebo, waaliwo Omuyudaaya omulala eyasooka Yesu, ng’ayita abantu eri okwenenya. Erinnya lye yali Yokaana. Abantu bwe beenenya ebibi byabwe n’obukyamu bwabwe, n’ababatiza mu mugga Yoludaani. N’agamba abantu nti waaliwo omukulu ennyo okumusinga eyali ajja — oyo gwe yali tasaanira na kusumulula lukoba lwa ngatto ze. Sikirowooza nga kitali kya bwerere nti bwe yalaba Yesu ng’asembera, yagamba ebibiina nti, ‘Laba Omwana gw’Endiga owa Katonda, aggyawo ekibi ky’ensi’ (Yokaana 1:29). Yategeera nti ebiweebwayo byonna eby’Amateeka byali biraga olunaku olwo omwana gw’endiga omutuukirivu lwe gwandizuuliddwa okuggyawo ekibi kyonna emirembe gyonna. Ggwe kennyini wagamba nti Yesu ye yali omuntu asinga obutuukirivu eyali abaddewo.

Ye yali omwana gw’endiga, yekka, eyasobola okutuukiriza ebyetaagisa eby’Amateeka. Yatuukiriza Amateeka mu byonna bye gaalagira. Olw’okufa kwe, yabikka ku bibi byaffe byonna emirembe gyonna. Kyekyava, olunaku olumu, omulenzi ono omutono Omunnamawanga n’asobola okufukamira ku kitanda kye, n’atunuulira omusaalaba mu Yerusaalemi, n’asaba Katonda w’Abayudaaya akkirize ekiweebwayo ekyo olw’ebibi byange nange.”

Mu kiseera kino Rabbi S. yali akutamizza omutwe gwe. Byonna byali bisirise, era saalina kirala kya kwogera. Awo ne mpulira eddoboozi lye ng’ali ng’ayogera yekka.

“Kale bwe kityo bwe kitegeeza! Kale bwe kityo bwe kitegeeza!” Awo bwe yatunula gye ndi n’agamba nti, “Nkiraba kaakati. Nkiraba kaakati.”

Simanyi obanga nnali nfunyeeko akaseera akasanyusa okusinga ako. Emirundi mingi neebuuza lwaki Mukama ampa okuloza kw’eggulu okwo, songa abalala baakola nnyo okumala ebbanga eddene nga bamuweereza mu bantu be abalonde naye nga tebalabangako kifaanana bwe kityo. Ekirala, kyeyolefu nti yali yateeseteese bino byonna emyaka mingi emabega bwe nnabuuza ku nsonga ze ez’okuggalawo oluggi olw’okujja kwaffe e Canada.

Okwennyamira kwaffe kwali kufuuka nteekateeka ye! Waaliwo oluguudo olw’olwatu olw’‘amayinja ag’okulinnyako’ okuva ku kwennyamira kwaffe mu Bugirimaani, nga tuyita mu Ogmore Grammar School, Toronto French School, Professor Carlisle n’ebbaluwa ey’okukakasa embeera, okutuuka ku dipuloma ey’‘Ekika-A’, okutuuka ku kulondebwa kwange mu Hebrew Academy, n’okutuuka ku lunaku luno lwennyini!

Sikkiriza nti Mukama akolako ekintu kyonna awatali kigendererwa, era bwe mmanyi nti ‘ekigambo kye tekiridda gy’ali nga nkalu,’ (Isaaya 55:11) nkakasibwa nti abamu mu kibiina ekyo, ne Rabbi, banaabeera nange mu ggulu.

fields.title: Ekigambo Kyange Tekiridda Nga Tekaliiko Kye Kikoze
fields.body_html:
Mu wiiki ennya ezaddirira, nayigiriza emisomo emirala mukaaga n’abayizi ab’omu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’esatu. Tewaali kiziyiza kunziyiza kwogera ku Mukama n’okukkiriza kwange. Sisobola kuwa lipoota nti waliwo ku bayizi eyatuuka ku kukkiriza okulokola mu Ye, naye nga nzikiriza nti Katonda tasiga nsigo za bwereere, nkakasa nti yalina ekigendererwa eky’olubeerera mu kunzikiriza okufuna omukisa ng’ogwo - era n’okugutegeka emyaka mingi oluberyeberye.

Nkakasa nti Mukama alidda nate mangu ago ng’ekisuubizo kye yawa abatume bwe kiri. Mu kiseera ekyo walibaawo okubonaabona okunene n’ennaku ku Nsi; kyokka, Katonda yalagira nti Abayudaaya emitwalo kkumi na ena mu enkumi nnya (144,000) balikuumibwa mu kiseera ekyo, nga be bajulirwa be, abavunaanyizibwa okulangirira ekitiibwa kye mu nsi yonna. Olw’obujulirwa bwabwe, bangi balikkiriza, ne bwe kiriba okutuusa mu kufa: abatukuvu ab’okubonaabona (Okubikkulirwa 7 ne 14). Nzikiriza nti abamu ku bayizi abo bayinza okuba mu 144,000, ne bwe kitaliba, baliba mu abo abalyatula Omulokozi mu kiseera ekyo. Nsaba nti Rabbi S. abeere mu bo.

Ssemesita ey’ettoggo yakoma ku wiikendi ya Canada Day. Kyali mpisa nti mu wiikendi eno ennwanvu, abayizi bonna baagendanga ku ‘field trips.’ Abayizi abamu ab’omu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu bansemberera ne bambuuza obanga nnandigenze nabo e Quebec City.

Nnagamba nti nnandisanyuse okukikola naye nnabuusabuusa obanga nnandikkirizibwa okugenda kubanga nnali sitegeera bulungi Kashrut (amateeka g’Abayudaaya agakwata ku mpisa, okulya, n’okusaba). Mr. Diamond bwe yaddamu okunkoowoola enkeera, nnamwogerako okutya kwe kumu. Nnandisanyukidde okukulembera olugendo naye nga mmanyi engeri abayizi bonna gye baagala okukozesa obubi abasomesa abatamanyi, saasobola kukkiriza buvunaanyizibwa bwa kuluŋŋamya mpisa z’Abayudaaya. Yankakasa nti omusomesa omulala Omuyudaaya naye yandigenze okunziggyako okweraliikirira okwo, bwe ntyo nnakkiriza okuyitibwa era nnasanyuka Ari Barchi bwe yabuuza oluvannyuma obanga yandibadde munnange.

Twava Toronto ng’enjuba yaakamala okugwa akawungeezi ka Lwamukaaga (oluvannyuma lwa Ssabbiiti) ne tutambula ekiro kyonna nga tuyita mu Ontario ne tuyingira Quebec. Nze ne Ari twali tutudde emabega w’omuvuzi. Essanyu ery’olubereberye ery’abayizi baffe amakumi ana bwe lyeyongera okuggwaamu ne lifuuka akasiriikiriro ak’otulo, twanyumya ku nzikiriza zaffe ez’enjawulo. Mu Montreal, twayimirira okulonda emmere eya kosher ey’olunaku olwaddirira ne tutuuka mu Quebec City ekirungi ku makya ga Ssande. Nnali nkooye nnyo bwe twalya ne tutuula mu ppaaka nga tetunnaba kutwalibwa mu Chateau de Frontenac Hotel.

Omuvubuka omu yansemberera n’abuuza nti, “Muli kibiina ekiva Toronto? Nze naba omukulembeze wammwe ow’okulambula mu nnaku ntono ezijja.”

Nnamwaniriza ne mmuwa sandwichi nga ŋŋamba nti, “Ze sandwichi za kosher - nnyulu nnyo. Oyinza okuba omanyi nti tuva mu ssomero ery’Abayudaaya,” ne nnyongerako, awatali kulowooza, nti, “Naye nze kennyini si Muyudaaya. Ndi Mukristaayo eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.” Osobola okuteebereza essanyu lyange bwe yaanukula n’obunyiikivu nti naye yali mukkiriza.

Nnakyukira Ari ne mmugamba nti, “Laba Mukama nga bw’ali omulungi. Amanyi nga bwe nkooye n’ebibuuzo bingi by’olina, kyavudde amutuma omuntu omulala okukuddiramu ebibuuzo byo!”

Twafuna wiikendi ennungi ennyo ffenna. Jean Mark Deneau, omukulembeze waffe, yeeraga okuba munnaffe eyeegombebwa era yali ayagalibwa bonna. Yalina akaseera ak’enjawulo n’abayizi bwe twayingira Notre Dame Cathedral. Abayizi baali basirise, naye ne beewuunya ebifaananyi ebiri ku bifo eby’omusaalaba, bw’atyo n’abayita okutuula ku ntebe ez’omu maaso ate ye - nga alina Baibuli eyabikkulwa - yabatambuza mu Kubonaabona kwa Yesu.

Ekiro kyali kiyiseeko ddala essaawa mukaaga ez’ekiro ku makya ga Lwokusatu bwe twakomawo ku njuyi za Toronto. Twali tunaayita ku nnyumba yange ekyandinziggyeko olugendo okuva ku ssomero okudda eka, naye nnasalawo okusigala ne Ari n’abayizi singa waliwo ekintu ekitategekeddwa ekiyinza okubaawo. Amangwago twali tudde ku ssomero emigugu gyonna gye gyaterekebwa, abayizi ne bakuŋŋaanyizibwa, ne nsigala nzekka ne bbaasi n’omuvuzi waayo. Nnali nkyalina olugendo lw’essaawa emu okutuusa lwe nnandituuse ku kitanda kyange, era mazima ddala saali njagala bbaasi bbiri n’eggaali z’omukka ez’emu ttaka ebbiri ze nnandyetaaze.

“Ogenda oluuyi lwe ŋŋenda?” Al, omuvuzi waffe, bwe yabuuza. Yali agenda okutwala bbaasi mu kibuga wakati ekyandinziggyeko ekitundu ky’olugendo lwange. Bwe twatambula ffembi, yayongerako ekigambo eky’ekyewuunyo eri wiikendi yaffe.

“Mbadde mpuliriza gy’oli ne Ari,” bwe yagamba. “Wamanyi nti ekitundu kimu ndi Muyudaaya n’ekitundu ekirala ndi Mukatuliki? Mbadde nnoonya amazima mu wiiki ntono eziyise, nga ndaba pulogulaamu za TV eza Bakristaayo, era nga nneebuuza oba bye boogera bya mazima. Kya mazima ddala nti nsobola okumanya nti ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa era nti Yesu ayinza okuba Omulokozi wange ow’obuntu?”

Saakkiriza matu gange newankubadde nti nnali nsaanidde okuba nga ntegeeredde amakubo ga Mukama edda. Mu ddakiika kkumi ezaddirira, nnamugumya okwesiga omulimu ogwa Kalivary, era bwe nnamuleka, yankakasa nti kaakati atandika okutambula okuggya okw’okukkiriza ne Omulokozi.

Bwe nnatuula ku ggaali ery’omukka ery’emu ttaka, nnatendereza Mukama waffe olw’obulungi bwe era nnasanyuka nnyo nti nnagondera okukubiriza kwe obutava ku bbaasi amangu ennyo.
fields.body_text: Mu wiiki ennya ezaddirira, nayigiriza emisomo emirala mukaaga n’abayizi ab’omu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’esatu. Tewaali kiziyiza kunziyiza kwogera ku Mukama n’okukkiriza kwange. Sisobola kuwa lipoota nti waliwo ku bayizi eyatuuka ku kukkiriza okulokola mu Ye, naye nga nzikiriza nti Katonda tasiga nsigo za bwereere, nkakasa nti yalina ekigendererwa eky’olubeerera mu kunzikiriza okufuna omukisa ng’ogwo - era n’okugutegeka emyaka mingi oluberyeberye. Nkakasa nti Mukama alidda nate mangu ago ng’ekisuubizo kye yawa abatume bwe kiri. Mu kiseera ekyo walibaawo okubonaabona okunene n’ennaku ku Nsi; kyokka, Katonda yalagira nti Abayudaaya emitwalo kkumi na ena mu enkumi nnya (144,000) balikuumibwa mu kiseera ekyo, nga be bajulirwa be, abavunaanyizibwa okulangirira ekitiibwa kye mu nsi yonna. Olw’obujulirwa bwabwe, bangi balikkiriza, ne bwe kiriba okutuusa mu kufa: abatukuvu ab’okubonaabona (Okubikkulirwa 7 ne 14). Nzikiriza nti abamu ku bayizi abo bayinza okuba mu 144,000, ne bwe kitaliba, baliba mu abo abalyatula Omulokozi mu kiseera ekyo. Nsaba nti Rabbi S. abeere mu bo. Ssemesita ey’ettoggo yakoma ku wiikendi ya Canada Day. Kyali mpisa nti mu wiikendi eno ennwanvu, abayizi bonna baagendanga ku ‘field trips.’ Abayizi abamu ab’omu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu bansemberera ne bambuuza obanga nnandigenze nabo e Quebec City. Nnagamba nti nnandisanyuse okukikola naye nnabuusabuusa obanga nnandikkirizibwa okugenda kubanga nnali sitegeera bulungi Kashrut (amateeka g’Abayudaaya agakwata ku mpisa, okulya, n’okusaba). Mr. Diamond bwe yaddamu okunkoowoola enkeera, nnamwogerako okutya kwe kumu. Nnandisanyukidde okukulembera olugendo naye nga mmanyi engeri abayizi bonna gye baagala okukozesa obubi abasomesa abatamanyi, saasobola kukkiriza buvunaanyizibwa bwa kuluŋŋamya mpisa z’Abayudaaya. Yankakasa nti omusomesa omulala Omuyudaaya naye yandigenze okunziggyako okweraliikirira okwo, bwe ntyo nnakkiriza okuyitibwa era nnasanyuka Ari Barchi bwe yabuuza oluvannyuma obanga yandibadde munnange. Twava Toronto ng’enjuba yaakamala okugwa akawungeezi ka Lwamukaaga (oluvannyuma lwa Ssabbiiti) ne tutambula ekiro kyonna nga tuyita mu Ontario ne tuyingira Quebec. Nze ne Ari twali tutudde emabega w’omuvuzi. Essanyu ery’olubereberye ery’abayizi baffe amakumi ana bwe lyeyongera okuggwaamu ne lifuuka akasiriikiriro ak’otulo, twanyumya ku nzikiriza zaffe ez’enjawulo. Mu Montreal, twayimirira okulonda emmere eya kosher ey’olunaku olwaddirira ne tutuuka mu Quebec City ekirungi ku makya ga Ssande. Nnali nkooye nnyo bwe twalya ne tutuula mu ppaaka nga tetunnaba kutwalibwa mu Chateau de Frontenac Hotel. Omuvubuka omu yansemberera n’abuuza nti, “Muli kibiina ekiva Toronto? Nze naba omukulembeze wammwe ow’okulambula mu nnaku ntono ezijja.” Nnamwaniriza ne mmuwa sandwichi nga ŋŋamba nti, “Ze sandwichi za kosher - nnyulu nnyo. Oyinza okuba omanyi nti tuva mu ssomero ery’Abayudaaya,” ne nnyongerako, awatali kulowooza, nti, “Naye nze kennyini si Muyudaaya. Ndi Mukristaayo eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.” Osobola okuteebereza essanyu lyange bwe yaanukula n’obunyiikivu nti naye yali mukkiriza. fields.title: Okukkiriza — Ekirabo Katonda ky'awa mu Buyinza Bwe
fields.body_html:
Omuntu tasaanidde kuzimba njigiriza ye ku bumanyirivu. Bangi nnyo baabuzibwa ne bava mu kukkiriza kubanga baakkiriza enjigiriza etasangibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, wabula eyeesigamiziddwa ku bumanyirivu bw’omuntu omulala, nga bunnyonnyolwa ne ‘nnyiriri ez’obukakafu’ ez’enjawulo. Wabula, nzikiriza nti Ebyawandiikibwa binaawagirwa obumanyirivu, wadde nga tebyetaaga kukakasibwa.

Bwe mba neebuuza ensonga lwaki Mukama yampeeredde omukisa mungi bw’atyo mu bumanyirivu bwe njogeddeko, ntuuse ku kutegeera okw’amaanyi okw’olugendo lw’okukkiriza, olunnyonnyola Abaebbulaniya 11 mu ngeri ennungi okusinga ennyonnyola endala ze nfunye. Kirabika lwatu nti yankulembera okuva ku ‘jjinja ery’okulinnyako’ okutuuka ku ‘jjinja eddala ery’okulinnyako,’ nga yagateekateeka nga sinnaba kutuukayo. Kino tekyabaawo lwa ‘kukkiriza’ kwange okunene, wadde okuddamu okw’obulamu bwange obw’okusaba okw’amaanyi, kubanga sisobola kwewaana kimu ku ebyo. Mu butuufu, kitono nnyo kye nsanga mu mpisa y’Omukristaayo ekinjawulako abakkiriza abalala abasinga obungi, okuggyako okwewaayo kwange okujjuvu okwagala Katonda by’ayagala mu bulamu bwange n’obukakafu nti anankulemberanga mu by’ayagala. Okusaba, kwe nnasooka okwogera awali Bridgend Rugby Field, kufuuse okukaaba kwange okutayogerwa.

Mpulidde okukkiriza nga kunnyonnyolwa mu ngeri nnyingi: kwe kukkiriza, kwe kwesiga, kwe kwesigama, era kwe kulangirira. Ababuulizi batukubirizza okuba n’‘okukkiriza okusingawo!’ Abamu bagamba nti ensonga lwaki bangi balwadde, baavu, oba tebayimirira bulungi, y’okuba nti tebalina kukkiriza kumala.

Ddala, abamu bakigeraageranya n’ekibi! Kya mazima nti ‘awatali kukkiriza, tekisoboka kusanyusa Katonda’ (Abaebbulaniya 11:6), naye ka tutegeere okukkiriza kye kiri. Mu njigiriza y’abantu bangi, waliwo olusalo oluwewuka nnyo wakati w’okukkiriza n’okuteekateeka Katonda ky’anaakola.

Okusinziira ku Strong’s Exhaustive Concordance, ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani, ‘pistis’ kivvuunulwa nga ‘okukkiriza’ emirundi egisukka mu 225. ‘Oligopistos’ kisangibwa emirundi ena nga kitegeeza ‘okubulwa obwesige’ (mu Kristo). Kya njawulo nti ‘Elpis,’ ekitera okuvvuunulwa nga ‘essuubi’ (mu butuufu ‘okusuubira n’obwegombe’), kivvuunulwa nga ‘okukkiriza’ mu Abaebbulaniya 10:23.

Bwe nsoma Ebyawandiikibwa, nsanga engeri ssatu ez’okukkiriza: 1. Waliwo ekiyinza okuyitibwa okukkiriza okulokola. ‘Kubanga olw’ekisa mwalokolebwa olw’okukkiriza; era ekyo si mmwe: kirabo kya Katonda’ (Abaefeso 2:8).

Katonda mu kusaasira kwe okungi atuuse eri omuntu ng’ayita mu Mwana we, Yesu Kristo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu amubikkulira gye tuli era atuwa ekirabo eky’okukkiriza, n’atusobozesa okuddamu nga tukkiriza era nga tumanya Katonda. Tewaali kye tuyinza okukola okusaanira oba okufuna okubikkulirwa kuno. Akola mu buyinza bwe ng’eyeeraga yekka. Ku Lusozi Kerumooni, Yesu bwe yabuuza abayigirizwa be nti, ‘Mmwe mugamba nti ndi ani?’ Peetero yayinza okuddamu nti, ‘Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda Omulamu.’ Yesu n’amuddamu nti, ‘Oli wa mukisa, Simooni omwana wa Yona! Kubanga kino tekyakubikkulirwa mubiri na musaayi, wabula Kitange ali mu ggulu’ (Matayo 16:13-17).

Kuno kwe kukkiriza okutegeera era okwaniriza ekirabo eky’obulokozi ekiri mu Kristo Yesu. Olw’okukkiriza kuno, tutuuka okumanya nti ebibi byaffe bisonyiyiddwa era nga tulina obumu ne Kitaffe. Ffe ‘abaana abato’ aboogerwako mu 1 Yokaana 2:12-13. Nkakasiza mu nnaku nti Abakristaayo bangi nnyo be nsisinkanye tebaakulaakulana kusukka mutindo guno ogw’okukkiriza.

2. Eky’okubiri, waliwo ekibala eky’okukkiriza. ‘Naye ekibala ky’Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, obukkakkamu, obulungi, okukkiriza…’ (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23).

Ng’ebibala byonna, okukkiriza kwetaaga ekiseera okukula. Kibala ekigenda kikula ekisangibwa mu bulamu bw’abo bokka abakula mu lugendo lwabwe olw’Ekikristaayo. Zabbuli 1:3 egamba nti omuntu omutuukirivu ali ‘ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’emigga gy’amazzi, ogubala ebibala byagwo mu biseera byagwo.’ Amaanyi gaffe tugaggya mu migga gy’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era olwo lwennyini bwe tubeera mu ye ebibala ng’ebyo we binaakulira mu bulamu bwaffe. Bwe ndowooza ku bibala ebyogerwako mu Abaggalatiya 5:22-23, nkwatibwa enkulaakulana yaabyo. Kirabika nga bwe bigenda mu maaso bwe bigenda bifuuka ebitalabikalabika oba ebitasangika mangu mu bulamu bwaffe. Kumpi abakkiriza abaggya bonna bawa obujulizi ku kwagala, essanyu n’emirembe ebiggya bye baafuna mu kukyuka kwabwe. Kino kirabika nga ke kalengo ku ekyo Mukama ky’atuteekedde ffenna. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera, essanyu ery’olubereberye lizikkirira, ne wandaawo omutendera ogw’okuyigiriza obuyigirizwa ogw’okukula okw’ekibala ekigumira. Ku ludda olulala, okukkiriza, obuwombeefu n’okwefuga bya bbeeyi; ne Pawulo yennyini yawa obujulizi ku kulwana kwe yamanya mu kwefuga (Abaruumi 7:15-25).

3. Waliwo ekirabo eky’okukkiriza. ‘…omulala n’aweebwa okukkiriza mu Mwoyo omu…’ (1 Abakkolinso 12:9).

Nga bwe kiri ku birabo byonna eby’omwoyo (charismata) ebyogerwako mu ssuula eno ne mu Abaruumi 12:6-9, okukkiriza kuweebwa olw’okuzimba ekkanisa yonna. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akozesa ekirabo kino ng’ayita mu buli gw’ayagala era mu kiseera kyonna ky’ayagala. Omuntu taba na kirabo kino nga kikye; akikozesa mu kiseera lwe kiweebwa. Si kya bakulembeze bokka oba abo abakuze; buli mukkiriza ayinza okukozesebwa mu ngeri eno okuzzaamu abalala amaanyi. Kikozesebwa Mukama bw’ayagala okutuzzaamu amaanyi ng’abantu okukumira mu maaso newankubadde nga ebintu bizibu.

Engeri zonna essatu ez’okukkiriza ensibuko yaazo eri mu Katonda. Akola mu buyinza bwe ng’ateeka okukkiriza mu mitima gy’abantu, era ng’akulabirira kukule. Kye nsobola okukola kwe kwewaayo eri omulimu gwe mu bulamu bwange n’okukola mu buwulize eri ekigambo kye n’okunkubiriza kwe. Obuwulize buno kwe kuddamu kw’okwesiga nti ekigambo kye kya mazima.

N’olwekyo, gye ndi, ‘olugendo lw’okukkiriza’ kwe lugendo Mukama mw’ankulembera nange ne mmugoberera, oluusi nga mmanyi naye emirundi mingi nga simanyi. Ebiseera ebimu akyusa ekkubo lyange ng’ayita mu mbeera oba mu ‘nteekateeka za Katonda.’ Tekyetaagisa nti nnoonye okumanya obulagirizi bwe oba by’ayagala ku bulamu bwange ebweru w’ebyo by’amaze okwatula mu Bayibuli. Kitange annyagala nnyo okusinga okuzannya n’enneewulira zange. Tampita kukola by’ayagala n’oluvannyuma n’ankweka by’ayagala mu ‘nteekateeka enzibu’ ezikwekeddwa mu Ggulu.

Tandalikiriza ng’ankaka okuzuula by’ayagala ng’ayita mu ssaawa nnyingi ez’okusaba n’okwegayirira, nga ntya nti nnyinza okukola ensobi eneenvaako okugwa okuva mu by’ayagala ne mu kisa kye; wabula asuubira nti ntambulire mu by’ayagala okutuuka we bikoma nga Bayibuli bw’abyatula. Olwo anankulembera mu by’ayagala ebinaanjeekera ng’ayita mu mbeera oba mu ‘nzigi enzigule’ z’ateeka mu maaso gange. Kye nteekwa okukola kwokka kwe kunywerera ku mukono gwe.

Neegomba by’ayagala Katonda mu bulamu bwange nga Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw’awandiika nti, ‘Ng’empeewo bw’eyaayaanira amazzi, bw’atyo emmeeme yange bw’ekuyaayaanira, Ayi Katonda’ (Zabbuli 42:1). Katonda yeegomba by’ayagala mu bulamu bwange! Kale, ani oba kiki ekiyinza okukiziyiza? Ddala nzikiriza nti Setaani alina obuyinza okuziyiza Katonda okutuukiriza by’ayagala? Mmanyi nti bulijjo anoonya engeri y’okuzikiriza omwana wa Katonda yenna, okubaggya mu by’ayagala Katonda, naye guli mulimu gwa Kitange okunkuuma — si gwange.

Nnina ekifaananyi kyange nga ntambula ku kkubo ery’oku mabbali nga nnywereye ku mukono gwa Kitange. Nze naye twogera era tussaawo obumu. Simanyi gy’ayinza okuntwala leero, oboolyawo eri essanyu ery’oluggya lw’ebiwoomerera by’obulamu, so nga enkya ayinza okuntwala eri omusawo w’amannyo! Ntambulidde ku kkubo lino ekiseera ekiwanvu okumala okumanya nti bwe njagala okumala ebbanga eddene mu ‘maduuka g’ebiwoomerera’ ag’obulamu, Kitange mazima ddala ateekwa okuntwala eri omusawo w’amannyo mu kiseera ekimu! Kyava akkiriza okuzibu n’ennaku okujja mu bulamu bwaffe, kubanga amanyi nti eyo y’engeri yokka gye tuli okukulira.

Nzijukira nti Omulokozi waffe ‘yatuukirizibwa ng’ayita mu kubonaabona’ (Abaebbulaniya 2:10). Ayinza okunserengetya mu kiwonvu ekimu ekkika, naye era njize nti buli kiwonvu kitwala ku nsozi, era ng’ekiwonvu bwe kikka wansi, n’olusozi bwe luli waggulu ennyo. Bw’oba oyagala okulaba obusika obw’oku ntikko y’olusozi ne Mukama, oteekwa okutambula olugendo lw’okukkiriza ng’oyita mu kiwonvu. Oluusi, ng’omwana yenna, nsanyaalatibwa ekintu ekiri emitala w’ekkubo ne nziggya amaaso ku Kitange, ne mpita mu kkubo. Kino kye kiseera Setaani ky’abadde alindirira. Akoleeza yingini y’‘eloole ye ey’ettani kkumi’ n’atandika okunnumba okunsesebbula! Naye nga tannatuuka, Kitange ow’amagezi era ow’okufaayo ampalambya n’anzizaayo ku kkubo ery’oku mabbali wamu naye. Si ky’ayagala nti nzikirire, era si kukkiriza kwange okunene okundokodde, wadde okukkiriza kwonna kwe neefunira nzekka, wabula bwe budeddangamu bwe. Ekyange kyokka kwali okwegomba okw’amaanyi okunywerera ku mukono gwe (okutambula mu by’ayagala) n’okwewaayo mu buwulize eri obulagirizi bwe.

Gye ndi, okwo kwe kukkiriza.

Abaebbulaniya 11:1 annyonnyola okukkiriza nga ‘obwesimbu obw’ebintu bye tusuubira; obukakafu obw’ebintu bye tutalaba.’ Ekigambo eky’olubereberye kyogera gye ndi ku kirabo, ate ekigambo eky’oluvannyuma, ku kibala. Ffenna twamanya kye kitegeeza okusuubira ekirabo ku lunaku olw’amazaalibwa oba ku Ssekukkulu. Tuba n’okusuubira okunene ennyo okukifuna, okutuusa ekirabo lwe kifuuka kyaffe okukikwatako. Twalina essuubi, kaakano tulina obwesimbu.

Ekigambo eky’okubiri, ‘obukakafu obw’ebintu bye tutalaba,’ kyogera ku kibala. Omuntu tasobola kulaba nsibuko yaakyo — omubisi ogukulukuta — naye obukakafu obw’obulamu bulabikira mu kibala. Olunyiriri olw’okubiri lugamba nti ‘olw’okukkiriza, abantu baasobola okuwa obujulizi obulungi.’ Nzikiriza nti olugero lwange lubadde bujulizi bulungi ku bulagirizi bwa Katonda obw’obwesigwa. Singa teyanjjululanga okuva mu bumanyirivu okudda mu bumanyirivu obulala, sandibadde na kya kwogera kitono ku bulamu bwange ekiyinza okumuwa ekitiibwa.

Olunyiriri olw’okusatu lugamba nti olw’okukkiriza, tusobola okutegeera ekitategeerekeka. Si na kumanya kwa ssaayansi, wabula n’obukakafu obw’emmeeme obuva mu kubikkulirwa okuva eri Katonda. Wabaawo olukalala lw’ebyokulabirako okutulaga engeri Katonda gye yateeka olugalo lwe mu bulamu bw’abasajja n’abakazi ab’edda okubasobozesa okutambula ng’ebyo by’ayagala ku bo ne ku ffe bwe biri. Abantu bano mwe mwali abatemu, abalimba, ab’okubuusabuusa, wamu n’abakkiriza n’abaafiira obukakafu. Bonna tebaali bawanguzi oba bazira olw’okuba baalina okukkiriza okunene, wabula ebyafaayo byabwe byawandiikirwa ffe tulyoke tunyweze amasomo Katonda g’ayagala tuyige ku lugendo lwaffe ffe olw’okukkiriza.

Nga bwe ntegeera, essuubi ery’omu Bayibuli, ‘elpis,’ elitegeeza ‘okusuubira n’obwegombe,’ likwatagana n’okukkiriza n’okwesiga. Mu Luyonaani, ‘okukkiriza,’ kwe ‘pistis’ era kusingira ddala okukwatagana n’okuwulira. Ddala, nnandinnyonnyodde okukkiriza ng’engeri ey’omutima, erabikira mu buwulize, ate essuubi nga ngeri ya kutegeera, erabikira mu bwesige.
fields.body_text: Omuntu tasaanidde kuzimba njigiriza ye ku bumanyirivu. Bangi nnyo baabuzibwa ne bava mu kukkiriza kubanga baakkiriza enjigiriza etasangibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, wabula eyeesigamiziddwa ku bumanyirivu bw’omuntu omulala, nga bunnyonnyolwa ne ‘nnyiriri ez’obukakafu’ ez’enjawulo. Wabula, nzikiriza nti Ebyawandiikibwa binaawagirwa obumanyirivu, wadde nga tebyetaaga kukakasibwa. Bwe mba neebuuza ensonga lwaki Mukama yampeeredde omukisa mungi bw’atyo mu bumanyirivu bwe njogeddeko, ntuuse ku kutegeera okw’amaanyi okw’olugendo lw’okukkiriza, olunnyonnyola Abaebbulaniya 11 mu ngeri ennungi okusinga ennyonnyola endala ze nfunye. Kirabika lwatu nti yankulembera okuva ku ‘jjinja ery’okulinnyako’ okutuuka ku ‘jjinja eddala ery’okulinnyako,’ nga yagateekateeka nga sinnaba kutuukayo. Kino tekyabaawo lwa ‘kukkiriza’ kwange okunene, wadde okuddamu okw’obulamu bwange obw’okusaba okw’amaanyi, kubanga sisobola kwewaana kimu ku ebyo. Mu butuufu, kitono nnyo kye nsanga mu mpisa y’Omukristaayo ekinjawulako abakkiriza abalala abasinga obungi, okuggyako okwewaayo kwange okujjuvu okwagala Katonda by’ayagala mu bulamu bwange n’obukakafu nti anankulemberanga mu by’ayagala. Okusaba, kwe nnasooka okwogera awali Bridgend Rugby Field, kufuuse okukaaba kwange okutayogerwa. Mpulidde okukkiriza nga kunnyonnyolwa mu ngeri nnyingi: kwe kukkiriza, kwe kwesiga, kwe kwesigama, era kwe kulangirira. Ababuulizi batukubirizza okuba n’‘okukkiriza okusingawo!’ Abamu bagamba nti ensonga lwaki bangi balwadde, baavu, oba tebayimirira bulungi, y’okuba nti tebalina kukkiriza kumala. Ddala, abamu bakigeraageranya n’ekibi! Kya mazima nti ‘awatali kukkiriza, tekisoboka kusanyusa Katonda’ (Abaebbulaniya 11:6), naye ka tutegeere okukkiriza kye kiri. Mu njigiriza y’abantu bangi, waliwo olusalo oluwewuka nnyo wakati w’okukkiriza n’okuteekateeka Katonda ky’anaakola. Okusinziira ku Strong’s Exhaustive Concordance, ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani, ‘pistis’ kivvuunulwa nga ‘okukkiriza’ emirundi egisukka mu 225. ‘Oligopistos’ kisangibwa emirundi ena nga kitegeeza ‘okubulwa obwesige’ (mu Kristo). Kya njawulo nti ‘Elpis,’ ekitera okuvvuunulwa nga ‘essuubi’ (mu butuufu ‘okusuubira n’obwegombe’), kivvuunulwa nga ‘okukkiriza’ mu Abaebbulaniya 10:23. Bwe nsoma Ebyawandiikibwa, nsanga engeri ssatu ez’okukkiriza: 1. Waliwo ekiyinza okuyitibwa okukkiriza okulokola. ‘Kubanga olw’ekisa mwalokolebwa olw’okukkiriza; era ekyo si mmwe: kirabo kya Katonda’ (Abaefeso 2:8). Katonda mu kusaasira kwe okungi atuuse eri omuntu ng’ayita mu Mwana we, Yesu Kristo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu amubikkulira gye tuli era atuwa ekirabo eky’okukkiriza, n’atusobozesa okuddamu nga tukkiriza era nga tumanya Katonda. Tewaali kye tuyinza okukola okusaanira oba okufuna okubikkulirwa kuno. Akola mu buyinza bwe ng’eyeeraga yekka. Ku Lusozi Kerumooni, Yesu bwe yabuuza abayigirizwa be nti, ‘Mmwe mugamba nti ndi ani?’ Peetero yayinza okuddamu nti, ‘Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda Omulamu.’ Yesu n’amuddamu nti, ‘Oli wa mukisa, Simooni omwana wa Yona! Kubanga kino tekyakubikkulirwa mubiri na musaayi, wabula Kitange ali mu ggulu’ (Matayo 16:13-17). Kuno kwe kukkiriza okutegeera era okwaniriza ekirabo eky’obulokozi ekiri mu Kristo Yesu. Olw’okukkiriza kuno, tutuuka okumanya nti ebibi byaffe bisonyiyiddwa era nga tulina obumu ne Kitaffe. Ffe ‘abaana abato’ aboogerwako mu 1 Yokaana 2:12-13. Nkakasiza mu nnaku nti Abakristaayo bangi nnyo be nsisinkanye tebaakulaakulana kusukka mutindo guno ogw’okukkiriza. 2. Eky’okubiri, waliwo ekibala eky’okukkiriza. ‘Naye ekibala ky’Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, obukkakkamu, obulungi, okukkiriza…’ (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23). Ng’ebibala byonna, okukkiriza kwetaaga ekiseera okukula. Kibala ekigenda kikula ekisangibwa mu bulamu bw’abo bokka abakula mu lugendo lwabwe olw’Ekikristaayo. Zabbuli 1:3 egamba nti omuntu omutuukirivu ali ‘ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’emigga gy’amazzi, ogubala ebibala byagwo mu biseera byagwo.’ Amaanyi gaffe tugaggya mu migga gy’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era olwo lwennyini bwe tubeera mu ye ebibala ng’ebyo we binaakulira mu bulamu bwaffe. Bwe ndowooza ku bibala ebyogerwako mu Abaggalatiya 5:22-23, nkwatibwa enkulaakulana yaabyo. Kirabika nga bwe bigenda mu maaso bwe bigenda bifuuka ebitalabikalabika oba ebitasangika mangu mu bulamu bwaffe. Kumpi abakkiriza abaggya bonna bawa obujulizi ku kwagala, essanyu n’emirembe ebiggya bye baafuna mu kukyuka kwabwe. Kino kirabika nga ke kalengo ku ekyo Mukama ky’atuteekedde ffenna. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera, essanyu ery’olubereberye lizikkirira, ne wandaawo omutendera ogw’okuyigiriza obuyigirizwa ogw’okukula okw’ekibala ekigumira. Ku ludda olulala, okukkiriza, obuwombeefu n’okwefuga bya bbeeyi; ne Pawulo yennyini yawa obujulizi ku kulwana kwe yamanya mu kwefuga (Abaruumi 7:15-25). 3. Waliwo ekirabo eky’okukkiriza. ‘…omulala n’aweebwa okukkiriza mu Mwoyo omu…’ (1 Abakkolinso 12:9). Nga bwe kiri ku birabo byonna eby’omwoyo (charismata) ebyogerwako mu ssuula eno ne mu Abaruumi 12:6-9, okukkiriza kuweebwa olw’okuzimba ekkanisa yonna. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akozesa ekirabo kino ng’ayita mu buli gw’ayagala era mu kiseera kyonna ky’ayagala. Omuntu taba na kirabo kino nga kikye; akikozesa mu kiseera lwe kiweebwa. Si kya bakulembeze bokka oba abo abakuze; buli mukkiriza ayinza okukozesebwa mu ngeri eno okuzzaamu abalala amaanyi. Kikozesebwa Mukama bw’ayagala okutuzzaamu amaanyi ng’abantu okukumira mu maaso newankubadde nga ebintu bizibu. Engeri zonna essatu ez’okukkiriza ensibuko yaazo eri mu Katonda. Akola mu buyinza bwe ng’ateeka okukkiriza mu mitima gy’abantu, era ng’akulabirira kukule. Kye nsobola okukola kwe kwewaayo eri omulimu gwe mu bulamu bwange n’okukola mu buwulize eri ekigambo kye n’okunkubiriza kwe. Obuwulize buno kwe kuddamu kw’okwesiga nti ekigambo kye kya mazima. N’olwekyo, gye ndi, ‘olugendo lw’okukkiriza’ kwe lugendo Mukama mw’ankulembera nange ne mmugoberera, oluusi nga mmanyi naye emirundi mingi nga simanyi. Ebiseera ebimu akyusa ekkubo lyange ng’ayita mu mbeera oba mu ‘nteekateeka za Katonda.’ Tekyetaagisa nti nnoonye okumanya obulagirizi bwe oba by’ayagala ku bulamu bwange ebweru w’ebyo by’amaze okwatula mu Bayibuli. Kitange annyagala nnyo okusinga okuzannya n’enneewulira zange. Tampita kukola by’ayagala n’oluvannyuma n’ankweka by’ayagala mu ‘nteekateeka enzibu’ ezikwekeddwa mu Ggulu. Tandalikiriza ng’ankaka okuzuula by’ayagala ng’ayita mu ssaawa nnyingi ez’okusaba n’okwegayirira, nga ntya nti nnyinza okukola ensobi eneenvaako okugwa okuva mu by’ayagala ne mu kisa kye; wabula asuubira nti ntambulire mu by’ayagala okutuuka we bikoma nga Bayibuli bw’abyatula. Olwo anankulembera mu by’ayagala ebinaanjeekera ng’ayita mu mbeera oba mu ‘nzigi enzigule’ z’ateeka mu maaso gange. Kye nteekwa okukola kwokka kwe kunywerera ku mukono gwe. Neegomba by’ayagala Katonda mu bulamu bwange nga Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw’awandiika nti, ‘Ng’empeewo bw’eyaayaanira amazzi, bw’atyo emmeeme yange bw’ekuyaayaanira, Ayi Katonda’ (Zabbuli 42:1). Katonda yeegomba by’ayagala mu bulamu bwange! Kale, ani oba kiki ekiyinza okukiziyiza? Ddala nzikiriza nti Setaani alina obuyinza okuziyiza Katonda okutuukiriza by’ayagala? Mmanyi nti bulijjo anoonya engeri y’okuzikiriza omwana wa Katonda yenna, okubaggya mu by’ayagala Katonda, naye guli mulimu gwa Kitange okunkuuma — si gwange. Nnina ekifaananyi kyange nga ntambula ku kkubo ery’oku mabbali nga nnywereye ku mukono gwa Kitange. Nze naye twogera era tussaawo obumu. Simanyi gy’ayinza okuntwala leero, oboolyawo eri essanyu ery’oluggya lw’ebiwoomerera by’obulamu, so nga enkya ayinza okuntwala eri omusawo w’amannyo! Ntambulidde ku kkubo lino ekiseera ekiwanvu okumala okumanya nti bwe njagala okumala ebbanga eddene mu ‘maduuka g’ebiwoomerera’ ag’obulamu, Kitange mazima ddala ateekwa okuntwala eri omusawo w’amannyo mu kiseera ekimu! Kyava akkiriza okuzibu n’ennaku okujja mu bulamu bwaffe, kubanga amanyi nti eyo y’engeri yokka gye tuli okukulira. Nzijukira nti Omulokozi waffe ‘yatuukirizibwa ng’ayita mu kubonaabona’ (Abaebbulaniya 2:10). Ayinza okunserengetya mu kiwonvu ekimu ekkika, naye era njize nti buli kiwonvu kitwala ku nsozi, era ng’ekiwonvu bwe kikka wansi, n’olusozi bwe luli waggulu ennyo. Bw’oba oyagala okulaba obusika obw’oku ntikko y’olusozi ne Mukama, oteekwa okutambula olugendo lw’okukkiriza ng’oyita mu kiwonvu. Oluusi, ng’omwana yenna, nsanyaalatibwa ekintu ekiri emitala w’ekkubo ne nziggya amaaso ku Kitange, ne mpita mu kkubo. Kino kye kiseera Setaani ky’abadde alindirira. Akoleeza yingini y’‘eloole ye ey’ettani kkumi’ n’atandika okunnumba okunsesebbula! Naye nga tannatuuka, Kitange ow’amagezi era ow’okufaayo ampalambya n’anzizaayo ku kkubo ery’oku mabbali wamu naye. Si ky’ayagala nti nzikirire, era si kukkiriza kwange okunene okundokodde, wadde okukkiriza kwonna kwe neefunira nzekka, wabula bwe budeddangamu bwe. Ekyange kyokka kwali okwegomba okw’amaanyi okunywerera ku mukono gwe (okutambula mu by’ayagala) n’okwewaayo mu buwulize eri obulagirizi bwe. Gye ndi, okwo kwe kukkiriza. Abaebbulaniya 11:1 annyonnyola okukkiriza nga ‘obwesimbu obw’ebintu bye tusuubira; obukakafu obw’ebintu bye tutalaba.’ Ekigambo eky’olubereberye kyogera gye ndi ku kirabo, ate ekigambo eky’oluvannyuma, ku kibala. Ffenna twamanya kye kitegeeza okusuubira ekirabo ku lunaku olw’amazaalibwa oba ku Ssekukkulu. Tuba n’okusuubira okunene ennyo okukifuna, okutuusa ekirabo lwe kifuuka kyaffe okukikwatako. Twalina essuubi, kaakano tulina obwesimbu. Ekigambo eky’okubiri, ‘obukakafu obw’ebintu bye tutalaba,’ kyogera ku kibala. Omuntu tasobola kulaba nsibuko yaakyo — omubisi ogukulukuta — naye obukakafu obw’obulamu bulabikira mu kibala. Olunyiriri olw’okubiri lugamba nti ‘olw’okukkiriza, abantu baasobola okuwa obujulizi obulungi.’ Nzikiriza nti olugero lwange lubadde bujulizi bulungi ku bulagirizi bwa Katonda obw’obwesigwa. Singa teyanjjululanga okuva mu bumanyirivu okudda mu bumanyirivu obulala, sandibadde na kya kwogera kitono ku bulamu bwange ekiyinza okumuwa ekitiibwa. Olunyiriri olw’okusatu lugamba nti olw’okukkiriza, tusobola okutegeera ekitategeerekeka. Si na kumanya kwa ssaayansi, wabula n’obukakafu obw’emmeeme obuva mu kubikkulirwa okuva eri Katonda. Wabaawo olukalala lw’ebyokulabirako okutulaga engeri Katonda gye yateeka olugalo lwe mu bulamu bw’abasajja n’abakazi ab’edda okubasobozesa okutambula ng’ebyo by’ayagala ku bo ne ku ffe bwe biri. Abantu bano mwe mwali abatemu, abalimba, ab’okubuusabuusa, wamu n’abakkiriza n’abaafiira obukakafu. Bonna tebaali bawanguzi oba bazira olw’okuba baalina okukkiriza okunene, wabula ebyafaayo byabwe byawandiikirwa ffe tulyoke tunyweze amasomo Katonda g’ayagala tuyige ku lugendo lwaffe ffe olw’okukkiriza. Nga bwe ntegeera, essuubi ery’omu Bayibuli, ‘elpis,’ elitegeeza ‘okusuubira n’obwegombe,’ likwatagana n’okukkiriza n’okwesiga. Mu Luyonaani, ‘okukkiriza,’ kwe ‘pistis’ era kusingira ddala okukwatagana n’okuwulira. Ddala, nnandinnyonnyodde okukkiriza ng’engeri ey’omutima, erabikira mu buwulize, ate essuubi nga ngeri ya kutegeera, erabikira mu bwesige.

fields.title: Hazelglen Fellowship
fields.body_html:
Hazelglen Fellowship yali mu Kitchener - kilomita 100 ebugwanjuba bwa Toronto. Yali emaze emyaka egisukka mu abiri nga gyaliwo, naye si bulijjo lwe yalaba abantu abasukka mu asatu mu kkanisa yaayo. Mu mwaka oguyise, omusumba omunyiikivu yali alabye abavubuka bangi nga bajja mu kkanisa, abasinga obungi nga tebalina musingi munene mu Bukristaayo. Abakadde abasatu baali bakyali mu myaka egy'amakumi asatu, era mu kkanisa mwalimu 'abakugu' babiri bokka, bombi nga basomesa b'abajjanjabi. Abasinga obungi tebaalina mirimu.

Wadde nga mu mwaka ogwayita waaliwo obuzibu obumu, ab'ekkanisa baatwaniriza n'ekisa. Mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka, waaliwo emirundi mingi lwe twebuuza lwaki Katonda yali atuleese eyo. Tewaali maka ga bantu bakulu abalina abaana ab'ekiyaayaana, gye twali tuyinza okussanga ekkanisa ffe n'abaana baffe abawala. Anne yayita mu kulwana kungi okutuusa lwe yakkiriza nti obanga Katonda yali ampise eyo - ky'ataabuusabuusanga - era yalina n'ekigendererwa mu ye n'abawala okubeera eyo; naye ate, ekkanisa eno yali nnungi gye ndi ng'omusumba omuggya, kubanga ddala yali 'kibiina ky'abavubuka' ekyakuŋŋaananga ku Ssande. Anne yabuuzibwa lumu enkyukakyuka ki ezaali mu bulamu bwaffe kaakati nga ndi musumba. N'addamu nti, “Tewali n'akamu. Kaakati akola obudde bwonna kye yali akola bulijjo mu budde bwe obw'okuwummula edda!”

Nnina ebijjukizo ebirungi bingi eby'emyaka gyaffe ena mu Kitchener, naye olw'okuba ng'olugero luno lukwata ku 'mayinja ag'okulinnyako' agatutuusa mu mbeera gye tuli kaakati, birituusa okutegeezebwa mu kiseera ekirala. Kyokka, bwe ndowooza ku ngeri Katonda gy'atuluŋŋamyamu, kiŋŋwanira okwogera ku kye nnayita mu mwaka ogusooka. Buli Lwakusatu ku makya, nnandanga okunoonya kye nnali nzikiririza nti Katonda ayagala mbuulire mu ssaawa yange emu ku Ssande. Mu kiseera ekyo okukuŋŋaana kwali okuva ku ssaawa munaana ez'olweggulo okutuuka ku ssaawa kkumi na bbiri buli Ssande: essaawa emu ey'okusinza, endala ey'okuyigiriza, endala ey'okulya wamu ekijjulo eky'obwesangibwa, n'endala ey'okulya Ekyokulya kya Mukama. Mu kiseera eky'okusinza, ab'ekkanisa baayinzanga okukulembera oluyimba lw'okusinza oba okusoma Ekyawandiikibwa. Buli Charlie, omu ku bakadde, lwe yayimuka okusoma Ekyawandiikibwa, nnasanyukanga. Emirundi egiwera mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka yasomanga Ebyawandiikibwa ebyetooloola ekyawandiikibwa kye nnali nnonze okubuulirako ku lunaku olwo, wadde nga tewaali ngeri gye yandimanyiddemu nga tannaba, wabula Mukama nga ye yamuluŋŋamya, era bw'atyo n'anduŋŋamya nange mu kwetegeka kwange! Osobola okulowooza engeri kino gye kyampa obuvumu okubuulira ekyali kya lwatu nti kye kigambo kya Mukama ku makya ago.

Kyali mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka lwe nnawulira ku “Wham!” oba bwe ntyo bwe nnalowooza nti bwe kiri! Rob ne Tim baali bavubuka babiri balungi abaali baakadda mu kkanisa oluvannyuma lw'okumala emyezi egiwera mu 'The Ark' mu Amsterdam. Baali bakolera mu bamalaaya n'ekibinja ky'abasajja abeegatta ne bannaabwe mu kibuga ekyo. Baŋŋamba nti 'The Ark' yali buweereza bwa YWAM - Youth With A Mission. Bwe nnalaga nti nnyongedde okwagala okumanya, nnaweebwa ekifo eky'ofiisi enkulu eya Canada eyali kilomita 10 zokka mu Cambridge, Ontario. Bwe kityo, wiiki ng'eyise, nnali ntudde mu ofiisi ya Uli Korsch, omukulembeze wa YWAM mu Canada, nga nsanyukira entandikwa y'obwe nnywanyi obulungi bwe twali tugenda okukola. Yaŋŋamba ku nnaku ez'edda ez'ekibiina kino, omutandisi waakyo Loren Cunningham, n'ebigendererwa byakyo n'ebyakyo bye kyayitamu.

Oluvannyuma lw'omwaka ogwo ogusooka, twakyusa enteekateeka y'okusinza kwaffe okutuuka ku ssaawa bbiri ku makya ga Ssande, nga tukyagenda mu maaso okussa essira ku kusinza n'ekigambo ekibuulirwa. Omuwendo gwaffe gwatandika okweyongera era amaka ag'abantu abakulu ne geegatta ku kkanisa. Emirundi egiwera twafuna obuweereza okuva mu bibinja bya YWAM; oluyimba lwabwe olwamanyibwa ennyo, “Toymaker and Son” lwayolesebwa ku ttwale ly'ekkanisa yaffe mu maaso g'ekibiina ekinene. Ku mulundi omulala abayizi 15 aba YWAM okuva Arkansas baamala wiiki nnya nga babeera era nga bakolera mu kkanisa yaffe... era ne tweyongera okukula. Sisobola kwetwalira kitiibwa kya kukula okuggyako nti nnakkiriza 'empungu okubuuka.' Ron Smith yalina omugugu gw'okusaba, era ye yatuyigiriza 'okuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda' n'okusaba ekyali ku mutima gwe ne kifuuka ekituufu. Osobola okusoma ebisingawo ku Ron n'engeri gye yakwatamu ekkanisa mu kitabo kyange ekirala, “Soar Like the Eagle.” Kyali nga tuli mu Hazelglen Fellowship lwe nnayitibwa mu buweereza obw'enjawulo. Vincent Cheah yali muyizi Omumalaysia mu yunivasite ey'omu kitundu era omulabirizi w'ekibinja ekinene eky'Abakristaayo Abamalaysia abaali basoma mu makoleji ne yunivasite ez'enjawulo mu Ontario. Yannyita okufuuka chaplain waabwe, obuweereza obusanyusa nnyo mu bavubuka abo ab'omuwendo. Nnabakubiranga emyeeteano mu Toronto, ne nkulembera olusiisira olw'ekyeya, era ne mbeegattako ku mikolo egy'enjawulo (gamba ng'ebijjulo eby'obwesangibwa). Oluusi baakuŋŋaananga mu Kitchener ne basula mu kyaggwa ky'ennyumba yaffe. Twali tetumanyi bwe baali bagenda okututwala mu mitima gyabwe olw'obwaniriza bwaffe, n'engeri abayizi bano gye baali bagenda okuba ab'obuyinza mu nsi yaabwe oluvannyuma.

Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka esatu, ffenna twamanya nti kaakati kye kiseera eky'okuzimba ekifo ky'okusinza ekisingako obunene. Lwali lunaku olw'ebbugumu era olw'obunnyogovu mu biseera eby'ekyeya mu Ontario, era nnali nnyimiridde ku kaveranda akatono ku mulyango ogw'omu maaso ogw'ekkanisa nga njogera n'omu ku baali baakajja mu kkanisa yaffe, Bill Williams. Nnamanya nti Bill yali yaakalwadde omutima era olw'ekyo yali yeeyawudde ku bimu ku bikolwa bye ebirala n'atandika okuddayo mu kkanisa. Bwe twatandika okwogera ku kwetaaga eky'ekizimbe ekirala, nnamugamba ku kunoonyereza kwe nnali nkoze ku nsaasaanya omulimu ng'ogwo bwe gwandyetaaze. “Tewali ngeri gye tuyinza kugusobola” bwe ntyo bwe nnagamba. Bill n'addamu nti, “Bwe kityo bwe kiri, tuteekwa okukyezimbira ffennyini!” Nnatandika okuseka okutuusa lwe nnategeera nti yali ayogera n'amazima. “Tuyinza tutya okukizimba?” bwe nnabuuza. “Tewali n'omu ku ffe amanyi ku by'okuzimba.” Nnewuunya bwe yaŋŋamba nti okumala emyaka mingi yali ye mulabirizi w'abakozi b'ebizimbe mu kitundu ekyo ekya Ontario, mu kyetooloola eky'obuwanvu obusukka mu mayilo 100! Eno ye nsonga lwaki Mukama yamuleeta mu kkanisa yaffe? Bwe kiba nga bwe kityo, guno gwali gwokka gw'ebyamagero bingi bye twalaba mu myezi egyaddirira nga tuzimba. Abavubuka baatwewuunyisa bwe baagaba n'omutima gwabwe gwonna okuwa ssente ez'okuzimba ekizimbe kino ekiggya, era ne tulaba n'ekitiibwa Katonda ng'akola ekyamagero oluvannyuma lw'ekyamagero ekirala.

Enteekateeka z'okuzimba zaaweebwayo bwereere, era ekinnya ekinene eky'ekyaggwa kyaffe kyasimibwa muganda waffe Omukristaayo eyalina yingini y'okusima. Twagula amatoffaali ga ssentaŋŋi ku muwendo ogutatuuka na kitundu kya muwendo gwago okuva mu kkampuni eyali egenda okuggalawo, nga buli limu Bill nange twalikwatako nga tugatambuza okuva mu dduuka okugatuusa ku kifo kyaffe! Twali twetegese okwezingako emikono okutandika okuteeka emisingi ng'essimu ejja mu wiiki eyo okuva eri muliraanwa, ng'ambuuza kye twali tugenda okuzimba. Ye nange twali twatuulanga wamu mu nkuŋŋaana z'akakiiko k'ekitundu nga twogera ku byetaago by'abantu b'ekitundu.

Bwe nnamugamba enteekateeka zaffe ez'okuzimba ekkanisa erimu ekifo ky'okuzannyiramu abavubuka b'ekitundu bye baayinza okukozesa, yambuuza ani eyali agenda okuba omuzimbi waffe. Nnali kumpi okuwulira enseko ye bwe nnamugamba nti twali tugenda kwezimbira ekkanisa ffennyini. Ku Lwamukaaga olwaddirira, yatuuka ku kifo n'abakozi bannaawe kkumi na bataano - bonna nga bazimbi b'amayinja. Yali muwandiisi w'ekibiina ky'abazimbi b'amayinja mu kitundu, era yali asendasenze abasajja bano okututeekera emisingi n'okutuzimbira ebisenge by'ekyaggwa kyaffe!

Baakolera naffe wamu wiikendi bbiri awatali kusasulwa - wadde nga, mazima ddala, twasanyuka okubawa ebirabo ebitono olw'ekisa kyabwe n'emmere mingi eya chilli con carne, coca cola ne aayisi kkiriimu!

Nga 1982 gunaatera okuggwaako twali tumaze okuzimba ekifo ky'okusinza ekirungi ekyatuuza abantu 250, nga waansi waalyo waaliwo ekisenge ekinene eky'okwewummuliramu n'effumbiro eryatereezebwamu ebintu byonna ebyetaagisa.

Ekizimbe kyamalirizibwa bulungi era kyalimu ettaala ez'omukaziko, entebe ennungi ez'okuwummuliramu, ne piyaano ennene! Emirimu gyonna kumpi twagikola ffennyini, nga Bill y'alabirira, era gyandisasuliddwa gyonna mu myaka esatu egyandiddiridde. Naye saali wa kubaawo kukiraba! Ku ntandikwa ya Marisi 1983, nnafuna essimu okuva Victoria, British Columbia, nga bambuuza obanga nnandirowoozezaako ku 'kuyitibwa' okuba omusumba wa Sidney Alliance Church ku kizinga ekirungi ekya Vancouver Island. Oluvannyuma lw'okusaba kungi n'okulowooza ku bigenda mu maaso bya Hazelglen Fellowship, twasiibula mikwano gyaffe egy'omu Kitchener ne tweteekateeka okutambula okwongera ebugwanjuba.
fields.body_text: Hazelglen Fellowship yali mu Kitchener - kilomita 100 ebugwanjuba bwa Toronto. Yali emaze emyaka egisukka mu abiri nga gyaliwo, naye si bulijjo lwe yalaba abantu abasukka mu asatu mu kkanisa yaayo. Mu mwaka oguyise, omusumba omunyiikivu yali alabye abavubuka bangi nga bajja mu kkanisa, abasinga obungi nga tebalina musingi munene mu Bukristaayo. Abakadde abasatu baali bakyali mu myaka egy'amakumi asatu, era mu kkanisa mwalimu 'abakugu' babiri bokka, bombi nga basomesa b'abajjanjabi. Abasinga obungi tebaalina mirimu. Wadde nga mu mwaka ogwayita waaliwo obuzibu obumu, ab'ekkanisa baatwaniriza n'ekisa. Mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka, waaliwo emirundi mingi lwe twebuuza lwaki Katonda yali atuleese eyo. Tewaali maka ga bantu bakulu abalina abaana ab'ekiyaayaana, gye twali tuyinza okussanga ekkanisa ffe n'abaana baffe abawala. Anne yayita mu kulwana kungi okutuusa lwe yakkiriza nti obanga Katonda yali ampise eyo - ky'ataabuusabuusanga - era yalina n'ekigendererwa mu ye n'abawala okubeera eyo; naye ate, ekkanisa eno yali nnungi gye ndi ng'omusumba omuggya, kubanga ddala yali 'kibiina ky'abavubuka' ekyakuŋŋaananga ku Ssande. Anne yabuuzibwa lumu enkyukakyuka ki ezaali mu bulamu bwaffe kaakati nga ndi musumba. N'addamu nti, “Tewali n'akamu. Kaakati akola obudde bwonna kye yali akola bulijjo mu budde bwe obw'okuwummula edda!” Nnina ebijjukizo ebirungi bingi eby'emyaka gyaffe ena mu Kitchener, naye olw'okuba ng'olugero luno lukwata ku 'mayinja ag'okulinnyako' agatutuusa mu mbeera gye tuli kaakati, birituusa okutegeezebwa mu kiseera ekirala. Kyokka, bwe ndowooza ku ngeri Katonda gy'atuluŋŋamyamu, kiŋŋwanira okwogera ku kye nnayita mu mwaka ogusooka. Buli Lwakusatu ku makya, nnandanga okunoonya kye nnali nzikiririza nti Katonda ayagala mbuulire mu ssaawa yange emu ku Ssande. Mu kiseera ekyo okukuŋŋaana kwali okuva ku ssaawa munaana ez'olweggulo okutuuka ku ssaawa kkumi na bbiri buli Ssande: essaawa emu ey'okusinza, endala ey'okuyigiriza, endala ey'okulya wamu ekijjulo eky'obwesangibwa, n'endala ey'okulya Ekyokulya kya Mukama. Mu kiseera eky'okusinza, ab'ekkanisa baayinzanga okukulembera oluyimba lw'okusinza oba okusoma Ekyawandiikibwa. Buli Charlie, omu ku bakadde, lwe yayimuka okusoma Ekyawandiikibwa, nnasanyukanga. Emirundi egiwera mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka yasomanga Ebyawandiikibwa ebyetooloola ekyawandiikibwa kye nnali nnonze okubuulirako ku lunaku olwo, wadde nga tewaali ngeri gye yandimanyiddemu nga tannaba, wabula Mukama nga ye yamuluŋŋamya, era bw'atyo n'anduŋŋamya nange mu kwetegeka kwange! Osobola okulowooza engeri kino gye kyampa obuvumu okubuulira ekyali kya lwatu nti kye kigambo kya Mukama ku makya ago. Kyali mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka lwe nnawulira ku “Wham!” oba bwe ntyo bwe nnalowooza nti bwe kiri! Rob ne Tim baali bavubuka babiri balungi abaali baakadda mu kkanisa oluvannyuma lw'okumala emyezi egiwera mu 'The Ark' mu Amsterdam. Baali bakolera mu bamalaaya n'ekibinja ky'abasajja abeegatta ne bannaabwe mu kibuga ekyo. Baŋŋamba nti 'The Ark' yali buweereza bwa YWAM - Youth With A Mission. Bwe nnalaga nti nnyongedde okwagala okumanya, nnaweebwa ekifo eky'ofiisi enkulu eya Canada eyali kilomita 10 zokka mu Cambridge, Ontario. Bwe kityo, wiiki ng'eyise, nnali ntudde mu ofiisi ya Uli Korsch, omukulembeze wa YWAM mu Canada, nga nsanyukira entandikwa y'obwe nnywanyi obulungi bwe twali tugenda okukola. Yaŋŋamba ku nnaku ez'edda ez'ekibiina kino, omutandisi waakyo Loren Cunningham, n'ebigendererwa byakyo n'ebyakyo bye kyayitamu. Oluvannyuma lw'omwaka ogwo ogusooka, twakyusa enteekateeka y'okusinza kwaffe okutuuka ku ssaawa bbiri ku makya ga Ssande, nga tukyagenda mu maaso okussa essira ku kusinza n'ekigambo ekibuulirwa. Omuwendo gwaffe gwatandika okweyongera era amaka ag'abantu abakulu ne geegatta ku kkanisa. Emirundi egiwera twafuna obuweereza okuva mu bibinja bya YWAM; oluyimba lwabwe olwamanyibwa ennyo, “Toymaker and Son” lwayolesebwa ku ttwale ly'ekkanisa yaffe mu maaso g'ekibiina ekinene. Ku mulundi omulala abayizi 15 aba YWAM okuva Arkansas baamala wiiki nnya nga babeera era nga bakolera mu kkanisa yaffe... era ne tweyongera okukula. Sisobola kwetwalira kitiibwa kya kukula okuggyako nti nnakkiriza 'empungu okubuuka.' Ron Smith yalina omugugu gw'okusaba, era ye yatuyigiriza 'okuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda' n'okusaba ekyali ku mutima gwe ne kifuuka ekituufu. Osobola okusoma ebisingawo ku Ron n'engeri gye yakwatamu ekkanisa mu kitabo kyange ekirala, “Soar Like the Eagle.” Kyali nga tuli mu Hazelglen Fellowship lwe nnayitibwa mu buweereza obw'enjawulo. Vincent Cheah yali muyizi Omumalaysia mu yunivasite ey'omu kitundu era omulabirizi w'ekibinja ekinene eky'Abakristaayo Abamalaysia abaali basoma mu makoleji ne yunivasite ez'enjawulo mu Ontario. Yannyita okufuuka chaplain waabwe, obuweereza obusanyusa nnyo mu bavubuka abo ab'omuwendo. Nnabakubiranga emyeeteano mu Toronto, ne nkulembera olusiisira olw'ekyeya, era ne mbeegattako ku mikolo egy'enjawulo (gamba ng'ebijjulo eby'obwesangibwa).
