fields.title: Sidney, B.C.
fields.body_html:
Ennaku bbiri nga sinnava mu Kitchener, nnali ntudde nga nnywa ekyokunywa ekinnyogovu ne Uli, ku kifo kya YWAM eky'e Cambridge. Twali twogera ku bintu ebingi ebirungi Mukama bye yali akoze mu bulamu bwaffe ffembi. Bwe twatandika okwogera ku nteekateeka ez'omu maaso, ne ŋŋamba nti, “Uli, bw'onooba weetaaga omuntu ow'okukwatagana naye ku lwa YWAM ku lubalama olw'ebugwanjuba, tobuusabuusa kumpita.” Saategeera nga okuyita okwo okwangu bwe kwandikoze ku biseera byaffe eby'omu maaso. Bagamba nti okuba Omukanada ow'amazima olina okukola ebintu bibiri; olina okwezimbira ennyumba yo era olina okutambula okuyita mu ggwanga lyonna. Nnali sizzimbye nnyumba yange, naye nnali ndabye ekkanisa nga ezimbibwa. Ndowooza nteekwa okuba nga nnakwatako buli jjinja ery'ezzimbe ne buli kipande ky'embaawo mu kizimbe ekyo, mu biseera eby'enjawulo! Kati kaali kiseera kya kuvuga nga tuyita mu kitundu kya Kanada ekisinga obunene.

Emmotoka ennene eya kupangisa yajjuzibwa ebintu byaffe byonna, emmotoka yaffe n'esibibwa n'ekintu eky'okusika, ne tutandika olugendo oluwanvu. Nga tuvuga ebirometa ebisukka mu bikumi bitaano buli lunaku, twatuuka e Sidney ku kizinga Vancouver Island, oluvannyuma lw'ennaku mukaaga. Twanirizibwa n'okwagala ab'ekkanisa entono, ne tutereera mangu mu mulimu omuggya. Sidney Alliance Church yali ttabi eryava mu kkanisa ey'e Victoria, ekibuga ekikulu ekya 'British Columbia ennungi.' Ab'ekkanisa baali bafaayo nnyo, nga baagala okutambulira mu buggya bw'ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu kye yali akola mu kitundu ekyo. Baali batadde 'omutendera gw'okukkiriza' nga bayita omusumba asasulwa omusaala okubalabirira, naye mangu ago ne kirabika nti omusingi gw'ensimbi ogw'ekkanisa gwali gwetaaga okwongerwako singa baali baakutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe. Ffenna twakola era ne tusaba nga tugendereza ekyo, naye oluvannyuma lw'emyezi esatu ne ndaba nti tunaatera okuyingira mu mbeera ey'okubulwa ensimbi. Nnalowooza okusaba omulimu gw'okuyigiriza ogw'ekiseera ekitono, olwo omusaala gwange, wadde nga mutono, guleme kuba muzigo eri ekkanisa. Kaali kawungeezi ka Ssande nga enkuba etonnya buto, era nnalina obulwadde bw'omutwe obutono. Anne yatwala abawala ku kkanisa endala kubanga tetwalina kukuŋŋaana kwa kawungeezi kwaffe ffe. Nnagenda okutambula ndyoke mmale ebiseera ebirala nga nsaba ku lw'embeera yaffe mu kkanisa. Oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika amakumi abiri, nnali ntuuse ku ntikko ya Bear Hill, ekifo eky'okwetegereza kye nnayagalanga ennyo. Tewaali muntu mulala yenna eyali ayinza okumpulira nga nkaabirira Mukama ampe obulagirizi bwe.

Nze siikkiriza mangu abantu bwe bagamba nti, “Mukama yaŋŋambye...” Bulijjo njagala okububuuza engeri gy'ayogeddemu nabo. Kinnyiiza nnyo naddala bwe bajja gy'oli okwebuuza ku magezi, naye ne basooka okwogera ku kwetaaga kwabwe nga bagamba nti “Mukama yaŋŋambye...” Nnyinza ntya okuwa amagezi agayinza okuba nga gakontana n'ekyo Mukama kye yagamba? Mazima ddala, nzikiriza nti Mukama ayogera naffe. Endiga zisaanidde okumanya eddoboozi lye. Wabula, obukakafu bungi obw'eddoboozi lya Katonda abantu bwe baagobereranga bunneeraliikiriza nnyo — era oluusi bukontana butereevu n'Ebyawandiikibwa. Ayogera mu ngeri nnyingi ez'enjawulo. Bear Hill kyali kimu ku biseera ebitali bya bulijjo lwe nnamuwulira ng'ayogera mu ddoboozi eritegeerekeka era eriwulikika!

“Totya! Nkuleese wano era nnaayongera okutuukiriza by'enjagala mu ggwe. Onoobeera mu kkanisa ey'e Sidney okutuusa lwe ndikuyita okugenda mu maaso. Olwo n'olabirira ekkanisa Victoria Alliance.” Nnawuniikirira! Eddoboozi lyali litegeerekeka nnyo era tewaali kubuusabuusa ku ekyo ekyayogerwa. Wabula, essuubi ery'okuba nti kinaatera okubaawo lyali ttono nnyo. Waaliwo abasumba basatu abaali mu kkanisa ennene ey'e Victoria mu kiseera ekyo, era omukulu wakati waabwe yali amaze omwaka gumu gwokka. Ate era eno yali ekkanisa ey'omu kibuga ekikulu, ate nze nnali naakayawulibwa era nga sirina kusomera mu ssomero ly'abasumba. Kyali kya lwatu nti wandiyiseewo emyaka mingi nga sinnasiimibwa okuba omusumba w'ekkanisa eyo. Wabula, eddoboozi lyali litegeerekeka nnyo bwe ntyo ne nva ku ntikko y'olusozi olwo nga nnina essanyu olw'okuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda, era n'emirembe nga mmanyi nti nnali wa kusigala mu Sidney Alliance Church ng'Ye anaatuwa bye twetaaga.

Saategeeza muntu yenna okuggyako Anne ku ekyo ekyabaawo akawungeezi ako ku Bear Hill, naye saawuniikirira nnyo oluvannyuma lw'omwezi gumu, amawulire bwe gaabuna ekibuga nti omusumba w'ekkanisa ey'e Victoria yali alangiridde okwesamba obuvunaanyizibwa bwe amangwago. Abasumba be yakolanga nabo nabo baali beeyabizza obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe era District Superintendent n'ayitibwa okuyamba akakiiko k'abakadde okunoonya omusumba omulala. Simanyi byonna ebyabaawo mu myezi egyaddirira, naye nnalwanagana n'okukemebwa okuleekaana ne mpuliza buli muntu nti nze nnali omusajja gwe baali banoonya! Mu kifo ky'ekyo, nze ne Anne twewala ekkanisa ey'omu kibuga wakati tuleme okukemebwa okuwaba embeera olwo abakadde balyoke bawulire nga banyweredde okumpita okuba omusumba waabwe.

Emyezi ena ne giyitawo nga sinnafuna essimu okuva ku District Superintendent waffe. “Gareth, Victoria Alliance Church bansabye nkuyite obeere omusumba waabwe. Wandyagadde ekifo ekyo?” Yeewuunya obwangu bwe nnaddamu, naye n'asingawo okwewuunya bwe namutegeeza nti nnali mmaze okumanya nti kino kigenda kubaawo, emyezi mingi emabega. Nnali mpulidde Mukama ng'ayogera naye nnali sikoze kintu kyonna okugezaako okukisobozesa okubaawo. Bw'ayogera, asobola ddala okutuukiriza ebigambo bye!

Mu Ssebutemba 1984, nnateekebwa okuba omusumba mu Victoria Alliance Church, nga wayiseewo omwaka gumu gwokka okuva lwe najja mu kkanisa yaabwe eya muwala ey'e Sidney. Wano kitugwanira okwongerako okutendereza n'okwagala abantu ab'e Sidney abaafuuka abawagizi baffe abasinga obunene mu myaka egyo. Okunyolwa kwabwe kwawangulwa okwagala kwe baatwagala n'okumanya nti Mukama yali mu nkyukakyuka eno. Bakyali mu mikwano gyaffe egy'oku lusegere n'abawagizi baffe ne kati oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi bwe gityo.

Bwe twatandika okwogera ku nteekateeka ez'omu maaso, ne ŋŋamba nti, “Uli, bw'onooba weetaaga omuntu ow'okukwatagana naye ku lwa YWAM ku lubalama olw'ebugwanjuba, tobuusabuusa kumpita.” Saategeera nga okuyita okwo okwangu bwe kwandikoze ku biseera byaffe eby'omu maaso. Bagamba nti okuba Omukanada ow'amazima olina okukola ebintu bibiri; olina okwezimbira ennyumba yo era olina okutambula okuyita mu ggwanga lyonna. Nnali sizzimbye nnyumba yange, naye nnali ndabye ekkanisa nga ezimbibwa. Ndowooza nteekwa okuba nga nnakwatako buli jjinja ery'ezzimbe ne buli kipande ky'embaawo mu kizimbe ekyo, mu biseera eby'enjawulo! Kati kaali kiseera kya kuvuga nga tuyita mu kitundu kya Kanada ekisinga obunene. Emmotoka ennene eya kupangisa yajjuzibwa ebintu byaffe byonna, emmotoka yaffe n'esibibwa n'ekintu eky'okusika, ne tutandika olugendo oluwanvu. Nga tuvuga ebirometa ebisukka mu bikumi bitaano buli lunaku, twatuuka e Sidney ku kizinga Vancouver Island, oluvannyuma lw'ennaku mukaaga. Twanirizibwa n'okwagala ab'ekkanisa entono, ne tutereera mangu mu mulimu omuggya. Sidney Alliance Church yali ttabi eryava mu kkanisa ey'e Victoria, ekibuga ekikulu ekya 'British Columbia ennungi.' Ab'ekkanisa baali bafaayo nnyo, nga baagala okutambulira mu buggya bw'ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu kye yali akola mu kitundu ekyo. Baali batadde 'omutendera gw'okukkiriza' nga bayita omusumba asasulwa omusaala okubalabirira, naye mangu ago ne kirabika nti omusingi gw'ensimbi ogw'ekkanisa gwali gwetaaga okwongerwako singa baali baakutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe. Ffenna twakola era ne tusaba nga tugendereza ekyo, naye oluvannyuma lw'emyezi esatu ne ndaba nti tunaatera okuyingira mu mbeera ey'okubulwa ensimbi. Nnalowooza okusaba omulimu gw'okuyigiriza ogw'ekiseera ekitono, olwo omusaala gwange, wadde nga mutono, guleme kuba muzigo eri ekkanisa. Kaali kawungeezi ka Ssande nga enkuba etonnya buto, era nnalina obulwadde bw'omutwe obutono. Anne yatwala abawala ku kkanisa endala kubanga tetwalina kukuŋŋaana kwa kawungeezi kwaffe ffe. Nnagenda okutambula ndyoke mmale ebiseera ebirala nga nsaba ku lw'embeera yaffe mu kkanisa. Oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika amakumi abiri, nnali ntuuse ku ntikko ya Bear Hill, ekifo eky'okwetegereza kye nnayagalanga ennyo. Tewaali muntu mulala yenna eyali ayinza okumpulira nga nkaabirira Mukama ampe obulagirizi bwe. Nze siikkiriza mangu abantu bwe bagamba nti, “Mukama yaŋŋambye...” Bulijjo njagala okububuuza engeri gy'ayogeddemu nabo. Kinnyiiza nnyo naddala bwe bajja gy'oli okwebuuza ku magezi, naye ne basooka okwogera ku kwetaaga kwabwe nga bagamba nti “Mukama yaŋŋambye...” Nnyinza ntya okuwa amagezi agayinza okuba nga gakontana n'ekyo Mukama kye yagamba? Mazima ddala, nzikiriza nti Mukama ayogera naffe. Endiga zisaanidde okumanya eddoboozi lye. Wabula, obukakafu bungi obw'eddoboozi lya Katonda abantu bwe baagobereranga bunneeraliikiriza nnyo — era oluusi bukontana butereevu n'Ebyawandiikibwa. Ayogera mu ngeri nnyingi ez'enjawulo. Bear Hill kyali kimu ku biseera ebitali bya bulijjo lwe nnamuwulira ng'ayogera mu ddoboozi eritegeerekeka era eriwulikika! “Totya! Nkuleese wano era nnaayongera okutuukiriza by'enjagala mu ggwe. Onoobeera mu kkanisa ey'e Sidney okutuusa lwe ndikuyita okugenda mu maaso. Olwo n'olabirira ekkanisa Victoria Alliance.” Nnawuniikirira! Eddoboozi lyali litegeerekeka nnyo era tewaali kubuusabuusa ku ekyo ekyayogerwa. Wabula, essuubi ery'okuba nti kinaatera okubaawo lyali ttono nnyo. Waaliwo abasumba basatu abaali mu kkanisa ennene ey'e Victoria mu kiseera ekyo, era omukulu wakati waabwe yali amaze omwaka gumu gwokka. Ate era eno yali ekkanisa ey'omu kibuga ekikulu, ate nze nnali naakayawulibwa era nga sirina kusomera mu ssomero ly'abasumba. Kyali kya lwatu nti wandiyiseewo emyaka mingi nga sinnasiimibwa okuba omusumba w'ekkanisa eyo. Wabula, eddoboozi lyali litegeerekeka nnyo bwe ntyo ne nva ku ntikko y'olusozi olwo nga nnina essanyu olw'okuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda, era n'emirembe nga mmanyi nti nnali wa kusigala mu Sidney Alliance Church ng'Ye anaatuwa bye twetaaga. Saategeeza muntu yenna okuggyako Anne ku ekyo ekyabaawo akawungeezi ako ku Bear Hill, naye saawuniikirira nnyo oluvannyuma lw'omwezi gumu, amawulire bwe gaabuna ekibuga nti omusumba w'ekkanisa ey'e Victoria yali alangiridde okwesamba obuvunaanyizibwa bwe amangwago. Abasumba be yakolanga nabo nabo baali beeyabizza obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe era District Superintendent n'ayitibwa okuyamba akakiiko k'abakadde okunoonya omusumba omulala. Simanyi byonna ebyabaawo mu myezi egyaddirira, naye nnalwanagana n'okukemebwa okuleekaana ne mpuliza buli muntu nti nze nnali omusajja gwe baali banoonya! Mu kifo ky'ekyo, nze ne Anne twewala ekkanisa ey'omu kibuga wakati tuleme okukemebwa okuwaba embeera olwo abakadde balyoke bawulire nga banyweredde okumpita okuba omusumba waabwe. Emyezi ena ne giyitawo nga sinnafuna essimu okuva ku District Superintendent waffe. “Gareth, Victoria Alliance Church bansabye nkuyite obeere omusumba waabwe. Wandyagadde ekifo ekyo?” Yeewuunya obwangu bwe nnaddamu, naye n'asingawo okwewuunya bwe namutegeeza nti nnali mmaze okumanya nti kino kigenda kubaawo, emyezi mingi emabega. Nnali mpulidde Mukama ng'ayogera naye nnali sikoze kintu kyonna okugezaako okukisobozesa okubaawo. Bw'ayogera, asobola ddala okutuukiriza ebigambo bye! Mu Ssebutemba 1984, nnateekebwa okuba omusumba mu Victoria Alliance Church, nga wayiseewo omwaka gumu gwokka okuva lwe najja mu kkanisa yaabwe eya muwala ey'e Sidney. Wano kitugwanira okwongerako okutendereza n'okwagala abantu ab'e Sidney abaafuuka abawagizi baffe abasinga obunene mu myaka egyo. Okunyolwa kwabwe kwawangulwa okwagala kwe baatwagala n'okumanya nti Mukama yali mu nkyukakyuka eno. Bakyali mu mikwano gyaffe egy'oku lusegere n'abawagizi baffe ne kati oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi bwe gityo.

fields.title: M/V Anastasis
fields.body_html:
Twamala emyaka munaana ku Victoria Alliance Church — emyaka emirungi mwe twafuna mikwano mingi emirungi ne tulaba omukono gwa Mukama nga gukola mu bulamu bw'abantu bangi. Nnatandika okwenyigira mu kibiina ky'abasumba (ministerium), era nga wayiseewo omwaka gumu, ne nnondebwa okuba omuwandiisi w'ekibiina ekyo. Buli mwezi twakuŋŋaananga okulya ekyemisana n'okugumyagana. Kyali mu biseera bya ttoggo eby'omwaka gwa 1985 lwe nnafuna essimu okuva e San Pedro, California.

Eyankubira essimu yambuuza oba nnali mpulidde ku kyombo ekiyitibwa M/V Anastasis. Nnamuddamu nti nedda, kwe kutandika okuntegeeza ku kyombo kino ekinene eky'ennyanja ekyali kigulibbwa Youth With A Mission. Ekirooto kyabwe kwali kutambula okutuuka mu bitundu by'ensi ebyetaaga, nga batwala abasawo, abazimbi, n'ebibinja by'ababuulizi b'enjiri. Kyali kyetaagisa okukola omulimu munene ku kyombo nga tekinnaba kutuukiriza ebiragiro by'obukuumi bw'abakuumi b'ennyanja ba Amerika, kwe baali bagenda okukireeta mu dry docks e Victoria. “Omukugu waffe omukulu ow'ebyuma, John Brignall, ajja kubeera e Victoria ku Lwakubiri,” eyankubira essimu bwe yagamba. “Oyinza okutuyamba ng'oteekateeka omuntu okumusanga ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi n'okumutwala mu graving docks?” Nnamuddamu nti nzija kusanyuka okukikola nze kennyini, kale ku Lwakubiri olw'omu wiiki eyaddirira, ne ntandika omukwano gwange ogw'ekiseera ekiwanvu ne John Brignall ne Anastasis.

Ekyombo bwe kyasembayo okutuuka e Victoria mu Sebuttemba 1985, nze nnali omuntu ow'olubereberye okulinnya ku kyombo. John yanguwa okuntegeeza ku maka ge, ne mikwano gye egiwerako, era n'oluvannyuma, Don Stephens, omutandisi era Pulezidenti wa Mercy Ships. Don yali wa kisa nnyo mu kunnyaniriza ku kyombo, n'atandika okuntegeeza ebirooto bye ku kiseera Anastasis kw'anaabeera e Victoria, ekiseera kye yasuubira okuba emyezi esatu oba ena.

“Tujja kwetaaga ebifo by'ofiisi ebiriko essimu,” bwe yagamba, “n'ekifo eky'okwezannyiza (gymnasium) ebibinja byaffe eby'emizannyo mwe biyinza okwegezaamu.” “Obirina,” ne nnyanukula, “Ekkanisa yaffe eggule gy'oli.” Bwe yambuuza oba waaliwo olukalala lw'ennamba z'essimu z'abasumba b'omu kitundu, ne mmutegeeza ku kifo kyange eky'obuwandiisi bw'ekibiina, nga nnina mu ofiisi yange byonna bye yali yeetaaga. Mu butonde yasanyuka nnyo! Amakanisa gaaniriza Don n'abakozi be n'ekisa, omukwano gwaffe ne gukula, era ne mmanyibwa nga 'omusajja waabwe ow'emirembe' (Lukka 10:6). Abakozi bonna beenyigira mu makanisa g'omu kitundu, nga tebabuukabuuka nga banoonya eryo lye baagala okusinga, wabula nga banywerera ku kkanisa emu. Ekkanisa yaffe yaweebwa omukisa mungi olw'okubaawo kw'amaka ga Brignall n'abalala nga kkumi abajjanga bulijjo. Ekiseera bwe kyeyongera okuva ku myezi mitono egyasuubirwa okutuuka ku myezi kkumi n'ena emiramba, abakozi ne batandika okuwulira nti Victoria ge maka gaabwe — era ffenna twawulira bwe tutyo.

Mu Novemba 1986, Anastasis eyali yaakaweebwa layisinsi era nga ewandiisiddwa mu Lloyds, yava e Victoria okutandika obuweereza bwayo. Lwali lunaku lwa mpewo nnyingi nnyo, naye emitima gyaffe gyali gyokya nga tuyimba ennyimba z'okusiibula. Nze ne Anne twali tuyitiddwa okuseeyeeyera n'ekyombo okutuuka ku mwalo gwakyo ogw'olubereberye.

Guno gwali mukisa gwa kikula ogw'okukyala mu Olympia, ekibuga ekikulu eky'essaza erya Washington eririraanye, mu Amerika. Nga wayiseewo wiiki emu, kyali kiseera kyaffe okuwa okugwa mu kifuba n'okunywegera emikwano mingi gye twali tufunye, nga bo bagoba amaato nga bagenda ku bukiikaddyo okutuuka e Mexico n'abo abaali beetaaga ab'eggwanga eryo. Tetwalowooza nti M/V Anastasis yali agenda kufuuka kitundu kya maanyi eky'ebiseera eby'omu maaso Mukama bye yali atuteekerateekera. Ekyo nga tekinnaba kubaawo, waaliwo amayinja g'okulinnyako amalala abiri Mukama ge yalina okututeekera mu maaso. Awatali gano, tetwandisobodde kugoberera bulagirizi bwe bwe yatuyita oluvannyuma.

Bwe twatuuka mu Canada mu 1975, twajja nga 'bannamawanga abakkiriziddwa okubeera' (landed immigrants) nga tulina eddembe erifaanagana kumpi n'ery'omutuuze yenna ow'eggwanga. Twasobola okulonda naye tetwasobola kwesimbawo mu bwapaalamende. Twasanyukira okubeera mu ggwanga lino eddungi era twali twenyumiririza okuyitibwa 'Bannakanada.' (Bannakanada Abawelusi!!) Kyokka, ekimu ku bizibu by'okuba omuntu akkiriziddwa okubeera mu ggwanga kiri nti oyinza okubeera ebweru w'eggwanga mu kiseera kimu okumala ekkomo ery'emyezi mukaaga. Bw'obeera ebweru okusingawo ku ekyo, kyetaagisa okuddamu okusaba obwannamawanga — era ekyo si kya kakasa.

Bwe nnasooka okuyingira mu Canada, nnali nnina omulimu ogunywevu gwe nnali ndaga ku ne sipoonsa ku Toronto French School. Kyali kijja kutuuka ekiseera lwe ssaalina nsimbi ziyingira wadde obukwakkulizo bwonna bwe nnandiwadde ofiisi y'abasenguse. Mu kiseera ekifaanana ng'ekyo, kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okuddamu okuyingira mu Canada wadde nga nnalina amaka e Victoria era nga bawala baffe baali babeera eyo.

Mazima ddala, ssaali ndowooza ku kino mu 1989 muwala waffe omuto, Lynette, bwe yali ateekateeka embaga ye ey'obugole ne Phillip, Omuwositureeliya, era ng'ayagala okuva mu Canada okugenda okubeera 'down under' (mu Awusiteraliya). Yayagala okufuuka omutuuze wa Canada ng'embaga ye tennatuuka, olwo singa yali ayagadde okudda mu Canada, yandisobodde okukikola. Nze ne Anne tetwakifiirako nnyo naye ne tusalawo nti kyandibadde kirungi gye tuli okukola kye kimu. Tetwalaba kiseera kyonna kye twandyetaaze okukozesa obwannakyalo bwaffe, wadde okulaba ensonga yonna ey'okutakifuuka. Okuva olwo twakyusa endowooza yaffe era tumanyi engeri, ne mu kino, Mukama gye yali atuteekerateekera. Bwe kityo, mu Juuni 1989 nze ne Anne twakkirizibwa nga abatuuze ba Canada.

Ejjinja ery'okulinnyako ery'okubiri lyali likwata ku maka gaffe. Mu 1986, twalina amaka amalungi mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Victoria, naye gaalina ebizibu ebinene bibiri. Nga ndi musumba, emirundi mingi nnasembezanga abantu mu maka gaffe olw'okubawa amagezi, ekintu ekyetaaga okukuuma ebyama. Kino kyali kizibu kubanga amaka gaffe gaali 'open plan' nga galina enzigi ntono ezaawula ekifo eky'okubeeramu.

Eky'okubiri, waaliwo obusaawe bw'omuddo busatu obwetaaga okulabirirwa bulijjo, ate nga nze siri wa kwagala mulimu gwa nnimiro. Omusawo wange bwe yazuula nti nnali nnina obuzibu obutono ku mutima (prolapse), twategeera nti kyali kiseera kya kwesengula okugenda mu maka amalala, agasingako okutuukiragana n'embeera yaffe ey'obulamu. Twalanga amaka gaffe okugatunda ne twewuunya bwe twafuna omuguzi mu wiiki emu. Omukyala yali agenda okusasula kye twali twetaaze mu ssente enkalu, ku nsonga emu — nti twava mu nnyumba ng'omwezi gunaggwaako, nga wabuluseewo wiiki ssatu zokka.

Mu butuufu, ekyo kyategeeza nti twalina ennaku kkumi zokka, kubanga twali tugenda mu kiwummulo mu kiseera ekyo, nga twateekateeka okukyala mwannyinaze mu Awusiteraliya, n'okuva eyo okutuuka e Kuala Lumpur okukyala Vincent Cheah, mukyala we Shirley n'abayizi abalala abaali kitundu ky'obuweereza bwaffe obw'obusumba (chaplaincy) mu Bumalaysia bwe twali e Kitchener. Twakkiriziganya ku ndagaano ne tutandika okupakanga. Ebintu byaffe eby'omu nnyumba byateekebwa mu maka g'abantu b'ekkanisa, ate obusanduuko obwo obutono bwonna ne buterekebwa mu ofiisi z'ekkanisa. Twasuubira okugenda okubeera mu nnyumba ey'okupangisa nga tukomyewo, ekyandituwadde ebbanga ery'okunoonya amaka amalala. Naye ekyo tekyabaawo, kubanga Lynette yali alabye 'amaka amatuufu ennyo' mu ntambula ze ez'okugenda n'okuva ku mirimu.

Tetwewuunya kusanga nga gasukka ku bbeeyi gye twali tusobola, nga galina obungi bwa ssente (equity) obusukka doola 50,000 okusinga ennyumba gye twali tutunze, naye twewuunya nnyo omuweereza waffe ow'amayumba bwe yannyonnyola nti kyandisoboka okufuna mmwanyi (mortgage) ng'ebisasulwa byayo bifaanagana n'ebyo bye twali tusasula dda. Ate era, ennyumba yalina apaatimenti ey'omu ttaka (basement) nga obupangisa obuvaamu bwandisasuddeko ekitundu ku mmwanyi. Awo omutunzi n'akendeeza ku bbeeyi ye, ne tugwa mu katego. Emmwanyi empya yali ya kika kya 'equity access,' ekitegeeza nti twasobolanga okusasula omuwendo omukulu ekiseera kyonna awatali kibonerezo. Ate era twasobolanga okuggyamu ssente buli lwe twandyetaaze ssente ez'enyongeza — ne bwe nnaabanga sifuna nsimbi zonna eziyingira!

Twagenda mu kiwummulo, nga tuwa muwala waffe omuto, Lynette, 'obuyinza obw'amateeka' (power of attorney) okugula ennyumba, nga ffe twali twota omusana ku mabbali g'ennyanja mu Bumalaysia. Bwe twakomawo nga wayiseewo wiiki ttaano ku lyato (ferry) ery'oluvannyuma okuva e Vancouver, twawuniikirira okusanga nga mikwano gyaffe egy'omu kkanisa gyali gizze ebintu byaffe byonna eby'omu nnyumba mu nnyumba empya, ne baayaliira n'obuliri era nga bateeka n'ebibbo eby'okuliisa mu ddiroowa! Ennyumba eyo efuuse mukisa munene gye tuli okuva lwe twagigula. Bwe twali tuli wala oluvannyuma lwa 1991 — olugero olukyaliyo mu maaso — twagipangisa abayizi ba yunivasite abaagikuuma bulungi ate era ne basasula emmwanyi yaffe yonna — ekintu kye ssaasuubira bwe twasooka okugula ennyumba. Kaakati efuuse ekkubo lyokka ery'okufuna ssente gye tuli nga tusembeza abayizi okuva mu masomero amakulu (colleges) ag'e Victoria era eyongeddeko obungi bwa ssente (equity) okusinga emirundi ebiri mu myaka munaana egiyise. Tukakasa nti Mukama ye yatuluŋŋamya, mu kufuna obwannamawanga bwaffe ne mu kugula ennyumba eno. Awatali kimu ku ebyo, tetwandisobodde kukola ekyo ekikoleddwa — era tumwebaza.

Tetwalowooza nti M/V Anastasis yali agenda kufuuka kitundu kya maanyi eky'ebiseera eby'omu maaso Mukama bye yali atuteekerateekera. Ekyo nga tekinnaba kubaawo, waaliwo amayinja g'okulinnyako amalala abiri Mukama ge yalina okututeekera mu maaso. Awatali gano, tetwandisobodde kugoberera bulagirizi bwe bwe yatuyita oluvannyuma. Bwe twatuuka mu Canada mu 1975, twajja nga 'bannamawanga abakkiriziddwa okubeera' (landed immigrants) nga tulina eddembe erifaanagana kumpi n'ery'omutuuze yenna ow'eggwanga. Twasobola okulonda naye tetwasobola kwesimbawo mu bwapaalamende. Twasanyukira okubeera mu ggwanga lino eddungi era twali twenyumiririza okuyitibwa 'Bannakanada.' (Bannakanada Abawelusi!!) Kyokka, ekimu ku bizibu by'okuba omuntu akkiriziddwa okubeera mu ggwanga kiri nti oyinza okubeera ebweru w'eggwanga mu kiseera kimu okumala ekkomo ery'emyezi mukaaga. Bw'obeera ebweru okusingawo ku ekyo, kyetaagisa okuddamu okusaba obwannamawanga — era ekyo si kya kakasa. Bwe nnasooka okuyingira mu Canada, nnali nnina omulimu ogunywevu gwe nnali ndaga ku ne sipoonsa ku Toronto French School. Kyali kijja kutuuka ekiseera lwe ssaalina nsimbi ziyingira wadde obukwakkulizo bwonna bwe nnandiwadde ofiisi y'abasenguse. Mu kiseera ekifaanana ng'ekyo, kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okuddamu okuyingira mu Canada wadde nga nnalina amaka e Victoria era nga bawala baffe baali babeera eyo. Mazima ddala, ssaali ndowooza ku kino mu 1989 muwala waffe omuto, Lynette, bwe yali ateekateeka embaga ye ey'obugole ne Phillip, Omuwositureeliya, era ng'ayagala okuva mu Canada okugenda okubeera 'down under' (mu Awusiteraliya). Yayagala okufuuka omutuuze wa Canada ng'embaga ye tennatuuka, olwo singa yali ayagadde okudda mu Canada, yandisobodde okukikola. Nze ne Anne tetwakifiirako nnyo naye ne tusalawo nti kyandibadde kirungi gye tuli okukola kye kimu. Tetwalaba kiseera kyonna kye twandyetaaze okukozesa obwannakyalo bwaffe, wadde okulaba ensonga yonna ey'okutakifuuka. Okuva olwo twakyusa endowooza yaffe era tumanyi engeri, ne mu kino, Mukama gye yali atuteekerateekera. Bwe kityo, mu Juuni 1989 nze ne Anne twakkirizibwa nga abatuuze ba Canada. Ejjinja ery'okulinnyako ery'okubiri lyali likwata ku maka gaffe. Mu 1986, twalina amaka amalungi mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Victoria, naye gaalina ebizibu ebinene bibiri. Nga ndi musumba, emirundi mingi nnasembezanga abantu mu maka gaffe olw'okubawa amagezi, ekintu ekyetaaga okukuuma ebyama. Kino kyali kizibu kubanga amaka gaffe gaali 'open plan' nga galina enzigi ntono ezaawula ekifo eky'okubeeramu. Eky'okubiri, waaliwo obusaawe bw'omuddo busatu obwetaaga okulabirirwa bulijjo, ate nga nze siri wa kwagala mulimu gwa nnimiro. Omusawo wange bwe yazuula nti nnali nnina obuzibu obutono ku mutima (prolapse), twategeera nti kyali kiseera kya kwesengula okugenda mu maka amalala, agasingako okutuukiragana n'embeera yaffe ey'obulamu. Twalanga amaka gaffe okugatunda ne twewuunya bwe twafuna omuguzi mu wiiki emu. Omukyala yali agenda okusasula kye twali twetaaze mu ssente enkalu, ku nsonga emu — nti twava mu nnyumba ng'omwezi gunaggwaako, nga wabuluseewo wiiki ssatu zokka. Mu butuufu, ekyo kyategeeza nti twalina ennaku kkumi zokka, kubanga twali tugenda mu kiwummulo mu kiseera ekyo, nga twateekateeka okukyala mwannyinaze mu Awusiteraliya, n'okuva eyo okutuuka e Kuala Lumpur okukyala Vincent Cheah, mukyala we Shirley n'abayizi abalala abaali kitundu ky'obuweereza bwaffe obw'obusumba (chaplaincy) mu Bumalaysia bwe twali e Kitchener. Twakkiriziganya ku ndagaano ne tutandika okupakanga. Ebintu byaffe eby'omu nnyumba byateekebwa mu maka g'abantu b'ekkanisa, ate obusanduuko obwo obutono bwonna ne buterekebwa mu ofiisi z'ekkanisa. Twasuubira okugenda okubeera mu nnyumba ey'okupangisa nga tukomyewo, ekyandituwadde ebbanga ery'okunoonya amaka amalala. Naye ekyo tekyabaawo, kubanga Lynette yali alabye 'amaka amatuufu ennyo' mu ntambula ze ez'okugenda n'okuva ku mirimu. Tetwewuunya kusanga nga gasukka ku bbeeyi gye twali tusobola, nga galina obungi bwa ssente (equity) obusukka doola 50,000 okusinga ennyumba gye twali tutunze, naye twewuunya nnyo omuweereza waffe ow'amayumba bwe yannyonnyola nti kyandisoboka okufuna mmwanyi (mortgage) ng'ebisasulwa byayo bifaanagana n'ebyo bye twali tusasula dda. Ate era, ennyumba yalina apaatimenti ey'omu ttaka (basement) nga obupangisa obuvaamu bwandisasuddeko ekitundu ku mmwanyi. Awo omutunzi n'akendeeza ku bbeeyi ye, ne tugwa mu katego. Emmwanyi empya yali ya kika kya 'equity access,' ekitegeeza nti twasobolanga okusasula omuwendo omukulu ekiseera kyonna awatali kibonerezo. Ate era twasobolanga okuggyamu ssente buli lwe twandyetaaze ssente ez'enyongeza — ne bwe nnaabanga sifuna nsimbi zonna eziyingira! Twagenda mu kiwummulo, nga tuwa muwala waffe omuto, Lynette, 'obuyinza obw'amateeka' (power of attorney) okugula ennyumba, nga ffe twali twota omusana ku mabbali g'ennyanja mu Bumalaysia. Bwe twakomawo nga wayiseewo wiiki ttaano ku lyato (ferry) ery'oluvannyuma okuva e Vancouver, twawuniikirira okusanga nga mikwano gyaffe egy'omu kkanisa gyali gizze ebintu byaffe byonna eby'omu nnyumba mu nnyumba empya, ne baayaliira n'obuliri era nga bateeka n'ebibbo eby'okuliisa mu ddiroowa! Ennyumba eyo efuuse mukisa munene gye tuli okuva lwe twagigula. Bwe twali tuli wala oluvannyuma lwa 1991 — olugero olukyaliyo mu maaso — twagipangisa abayizi ba yunivasite abaagikuuma bulungi ate era ne basasula emmwanyi yaffe yonna — ekintu kye ssaasuubira bwe twasooka okugula ennyumba. Kaakati efuuse ekkubo lyokka ery'okufuna ssente gye tuli nga tusembeza abayizi okuva mu masomero amakulu (colleges) ag'e Victoria era eyongeddeko obungi bwa ssente (equity) okusinga emirundi ebiri mu myaka munaana egiyise. Tukakasa nti Mukama ye yatuluŋŋamya, mu kufuna obwannamawanga bwaffe ne mu kugula ennyumba eno. Awatali kimu ku ebyo, tetwandisobodde kukola ekyo ekikoleddwa — era tumwebaza.

fields.title: Omutima gwa Katonda Ogumenyese
fields.body_html:
Tetwamanya nti bwe twali tusanyukira obumu n'emikwano gyaffe emingi ku M/V Anastasis, Mukama yali yeeyongera okutukulembera ng'ateekateeka omutendera oguddako mu bumanyirivu bwaffe obweyongera obw'okutuluŋŋamya kwe mu bulamu bwaffe. Mazima twali tusanyufu okwegatta n'abakozi b'ekyombo, naye tetwali tusuubira wadde okusuubira nti olunaku lumu, tuligenda kuba kitundu ky'amaka ago. Ddala, wadde nga Anne yali ayogeranga bulijjo nga bw'ayagala 'ennyumba eri ku lubalama lw'ennyanja', saarootera nti olunaku lumu, yali wa kubeera n'amaka 'ku nnyanja!' Nkakasa nti singa nnali mmutegeezezza ekintu ng'ekyo ekyombo bwe kyali mu Victoria, nnandiwulidde eddoboozi ery'omwanguka nnyo nga ligamba nti “Tekisoboka n'akatono!”

Naye okusooka, Katonda yalina okukola ekintu ekirala mu mutima gwange okunziggya ku bukuumi bw'omulimu ogusasulwa empeera nga omusumba 'ow'ekiseera kyonna'. Nnali mmaze okuleka omulimu ogwalimu 'empeera ennungi ne penseni ennungi' ng'omusomesa w'essomero, ne nfuuka omusumba 'ku kitundu ky'empeera ne kitundu kya penseni'. Yayagala okunneeyongerayo n'okunzija ku kifo ky'omuminsani nga 'siriiko mpeera so siriiko penseni!'

Nga ndi musumba wa kkanisa ya Christian & Missionary Alliance, nnakubirizanga abantu bange okumanya obuvunaanyizibwa obw'obuminsani Mukama bwe yatuwa okugenda mu nsi yonna okubuulira enjiri. Buli mwaka twafubanga nnyo okukuŋŋaanya ssente ez'okuwagira abaminsani baffe mu kyalo, nga tukkiriza nti omulimu gwe bakola gwa mugaso nnyo.

Nnabuuliranga ebigambo eby'obuminsani ne nkubiriza okusaba. Naye, nga tekunnatuuka mu 1988 lwe nnasooka okutegeera Katonda bw'akaabira ababuze n'abanyigirizibwa ab'ensi.

Nnali ntandiseewo essomero lya Mission Bridge mu kkanisa, nga tukuŋŋaana emirundi ebiri buli wiiki okuwulira okuyigiriza okuva ku tepu n'okuva eri abasumba b'omu kitundu, ku bikwata ku buyigirizwa obw'Ekikristaayo. Waaliwo abayizi kkumi na bataano mu kibiina nga bava mu kkanisa ez'enjawulo. Okwewaayo kwabwe kwali kwa myezi mukaaga egy'okusoma nga mwe muli n'‘okutuuka ku balala’ okwa wiiki ssatu okukolera mu maka g'abaana bamulekwa mu Mexico. Bwe twali mu maka g'obulekwa ng'ago Mukama mwe yanjolekera omutima gwe.

Munnange Omu-Mexican, Francisco, yali akuba ebifaananyi by'abaana abato basobole okuweerezebwa e Canada, USA ne Great Britain okusobola okuzzaamu amaanyi abawi b'obuyambi abaweereza obuyambi obwa buli mwezi obwandisobozesezza omulimu gw'amaka g'abalekwa okweyongera. Omu ku bayizi bange yali atudde ku bbugwe omumpi mu maka g'abalekwa ng'akutte omuwala omuto Omu-Mexican mu mikono gye gyombi. Cindy yali akaaba n'amaziga ge nga gakuŋŋaanira ku kalevu ke nga tegannagwa mu kifuba kye. Ng'amutunuulira, Francisco n'ayogera mpola nti, “Cindy, emitima gyaffe gimenyeka buli lunaku!” Nnali mbuulidde bulijjo ku bwesigwa bwa Katonda. Yali afuuse Omulokozi wange, Amaanyi gange, Omuwi wange, Omuwonya wange, Omutukuza wange n'ebirala bingi. Nnawa obujulirwa n'essanyu ku bulungi bwe bwonna gye ndi. Yaliwo okumpa omukisa!

Francisco bwe yali ayogera ne Cindy, nnandisobodde okuwa obujulirwa nti ntudde mu bifo eby'omu ggulu mu Yesu, nga nsanyukira obukuumi obw'omu kifuba kye. (Bef 2:6). Naye, mu kaseera ako nnawulira, ng'ekyokusooka, amaziga ge agabuguma nga gagwa ku mutwe gwange. Nnawulira omutima gwe ogumenyese - si lwa balekwa abato ab'omu Mexico bokka naye lwa bonna abaavu abalumizibwa era abafumitibwa ab'ensi eno. Nga yali ayaayaanira nnyo nze okumusiima! Yayagala nze okuba emikono gye egigolola. Ku lugendo olwo olusooka mu Mexico kwe nnaweerwa essanyu ery'enjawulo.

Okumala emyaka mingi, nze ne Anne twali tuwadde obuyambi abaana nga tuyita mu Compassion – era omwana waffe ow'omu kiseera kino, Vicky yali mu Mexico, mu kifo ekimu. Lowooza ku ssanyu lyange bwe nnazuula nti yabeeranga edakiika 15 zokka okuva we twali tukolera era nti kyandisobose okumusisinkana ye n'amaka ge. Teyali mulekwa, naye amaka ge gaali gaavu nnyo era obuyambi bwange bwabasobozesa okufuna emmere n'engoye ez'obwetaavu nga biyita mu Compassion. Bwe nnasisinkana Vicky, nnamwagala nnyo! Yatukyalidde e Canada, ne nze ntuuse ewuwe emirundi mingi.

Amaka ge gaafuuka amaka gange era ne kaakano, nga wayiseewo emyaka mingi, Vicky ng'alina abaana abawala bana, tukyawandiikagana era emirundi mingi tumaliriza emboozi zaffe nga tugamba nti “Te quyiero mucho” – Nkwagala nnyo nnyo.

Nnafiirwa ekitundu ky'omutima gwange mu ngendo ezo zombi mu Mexico. Nga bwe kyali eri bangi ku bakozi b'Outreach, ssaddayo kuba nga bwe nnali. Katonda yali anaatera okuntwala ku lusozi olulala oluwanvu - naye nnali wa kutambulira mu kiwonvu ekiwanvu era eky'ekizikiza okutuukayo!

Bwe nnava e Mexico mu January 1990, nneenyigira mu bakkiriza abazaaliranwa ab'omu kitundu. Abavubuka baabwe bangi baali bakkirizza Mukama era kaakano baali boolekedde okuyigganyizibwa mu kitundu kyabwe. Omu ku bo yali 'awambiddwa' n'atwalibwa mu nnyumba empanvu, gye yandiyisiddwa mu mukolo gw'okwatikibwa okufuna emyoyo egy'obasetaani. Kino kyali si kya kwagala kwe, naye poliisi ya Canada teyakola kikola kinene kukiziyiza kubanga okusomoka ensalo z'ekitundu ky'abazaaliranwa kyali kigambo kya byabufuzi ekyobuggya nnyo.

Mu February 1990, abantu abazaaliranwa bangi baadduka okuva mu kitundu kyabwe ne beekweka mu kisenge ekya wansi mu kkanisa yaffe. Mu kiseera kino nnali nnyukanya bulijjo n'abakulembeze b'ebyobufuzi ab'eggwanga n'ab'essaza era nga nneesigamye nnyo ku buwagizi bwa bannange abasumba.

Ffembi abaali beenyigidde ennyo mu mbeera eno, twembi twalwala nnyo.

Abakkiriza bangi okuva mu bukiikakkono-bugwanjuba bwonna obwa USA ne Canada baali bampandiikira oba okumpita n'ebigambo eby'okuzzaamu amaanyi, nga bamanyi nti nnali mpitamu mu kiseera ekizibu, oboolyawo nga bangi bwe baagamba, olw'ekikolimo ky'abazaaliranwa. Simanyi bulungi endowooza yange ey'obuyigirizwa bw'eddiini bw'eri ku bikolimo ng'ebyo, wadde nga mmanyi nti abakkiriza bangi, mwe muli n'abakulembeze b'ekkanisa, baalowooza nti bwe kityo bwe kyali.

Okuva ku kiro ekisooka abazaaliranwa abaayigganyizibwa lwe baali mu kkanisa, nnalekera awo okwebaka. Nnasaba bannange abasumba okunsabira, omu ku bo n'agamba nti yawulira 'omwoyo omubi ogw'okulekebwa' nga guli ku nze. Ssaategeera kye yali ategeeza.

Mu May, nze ne Anne twagenda ku lukuŋŋaana lw'okwewummulako olwa wiiki emu olw'abasumba olwakolebwa Ekkanisa ya Anglican. Eyo gye nnategeezeddwa nti nnali nfugibwa ekikolimo, naye kaakano kyali kimenyese. Omukulembeze n'agattako nti, “Waliwo ekitundu ekinene eky'enneewulira zo ekibulako era kikwatagana n'okufa kwa maama wo.” Nate, ssaategeera kye yali ategeeza.

Mu June, nnava mu kkanisa nga njeyongera n'obutebaka. Ebirowoozo byange byali 'bitabuse'; ssaasobola kulowooza bulungi kusoma wadde kubudaabuda. Nnagalamiranga wansi mu kisenge kyange eky'okusomeramu, nga nkaabira Mukama, nga mbuuza lwaki mpita mu bumanyirivu buno. Ssaabuusabuusa ku kubeerawo kwe, naye nnali sikwatibwako. Nnamiranga eddagala eddiingirira lingi buli kawungeezi okunnyamba okuwummula naye nga nkyalemwa okwebaka. Ekkanisa yagaana okuva kwange era Ssupaadeenti w'Essaza n'ansaba nsigalewo.

Mu September, oluvannyuma nnayingira eddwaaliro ery'otulo mu University of British Columbia mu Vancouver. Eyo gye kyazuuliddwa nti waaliwo okwonooneka okutuukiridde okw'enkola etandika otulo mu ekirwiro ekiyitibwa pineal gland, era nnabuulirirwa nnyo okulekera awo omulimu gwange.

Ku Ssande eyaddirira nnategeeza ekkanisa amagezi g'omukugu era ne mpaayo okuva kwange, nga kutandika mangu ago. Nnatandika, ekyo omusawo kye yali asuubira, okuwummula okwa myaka ebiri okuva mu buweereza. Nnatambulanga nnyo, nnasoma ebitabo bingi ne ndowooza ku byonna bye nnali njize ku nze kennyini ne ku kweraliikirira okuleeta obutebaka.

Ku Lwakusatu, oluvannyuma lw'okuva kwange, nnagenda ku kyenkya n'abasumba abamu bannange. Bwe baali boogera ku mbeera yange, omu ku bo, omuggya mu kibiina, n'agamba nti, “Gareth, mpulira omwoyo omubi ogw'okulekebwa nga guli ku ggwe!” Ebigambo bye bimu byennyini ebyali binnyogeddwa emyezi musanvu emabega! Bwe nnadda eka, nze ne Anne twatuula ne tulowooza ku bulamu bwange. Twewuunya bwe twalaba emirundi emingi omulenzi omuto ali munda yange gye yali awulidde obulumi obw'okulekebwa, so si katono nga kwe kwali okufa kwa maama wange, ng'andeseewo, nga ndi wa myaka kkumi n'esatu. Ssaakaaba ku kufa kwe - kubanga abalenzi tebateekwa kukaaba! Naye, nnali nnakuwadde munda, era okumala emyaka mingi oluvannyuma.

Ku kawungeezi ako kennyini, nnaddira ekitabo okusoma. Kyali kitabo kya lugero ku ntalo z'aba-crusade ez'omu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'ogumu. Omwo, abaserikale babiri abeebagala embalaasi ne booleragana mu lutalo. Naye, omuserikale ow'aba-crusade yali afumitiddwa era yali akutamye ku ntebe y'embalaasi n'ekitala kye nga kiwanikiddwa awo obwereere ku lubbu lwe. Omulabe we n'ajja okumutta, ng'ayimusa ekitala kye eky'amaanyi okutta omu-crusade. Yali ayambadde ebyokulwanyisa eby'amaanyi era obusaale bw'aba-crusade bwali tebumukolako. Naye, bwe yayimusa omukono gwe, obusaale mwenda ne butuuka amangu ku kifo mu nkwawa ye etaali nkuume, n'agwa okuva ku mbalaasi ye, ng'afumitiddwa okutuusa ku kufa. Nnawulira Omwoyo wa Katonda ng'ayogera nange. “Gareth, oyinza okwambala ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda ku lutalo olwa buli lunaku. Naye, omulabe amanyi ebifo byo ebinafu era mweteefuteefu okukufumita bw'oyimusa omukono gwo okumulwanyisa.

Ekifo kyo ekinafu, ebiwundu byo, biri mu kitundu eky'okulekebwa.” Kaakano nnatandika okutegeera enkola Setaani ze yali akozesezza okuziyiza obuweereza bwange.

Mu kiseera ky'obulwadde bwange, abantu bwe baatandika okuva mu kkanisa, nnawuliranga bulijjo obulumi obw'okugattululwa - okulekebwa. Nnalaba engeri kino gye kyankwatako, ne nga embeera y'abazaaliranwa tennabaawo. Ku nkomerero, 'obulumi' bwali buleeteddewo obutebaka era nnali munafu mu lutalo.

Nnayiga bingi nnyo mu kiwonvu ekyo Katonda bye yansobozesa okukozesa mu kubudaabuda bangi abalina ebiwundu eby'emmeeme. Mu kitabo kyange ekirala: “The Key in My Hand”, ntererako ebimu ku mboozi ezo. Naye, Katonda tatuyisa mu kiwonvu okuggyako ng'ayagala okutukulembera okutuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi, era ekyange kyali kumpi okulabika.

Munnange Omu-Mexican, Francisco, yali akuba ebifaananyi by'abaana abato basobole okuweerezebwa e Canada, USA ne Great Britain okusobola okuzzaamu amaanyi abawi b'obuyambi abaweereza obuyambi obwa buli mwezi obwandisobozesezza omulimu gw'amaka g'abalekwa okweyongera. Omu ku bayizi bange yali atudde ku bbugwe omumpi mu maka g'abalekwa ng'akutte omuwala omuto Omu-Mexican mu mikono gye gyombi. Cindy yali akaaba n'amaziga ge nga gakuŋŋaanira ku kalevu ke nga tegannagwa mu kifuba kye. Ng'amutunuulira, Francisco n'ayogera mpola nti, “Cindy, emitima gyaffe gimenyeka buli lunaku!” Nnali mbuulidde bulijjo ku bwesigwa bwa Katonda. Yali afuuse Omulokozi wange, Amaanyi gange, Omuwi wange, Omuwonya wange, Omutukuza wange n'ebirala bingi. Nnawa obujulirwa n'essanyu ku bulungi bwe bwonna gye ndi. Yaliwo okumpa omukisa! Francisco bwe yali ayogera ne Cindy, nnandisobodde okuwa obujulirwa nti ntudde mu bifo eby'omu ggulu mu Yesu, nga nsanyukira obukuumi obw'omu kifuba kye. (Bef 2:6). Naye, mu kaseera ako nnawulira, ng'ekyokusooka, amaziga ge agabuguma nga gagwa ku mutwe gwange. Nnawulira omutima gwe ogumenyese - si lwa balekwa abato ab'omu Mexico bokka naye lwa bonna abaavu abalumizibwa era abafumitibwa ab'ensi eno. Nga yali ayaayaanira nnyo nze okumusiima! Yayagala nze okuba emikono gye egigolola. Ku lugendo olwo olusooka mu Mexico kwe nnaweerwa essanyu ery'enjawulo. Okumala emyaka mingi, nze ne Anne twali tuwadde obuyambi abaana nga tuyita mu Compassion – era omwana waffe ow'omu kiseera kino, Vicky yali mu Mexico, mu kifo ekimu. Lowooza ku ssanyu lyange bwe nnazuula nti yabeeranga edakiika 15 zokka okuva we twali tukolera era nti kyandisobose okumusisinkana ye n'amaka ge. Teyali mulekwa, naye amaka ge gaali gaavu nnyo era obuyambi bwange bwabasobozesa okufuna emmere n'engoye ez'obwetaavu nga biyita mu Compassion. Bwe nnasisinkana Vicky, nnamwagala nnyo! Yatukyalidde e Canada, ne nze ntuuse ewuwe emirundi mingi. Amaka ge gaafuuka amaka gange era ne kaakano, nga wayiseewo emyaka mingi, Vicky ng'alina abaana abawala bana, tukyawandiikagana era emirundi mingi tumaliriza emboozi zaffe nga tugamba nti “Te quyiero mucho” – Nkwagala nnyo nnyo. Nnafiirwa ekitundu ky'omutima gwange mu ngendo ezo zombi mu Mexico. Nga bwe kyali eri bangi ku bakozi b'Outreach, ssaddayo kuba nga bwe nnali. Katonda yali anaatera okuntwala ku lusozi olulala oluwanvu - naye nnali wa kutambulira mu kiwonvu ekiwanvu era eky'ekizikiza okutuukayo! Bwe nnava e Mexico mu January 1990, nneenyigira mu bakkiriza abazaaliranwa ab'omu kitundu. Abavubuka baabwe bangi baali bakkirizza Mukama era kaakano baali boolekedde okuyigganyizibwa mu kitundu kyabwe. Omu ku bo yali 'awambiddwa' n'atwalibwa mu nnyumba empanvu, gye yandiyisiddwa mu mukolo gw'okwatikibwa okufuna emyoyo egy'obasetaani. Kino kyali si kya kwagala kwe, naye poliisi ya Canada teyakola kikola kinene kukiziyiza kubanga okusomoka ensalo z'ekitundu ky'abazaaliranwa kyali kigambo kya byabufuzi ekyobuggya nnyo. Mu February 1990, abantu abazaaliranwa bangi baadduka okuva mu kitundu kyabwe ne beekweka mu kisenge ekya wansi mu kkanisa yaffe. Mu kiseera kino nnali nnyukanya bulijjo n'abakulembeze b'ebyobufuzi ab'eggwanga n'ab'essaza era nga nneesigamye nnyo ku buwagizi bwa bannange abasumba. Ffembi abaali beenyigidde ennyo mu mbeera eno, twembi twalwala nnyo. Abakkiriza bangi okuva mu bukiikakkono-bugwanjuba bwonna obwa USA ne Canada baali bampandiikira oba okumpita n'ebigambo eby'okuzzaamu amaanyi, nga bamanyi nti nnali mpitamu mu kiseera ekizibu, oboolyawo nga bangi bwe baagamba, olw'ekikolimo ky'abazaaliranwa. Simanyi bulungi endowooza yange ey'obuyigirizwa bw'eddiini bw'eri ku bikolimo ng'ebyo, wadde nga mmanyi nti abakkiriza bangi, mwe muli n'abakulembeze b'ekkanisa, baalowooza nti bwe kityo bwe kyali. Okuva ku kiro ekisooka abazaaliranwa abaayigganyizibwa lwe baali mu kkanisa, nnalekera awo okwebaka. Nnasaba bannange abasumba okunsabira, omu ku bo n'agamba nti yawulira 'omwoyo omubi ogw'okulekebwa' nga guli ku nze. Ssaategeera kye yali ategeeza. Mu May, nze ne Anne twagenda ku lukuŋŋaana lw'okwewummulako olwa wiiki emu olw'abasumba olwakolebwa Ekkanisa ya Anglican. Eyo gye nnategeezeddwa nti nnali nfugibwa ekikolimo, naye kaakano kyali kimenyese. Omukulembeze n'agattako nti, “Waliwo ekitundu ekinene eky'enneewulira zo ekibulako era kikwatagana n'okufa kwa maama wo.” Nate, ssaategeera kye yali ategeeza. Mu June, nnava mu kkanisa nga njeyongera n'obutebaka. Ebirowoozo byange byali 'bitabuse'; ssaasobola kulowooza bulungi kusoma wadde kubudaabuda. Nnagalamiranga wansi mu kisenge kyange eky'okusomeramu, nga nkaabira Mukama, nga mbuuza lwaki mpita mu bumanyirivu buno. Ssaabuusabuusa ku kubeerawo kwe, naye nnali sikwatibwako. Nnamiranga eddagala eddiingirira lingi buli kawungeezi okunnyamba okuwummula naye nga nkyalemwa okwebaka. Ekkanisa yagaana okuva kwange era Ssupaadeenti w'Essaza n'ansaba nsigalewo. Mu September, oluvannyuma nnayingira eddwaaliro ery'otulo mu University of British Columbia mu Vancouver. Eyo gye kyazuuliddwa nti waaliwo okwonooneka okutuukiridde okw'enkola etandika otulo mu ekirwiro ekiyitibwa pineal gland, era nnabuulirirwa nnyo okulekera awo omulimu gwange. Ku Ssande eyaddirira nnategeeza ekkanisa amagezi g'omukugu era ne mpaayo okuva kwange, nga kutandika mangu ago. Nnatandika, ekyo omusawo kye yali asuubira, okuwummula okwa myaka ebiri okuva mu buweereza. Nnatambulanga nnyo, nnasoma ebitabo bingi ne ndowooza ku byonna bye nnali njize ku nze kennyini ne ku kweraliikirira okuleeta obutebaka. Ku Lwakusatu, oluvannyuma lw'okuva kwange, nnagenda ku kyenkya n'abasumba abamu bannange. Bwe baali boogera ku mbeera yange, omu ku bo, omuggya mu kibiina, n'agamba nti, “Gareth, mpulira omwoyo omubi ogw'okulekebwa nga guli ku ggwe!” Ebigambo bye bimu byennyini ebyali binnyogeddwa emyezi musanvu emabega! Bwe nnadda eka, nze ne Anne twatuula ne tulowooza ku bulamu bwange. Twewuunya bwe twalaba emirundi emingi omulenzi omuto ali munda yange gye yali awulidde obulumi obw'okulekebwa, so si katono nga kwe kwali okufa kwa maama wange, ng'andeseewo, nga ndi wa myaka kkumi n'esatu. Ssaakaaba ku kufa kwe - kubanga abalenzi tebateekwa kukaaba! Naye, nnali nnakuwadde munda, era okumala emyaka mingi oluvannyuma. Ku kawungeezi ako kennyini, nnaddira ekitabo okusoma. Kyali kitabo kya lugero ku ntalo z'aba-crusade ez'omu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'ogumu. Omwo, abaserikale babiri abeebagala embalaasi ne booleragana mu lutalo. Naye, omuserikale ow'aba-crusade yali afumitiddwa era yali akutamye ku ntebe y'embalaasi n'ekitala kye nga kiwanikiddwa awo obwereere ku lubbu lwe. Omulabe we n'ajja okumutta, ng'ayimusa ekitala kye eky'amaanyi okutta omu-crusade. Yali ayambadde ebyokulwanyisa eby'amaanyi era obusaale bw'aba-crusade bwali tebumukolako. Naye, bwe yayimusa omukono gwe, obusaale mwenda ne butuuka amangu ku kifo mu nkwawa ye etaali nkuume, n'agwa okuva ku mbalaasi ye, ng'afumitiddwa okutuusa ku kufa. Nnawulira Omwoyo wa Katonda ng'ayogera nange. “Gareth, oyinza okwambala ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda ku lutalo olwa buli lunaku. Naye, omulabe amanyi ebifo byo ebinafu era mweteefuteefu okukufumita bw'oyimusa omukono gwo okumulwanyisa. Ekifo kyo ekinafu, ebiwundu byo, biri mu kitundu eky'okulekebwa.” Kaakano nnatandika okutegeera enkola Setaani ze yali akozesezza okuziyiza obuweereza bwange. Mu kiseera ky'obulwadde bwange, abantu bwe baatandika okuva mu kkanisa, nnawuliranga bulijjo obulumi obw'okugattululwa - okulekebwa. Nnalaba engeri kino gye kyankwatako, ne nga embeera y'abazaaliranwa tennabaawo. Ku nkomerero, 'obulumi' bwali buleeteddewo obutebaka era nnali munafu mu lutalo. Nnayiga bingi nnyo mu kiwonvu ekyo Katonda bye yansobozesa okukozesa mu kubudaabuda bangi abalina ebiwundu eby'emmeeme. Mu kitabo kyange ekirala: “The Key in My Hand”, ntererako ebimu ku mboozi ezo. Naye, Katonda tatuyisa mu kiwonvu okuggyako ng'ayagala okutukulembera okutuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi, era ekyange kyali kumpi okulabika.

fields.title: Okuyitibwa mu Afirika
fields.body_html:
Kaakati nga nnina ebiseera bingi eby'okuwummulamu, nnandikoze ki? Eddagala lyange lyali likola, era buli kiro nnali nsula essaawa ntono. Mu mubiri nnali mpulira bulungi, naye omutwe gwange gwali gukyakooye. Mpolampola okwegomba kwana ne kutandika okubaawo.

Nnali njagala okukola omulimu ogw'okweyimirizaawo; ku kyombo Anastasis. Mu kiseera ekyo kyali mu Afirika ey'Ebugwanjuba, naye kyandibadde kirungi okuwummulako nga ‘nkuŋŋuunya obutalagge’ - oba kyonna ekirala ekyali kyetaagisa. Oboolyawo nnandigenze e Hawaii. YWAM baali bagguddewo University of the Nations eyo, era nnandiyinzizza okugenda mu Crossroads School okumala emyezi etaano. Kyandibadde kirungi ‘okuweebwako’ mu kifo ky'okubeera nga ‘mpaayo’ bulijjo.

Nnandiyinzizza okugenda mu Latin America okuyamba ababaka b'enjiri abaali eyo. Nnali mmaze okugenda e Mexico ne ndaba n'amaaso gange obwetaavu bw'omusumba eri ababaka b'enjiri. Oboolyawo nnanditandiseewo essomero mu Victoria okuyigiriza emisingi gy'Ekigambo n'okutendeka abayigirizwa okugenda mu bubaka.

Emyaka ebiri emabega, nnali nsabiddwa okuweereza ku Kakiiko k'e Canada aka Mercy Ships, ekitongole kya YWAM ekivunaanyizibwa ku kyombo M/V Anastasis. Kino kyali kya mateeka kyokka, okusobozesa abawi b'ensimbi ab'e Canada okufuna risiiti ezikendeeza omusolo.

Twali tuteekwa okukola enkuŋŋaana za buli mwaka ezandiyinzizza okukolebwa nga tuyita mu ssimu eya ‘conference call’. Bwe kityo, wakati mu Okitobba, Don Stephens, pulezidenti wa Mercy Ships, yakola olukuŋŋaana lwa ssaawa emu nga luyita mu ssimu, era ku nkomerero yaalwo ne mmusaba ampiteko ku nsonga yange ey'obwannannyini. Nnali njagala okumubuuza ebirowoozo bye ku ndowooza ebbiri ezisooka ze nnali mpandiseewo. Nnandibadde n'omugaso gwonna ku kyombo?

Waaliwo omugaso gwonna mu kugenda mu Crossroads School? Yagamba nti anaddamu okumpita. Nga wayiseewo akaseera, Don n'agenda okukyalira Asia ey'Ebugwanjuba-Obukiikaddyo, era okusaba kwange ne kwerabirwa. Yali tannampita okutuusa oluvannyuma lw'omwezi, era mu kiseera ekyo embeera endala zaali zifudde kizibu gye ndi okutuuka mu Afirika ey'Ebugwanjuba oba e Hawaii - okumala waakiri emyezi esatu. Yasaba ekitundu olw'okwerabira kwe, n'awuliriza nga nnyinnyonnyola ensonga lwaki nnali mmusabye okumpita.

Awo Don n'agamba nti, “Nnina ensonga endala lwaki mpita. Eggulo, Olukiiko lwaffe lwatuula, era omusumba aliwo kaakati yasabye okuwummulako. Ggwe ne Anne mwandyagadde okujja ku kyombo okuba abasumba baffe? Nnamba yange eya fax y'eno. Munziremu amangu nga ggwe ne Anne mumaze okusalawo!”

Nnakubira Anne ku mirimu, nga nsuubira nnyo okuddibwamu okugaana. Tekyandibadde kisoboka ye okwagala okuleka amaka gaffe, bawala baffe n'abazzukulu okugenda okubeera mu kibiina ku kyombo mu bbugumu ery'omu Afirika ey'Ebugwanjuba. Saakkiriza matu gange bwe yagamba nti, “Tugenda ddi?” Nnali nkakasa nti mpisizza ennamba enkyamu! Yeewuunya nga nange bwe nneewuunya olw'okuddamu kwe, naye twazuula nti Mukama abulijjo awa ekisa mu kiseera ennyo kye kyetaagibwa. Ne tuteekateeka okwegatta ku kyombo mu Rotterdam mu Maayi 1991, nga kaakati kyakomyewo okuva ku lugendo lwakyo olusooka olw'okuweereza mu Ghana, Afirika ey'Ebugwanjuba.

Nga tukyalindirira ekyombo, twafuna omukisa okugenda mu Crossroads School mu Lindale, Texas, ewaka wa Mercy Ships. Twalina emyezi esatu emirungi eminyuvu nga tusanyukira okuyigirizibwa n'obussekimu. Oluvannyuma, mu wiiki yaffe esooka ku kyombo, nnayitibwa okuyigiriza mu Discipleship Training School (DTS), ne ndyoka ntegeera nti mu myezi ena nnali nkola ebintu byonna ebina bye nnali njagadde. Naye, nnali kumpi ssi n'omubaka omu wabula okusukka ebikumi bisatu! Mmanyi engeri gye nnali n'enkizo okuweereza ku kyombo kino, naye nsobola kutunuulira mabega na kwewuunya engeri Mukama gye yankulembera mu buli mutendera okuntuusa eyo. Mmanyi nti ekiwonvu eky'omu 1990 kyali kya buziba nnyo, naye kaakati yali antuusizza ku ntikko y'olusozi eyali ya waggulu nnyo. Bulijjo kya mazima nti ebiwonvu eby'obuziba bikulembera ensozi empanvu ez'awaggulu.

Nnalabye abantu nga bajja ku kyombo n'obulema obw'ekyenyi obw'entiisa, nga tebeetwala nga ba mugaso era nga batwalibwa ng'ekikolimo mu bantu baabwe bennyini. Nnalabye abantu abo bennyini nga bagenda nga bawanamye emitwe gyabwe oluvannyuma ng'abalongoosa baffe babawadde ekitiibwa. Nnagenze mu bulwaliro obw'eddagala n'obw'amannyo ne ndaba obutasuubira nga bufuuka essuubi, ng'abeeyimirizaawo abeewaddeyo baweereza obwetaavu bw'abantu abatasobola kufuna bujjanjabi bwe tutwala nga bwa bulijjo.

Nsobola okusuubira emikisa gye twaleka mu mawanga gye twazimba essomero oba ekitundu ky'eddwaliro oba obulwaliro, gye amazzi amayonjo n'obusenge obuyonjo biyamba okuziyiza endwadde ezitta. Naye essanyu lyange erisingayo lyali mu mukisa gwe nnalina okuweereza ababaka b'enjiri n'abasumba mu misomo gya buli wiiki n'enkuŋŋaana.

Nga ndaba obumu bwe bwakula wakati waabwe era nga mpulira nga bwe beebaza olw'okuyigiriza, nnamanya nti Mukama yali anywezezza ddala omukisa. Mu Sierra Leone, okugeza, nnasobola okuyigiriza abakulembeze b'ekkanisa abasukka mu 150, essaawa ssatu buli wiiki, okumala wiiki kkumi na emu zonna! Wadde nga saali nnagenze mu Ssomero lya Tiyoloji, nnayigiriza abakulembeze bonna ab'amadiini amakulu ag'eggwanga eryo - abasajja 23 - okumala ennaku bbiri.

Kyusa omusumba, ng'okyusizza ekkanisa; kyusa abasumba 100, ng'okyusizza eggwanga!! Nga guno mukisa gwa ku ntikko y'olusozi!

Mu Sierra Leone, okugeza, nnasobola okuyigiriza abakulembeze b'ekkanisa abasukka mu 150, essaawa ssatu buli wiiki, okumala wiiki kkumi na emu zonna! Wadde nga saali nnagenze mu Ssomero lya Tiyoloji, nnayigiriza abakulembeze bonna ab'amadiini amakulu ag'eggwanga eryo - abasajja 23 - okumala ennaku bbiri. Kyusa omusumba, ng'okyusizza ekkanisa; kyusa abasumba 100, ng'okyusizza eggwanga!! Nga guno mukisa gwa ku ntikko y'olusozi!

fields.title: Okukwata ku Mirandira Gyaffe
fields.body_html:
Ebintu ebyasingayo obulungi mu myaka ena gye twamala nga tuli ku kyombo Anastasis byali bingi. Kyali kiseera kya njawulo eri ffe fembi, nze ne Anne. Kyokka, bwe ndowooza ku ‘mayinja g’okulinnyako,’ nsobola okulaba nga Katonda teyali ansobozesa kwetegekera buweereza bwa mu maaso bwokka, wabula era nga yali atusobozesa ‘okukwata ku mirandira gyaffe.’ Nja kwogera ku bimu ku ‘bintu eby’ekitalo ebyagwira awamu’ ebyeyongera mu kiseera ekyo.

Twetaba ku kyombo mu Amsterdam era ne twanirizibwa n’okwagala abantu abawerako be twajjukira okuva mu nnaku ez’e Victoria. Mu bo mwalimu Odd Neilson eyajjanga mu kkanisa yange okumala emyezi kkumi n’ena kyombo lwe kyali mu dry dock, mu 1986. Yaŋŋamba nti yali agenda kuwasa nga wakayitawo wiiki mukaaga kyombo lwe kyalituuka mu Oslo, e Norway, era n’ambuuza oba nnandikoze omukolo gw’obugole. Awo nga bwe kiri, nnasanyuka nnyo.

Obugole bwali bugenda kubeera mu Salem Pentecostal Church. Bwe kityo, kyombo lwe kyatuuka, twagenda mu kkuŋŋaana lya Ssande wiiki emu obugole nga tebunnatuuka. Omusumba yannyita okuleetera ekkuŋŋaana lye okulamusa n’okwogera ku bikwata ku Anastasis. Kino nakikola, ne nnyongerako nti, “Era mbaleetedde okulamusa okuva eri nnyazaala wange eyajjanga mu kkanisa eno emyaka egisukka mu ataano egiyise ne bba n’abaana babiri.” Omusumba n’asaba erinnya lya kitaawe wa Anne, olw’okusuubira nti oboolyawo waaliwo omuntu ayinza okubajjukira.

Ku nkomerero y’ekkuŋŋaana, omukyala n’asemberera Anne n’agamba nti, “Nzijukira maama wo ne taata wo, ne mwannyoko Betty, ne muganda wo David. Kitaawo alina mwannyina, Paula ni kaakati abeera mu Karlskoga, e Sweden, era ye mukwano gwange omuyita. N’ekirala, kaakati andabye era ali mu maka gange agali okumpi n’ekkanisa eno!” Awo nga bwe kiri, Anne yasanyuka nnyo okugenda n’omukyala oyo oluvannyuma lw’ekkuŋŋaana okusisinkana Ssenga Paula, era ng’ayita mu ye, ab’oluganda abalala bonna abaabeeranga mu Oslo. Mu wiiki essatu ezaddirira, twasisinkana ab’oluganda ba Anne abasukka mu abiri mu bataano, nga buli kiro tulya mu maka aga njawulo.

Kyombo nga tekinnava mu Bulaaya okugenda okumala emyezi mukaaga mu Afirika, twafuna omukisa okukyalira mikwano gyaffe emirala mingi gye twali tumanyi mu myaka gyaffe egy’e Hamm nga tuli n’Amagye g’e Bungereza. Kyalabika ng’abo bokka be twali tugenda okusubwa be Lars ne Marion Friedner, n’emikwano gy’amaka mu Stockholm. Bwe kityo, twasanyuka nnyo bwe twafuna okuyitibwa okuyigiriza mu kambi ya YWAM ey’obuweereza bwabwe obw’abavubuka KING’S KIDS, mu Laxo, essaawa nnya ku bukiikaddyo bw’obugwanjuba bwa Stockholm. Amangwago twawandiikira Lars ne Marion nga tubategeeza enteekateeka yaffe ey’okuvuga okubalaba ku lumu ku nnaku ez’okuwummulako mu kambi, naye tetwafuna kuddamu nga tetunnava ku kyombo. Tetwamanya nti baali bagenze ku kiwummulo mu wiiki y’emu ne kambi yaffe, era nti ennyumba yaabwe ey’okuwummuliramu yali lugendo lutono okuva e Laxo.

Ku Lwakuna, muwala waabwe Ingemo ne bba baavuga okukyalira bazadde be nga baleese n’ebbaluwa zaabwe zonna ez’omu kiseera ekyo, nga mwe muli n’ebbaluwa yaffe. Bwe baayimirira okulya eky’emisana mu lugendo lwabwe, Ingemo n’ategeera amannya gaffe ku mugongo gw’envera n’agiggula n’asoma nti twali tunaabeera mu Laxo mu kiseera ekyo. N’atuula n’akamwa kaaggule kubanga baali bayimiridde wakati mu Laxo okuwummulako. Ku ssaawa ez’olweggulo olwo, Lars n’atukubira essimu ne tuteesa okusisinkana bonna ku lunaku olwaddirira.

Obuweereza bwaffe obwasembayo n’Anastasis bwali kukulembera Advance Team nga kyombo tekinnakyalira Cardiff, e Wales mu Sebuttemba 1994. Nnakulembera ekibinja ky’abavubuka bataano abalungi ennyo nga tutuukirira ab’amawulire, amakkanisa, bizinensi, amasomero, n’ebirala, nga tubategeeza era nga tubateekerateekera okujja kw’ekyombo.

Awo nga bwe kiri, nga ndi mutabani wa mu kitundu ekyo, nnalina abantu bangi be nnamanyi mu makkanisa era enteekateeka yange yali ejjudde emikolo egy’okwogerako. Nnayitibwa okwogera ku mukolo gw’Amakungula ogw’olweggulo mu Zoar, ekkanisa ya Presbyterian gye nnakulira n’okusomamu Ssande, era maama we yakubiranga piyano era gy’aziikibwa. Bwe nnali nkyalidde amalaalo ge, omusajja omukadde n’ansemberera n’agamba nti, “Wafuuka otya omusumba, ggwe omusiru ng’ono?” Oluvannyuma nga tulya sandwiji za kakwanzi ne caayi omuyokivu, nnayanjulirwa omuvubuka, eyali akomyewo okuva e Madagascar gy’aweerereza ng’omuweereza wa Katonda. Nnazuula nti yali mutabani w’omwagalwa wange ow’olubereberye nga nkyalina emyaka kkumi. Nga bwe nnakubibwa emiggo mingi omukulu w’essomero mu nnaku ezo olw’okuwandiikira Barbara ebbaluwa ez’okwagala!

Oluvannyuma, kyombo lwe kyali kuyimiridde ku mwalo era ng’abakyala bangi bajja ku kyombo olw’olukuŋŋaana lw’abakyala, nnamagamaga okulaba oba Barbara yali mu bagenyi, naye ssaamulaba. Kyokka, oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ntono, nnaweebwa akapapula okuva ku mmeeza yaffe ey’okwaniriza abagenyi akaali kagamba nti, “Owoomukwano Chaplain, njagala kukumanyisa nti omusajja omwagalwa wa kaakati ow’omuwala gwe wasooka okwagala yajja ku kyombo leero!”

Wiiki emu oluvannyuma lwa Zoar, nnali ŋŋenda kwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw’abakadde mu kkanisa munnaayo, mailo ttaano okuva awo. Bwe nnali ntudde ku ntebe ey’omu maaso nga nteekateeka ebyokwogera byange, omusumba n’ajja n’omukyala omukadde n’asaba oba yandituudde okumpi nange kubanga “Dolly ye munnaffe asinga obukadde era yeetaaga okutuula mu maaso okusobola okuwulira.” Nnamubuuza oba yali abeeredde bulungi, n’alyoka ambuuza nti nze ani. Bwe nnamutegeeza, n’agamba nti, “Owange, ggwe nange tuli ba luganda!” Nnazuula nti Dolly Hallett yali muganda wa maama era yabeeranga mu nnyumba eriraanye mu Railway Terrace, Peterston-super-Ely, ekifo maama we yakulira.

Mu butuufu, nnali nkyusizza mmotoka yange mu luggya lwe ku lweggulo olwo lwennyini bwe nnali mvuga okwetooloola ebifo bye nnakuliramu era nga ntuuse okulaba ennyumba enkadde eya bajjajjange. Nnasuubiza okumukyalira ku ssaawa ez’omu ttuntu ez’olunaku olwaddirira, nga ndeese Anne. Twasisinkana Dolly ne bawala be babiri Dorothy ne Thelma abaagamba, bwe baandaba, nti “Owange, oli Lovelock ddala!” Ne balyoka bantegeeza emboozi ennungi ennyo eza maama nga muwala muto, emboozi ze nnali sitegedde edda. Baajjukira ennaku gye baalina bwe yafa nga yali “omuwala omuto omulungi bw’atyo.”

Nnabategeeza nti ekyombo kyali kijja mu wiiki bbiri era ne nnyongerako nti George Thomas, Lord Tonypandy, eyali Ssipiika wa House of Commons era omu ku basajja abaamanyibwa ennyo mu byafaayo bya Wales, yali agenda kuba mugenyi waffe ku lumu ku kyombo. “Owange, George tumumanyi bulungi,” bannyabo bwe baagamba, “Yajjanga mu Railway Terrace okukyalira mwannyina eyabeeranga wano. Twagenda mu maka ge emirundi mingi.”

Ku lunaku olwalondebwa, Lord Tonypandy n’ajja n’amala essaawa nga bbiri n’abamu ku bakulembeze baffe, nga yabuulira ku kukkiriza kwe mu Mukama era nga atugumya mu mulimu gwaffe. Oluvannyuma, bwe nnali mumufulumya ku katala k’ekyombo ng’addayo mu mmotoka ye, nnamubuuza kye yajjukira ku Dolly Hallett ne bawala be. Ebijjukizo bye byali bingi naye n’alyoka ambuuza nga bwe nnabamanya. Nnamutegeeza nti Dolly yali muganda wa maama era nti baabeeranga mu nnyumba eriraanye mu Peterston. Bwe yawulira nti maama yali Ethel, n’aleekaana nti, “Ethel! Oli mutabani wa Ethel?” Kyalabika nti naye yali n’ekijjukizo eky’okwagala ennyo eky’omuwala asembayo obuto mu ‘maka ago amanene.’ (Maama yali asembayo obuto mu baana kkumi na basatu).

Bwe nnali nzaayo ku katala, nnategeera nti yandibadde n’emyaka gy’emu ne maama — oboolyawo yali mwagalwa we ow’olubereberye! Neebuuza oba naye yakubibwa emiggo mingi olw’okuwandiika ebbaluwa ez’okwagala. Kyali kirungi nnyo okukwata ku mirandira gino n’okufuna ebigambo ebyo eby’okwagala ku maama.

fields.title: Okuggulawo Enzigi
fields.body_html:
Nze ne Anne twava ku M/V Anastasis ku nkomerero y’omwaka 1994. Zaali myaka ena egy’essanyu lingi okuva mu kiwonvu kyange eky’obutebenkevu bw’otulo, era twali tuweereddwa omukisa ogw’ebintu ebingi eby’ekitalo n’emikwano emipya. Twali tugenderedde okudda mu British Columbia ennungi, ate nate, okutwala obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okukulembera ekkanisa ne Christian & Missionary Alliance. Baali bampadde ekitiibwa kinene nga bakuumira okwewandiisa kwange gye bali, wadde nga saali nkyakola mirimu gy’ekibiina ekyo mu butongole. Nnaweebwa erinnya ery’obuweereza obw’enjawulo, kubanga Omukulu w’Ekitundu yamanya omugaso gw’omulimu ogwakolebwa abakozi ba Anastasis mu nnimiro y’obwamisonaali eya West Africa, ekitundu C&MA gye baali ne kinene.

Naye okusooka, twalina okukozesa omukisa okukyalira muwala waffe Lynette n’ab’omu maka ge mu Australia. Twasobozesebwa okukola kino olw’ekisa kya musawo eyali akyalidde ku Anastasis. Ekiro kimu, nga twogera, nnayogera nti nnalina abaana b’abaana basatu mu Australia be nnali sinnaba kulaba. Ku ssaawa ez’olweggulo lwennyini, yagenda mu kisenge kyaffe n’agamba Anne nti, “Buli lwe munaayagala okugenda e Australia, amatikiti gammwe gamaze okusasulirwa!” Kino kyandibadde olugendo olw’omu bulamu omulundi gumu gwokka, bwe tutyo ne tuteekateeka okukyala emyezi mukaaga.

Lowooza essanyu lyaffe bwe lyeyongera Anne bwe yategeezebwa, ng’asaba n’ekisa, omukozi w’entambula Omungereza nti engeri esinga okukekkereza ye kuyita mu Canada nga tuyimirira mu Vancouver. “Yee, tuyinza okuyimirira mu kkubo bwe tuba twagadde.” Bwe kityo, omwezi gumu ne guyisibwa mu Victoria, nga tulaba ab’omu maka ga bawala baffe abalala n’emikwano, nga tetunnaba kweyongera mu lugendo lwaffe okutuuka eri Lynette n’ab’omu maka ge mu Canberra.

Omwezi ogusooka gwandibadde omuzibu nnyo gye ndi, okwetegereza obulamu obutali na mulimu n’obutamanya bya mu maaso. Oluvannyuma ne ŋŋenda okuyigiriza essomero ery’ekyeya ery’e Capernwray Bible School mu Moss Vale, okumpi ne Sydney. Kino kyali wiiki esooka eya Jjanwali 1995, abayizi nga bajja okumala wiiki emu okuva mu buvanjuba bwonna obwa Australia.

Okuyitibwa kwange okwogera mu ssomero lino kwajja nga kya kwewuunya nnyo era kisaanira okubuulirwa. Emyaka ebiri emabega, nga ndi mu Africa, nnali mfunye ebbaluwa okuva mu bafumbo abato abaali baze ku Capernwray mu Australia okumala essomero ery’emyezi mukaaga. Baŋŋamba nti omukulembeze yali agambye nti singa nnajja mu Australia, nnandisanyusibbwa okuyigiriza mu ssomero (nnakisoma ng’ekigambo ekya bulijjo eky’omukulembeze ng’addamu okusaba kw’omuyizi okugamba nti ‘tusaba oyite omusumba wange ajje ayigirize mu ssomero’ – nga amanyi nti batono ku bo abandituuse ‘wansi w’ensi’).

Bwe twamanya nti tugenda mu Australia okuva Okitobba 1995 okutuuka Maaki 1996, nnawandiikira omukulembeze w’essomero nga mmutegeeza olugendo lwaffe era nga neebuuza oba wandibadde omukisa okuyigiriza mu ssomero okumala wiiki emu oba nga bwe kityo.

Okuddamu kwe kwali kusinga bye nnali nsuubidde kubanga yampita okuyigiriza mu ‘ssomero ery’ekyeya’ lino ery’ewiiki bbiri, abantu okuva ku lubalama lwonna olw’ebuvanjuba bwa Australia gye baali bajja. Nnayitibwa okuwa okusoma kkumi, buli kumu nga kwa ssaawa emu, ku mulamwa gwe nnaali neerondedde.

Ffe abawera nga nsanvu twakuŋŋaanira e Wongabri, amaka amalungi aga Capernwray, ku Lunaku olw’Enkomerero y’Omwaka 1995. Peter McDonough, omukulembeze, yatwaniriza n’oluvannyuma n’asaba buli omu ayimirire era yeeyanjule. Bangi baali batambudde ebbanga eddene okutuuka ku wiiki eno, okuva e Adelaide, Melbourne ne Brisbane, okwo nga otadde ne abo abaali okumpi. Nze nnali wa nkomerero okuyimirira era nnatandika okweyanjula nga ŋŋamba nti, “Peter McDonough, oli musajja mugumu nnyo, oba musajja musirusiru nnyo, oba musajja wa mwoyo nnyo!” Ne neeyongera okubagamba engeri gye yampita okuba omwogezi waabwe, nga saalabwangako era nga saawulirwangako.

“Nnyinza okuba omwogezi asinga okukoowoola gwe muwuliddeko, ate musasudde ssente nnungi okutuuka wano n’okusoma mu ssomero lino.” Kimala okugamba nti wiiki eyo yagenda bulungi nnyo, era nnali nkimanyi bulijjo okukulembera kwa Mukama nga okuyigiriza kwange okuva mu Kitabo ky’Abaefeso kwegatta bulungi n’okusoma okulala okwaweebwa Peter ne mukozi munne omu. (Omulamwa gw’okuyigiriza kwange gwafuuka ensibuko y’ekitabo ekisooka kye nnawandiika “The Key in My Hand”) Bwe twakuŋŋaana okusiibula, Peter yatubuulira engeri gye yali atuuse okumpita okuba omuyigiriza waabwe. Yali ayingidde mu ofiisi ye olunaku olumu ng’alina olukalala lw’amannya ge yali agenda okusabira alabe gw’ayite. Yasaba omuwandiisi we obutamutawaanya kubanga yandimazizza enkya eno mu kusaba.

Yawuniikirira okuwulira nti waaliwo ebbaluwa emu yokka eyali etuuse ku lunaku olwo mu kifo ky’ennyingi ez’ebulijjo, bwe kityo n’asalawo okugisoma nga tannatandika kusaba. Yali eva eri omuntu gw’atamanyi mu Africa ng’agamba nti yandisanyusibbwa okuyigiriza mu ssomero (erya bulijjo) singa wabaawo omukisa. Peter yawuniikirira olw’ekigambo nti ebbaluwa emu yokka ye yali etuuse ku lunaku olwo n’atandika okwebuuza oba kino kyali kya kutaataaganya kwa Mukama. Teyafuna mirembe ku gw’ayita bwe yagenda ka a mu maka okulya n’omukazi we, Pam. Baasaba bombi ne bawulira nti Mukama mazima yali abakulembedde nga akozesa ebbaluwa eno emu yokka – “bwe ntyo ne ŋŋita Gareth n’okutya kungi.”

Olw’ekyava mu wiiki eyo, nnafuna okuyitibwa okwogera mu makkanisa mangi. Mu Febwali, nze ne Anne twavuga okugenda e Melbourne gye twali mu lukiiko olwa buli mwaka olwa C&MA mu Australia. Okuyitibwa okulala kwe kwagoberera bwe kityo nti, mangu, twasanga buli wiikendi eyimiriddwa emirimu gy’okwogera. Waaliwo enkuŋŋaana bbiri eza wiikendi mu Adelaide, ezaali zaawukanyizibbwa ennaku kkumi ez’e Perth, mu bugwanjuba bwa Australia. Oluvannyuma ne tukyalira e Brisbane gye twali n’omukisa okumala ekiseera ne mwannyinaze n’ab’omu maka ge.

Nga tetunnaba kuva mu Australia, nnakyalirwa Pulezidenti wa C&MA ow’omu Australia eyampita okudda emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma okukulembera olukuŋŋaana lw’okuwummulamu olw’abasumba be, abakadde n’abakazi baabwe mu Melbourne.

“Kino kye kikola kye kirikuweesa,” Anne bwe yagamba. “Omutima gwo teguli mu bufuzi bw’ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu, naye guli mu kubeera awamu n’abasumba n’abamisonaali okubagumya n’okubaweereza. Twala ekiseera olabe oba eno Mukama gy’anaakukulembera okugenda ekiseera ekiddako.

Tuyinza okuwangaala ku nfuna eva mu bayizi abali mu maka gaffe, ate ggwe ogende otambule oyigirize.” Kimala okugamba nti, mu myaka egyaddirira gino, twewuunyizza nnyo bwe twalaba okukulembera kwa Mukama mu kuggulawo enzigi gye ndi okutambula n’okuweereza mu nsi nnyingi bwe zityo, nga tewali n’emu gye nnanoonya nga mpandiika bbaluwa oba nga nkuba ssimu. Ampadde buli ssente ye nnetaaga olw’entambula, awatali kusaba wadde okumanyisa omuntu yenna obwetaavu. Ntambudde okugenda e Mexico, Peru ne Brazil, India ne Nepal, Australia ne New Zealand, Holland ne Great Britain.

Buli lwe nninnya ku nnyonyi, njolesa okwewuunya kwange eri Mukama n’okusaba nti ankuume obutaba na ndowooza ya mukyala wabweru n’amalala, era nti ankulembere okutuuka eri omukozi alumwa Mukama gw’ayagala mmwogerere.
fields.body_text: Nze ne Anne twava ku M/V Anastasis ku nkomerero y’omwaka 1994. fields.title: Obuyita Obungi Obw'Obuweereza obw'Okutambulatambula
fields.body_html:
Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera kyaffe eky'ekitalo mu Australia, ne kuddako emyezi esatu egyaddirira nga tuzzeeyo mu Wales, natandika okufuna obuyita okutambula okugenda mu nsi endala, okusinga obwava mu bakulembeze ba YWAM abaali baagala mbayigirize mu masomero gaabwe aga DTS. Olugendo lwange olusooka mu February 1996, lwali okudda mu Mexico City gye ‘nnafiirwa omutima gwange’ era gye nawulirira okuyitibwa okw'obumisoni mu 1988/9. Eyo neefunira emikwano emipya mingi era ne nzizaawo enkolagana ne ‘muwala waffe’ Vicky gwe twali twayambye okuyita mu Compassion emyaka mingi emabega.

Kyali kya ssanyu okusisinkana Francisco n'ab'omu maka ge nate era n'okutandika omukwano omupya ne Maritza Sierra, muwala wa Paco Sierra, omwana wa Mexico eyasinga okwatiikirira mu by'ennyimba ez'opera. Yali mukwano gwa bazadde ba Placido Domingo, era ye Placido gwe yawaayo enkola ye ey'olubereberye eya Othello mu New York Metropolitan Opera House, kubanga “ggwe Othello asinga obulungi gwe nnali mpuliddeko.”

Okwongera ku kuyigiriza mu DTS, nayitibwa okwogera mu makanisa ag'ekitundu, okukulembera olukiiko lw'ennaku bbiri olw'abasumba, n'okuyigiriza olukungaana olw'oku makya olw'obufumbo. Maritza, ne mwannyina Martha, baali bakkiriza abapya abaanyita okugenda okulya emmere ey'omu ttuntu mu wooteeri eyali mu Chapultapek Park, ekifo ekinene eky'ebbuga wakati.

Twatuuka mu kiseera eky'emmere ey'omu ttuntu era tetwava okutuusa nga wayiseewo n'edda essaawa ya musanvu ez'akawungeezi, kubanga baabuuza ebibuuzo bingi nnyo ebikwata ku kukkiriza kwabwe okupya. Nga kya ssanyu okuyigiriza abakazi abato abanyiikivu bwe batyo – era nga kya ssanyu okumanya nti bombi bakyagenda mu maaso obulungi ne Mukama waabwe! Mu August 1996, nayitibwa e YWAM Fortaleza mu bukiikakkono obw'ebuvanjuba obwa Brazil.

Tony Lima, omu ku bavubuka abaasinga okufukibwako amafuta be nnali nsanze, yali atandiseewo omulimu gwa YWAM ogw'ekitalo mu kibuga kino, ekyayitibwa Canadian Broadcasting Corporation nga ‘ekibuga eky'obukulu obw'ensi yonna mu by'obwenzi bw'abaana!’ Okutuuka kwange kwajja mu kiseera ekitali kirungi, kubanga Tony yali yeetaaze okutambula okugenda mu kibuga Brazilia, ng'awamu n'omulambo gw'omuvubuka eyafiira ku kifo kya YWAM silinda ya gaasi bwe yabwatuka. Yali agezaako okuwonya abalala obulabe bwayo, silinda bwe yamala okwesumattula ku sitoovu ya gaasi gye yali agyawa gaasi. Neewaayo okugumya mu kunakuwala abayizi abalala, naddala mwannyina w'omuvubuka eyali alabye okubwatuka okwo.

Kyokka nabasanga nga bavubuka abagumu nnyo, nga banakuwadde ennaku bbiri zokka ne baddamu okweyongera n'obulamu bwabwe nga beewaayo buggya okuweereza Mukama gwe baali batakendeezezaako bwesige bwabwe.

Okumala wiiki ssatu nayigiriza mu ssomero buli nkya ne njogera mu makanisa ag'ekitundu buli kawungeezi. Kino kyali kitegekeddwa bwe kityo, bwe ntyo nnali n'obudde obw'akawungeezi busatu ne ku makya ga Ssande mu kkanisa emu, ne kuddako akawungeezi aka Ssande n'obudde obw'akawungeezi obulala busatu mu kkanisa endala.

Nnalina ekisa eky'ekitalo buli we nnagenda, kye nkakasa nti kyava ku kitiibwa ekinene abasumba ab'ekitundu kye baali bawa Tony ne mukazi we Christine.

Nga nzeeyo ewaffe mu BC, nayitibwa okukulembera Olusiisira lw'Abasajja n'abasajja nga 70 abaava mu Kkanisa ya Baputiisiti mu Kelowna. Kino kyali kiseera kya magoba mangi nga njigiriza ku Kuteebwa – (laba ekitabo kyange The Key in My Hand). Mexico yaddamu okubeera ku ntegeka emyezi esatu oluvannyuma, naye ku mulundi guno ne wagattibwako olugendo lwa wiiki bbiri okugenda e Peru. Nayigiriza mu ssomero lya DTS eryali mu kiwonvu ekimeramera ku buvanjuba bwa Lima ekibuga ekikulu, oluvannyuma ne mbeera omugenyi wa Betty Mariaca n'ab'omu maka ge mu Lima. Kitaawe yali omukulu wa poliisi eyawummula – weewaawo, ow'ekika ky'omunene, ow'amaanyi ogwo gwe tutera okwerabira ku bakulu ba poliisi ab'omu Latin America. Kyali ku makya ag'oluvannyuma bwe yannyita okunywa naye kaawa. Natuula ku kammeeza akatono nga waliwo obukopo obutono bubiri obwa kaawa mu maaso gaffe, bwe yaggya mu ssanduuko ye eddebe eddene erya kaawa owa Tim Horton – ekika ekyamanyibwa nnyo era ekimanyiddwa Abakanada bonna. Yali akifunye ng'ekirabo okuva eri owooluganda mu Ottawa, Canada, era yayagala okukigabana n'omugenyi we Omukanada.

Ne kuddako obuyita okugenda e India ne Nepal nga tetunnadda mu Australia okwanukula obuyita bwa pulezidenti wa C&MA obwa 1995. Kya lwatu nti, Mukama yali atuggulirawo enzigi era ng'akakasa obuweereza bwange obw'omu maaso, kubanga saali nnoonyezza buyita bwonna obwali bunjijira kaakati. Saali mpandiise baruwa n'emu, saali nkubye ssimu n'emu era saali nsabye ssente n'emu okuwagira emirimu gyange. Kaakati, saalina nsimbi za bulijjo eziva mu lukiiko lwa kkanisa. Katonda yalina okweraga nga ye Yehova Yire wange – era mazima ddala akikoze!
