Tony Lima, omu ku bavubuka abaasinga okufukibwako amafuta be nnali nsanze, yali atandiseewo omulimu gwa YWAM ogw'ekitalo mu kibuga kino, ekyayitibwa Canadian Broadcasting Corporation nga ‘ekibuga eky'obukulu obw'ensi yonna mu by'obwenzi bw'abaana!’ Okutuuka kwange kwajja mu kiseera ekitali kirungi, kubanga Tony yali yeetaaze okutambula okugenda mu kibuga Brazilia, ng'awamu n'omulambo gw'omuvubuka eyafiira ku kifo kya YWAM silinda ya gaasi bwe yabwatuka. Yali agezaako okuwonya abalala obulabe bwayo, silinda bwe yamala okwesumattula ku sitoovu ya gaasi gye yali agyawa gaasi. Neewaayo okugumya mu kunakuwala abayizi abalala, naddala mwannyina w'omuvubuka eyali alabye okubwatuka okwo. Kyokka nabasanga nga bavubuka abagumu nnyo, nga banakuwadde ennaku bbiri zokka ne baddamu okweyongera n'obulamu bwabwe nga beewaayo buggya okuweereza Mukama gwe baali batakendeezezaako bwesige bwabwe. Okumala wiiki ssatu nayigiriza mu ssomero buli nkya ne njogera mu makanisa ag'ekitundu buli kawungeezi. Kino kyali kitegekeddwa bwe kityo, bwe ntyo nnali n'obudde obw'akawungeezi busatu ne ku makya ga Ssande mu kkanisa emu, ne kuddako akawungeezi aka Ssande n'obudde obw'akawungeezi obulala busatu mu kkanisa endala. Nnalina ekisa eky'ekitalo buli we nnagenda, kye nkakasa nti kyava ku kitiibwa ekinene abasumba ab'ekitundu kye baali bawa Tony ne mukazi we Christine. Nga nzeeyo ewaffe mu BC, nayitibwa okukulembera Olusiisira lw'Abasajja n'abasajja nga 70 abaava mu Kkanisa ya Baputiisiti mu Kelowna. Kino kyali kiseera kya magoba mangi nga njigiriza ku Kuteebwa – (laba ekitabo kyange The Key in My Hand). Mexico yaddamu okubeera ku ntegeka emyezi esatu oluvannyuma, naye ku mulundi guno ne wagattibwako olugendo lwa wiiki bbiri okugenda e Peru. Nayigiriza mu ssomero lya DTS eryali mu kiwonvu ekimeramera ku buvanjuba bwa Lima ekibuga ekikulu, oluvannyuma ne mbeera omugenyi wa Betty Mariaca n'ab'omu maka ge mu Lima. Kitaawe yali omukulu wa poliisi eyawummula – weewaawo, ow'ekika ky'omunene, ow'amaanyi ogwo gwe tutera okwerabira ku bakulu ba poliisi ab'omu Latin America. Kyali ku makya ag'oluvannyuma bwe yannyita okunywa naye kaawa. Natuula ku kammeeza akatono nga waliwo obukopo obutono bubiri obwa kaawa mu maaso gaffe, bwe yaggya mu ssanduuko ye eddebe eddene erya kaawa owa Tim Horton – ekika ekyamanyibwa nnyo era ekimanyiddwa Abakanada bonna. Yali akifunye ng'ekirabo okuva eri owooluganda mu Ottawa, Canada, era yayagala okukigabana n'omugenyi we Omukanada. Ne kuddako obuyita okugenda e India ne Nepal nga tetunnadda mu Australia okwanukula obuyita bwa pulezidenti wa C&MA obwa 1995. Kya lwatu nti, Mukama yali atuggulirawo enzigi era ng'akakasa obuweereza bwange obw'omu maaso, kubanga saali nnoonyezza buyita bwonna obwali bunjijira kaakati. Saali mpandiise baruwa n'emu, saali nkubye ssimu n'emu era saali nsabye ssente n'emu okuwagira emirimu gyange. Kaakati, saalina nsimbi za bulijjo eziva mu lukiiko lwa kkanisa. Katonda yalina okweraga nga ye Yehova Yire wange – era mazima ddala akikoze!

fields.title: Ku Kkubo Eritwala e Varanasi
fields.body_html:
Mu 1996, nafuna ebbaluwa okuva mu sseminari eyali mu bukiikakkono bwa India, nga bambuuza oba nnandyagadde okujja eyo okusomesa mu wiiki eyayitibwanga “Spiritual Emphasis” (Okussa Essira ku by’Omwoyo). Waaliwo omusajja Omuyindi eyali wa kwogera mu weema ennene buli kiro, ate nze nnali wa kusomesa essaawa emu buli nkya eri abayizi bonna, abakozi n’abakkiriza ab’omu kitundu abaali basobola okujja. Eyampandiikira yayongerako nti erinnya lyange yali aliweereddwa ow’oluganda ali mu UK, eyali ayogedde nti nnandijja newankubadde nga tebaali basobola kumpa buyambi bwa nsimbi. Nakkiriza okugenda kubanga nnali neewaddeyo dda eri Mukama nti nnandikkirizza obuyita bwonna, okuba nga waliwo ensimbi ezimala mu ‘akawunti kange ak’obuweereza’ omwo mwe mwateekebwanga ebirabo, ensimbi z’ekitiibwa, n’ebirala byonna.

Olugendo lwateekebwateekebwa okubaawo mu February 1997. Anne yaboga ku lugendo luno mu bbaluwa yaffe eya Sekukkulu ku nkomerero y’omwaka ogwo, bwe tutyo tetwewuunya nnyo bbaluwa endala bwe yajja ku ntandikwa y’Omwaka Omuggya nga bambuuza oba nnandyongedde olugendo lwange mu Asia okwongerako omwezi gumu ogw’obuweereza ne Youth With A Mission (YWAM) mu Nepal. Kino nnali njagala nnyo okukikola kubanga tulina ebijjukizo eby’ekyokusanyusa eby’obumu bwaffe n’abakkiriza b’e Nepal mu baserikale ba Ghurka ab’e Hong Kong. Bwe lutyo olugendo lwateekebwateekebwa – wiiki bbiri mu Allahabad, India, oluvannyuma omwezi gumu mu Nepal, gye nnandivudde ne ntambula okutuuka mu Australia n’essomero lya Capernwray, Anne gye yali andindiridde.

Tikiti yange ey’olugendo lwonna olw’emyezi etaano yali ya muwendo ogwenkanankana ddala n’ekyo kye nnalina mu ‘akawunti k’obuweereza.’

Nayogera mu bibinja bitaano ebitono eby’esseminari mu New Dehli nga sinnaba kusaabala ggaali ery’ekiro okutuuka mu Allahabad ne mu sseminari. Olwokubanga omwogezi omukulu teyatuuka ku Ssande, nasabibwa okwogera mu lukuŋŋaana lw’omu weema ennene eri abakkiriza ebikumi n’ebikumi. Awo buli nkya, nnayogera eri abayizi ekikumi awamu n’abakozi n’abagenyi, nga mw’otwalidde bangi abaava mu sseminari y’abakazi ey’omu kitundu – awamu abantu nga ebikumi bibiri. Kyagenda bulungi nnyo, era bonna baakkiriza okusomesa kwange n’ekisa.

Ku Lwamukaaga, omulimu gwange gwali guwedde naye nnali n’ekizibu. Ku Balaza eyaddirira, nnali nteekwa okubuuka ennyonyi okutuuka mu Kathmandu. Naye ababaka ba Air India baŋŋamba nti tikiti yange ey’ennyonyi (eyalagirwa ne kompyuta emala wiiki nga si nnyingi mu Canada) teyalabika, era nti olunaku olusooka lwe baali basobola okunteeka ku nnyonyi lwali Lwakutaano, ng’ewiiki eyitawo. Enkola endala yokka yali kusaabala baasi okumala essaawa kkumi na ttaano ku luguudo olutali lulungi, n’okusitula ensawo zange zombi enzito ez’olugendo olubanga oluwanvu okusala ku nsalo. Ekisaawe ky’ennyonyi ekyali okumpi kyali Varanasi, kilomita 150 okuvaawo, bwe ntyo saasobola kugenda mangu ku kisaawe kwekebejja ekizibu.

Mu mwaka oguyise, pulezidenti wa sseminari yali avuddeyo, ne wabaawo omukulembeze ow’akaseera, eyali minsani okuva mu USA, eyali akulembera omulimu. Rudy Raby ne mukyala we Eleanor baali bawezezza emyaka egisukka mu nsanvu naye okwagala kwabwe eri Mukama n’omulimu gwe tekwakendeera.

“Gareth, nteekwa okugenda ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ku Lwamukaaga, okukima omugenyi ava mu Australia,” Rudy bwe yagamba. “Lwaki tojja nange tulabe oba tusobola okuzuula ekyagwa ku tikiti yo? Oboolyawo erinnya lyo baalitabudde mu bikwata byabwe eyo.” Bwe nnazuukuka ku makya g’Olwamukaaga olwo, nakakasa Mukama nti nnali mwetegefu okutambula mu baasi, naye nnandisinze nnyo okutambula mu nnyonyi! Bwe kityo, nga wayiseewo akaseera katono, Rudy, Eleanor nange ne tutandika olugendo olw’essaawa ttaano okuva Allahabad okutuuka Varanasi, ekisaawe ky’ennyonyi.

Olugendo lwali lwa mpola kubanga oluguudo olufunda olwakyukakyuka lwali lujjudde ebinnya, abantu, n’ente. Nga wayiseewo essaawa nga ssatu mu lugendo lwaffe, Eleanor yawulira etteeka eritagambika ery’okuseeyeeya. Mu India ekyo kitera kutegeeza ‘emabega w’ekisaka ekiri okumpi’ bwe kityo Rudy n’alagirwa okuyimirira mu kifo ekisooka ekituufu. Ekyo tekyagwana Eleanor bwe kityo Rudy n’agambibwa okuvuga akatono nga yeeyongerayo. Kino kyeddiŋŋana emirundi esatu okutuusa lwe twayimirira emabega w’emmotoka eyali eyimiridde.

Eleanor bwe yagenda mu bisaka ebyali okumpi, omuvuzi w’emmotoka, eyandiraba engeri gye twali tuyimiriramu ne tugendako mu ddakiika ezaali ziyise, n’ava mu mmotoka ye n’atusemberera.

“Waliwo ekitali kituufu?” n’abuuza. “Nedda, kaseera ka kuseeyeeya kokka,” Rudy n’addamu, oluvannyuma, bwe yamutunuulira ennyo, “Ki ekyo, si ggwe Simon Job?”

“Yee,” omugwira n’addamu. “Ggwe ani?” “Nze Rudy Rabi!” Rudy n’aleekaana bwe yava mu mmotoka ne bombi ne bagwiramukiriza. Kyeyoleka nti, emyaka kkumi na etaano emabega, Simon ne mutabani wa Rudy baali mikwano mikulu ennyo mu ssomero awamu, nga ne bakitaabwe basomeseza mu sseminari.

Baamanyisa nange, era bwe yawulira ku kizibu kyange eky’etikiti, Simon n’ansaba enteekateeka yange ey’olugendo, ng’agamba nti “Kino kiveeyo ndabirira nze.” “Oli malayika?” ne mubuuza, nga ntunula okulaba oba waliwo ebiwaawaatiro ebirabika.

Oluvannyuma akawungeezi ako, nga tuwummulira mu wooteeri e Varanasi, Simon n’ampita okuŋŋamba nti omubaka we yali wa kuntwala ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ku makya. Yali tasobodde kutegeka tikiti naye n’ankakasa nti omubaka we yandigezezzaako kyonna kye yasobola.

Mu lugendo olwa kilomita 25 okutuuka ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ku makya ag’oluvannyuma, ‘omubaka’ we, eyali maneja wa wooteeri yange, yaŋŋamba nti, mu kibuga ekyo eky’Abahindu, Simon Job yali omu ku basajja abaasinganga okussibwamu ekitiibwa, empisa ze ez’Ekikristaayo nga zirabika mu bikolwa bye byonna eby’obusuubuzi. N’aŋŋamba nate nti yali ayogeddeganya n’ofiisi ya Air India ku makya ago era nga banteeseeko nga nammba 10 ku lukalala lwabwe olw’abalindirira ab’omu ‘business class’. Nammba 10! Omutima gwange ne guggwaamu essuubi bwe nnategeera essuubi ttono lye nnali nnina ery’okufuna entebe, nga mmanyi nti waliwo entebe nga kkumi zokka mu business class.

Ekisenge ky’okulindirira eky’oku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi kyali kijjudde abatambuze, okusinga abasaddaaka n’abalambuzi abaali bajja mu kibuga kino ekisinga byonna okuba eky’Abahindu mu India. Nnatuula ku migugu gyange mu nsonda emu ate omubaka n’agenda okunoonya tikiti yange. Nga wayiseewo eddakiika kkumi n’akomawo. “Mwami Evans, nzudde erinnya lyo!” n’aleekaana, “naye baakuggyeeko ku lukalala lw’Olwabalaza kubanga balina ekibinja kinene eky’abalambuzi ekiyita!” Bwe yalaba obunyiivu bwange, n’ayanguwa okugattako nti, “Nabagambye nti tewali muntu aggya mukwano gwa Simon Job ku lukalala!”

Essaawa emu n’eyitawo. Ekibinja ekinene eky’abatambuze kyali kigenze mu kisenge ky’okusimbula, nze nga nkyalindirira n’obugumiikiriza omubaka n’omuvuzi we okukomawo tulyoke tuddeyo mu kibuga. Mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini, omuvubuka n’ajja ng’adduka ng’akutte tikiti mu ngalo ze. “Jangu, ssebo,” n’aleekaana, “Oli ku nnyonyi eno leero.” N’atwala ensawo zange zombi ez’olugendo n’adduka okwolekera omulyango gw’okusimbula. Bwe nnamutuukako, ne mubuuza nti, “Bameka ku lukalala lw’abalindirira abaayingidde ku nnyonyi?” Bwe yaŋŋamba nti babiri bokka be baafuna tikiti, ne neewuunya, nga mmanyi nti nnali nammba 10. N’addamu nti, “Nedda ssebo, buli muntu yenna mukwano gwa Simon Job wano ye nammba 1!” Ne nnyiruka mu kkubo ne nnyingira mu nnyonyi ne nsanga nti nze nnekka nnali mu nnyonyi!

Ng’omuweereza w’omu nnyonyi antuzza mu ntebe esooka, ne ntya nti nnali mu nnyonyi etali yo, okutuusa lwe nnalaba enzigi z’ekisaawe nga zigguddwawo n’abatambuze abalala bonna nga batambula nga batwolekera. Buli omu ku bo yankutamiza omutwe bwe yayingira nga balowooza nti nnali mukungu mukulu! Era mazima ddala ndi bwe ntyo – Omwana wa Kabaka – era mukwano gwa Simon Job!

Kiyinza okuba nti Katonda, ng’amanyi nti omwana we yali n’ebizibu by’olugendo, ye yaleetera omusuubuzi omuvubuka okuyimirira ku mabbali g’oluguudo mu kifo kye kimu ddala, awo nga wayiseewo eddakiika ntono, omukazi omukadde gy’ali yeetaaga okuyimirira aseeyeeye? Kya kabwabwenyi? Sirowooza bwe kityo!

Waaliwo omwezi ogw’ekitalo ogw’obuweereza mu Nepal, mwe nnazuulira babiri ku baserikale ba Ghurka be nnalina omukisa okusomesa mu Hong Kong. Nayogera eri ebibinja bingi ebya YWAM ne mu makanisa mangi.

Nnalina omukisa omukulu okusisinkana omusajja eyali akulembera ekkanisa mu biseera eby’okuyigganyizibwa okunene, ng’eggwanga terinnaba kukkiriza obuweereza bw’Ekikristaayo ku ntandikwa y’emyaka gy’ekyenda mu 90. Emiwendo gye mpandiise wammanga giyinza okuba nga si mituufu naye si kya bunene. Yali akwatiddwa emirundi abiri, ng’ateekeddwa mu kkomera emirundi munaana ng’amaze n’emyaka nga kkumi n’ebiri mu kkomera. Buli lwe yateebwanga, yaddangayo mu kkanisa ye eyayokebwa n’atandika okubuulira nate. Okutiisibwatiisibwa, okukubibwa n’okukwatibwa ne bimuddirira nate.

Olwokubanga nze saali nnabonaabonyezebwa, ne mubuuza engeri gye yasobozesa okuba omuvumu mu byonna ebyo. Okuddamu kwe kwali kwa kumulisa. Yagamba nti, “Gareth, lwaki nnanditeredde nga mmanyi nti empologoma emaze okuwuluguma n’eddoboozi lyayo erisinga obw’amaanyi?” Obuwombeefu bwe bwayolekebwa era bwe, mu kaseera we twawummuliramu okusomesa kwange, kwe yali avvuunula, ffembi ne batuleetera ebikopo eby’ekyuma ebijjudde Coca Cola okunywako. N’agamba nti, “Nga kya mukisa okuyimirira awamu ne nnabbi – kubanga n’endogoyi eweebwa okunywako!”

Ku nnyonyi bwe twava mu Kathmandu, nnaweebwa omukisa okuba n’entebe eri ku ddirisa ku ludda olwa kkono, we nnasobolera okulaba obulungi ensozi za Himalaya, nga tutambula okwolekera ebuvanjuba nga tetunnakyuka kwolekera bukiikaddyo okutuuka Singapore ne Sydney. Eggulu lyali bbululu ng’erabika bulungi, ensozi nga zimasamasa nga nnyeru era nga zirabika kaati, wabula akatundu kamu akatono akaddugavu ak’enseŋŋo ssatu – Everest, olubaju lwayo olw’obukiikaddyo lwe lukkakkamu nnyo obutayinza kukwata muzira gwonna!

Nabuuka ne ntuuka mu Sydney, okuva awo ne ntuuka ku Ssomero lya Baibuli erya Capernwray, Anne gye yali andindirira. Wano, nnasomesa abavubuka abaava mu Australia, Bulaaya ne Canada okumala wiiki.

Zino zandibadde ensimbi z’ekitiibwa ez’olubereberye ze nnali nfunye mu myezi ebiri kubanga wadde emirimu egyali mu India oba Nepal tegyali gisobola kunnyamba mu nsaasaanya yange yonna ey’olugendo. Kimala kwogera nti oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu mu Australia, ensimbi z’ekitiibwa zonna ze nnafunayo zaali zenkanankana ddala n’omuwendo gwa tikiti yange ey’emyezi etaano ey’olugendo luno olugatte! Ku ekyo kwe kwongera nti, ekkanisa ya Lynette yali esazeewo okutwewuunyisa n’okutuwa omukisa n’‘ekirabo eky’okwagala’ ekyaddamu ne kyenkana n’omuwendo gwa tikiti egenda mu Brazil, gye nnali ŋŋenda oluvannyuma lw’omwezi gumu. Katonda mwesigwa!

Eleanor bwe yagenda mu bisaka ebyali okumpi, omuvuzi w’emmotoka, eyandiraba engeri gye twali tuyimiriramu ne tugendako mu ddakiika ezaali ziyise, n’ava mu mmotoka ye n’atusemberera. “Waliwo ekitali kituufu?” n’abuuza. “Nedda, kaseera ka kuseeyeeya kokka,” Rudy n’addamu, oluvannyuma, bwe yamutunuulira ennyo, “Ki ekyo, si ggwe Simon Job?” “Yee,” omugwira n’addamu. “Ggwe ani?” “Nze Rudy Rabi!” Rudy n’aleekaana bwe yava mu mmotoka ne bombi ne bagwiramukiriza. Kyeyoleka nti, emyaka kkumi na etaano emabega, Simon ne mutabani wa Rudy baali mikwano mikulu ennyo mu ssomero awamu, nga ne bakitaabwe basomeseza mu sseminari. Baamanyisa nange, era bwe yawulira ku kizibu kyange eky’etikiti, Simon n’ansaba enteekateeka yange ey’olugendo, ng’agamba nti “Kino kiveeyo ndabirira nze.” “Oli malayika?” ne mubuuza, nga ntunula okulaba oba waliwo ebiwaawaatiro ebirabika. Oluvannyuma akawungeezi ako, nga tuwummulira mu wooteeri e Varanasi, Simon n’ampita okuŋŋamba nti omubaka we yali wa kuntwala ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ku makya. Yali tasobodde kutegeka tikiti naye n’ankakasa nti omubaka we yandigezezzaako kyonna kye yasobola. Mu lugendo olwa kilomita 25 okutuuka ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi ku makya ag’oluvannyuma, ‘omubaka’ we, eyali maneja wa wooteeri yange, yaŋŋamba nti, mu kibuga ekyo eky’Abahindu, Simon Job yali omu ku basajja abaasinganga okussibwamu ekitiibwa, empisa ze ez’Ekikristaayo nga zirabika mu bikolwa bye byonna eby’obusuubuzi. N’aŋŋamba nate nti yali ayogeddeganya n’ofiisi ya Air India ku makya ago era nga banteeseeko nga nammba 10 ku lukalala lwabwe olw’abalindirira ab’omu ‘business class’. Nammba 10! Omutima gwange ne guggwaamu essuubi bwe nnategeera essuubi ttono lye nnali nnina ery’okufuna entebe, nga mmanyi nti waliwo entebe nga kkumi zokka mu business class. Ekisenge ky’okulindirira eky’oku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi kyali kijjudde abatambuze, okusinga abasaddaaka n’abalambuzi abaali bajja mu kibuga kino ekisinga byonna okuba eky’Abahindu mu India. Nnatuula ku migugu gyange mu nsonda emu ate omubaka n’agenda okunoonya tikiti yange. Nga wayiseewo eddakiika kkumi n’akomawo. “Mwami Evans, nzudde erinnya lyo!” n’aleekaana, “naye baakuggyeeko ku lukalala lw’Olwabalaza kubanga balina ekibinja kinene eky’abalambuzi ekiyita!” Bwe yalaba obunyiivu bwange, n’ayanguwa okugattako nti, “Nabagambye nti tewali muntu aggya mukwano gwa Simon Job ku lukalala!” Essaawa emu n’eyitawo. Ekibinja ekinene eky’abatambuze kyali kigenze mu kisenge ky’okusimbula, nze nga nkyalindirira n’obugumiikiriza omubaka n’omuvuzi we okukomawo tulyoke tuddeyo mu kibuga. Mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini, omuvubuka n’ajja ng’adduka ng’akutte tikiti mu ngalo ze. “Jangu, ssebo,” n’aleekaana, “Oli ku nnyonyi eno leero.” N’atwala ensawo zange zombi ez’olugendo n’adduka okwolekera omulyango gw’okusimbula. Bwe nnamutuukako, ne mubuuza nti, “Bameka ku lukalala lw’abalindirira abaayingidde ku nnyonyi?” Bwe yaŋŋamba nti babiri bokka be baafuna tikiti, ne neewuunya, nga mmanyi nti nnali nammba 10. N’addamu nti, “Nedda ssebo, buli muntu yenna mukwano gwa Simon Job wano ye nammba 1!” Ne nnyiruka mu kkubo ne nnyingira mu nnyonyi ne nsanga nti nze nnekka nnali mu nnyonyi! Ng’omuweereza w’omu nnyonyi antuzza mu ntebe esooka, ne ntya nti nnali mu nnyonyi etali yo, okutuusa lwe nnalaba enzigi z’ekisaawe nga zigguddwawo n’abatambuze abalala bonna nga batambula nga batwolekera. Buli omu ku bo yankutamiza omutwe bwe yayingira nga balowooza nti nnali mukungu mukulu! Era mazima ddala ndi bwe ntyo – Omwana wa Kabaka – era mukwano gwa Simon Job! Kiyinza okuba nti Katonda, ng’amanyi nti omwana we yali n’ebizibu by’olugendo, ye yaleetera omusuubuzi omuvubuka okuyimirira ku mabbali g’oluguudo mu kifo kye kimu ddala, awo nga wayiseewo eddakiika ntono, omukazi omukadde gy’ali yeetaaga okuyimirira aseeyeeye? Kya kabwabwenyi? Sirowooza bwe kityo! Waaliwo omwezi ogw’ekitalo ogw’obuweereza mu Nepal, mwe nnazuulira babiri ku baserikale ba Ghurka be nnalina omukisa okusomesa mu Hong Kong. Nayogera eri ebibinja bingi ebya YWAM ne mu makanisa mangi. Nnalina omukisa omukulu okusisinkana omusajja eyali akulembera ekkanisa mu biseera eby’okuyigganyizibwa okunene, ng’eggwanga terinnaba kukkiriza obuweereza bw’Ekikristaayo ku ntandikwa y’emyaka gy’ekyenda mu 90. Emiwendo gye mpandiise wammanga giyinza okuba nga si mituufu naye si kya bunene. Yali akwatiddwa emirundi abiri, ng’ateekeddwa mu kkomera emirundi munaana ng’amaze n’emyaka nga kkumi n’ebiri mu kkomera. Buli lwe yateebwanga, yaddangayo mu kkanisa ye eyayokebwa n’atandika okubuulira nate. Okutiisibwatiisibwa, okukubibwa n’okukwatibwa ne bimuddirira nate. Olwokubanga nze saali nnabonaabonyezebwa, ne mubuuza engeri gye yasobozesa okuba omuvumu mu byonna ebyo. Okuddamu kwe kwali kwa kumulisa. Yagamba nti, “Gareth, lwaki nnanditeredde nga mmanyi nti empologoma emaze okuwuluguma n’eddoboozi lyayo erisinga obw’amaanyi?” Obuwombeefu bwe bwayolekebwa era bwe, mu kaseera we twawummuliramu okusomesa kwange, kwe yali avvuunula, ffembi ne batuleetera ebikopo eby’ekyuma ebijjudde Coca Cola okunywako. N’agamba nti, “Nga kya mukisa okuyimirira awamu ne nnabbi – kubanga n’endogoyi eweebwa okunywako!” Ku nnyonyi bwe twava mu Kathmandu, nnaweebwa omukisa okuba n’entebe eri ku ddirisa ku ludda olwa kkono, we nnasobolera okulaba obulungi ensozi za Himalaya, nga tutambula okwolekera ebuvanjuba nga tetunnakyuka kwolekera bukiikaddyo okutuuka Singapore ne Sydney. Eggulu lyali bbululu ng’erabika bulungi, ensozi nga zimasamasa nga nnyeru era nga zirabika kaati, wabula akatundu kamu akatono akaddugavu ak’enseŋŋo ssatu – Everest, olubaju lwayo olw’obukiikaddyo lwe lukkakkamu nnyo obutayinza kukwata muzira gwonna! Nabuuka ne ntuuka mu Sydney, okuva awo ne ntuuka ku Ssomero lya Baibuli erya Capernwray, Anne gye yali andindirira. Wano, nnasomesa abavubuka abaava mu Australia, Bulaaya ne Canada okumala wiiki. Zino zandibadde ensimbi z’ekitiibwa ez’olubereberye ze nnali nfunye mu myezi ebiri kubanga wadde emirimu egyali mu India oba Nepal tegyali gisobola kunnyamba mu nsaasaanya yange yonna ey’olugendo. Kimala kwogera nti oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu mu Australia, ensimbi z’ekitiibwa zonna ze nnafunayo zaali zenkanankana ddala n’omuwendo gwa tikiti yange ey’emyezi etaano ey’olugendo luno olugatte! Ku ekyo kwe kwongera nti, ekkanisa ya Lynette yali esazeewo okutwewuunyisa n’okutuwa omukisa n’‘ekirabo eky’okwagala’ ekyaddamu ne kyenkana n’omuwendo gwa tikiti egenda mu Brazil, gye nnali ŋŋenda oluvannyuma lw’omwezi gumu. Katonda mwesigwa!

fields.title: Obuweereza mu Brazil
fields.body_html:
Mu biseera eby'omusenyu ogw'omu 1997, nakola olugendo lwange olwokubiri okugenda e Fortaleza, ekibuga ekirungi eky'oku lubalama lw'ennyanja mu Ceara mu bukiikakkono-buvanjuba bwa Brazil. Nga bwe kyali edda, luno lwali lugendo lwa mwezi gumu era omulundi guno nnali n'Anne. Ku lugendo lwange olwasooka nnali nfunye emikwano mingi, kyennava nsanyuka okubannyanulira era n'okuddamu okuloza ku byokunywa eby'ebibala ebibisi n'ekyokunywa kyange kye njagala ennyo, Guarana. Nnalina obuweereza bungi, wamu ne YWAM ne mu kkanisa ez'omu kitundu. Twasula ku base ya YWAM, ewatali wala n'ekibuga, naye twasobola okutambula okugenda mu bifo bingi olw'obuweereza, okugula ebintu, ku mabbali g'ennyanja, n'ebirala.

Emikwano gyange gyabuna Anne n'okwagala, era mangu ago yawulira ng'ali ewaabwe, wadde nga si bonna abaasobola okwogera Olungereza, era mazima ddala ye teyasobola kwogera Lupotugiisi. Nze n'awo nnalina Olusipeyini kwe nnyinza okwesigama kubanga bangi baasobola okutegeera Olusipeyini bwe baba nga tebategeera Lungereza.

Twaddayo e Canada nga tuyita e Rio olw'abafumbo abato be nnamanya ku lugendo lwange olwasooka, mu kiseera lwe nnali mfumbiddwa ne nsengukira eyo. Claudia ne JudeClair baali bakolera mu favella – ekitundu ky'ekibuga ekijjudde ennyo eky'obwavu – kyetwava tusula nabo ennaku bbiri. Batutwala mu nkuba ey'amaanyi, mu nnyumba ey'ebisenge bibiri wakati mu lusozi omwali favella.

Eyo twali ne bulago ku ttaka era ne batulabula nti bwe twandiwulidde okuvuga kw'emmundu oba okuleekaana ekiro, TETWANDIGOLOKOSE kutunula bweru kubanga kirabika ffe twandibadde abanaddirira okuttibwa emmundu! Oluvannyuma ne batulaga ekifaananyi ekyakubibwa ekiro ekyayita eky'omulambo ogwali gukanyuguddwa okuva waggulu, ne gugwa ku mulyango gwabwe. Ekitundu kino kyali kijjudde ebibinja by'abamenyi b'amateeka n'abasuubuzi abakulu b'ebiragalalagala.

Ku makya ag'oluvannyuma, nabuuza JudeClair oba nnyinza okulinnya ku ntikko y'olusozi ndyoke nkube ekifaananyi ky'olusozi olw'okumpi omwayimirizibwa ekifaananyi ekyatiikirira Christo Rey (Kristo Kabaka). “Olina akakalu akakulaga?” yambuuza n'oluvannyuma, bwe yaddira akakalu kange aka Canada ke nnamuwa, n'afuluma ku mulyango, emikono gyombi ng'agiyimusa waggulu w'omutwe gwe, ng'awanika obukalu bwe n'obwange. “Wano, basooka kulasa n'oluvannyuma ne babuuza ebibuuzo” ago ge yayogera mu ngeri ey'ekyama.

Bwe nnatuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi nnasanga base endala eya YWAM eyalabiriranga abaana b'omu favella. Yali kumpi n'akabuga akatono ak'omupiira ak'omuyanja ogw'amayinja nga ka mita nga 50 ku mita 30, nga keetooloddwa olukomera olw'emiguwa gy'ebyuma. Ku ludda olumu waaliwo, kye nnalowooza nti bwe byabanga ebisenge eby'okwambaliramu, ebyazimbibwa n'amatoffaali ag'amayinja. Kati byali bigudde era nga tebikyagasa. JudeClair yaŋŋamba nti oluberyeberye, abasajja abamu ab'omu favella baali bazannya wano ne wajja ekibinja ky'abapoliisi nga balinnye olusozi mu kkubo eddala, ne balabika mangu ku ntikko ne batandika okulasa, ne batta abasajja bonna. ‘Ensonga’ yaabwe yali nti abasajja bano mwe mwali n'abamu abaali bamanyiddwa nga abamenyi b'amateeka n'abasuubuzi b'ebiragalalagala!

Twasiima nnyo omulimu abavubuka bano gwe bakolera Mukama mu bifo eby'akabi ennyo. Obukulembeze bwa YWAM obw'ensi yonna bwali bwa kukuŋŋaanira mu mwaka ogwaddirira mu Brazil kubanga pulezidenti waabwe ow'omu kiseera ekyo yali muminsani Omubrazil. Base ya Tony ey'e Fortaleza yalondebwa base zonna endala ez'e Brazil okuba ekifo eky'okukuŋŋaaniramu abakulembeze ba YWAM okuva wonna mu nsi, kyeyava atandika n'essanyu okuteekateeka omukolo guno. Yasalawo okuyita abasumba bonna ab'omu kitundu okukuŋŋaana okwogera ku kusoboka okusibako olukuŋŋaana lw'obuminsani nga lugenderera n'okujja kw'abaminsani ba YWAM mu kibuga kyabwe, era yasuubira okubasembeza ku base – eyayinza okusembeza abantu nga kikumi mu kkanisa yaayo entono – okutuusa woteeri ow'omu kitundu (owa emmunyeenye ttaano) lwe yeewaayo okugabula eky'emisana ku muwendo omwangu.

Lowooza okwewuunya n'essanyu lyaffe bwe waajja abasajja abasukka mu 250 ne bakkiriza n'obunyiikivu ekirowoozo kya Tony eky'okusibako, si lukuŋŋaana lwa buminsani lwokka, naye n'akaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri mu kibuga kyonna. Bwe gwali gutyo omukisa omuvubuka ono gwe yalina eri abakulembeze b'ekkanisa ab'omu kitundu!

Olwokubanga Tony yali wa kubeera n'emirimu mingi egyetaagisa okukola emikolo gino gyombi, awamu n'okutegeka olukuŋŋaana lw'abakulembeze ba YWAM ab'ensi yonna, yaanjula nti nzireyo mu mwaka ogwaddirira, okumala emyezi esatu, okulabirira abakozi ba YWAM bonna nga bategeka enkuŋŋaana.

Nze ne Anne twakkiriza okuddayo era bwe kityo mu biseera eby'omusenyu ogw'omu 1998 twaddayo e Fortaleza okumala emyezi esatu. Abaatusembeza baali Marcello ne Aline Ramos, abafumbo abato abatya Katonda abataakoowa kutuwa mukisa.

Ennyumba yaabwe yali ku kalinnya akookutaano ak'ennyumba ey'amagolofa okumpi n'olubalama lw'ennyanja era olutambula olusanyusa lwatutuusanga ku ofiisi ennene ey'omu kibuga wakati eyafuuka essinga ery'enteekateeka zonna. Obudde bwa buli kiseera bubuguma e Fortaleza naye buli kawungeezi, empewo empola yafuuwanga ng'eyita mu nnyumba n'ekankanya ebifaananyi byonna okuva ku kisenge singa twali basirusiru okuleka amadirisa gonna nga gaggule!

Nayiga okwogera mu Lupotugiisi n'okugonjoola okutaataaganya okumu okwavanga mu ofiisi, naddala olw'enjawulo mu buwangwa wakati w'abakozi ab'omu kitundu n'abakozi ba YWAM abaava ebweru w'eggwanga abaali bazze okwenyigira mu kaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri, nga bakolera mu nguudo ne mu masomero nga tunnatuuka ku nnaku ssatu ze twali tugenda okumala mu kisaawe ky'omupiira eky'omu kitundu okumaliriza kaweefube.

Ekyokulabirako kimu kyandirabise nga kya kusesa bwe tukirowoozaako oluvannyuma. Ekibinja ky'abavubuka abaava mu USA baali bakoze ttiisi eza langi ezaliko ekigambo “No comprommiso,” nga balowooza nti kino kitegeeza “Tetukyusa” (No compromise). Emikwano gyange Ababrazil ne kibasobera kubanga ebigambo mu Lupotugiisi mu butuufu bitegeeza nti “tewali kwewaayo” – ekyawukana ddala ne kye baali bagenderedde!

Essanyu mu kibuga lyalabikira ddala kubanga buli gy'olaga, waaliwo obukakafu ‘obw'okuwamba kw'Enjiri.’ Olukuŋŋaana lw'obukulembeze lwa YWAM lwali lulungi nnyo era lwampa omukisa okuddamu okusisinkana n'abamu be nnamanya mu kiseera we nnali ku Anastasis.

Abaminsani okuva mu mawanga mangi bajja okwogera ku Lukuŋŋaana lw'Obuminsani, olwajjibwako Ababrazil enkumi n'enkumi – obuwanguzi obw'amaanyi obwandyanjudde abaminsani abapya bangi mu nsi. Munnange Marcello muvunuzi mulungi nnyo kyeyava aba ye avunula mu kaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri okusinga. Kino nakyo kyali kya buwanguzi bwa maanyi mu bikola byakyo ne mu muwendo gw'obukalu bw'abo abaali beebuuza ge twali tugenda okuwa abasumba ab'omu kitundu oluvannyuma balyoke bagobererenga. Bwe nnabuuza Jon, eyavunaanyizibwanga obukalu buno, obungi bwe twali tufunye, ebigambo bye tebigenda kwerabirwa. “Gareth” yagamba, “twalekera awo okubala nga tutuuse ku 45,000!”

Nasanyusibwa nnyo ekibiina ky'ennyimba ekyakulembera okusinza mu buli kawungeezi ku nnaku essatu mu kisaawe ky'omupiira. Baali kibiina kya mwannyina omusajja ne mwannyina omuwala, nga balina abayimbi abaddirira abaava mu kkanisa ennene mu Belo Horizonte. Kyali kirabika nti buli abavubuka lwe baabanga abanyiikivu mu ngeri gye baddangamu ku nnyimba, oba mwannyina omusajja oba mwannyina omuwala amangu ago yabakomyawo ku kussa ekitiibwa ng'afukamira mu kasirise ku maykolofoni n'asaba.

Nasisinkana mwannyina omusajja bwe nnali ntambula ne Marcello ku lubalama lw'ennyanja ku lunaku olwaddirira ne mmwogerako ku kino. Okuddamu kwe kwali kuzzaamu nnyo amaanyi kubanga yagamba nti baali bategeera engeri ebiseera ng'ebyo gye byandibadde 'eby'emmeeme' (nga bigobererera enneewulira z'omuntu okusinga Omwoyo), kyebaava bamalirira ye ne mwannyina omuwala okukyusa obunyiikivu bwonna okubuzza ku Mulokozi oyo yekka asaanira ekitiibwa. Tekyewuunyisa nga balaba Mukama ng'akola ebintu ebyewuunyisa bwe bityo mu buweereza bwabwe!

Nnadda e Fortaleza mu 2002, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ena, era nnasanyuka okulaba nga buli kkanisa gye nnakyalira yali eyongeddeko waakiri emirundi ebiri mu muwendo okuva ku lugendo lwange olwasembayo. Nate, nnayogera mu kkanisa nnyingi ne mpeereza abantu bangi abaakwatibwako okuyigiriza kwange ku 'Release' (laba ekitabo kyange The Key in My Hand). Mu bintu ebisinga obukulu, mwe mwali okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw'abasumba ba Assembly of God olw'obukiikakkono-buvanjuba bwa Brazil. Guno gwali mukolo gwa nnaku ssatu era gwalimu abasumba nga 150.

Ekintu ekirala ekikulu kyali okuweereza abafumbo abato abaali baakamala emyezi mukaaga gyokka nga bafumbiŋŋanye naye kati nga bali mu nkolagana embi nga tewali kwagalana. Maria omutono ono yajja gye ndi n'ennaku nnyingi ng'agamba nti Alfonse yali amwesuddeko (si mannya gaabwe ga ddala). Nga olugero lwe bwe lwagenda lwanjuluka, nawulira obulumi okuddamu okuwulira ku bukambwe bangi bwe bafuna okuva ku bakitaabwe. Sijja kwogera ku byama byonna Maria bye yanjagaza naye kimala okugamba nti waaliwo okuvuma kungi okw'ebigambo okuva eri kitaawe. Bwe yali mu myaka egisembayo egy'obuvubuka bwe yajja eri Kristo, n'asisinkana omuvubuka (Alfonse) n'afumbirwa.

Olwokubanga omusumba yakkiriza eŋŋambo nti yali malaaya, eŋŋambo ze yeegaana, yagaana okubagattira mu kkanisa, n'alonda okukola omukolo omutono ku maka g'omugole omusajja, ogwajjibwako bazadde be bokka. Oluvannyuma lwa bbanga ttono ne bajja e Fortaleza okukolera ne YWAM. Nayigiriza Maria nti kitaawe n'omusumba baali bamwonoonye era nti yali yeetaaga okubasumulula alyoke Katonda atandike enkola y'okumuwonya.

Yali ateekwa okuwandiika ebbaluwa ng'ategeeza ensonga ze zonna eziri ku kitaawe alyoke abeere n'ekiwandiiko kya byonna bye yali amwetegefu okumusonyiwako. Ekiro ekyaddirira yasula okuwandiika ebbaluwa (etaali ya kuweerezebwa) era yali yaakamala okugiwandiika Alfonse bwe yazuukuka mu tulo, n'ayingira mu kisenge n'aggya ku Maria ebbaluwa n'obusungu. Yaddamu okuyingira mu kisenge oluvannyuma lwa ddakiika ntono ng'akaaba nga agamba nti, “Saategeera! Saategeera!” Ne beegwatako era ekiro ne kikoma mu kwagalana. Ku makya, ne bajja bonna okundaba, nga basazeewo ‘okusumulula’ kitaawe wa Maria n'okumusabira emikisa.

Ku lunaku olwaddirira Christine, mukyala wa Tony yajja gye ndi ng'agamba nti, “Gareth, buli mwezi abafumbo ab'oku base bakuŋŋaana wamu okumala akawungeezi ak'okussa ekimu n'okusanyuka, oluvannyuma ne tuwaayo ekiweebwayo omufumbo omu alyoke afune akawungeezi ak'okwagalana mu woteeri ow'omu kitundu ewala ne base.”

“Omwezi guno, ssente zaawebwa Maria ne Alfonse, naye ne bazigaana.” Nnamanya ensonga lwaki. “Kaakano bazze ne bazisaba kyebava baba nga bagenda okuva ku base ku nkomerero y'omwezi guno. Omanyi nti tebaali na mbaga ntuufu, tebalina bifaananyi bya mbaga era tebaali na kuyaniriza bagenyi? Nnali njjagala okumanya ky'olowooza ku kirowoozo kino. Nninawo olugoye lwange olw'embaga era ndi wa kigero kimu ne Maria. Olowooza banaanyiigala singa mbawa olugoye lwange balyoke bafune ekifaananyi ekirungi nga tebannagenda mu woteeri?”

Wadde nga Christine yali tamanyi nti nnali nzenyigidde mu kubuulirira abafumbo bano, namukakasa nti ekyo kyandibadde kirowoozo kirungi, kyetwava tugenda ffembi okubabuulira, ekyampa n'omukisa okubakakasa nti nnali nkyakuumye ebyama byabwe.

Ku lunaku olwaddirira nnali ŋŋenda e Canada, Tony bwe yali antwala ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi, ne mmuwa ekirowoozo nti ayinza okuyita base yonna wamu ku wikeendi ne bakola omukolo ‘ogw'okujaguza okwagala’ ku lwa Alfonse ne Maria, kwe bandyambadde ‘engoye zaabwe ez'embaga’, ne bakola obweyamo n'ebifaananyi eby'okujjukira. Yakirowoozako nga kirowoozo kirungi. N'agattako n'ekikye. Olwokubanga yali ateekeddwa okubatwala mu woteeri, yandibuze ‘ekkubo’ mu lugendo n'akoma ku nnyumba ey'oku lubalama lw'ennyanja, eyalina ekidiba kyayo eky'okuwuga, eya Romeo mukwano gwe eyali agiwaddeyo bwereere ku wikeendi. Abalala bonna ab'oku base bandibaddeyo n'akakeeke ak'embaga n'okuyaniriza abafumbo. Bwe kityo, mu nnaku bbiri ez'okuba nga ‘asumuludde’ kitaawe, Maria yandyeyagalidde emikisa gyonna egy'embaga, okuyaniriza n'emikwano n'ebifaananyi. Nabuuka okudda eka nga nsanyukira obulungi bwa Katonda waffe!
fields.body_text: Mu biseera eby'omusenyu ogw'omu 1997, nakola olugendo lwange olwokubiri okugenda e Fortaleza, ekibuga ekirungi eky'oku lubalama lw'ennyanja mu Ceara mu bukiikakkono-buvanjuba bwa Brazil. Nga bwe kyali edda, luno lwali lugendo lwa mwezi gumu era omulundi guno nnali n'Anne. Ku lugendo lwange olwasooka nnali nfunye emikwano mingi, kyennava nsanyuka okubannyanulira era n'okuddamu okuloza ku byokunywa eby'ebibala ebibisi n'ekyokunywa kyange kye njagala ennyo, Guarana. Nnalina obuweereza bungi, wamu ne YWAM ne mu kkanisa ez'omu kitundu. Twasula ku base ya YWAM, ewatali wala n'ekibuga, naye twasobola okutambula okugenda mu bifo bingi olw'obuweereza, okugula ebintu, ku mabbali g'ennyanja, n'ebirala. Emikwano gyange gyabuna Anne n'okwagala, era mangu ago yawulira ng'ali ewaabwe, wadde nga si bonna abaasobola okwogera Olungereza, era mazima ddala ye teyasobola kwogera Lupotugiisi. Nze n'awo nnalina Olusipeyini kwe nnyinza okwesigama kubanga bangi baasobola okutegeera Olusipeyini bwe baba nga tebategeera Lungereza. Twaddayo e Canada nga tuyita e Rio olw'abafumbo abato be nnamanya ku lugendo lwange olwasooka, mu kiseera lwe nnali mfumbiddwa ne nsengukira eyo. Claudia ne JudeClair baali bakolera mu favella – ekitundu ky'ekibuga ekijjudde ennyo eky'obwavu – kyetwava tusula nabo ennaku bbiri. Batutwala mu nkuba ey'amaanyi, mu nnyumba ey'ebisenge bibiri wakati mu lusozi omwali favella. Eyo twali ne bulago ku ttaka era ne batulabula nti bwe twandiwulidde okuvuga kw'emmundu oba okuleekaana ekiro, TETWANDIGOLOKOSE kutunula bweru kubanga kirabika ffe twandibadde abanaddirira okuttibwa emmundu! Oluvannyuma ne batulaga ekifaananyi ekyakubibwa ekiro ekyayita eky'omulambo ogwali gukanyuguddwa okuva waggulu, ne gugwa ku mulyango gwabwe. Ekitundu kino kyali kijjudde ebibinja by'abamenyi b'amateeka n'abasuubuzi abakulu b'ebiragalalagala. Ku makya ag'oluvannyuma, nabuuza JudeClair oba nnyinza okulinnya ku ntikko y'olusozi ndyoke nkube ekifaananyi ky'olusozi olw'okumpi omwayimirizibwa ekifaananyi ekyatiikirira Christo Rey (Kristo Kabaka). “Olina akakalu akakulaga?” yambuuza n'oluvannyuma, bwe yaddira akakalu kange aka Canada ke nnamuwa, n'afuluma ku mulyango, emikono gyombi ng'agiyimusa waggulu w'omutwe gwe, ng'awanika obukalu bwe n'obwange. “Wano, basooka kulasa n'oluvannyuma ne babuuza ebibuuzo” ago ge yayogera mu ngeri ey'ekyama. Bwe nnatuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi nnasanga base endala eya YWAM eyalabiriranga abaana b'omu favella. Yali kumpi n'akabuga akatono ak'omupiira ak'omuyanja ogw'amayinja nga ka mita nga 50 ku mita 30, nga keetooloddwa olukomera olw'emiguwa gy'ebyuma. Ku ludda olumu waaliwo, kye nnalowooza nti bwe byabanga ebisenge eby'okwambaliramu, ebyazimbibwa n'amatoffaali ag'amayinja. Kati byali bigudde era nga tebikyagasa. JudeClair yaŋŋamba nti oluberyeberye, abasajja abamu ab'omu favella baali bazannya wano ne wajja ekibinja ky'abapoliisi nga balinnye olusozi mu kkubo eddala, ne balabika mangu ku ntikko ne batandika okulasa, ne batta abasajja bonna. ‘Ensonga’ yaabwe yali nti abasajja bano mwe mwali n'abamu abaali bamanyiddwa nga abamenyi b'amateeka n'abasuubuzi b'ebiragalalagala! Twasiima nnyo omulimu abavubuka bano gwe bakolera Mukama mu bifo eby'akabi ennyo. Obukulembeze bwa YWAM obw'ensi yonna bwali bwa kukuŋŋaanira mu mwaka ogwaddirira mu Brazil kubanga pulezidenti waabwe ow'omu kiseera ekyo yali muminsani Omubrazil. Base ya Tony ey'e Fortaleza yalondebwa base zonna endala ez'e Brazil okuba ekifo eky'okukuŋŋaaniramu abakulembeze ba YWAM okuva wonna mu nsi, kyeyava atandika n'essanyu okuteekateeka omukolo guno. Yasalawo okuyita abasumba bonna ab'omu kitundu okukuŋŋaana okwogera ku kusoboka okusibako olukuŋŋaana lw'obuminsani nga lugenderera n'okujja kw'abaminsani ba YWAM mu kibuga kyabwe, era yasuubira okubasembeza ku base – eyayinza okusembeza abantu nga kikumi mu kkanisa yaayo entono – okutuusa woteeri ow'omu kitundu (owa emmunyeenye ttaano) lwe yeewaayo okugabula eky'emisana ku muwendo omwangu. Lowooza okwewuunya n'essanyu lyaffe bwe waajja abasajja abasukka mu 250 ne bakkiriza n'obunyiikivu ekirowoozo kya Tony eky'okusibako, si lukuŋŋaana lwa buminsani lwokka, naye n'akaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri mu kibuga kyonna. Bwe gwali gutyo omukisa omuvubuka ono gwe yalina eri abakulembeze b'ekkanisa ab'omu kitundu! Olwokubanga Tony yali wa kubeera n'emirimu mingi egyetaagisa okukola emikolo gino gyombi, awamu n'okutegeka olukuŋŋaana lw'abakulembeze ba YWAM ab'ensi yonna, yaanjula nti nzireyo mu mwaka ogwaddirira, okumala emyezi esatu, okulabirira abakozi ba YWAM bonna nga bategeka enkuŋŋaana. Nze ne Anne twakkiriza okuddayo era bwe kityo mu biseera eby'omusenyu ogw'omu 1998 twaddayo e Fortaleza okumala emyezi esatu. Abaatusembeza baali Marcello ne Aline Ramos, abafumbo abato abatya Katonda abataakoowa kutuwa mukisa. Ennyumba yaabwe yali ku kalinnya akookutaano ak'ennyumba ey'amagolofa okumpi n'olubalama lw'ennyanja era olutambula olusanyusa lwatutuusanga ku ofiisi ennene ey'omu kibuga wakati eyafuuka essinga ery'enteekateeka zonna. Obudde bwa buli kiseera bubuguma e Fortaleza naye buli kawungeezi, empewo empola yafuuwanga ng'eyita mu nnyumba n'ekankanya ebifaananyi byonna okuva ku kisenge singa twali basirusiru okuleka amadirisa gonna nga gaggule! Nayiga okwogera mu Lupotugiisi n'okugonjoola okutaataaganya okumu okwavanga mu ofiisi, naddala olw'enjawulo mu buwangwa wakati w'abakozi ab'omu kitundu n'abakozi ba YWAM abaava ebweru w'eggwanga abaali bazze okwenyigira mu kaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri, nga bakolera mu nguudo ne mu masomero nga tunnatuuka ku nnaku ssatu ze twali tugenda okumala mu kisaawe ky'omupiira eky'omu kitundu okumaliriza kaweefube. Ekyokulabirako kimu kyandirabise nga kya kusesa bwe tukirowoozaako oluvannyuma. Ekibinja ky'abavubuka abaava mu USA baali bakoze ttiisi eza langi ezaliko ekigambo “No comprommiso,” nga balowooza nti kino kitegeeza “Tetukyusa” (No compromise). Emikwano gyange Ababrazil ne kibasobera kubanga ebigambo mu Lupotugiisi mu butuufu bitegeeza nti “tewali kwewaayo” – ekyawukana ddala ne kye baali bagenderedde! Essanyu mu kibuga lyalabikira ddala kubanga buli gy'olaga, waaliwo obukakafu ‘obw'okuwamba kw'Enjiri.’ Olukuŋŋaana lw'obukulembeze lwa YWAM lwali lulungi nnyo era lwampa omukisa okuddamu okusisinkana n'abamu be nnamanya mu kiseera we nnali ku Anastasis. Abaminsani okuva mu mawanga mangi bajja okwogera ku Lukuŋŋaana lw'Obuminsani, olwajjibwako Ababrazil enkumi n'enkumi – obuwanguzi obw'amaanyi obwandyanjudde abaminsani abapya bangi mu nsi. Munnange Marcello muvunuzi mulungi nnyo kyeyava aba ye avunula mu kaweefube k'okubuulira Enjiri okusinga. Kino nakyo kyali kya buwanguzi bwa maanyi mu bikola byakyo ne mu muwendo gw'obukalu bw'abo abaali beebuuza ge twali tugenda okuwa abasumba ab'omu kitundu oluvannyuma balyoke bagobererenga. Bwe nnabuuza Jon, eyavunaanyizibwanga obukalu buno, obungi bwe twali tufunye, ebigambo bye tebigenda kwerabirwa. “Gareth” yagamba, “twalekera awo okubala nga tutuuse ku 45,000!” Nasanyusibwa nnyo ekibiina ky'ennyimba ekyakulembera okusinza mu buli kawungeezi ku nnaku essatu mu kisaawe ky'omupiira. Baali kibiina kya mwannyina omusajja ne mwannyina omuwala, nga balina abayimbi abaddirira abaava mu kkanisa ennene mu Belo Horizonte. Kyali kirabika nti buli abavubuka lwe baabanga abanyiikivu mu ngeri gye baddangamu ku nnyimba, oba mwannyina omusajja oba mwannyina omuwala amangu ago yabakomyawo ku kussa ekitiibwa ng'afukamira mu kasirise ku maykolofoni n'asaba. Nasisinkana mwannyina omusajja bwe nnali ntambula ne Marcello ku lubalama lw'ennyanja ku lunaku olwaddirira ne mmwogerako ku kino. Okuddamu kwe kwali kuzzaamu nnyo amaanyi kubanga yagamba nti baali bategeera engeri ebiseera ng'ebyo gye byandibadde 'eby'emmeeme' (nga bigobererera enneewulira z'omuntu okusinga Omwoyo), kyebaava bamalirira ye ne mwannyina omuwala okukyusa obunyiikivu bwonna okubuzza ku Mulokozi oyo yekka asaanira ekitiibwa. Tekyewuunyisa nga balaba Mukama ng'akola ebintu ebyewuunyisa bwe bityo mu buweereza bwabwe! Nnadda e Fortaleza mu 2002, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ena, era nnasanyuka okulaba nga buli kkanisa gye nnakyalira yali eyongeddeko waakiri emirundi ebiri mu muwendo okuva ku lugendo lwange olwasembayo. Nate, nnayogera mu kkanisa nnyingi ne mpeereza abantu bangi abaakwatibwako okuyigiriza kwange ku 'Release' (laba ekitabo kyange The Key in My Hand). Mu bintu ebisinga obukulu, mwe mwali okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw'abasumba ba Assembly of God olw'obukiikakkono-buvanjuba bwa Brazil. Guno gwali mukolo gwa nnaku ssatu era gwalimu abasumba nga 150. Ekintu ekirala ekikulu kyali okuweereza abafumbo abato abaali baakamala emyezi mukaaga gyokka nga bafumbiŋŋanye naye kati nga bali mu nkolagana embi nga tewali kwagalana. Maria omutono ono yajja gye ndi n'ennaku nnyingi ng'agamba nti Alfonse yali amwesuddeko (si mannya gaabwe ga ddala). Nga olugero lwe bwe lwagenda lwanjuluka, nawulira obulumi okuddamu okuwulira ku bukambwe bangi bwe bafuna okuva ku bakitaabwe. Sijja kwogera ku byama byonna Maria bye yanjagaza naye kimala okugamba nti waaliwo okuvuma kungi okw'ebigambo okuva eri kitaawe. Bwe yali mu myaka egisembayo egy'obuvubuka bwe yajja eri Kristo, n'asisinkana omuvubuka (Alfonse) n'afumbirwa. Olwokubanga omusumba yakkiriza eŋŋambo nti yali malaaya, eŋŋambo ze yeegaana, yagaana okubagattira mu kkanisa, n'alonda okukola omukolo omutono ku maka g'omugole omusajja, ogwajjibwako bazadde be bokka. Oluvannyuma lwa bbanga ttono ne bajja e Fortaleza okukolera ne YWAM. Nayigiriza Maria nti kitaawe n'omusumba baali bamwonoonye era nti yali yeetaaga okubasumulula alyoke Katonda atandike enkola y'okumuwonya. Yali ateekwa okuwandiika ebbaluwa ng'ategeeza ensonga ze zonna eziri ku kitaawe alyoke abeere n'ekiwandiiko kya byonna bye yali amwetegefu okumusonyiwako. Ekiro ekyaddirira yasula okuwandiika ebbaluwa (etaali ya kuweerezebwa) era yali yaakamala okugiwandiika Alfonse bwe yazuukuka mu tulo, n'ayingira mu kisenge n'aggya ku Maria ebbaluwa n'obusungu. Yaddamu okuyingira mu kisenge oluvannyuma lwa ddakiika ntono ng'akaaba nga agamba nti, “Saategeera! Saategeera!” Ne beegwatako era ekiro ne kikoma mu kwagalana. Ku makya, ne bajja bonna okundaba, nga basazeewo ‘okusumulula’ kitaawe wa Maria n'okumusabira emikisa. Ku lunaku olwaddirira Christine, mukyala wa Tony yajja gye ndi ng'agamba nti, “Gareth, buli mwezi abafumbo ab'oku base bakuŋŋaana wamu okumala akawungeezi ak'okussa ekimu n'okusanyuka, oluvannyuma ne tuwaayo ekiweebwayo omufumbo omu alyoke afune akawungeezi ak'okwagalana mu woteeri ow'omu kitundu ewala ne base.” “Omwezi guno, ssente zaawebwa Maria ne Alfonse, naye ne bazigaana.” Nnamanya ensonga lwaki. “Kaakano bazze ne bazisaba kyebava baba nga bagenda okuva ku base ku nkomerero y'omwezi guno. Omanyi nti tebaali na mbaga ntuufu, tebalina bifaananyi bya mbaga era tebaali na kuyaniriza bagenyi? Nnali njjagala okumanya ky'olowooza ku kirowoozo kino. Nninawo olugoye lwange olw'embaga era ndi wa kigero kimu ne Maria. Olowooza banaanyiigala singa mbawa olugoye lwange balyoke bafune ekifaananyi ekirungi nga tebannagenda mu woteeri?” Wadde nga Christine yali tamanyi nti nnali nzenyigidde mu kubuulirira abafumbo bano, namukakasa nti ekyo kyandibadde kirowoozo kirungi, kyetwava tugenda ffembi okubabuulira, ekyampa n'omukisa okubakakasa nti nnali nkyakuumye ebyama byabwe. fields.title: Circuit Teaching International
fields.body_html:
Omwaka gwa 1998 gwali mwaka gwa kunyiikira nnyo gye ndi olw’obuweereza mu Baja California, Mexico, Bungereza, Brazil (olugendo lwange olw’okusatu olw’olukuŋŋaana lw’obuweereza n’oluboozi lw’okwolesa Enjiri – laba Essuula 28), Bungereza nate ne Mexico City n’ebyetooloolo byakyo.

Mu Febwali, nayitibwa okuyigiriza abasumba mu Baja California nga tuli ne Circuit Teaching International – enteekateeka eyakolebwa mu Afrika okuyigiriza abasumba abaali tebasobola kusasula kugenda mu ssomero ery’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’obusumba (seminary). Twavuga okukka e San Diego, emikwano gyaffe egyagalibwa ennyo okuva mu nnaku z’e Anastasis, Randy ne Barbara Sizemore, gye baali kati basibye amaka gaabwe. Anne yamala ebbanga lingi nabo naye era n’anneegattako ekiseera ekimu e Tecate mu maka ga Dave ne Beth Goff. Baali mikwano gya muwendo nnyo, kubanga baatutwala okwetooloola ekitundu kinene eky’e Baja California olw’emikisa gy’obuweereza eri abasumba abaali baagala nnyo okuwulira mu bifo ebyo byonna. Oluvannyuma nnamala emirundi mingi mu bibuga bya Baja eby’enjawulo, nga njiga okulongoosa Oluspanish lwange era nga nsanyukira obuwangwa bw’Abamexico, obuseko bwabwo, n’emmere yaabwe, era nga nneeyagaza mu buwaawaabu obw’ekitalo. Emikwano emipya mingi gyafunibwa mu Valle de Trinidad, San Filipe ne San Matias ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, ne Mexicali ne Tijuana ku nsalo ya Amerika.

Mu Maayi, nagenda okumala wiiki mukaaga mu Bungereza olw’okuyitibwa abakozi Abakristaayo aba National Westminster Bank (NatWest). Waliwo ebibinja (‘chapters’) bingi eby’abakkiriza mu kitundu ekinene eky’e London, na ddala mu ‘ekibuga’ (the city), abakuŋŋaana buli wiiki olw’obuwaawaabu. Kyali kya kitiibwa gye ndi okwogera eri ebibinja bino byonna mu wiiki omukaaga era n’okuba omugenyi waabwe mu nnyumba ya NatWest ey’omu byalo, Haythorp Hall mu Oxfordshire, olw’olukuŋŋaana lw’olunaku olumu olwajjulwako abantu nga nsanvu ‘ab’amabanka’ nga lwa mutwe nti “Okuta ebirabo byo eby’omwoyo mu katale ak’ensi.” Guno gwe mutwe omukulu ogw’ekitabo kyange ‘Soar Like the Eagle’.

Engeri kino gye kyava kubaawo lugero lwa kusikiriza. Martin Edwards, mukwano gwa Anne (mwana wa kojjaawe), eyali n’ekifo eky’oku ntikko mu banka, yasemberwa Peter mu kiseera eky’okuwummulako okuva ku mirimu egya buli lunaku. “Nnakuwadde nnyo,” bwe yagamba. “Mpulira nga nyitiddwa mu buweereza bw’obusumba, naye ekkanisa yange teka nkkiriza kukola mu ngeri eno.” “Olaba omukyala oli eyo?” Martin bwe yaddamu. “Yaakafiirwa muwala we omuvubuka mu kabenje.” “Omusajja oli eyo yaakaggyibwa mu mulimu oluvannyuma lw’emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano.” Omuvubuka ali ku kkono lyo yaakamenyeddwa endagaano ye ey’obugole.” “Tolowooza nti beetaaga omusumba?” Amangwago Peter yakwata omulimu gw’okuweereza abantu bano abaali balumizibbwa, era oluvannyuma lw’omwaka gumu, yali afuuse omusumba w’abakozi bonna aba banka abaali ku kalale ako – era yajjula essanyu mu kutuukiriza obuweereza bwe mu katale kino ak’ensi.

Okuva mu Bungereza natuuka e Fortaleza, mu Brazil, Anne gye yandinsanze era gye twali tunaatandikira emyezi gyaffe esatu, nga tuweereza abakulembeze abavubuka aba YWAM nga bateekateeka olukuŋŋaana lw’obuweereza n’oluboozi lw’okwolesa Enjiri, obuwanguzi bwalwo bwe nategeezezza mu ssuula eyayise.

Mu Sebuttemba, Anne bwe yaddayo e Canada oluvannyuma lw’e Fortaleza, nze naddayo e Bungereza kubanga tikiti yange yali eyita mu nsi gye nava. Nate, naweereza mu kkanisa nnyingi nga sinnadda eka, era ekisingira ddala kwe kuddayo mu kkanisa ya Assembly of God mu Nottingham. Mukwano gwange ow’edda, Yorrie Richards, yali agenda mu kkanisa eyo era yali antegekedde okwogerera eyo. Kyali kiseera kya kitalo ddala nga kirimu ebibala bingi olw’okufuba kwange, na ddala mu bulamu bw’abantu bana – nneebaka bulungi ekiro ekyo!

Mu Novemba, nate nagenda e Mexico, ku mulundi guno mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Mexico City. Francisco yali antegekedde enkuŋŋaana nnyingi nga tuli ne CTI, era natambula bamayilo bangi ku basubbaawa (buses) abalungi ennyo, ne mu bifo ebiri ewala era eby’akabi. Twayogera eri ebibinja ebinene ennyo eby’abasumba n’ebibinja ebitono ebiwerako, okuva e Cuidad Victoria ne Tampico mu bukiikakkono okutuuka e Oaxaca ne Matias Romero mu bukiikaddyo, nga twongera okumala ebbanga e Vera Cruz. Omwaka gwa 1999 gwali gunaamala okusinga eka mu Victoria nga gujjudde emirimu mingi egy’okwogera mu kkanisa nnyingi.

Nnasanyuka nnyo okwogera emirundi mingi mu kkanisa yange eya edda, kati emanyiddwa nga Pacific Rim Alliance Church, era ne mu Oaklands Chapel, ekkuŋŋaaniro ery’Ab’Oluganda (Brethren) eryakulemberwa mukwano gwange omulungi, Denis Scott.

Kyokka, ku nkomerero y’omwaka, nate natambula okugenda e Baja California okuyigiriza enkuŋŋaana endala ez’abasumba nga tuli ne CTI, ku mulundi guno nga nkyalira ebibinja ebipya e Rosarito, Sonora ne Carranza, byombi mu Valle de Mexico. Nate, Dave ne Beth banyweza omukwano gwaffe ogubeerawo n’okutuusa leero.

Omwaka gwakoma nga tukola, ekintu ekifuuse kya bulijjo mu bulamu bwaffe, olugendo okulaba muwala waffe n’abazzukulu baffe mu Australia. Okumala emyezi mukaaga, naweereza mu kkanisa okwetooloola olubalama lw’ebuvanjuba lw’ensi eyo ennene, oluusi okumala wikendi zonna. Abantu be nakwatagana nabo be baabo be nafuna e Capernwray emyaka etaano emabega, nga bakyayagala okuwulira Ekigambo n’okukulira mu Mukama.
fields.body_text: Omwaka gwa 1998 gwali mwaka gwa kunyiikira nnyo gye ndi olw’obuweereza mu Baja California, Mexico, Bungereza, Brazil (olugendo lwange olw’okusatu olw’olukuŋŋaana lw’obuweereza n’oluboozi lw’okwolesa Enjiri – laba Essuula 28), Bungereza nate ne Mexico City n’ebyetooloolo byakyo. Mu Febwali, nayitibwa okuyigiriza abasumba mu Baja California nga tuli ne Circuit Teaching International – enteekateeka eyakolebwa mu Afrika okuyigiriza abasumba abaali tebasobola kusasula kugenda mu ssomero ery’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’obusumba (seminary). Twavuga okukka e San Diego, emikwano gyaffe egyagalibwa ennyo okuva mu nnaku z’e Anastasis, Randy ne Barbara Sizemore, gye baali kati basibye amaka gaabwe. Anne yamala ebbanga lingi nabo naye era n’anneegattako ekiseera ekimu e Tecate mu maka ga Dave ne Beth Goff. Baali mikwano gya muwendo nnyo, kubanga baatutwala okwetooloola ekitundu kinene eky’e Baja California olw’emikisa gy’obuweereza eri abasumba abaali baagala nnyo okuwulira mu bifo ebyo byonna. Oluvannyuma nnamala emirundi mingi mu bibuga bya Baja eby’enjawulo, nga njiga okulongoosa Oluspanish lwange era nga nsanyukira obuwangwa bw’Abamexico, obuseko bwabwo, n’emmere yaabwe, era nga nneeyagaza mu buwaawaabu obw’ekitalo. Emikwano emipya mingi gyafunibwa mu Valle de Trinidad, San Filipe ne San Matias ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, ne Mexicali ne Tijuana ku nsalo ya Amerika. Mu Maayi, nagenda okumala wiiki mukaaga mu Bungereza olw’okuyitibwa abakozi Abakristaayo aba National Westminster Bank (NatWest). Waliwo ebibinja (‘chapters’) bingi eby’abakkiriza mu kitundu ekinene eky’e London, na ddala mu ‘ekibuga’ (the city), abakuŋŋaana buli wiiki olw’obuwaawaabu. Kyali kya kitiibwa gye ndi okwogera eri ebibinja bino byonna mu wiiki omukaaga era n’okuba omugenyi waabwe mu nnyumba ya NatWest ey’omu byalo, Haythorp Hall mu Oxfordshire, olw’olukuŋŋaana lw’olunaku olumu olwajjulwako abantu nga nsanvu ‘ab’amabanka’ nga lwa mutwe nti “Okuta ebirabo byo eby’omwoyo mu katale ak’ensi.” Guno gwe mutwe omukulu ogw’ekitabo kyange ‘Soar Like the Eagle’. Engeri kino gye kyava kubaawo lugero lwa kusikiriza. Martin Edwards, mukwano gwa Anne (mwana wa kojjaawe), eyali n’ekifo eky’oku ntikko mu banka, yasemberwa Peter mu kiseera eky’okuwummulako okuva ku mirimu egya buli lunaku. “Nnakuwadde nnyo,” bwe yagamba. “Mpulira nga nyitiddwa mu buweereza bw’obusumba, naye ekkanisa yange teka nkkiriza kukola mu ngeri eno.” “Olaba omukyala oli eyo?” Martin bwe yaddamu. “Yaakafiirwa muwala we omuvubuka mu kabenje.” “Omusajja oli eyo yaakaggyibwa mu mulimu oluvannyuma lw’emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano.” Omuvubuka ali ku kkono lyo yaakamenyeddwa endagaano ye ey’obugole.” “Tolowooza nti beetaaga omusumba?” Amangwago Peter yakwata omulimu gw’okuweereza abantu bano abaali balumizibbwa, era oluvannyuma lw’omwaka gumu, yali afuuse omusumba w’abakozi bonna aba banka abaali ku kalale ako – era yajjula essanyu mu kutuukiriza obuweereza bwe mu katale kino ak’ensi. Okuva mu Bungereza natuuka e Fortaleza, mu Brazil, Anne gye yandinsanze era gye twali tunaatandikira emyezi gyaffe esatu, nga tuweereza abakulembeze abavubuka aba YWAM nga bateekateeka olukuŋŋaana lw’obuweereza n’oluboozi lw’okwolesa Enjiri, obuwanguzi bwalwo bwe nategeezezza mu ssuula eyayise. Mu Sebuttemba, Anne bwe yaddayo e Canada oluvannyuma lw’e Fortaleza, nze naddayo e Bungereza kubanga tikiti yange yali eyita mu nsi gye nava. Nate, naweereza mu kkanisa nnyingi nga sinnadda eka, era ekisingira ddala kwe kuddayo mu kkanisa ya Assembly of God mu Nottingham. Mukwano gwange ow’edda, Yorrie Richards, yali agenda mu kkanisa eyo era yali antegekedde okwogerera eyo. Kyali kiseera kya kitalo ddala nga kirimu ebibala bingi olw’okufuba kwange, na ddala mu bulamu bw’abantu bana – nneebaka bulungi ekiro ekyo! Mu Novemba, nate nagenda e Mexico, ku mulundi guno mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Mexico City. Francisco yali antegekedde enkuŋŋaana nnyingi nga tuli ne CTI, era natambula bamayilo bangi ku basubbaawa (buses) abalungi ennyo, ne mu bifo ebiri ewala era eby’akabi. Twayogera eri ebibinja ebinene ennyo eby’abasumba n’ebibinja ebitono ebiwerako, okuva e Cuidad Victoria ne Tampico mu bukiikakkono okutuuka e Oaxaca ne Matias Romero mu bukiikaddyo, nga twongera okumala ebbanga e Vera Cruz. Omwaka gwa 1999 gwali gunaamala okusinga eka mu Victoria nga gujjudde emirimu mingi egy’okwogera mu kkanisa nnyingi. Nnasanyuka nnyo okwogera emirundi mingi mu kkanisa yange eya edda, kati emanyiddwa nga Pacific Rim Alliance Church, era ne mu Oaklands Chapel, ekkuŋŋaaniro ery’Ab’Oluganda (Brethren) eryakulemberwa mukwano gwange omulungi, Denis Scott. Kyokka, ku nkomerero y’omwaka, nate natambula okugenda e Baja California okuyigiriza enkuŋŋaana endala ez’abasumba nga tuli ne CTI, ku mulundi guno nga nkyalira ebibinja ebipya e Rosarito, Sonora ne Carranza, byombi mu Valle de Mexico. Nate, Dave ne Beth banyweza omukwano gwaffe ogubeerawo n’okutuusa leero. Omwaka gwakoma nga tukola, ekintu ekifuuse kya bulijjo mu bulamu bwaffe, olugendo okulaba muwala waffe n’abazzukulu baffe mu Australia. Okumala emyezi mukaaga, naweereza mu kkanisa okwetooloola olubalama lw’ebuvanjuba lw’ensi eyo ennene, oluusi okumala wikendi zonna. Abantu be nakwatagana nabo be baabo be nafuna e Capernwray emyaka etaano emabega, nga bakyayagala okuwulira Ekigambo n’okukulira mu Mukama.

fields.title: Okuyingira mu Mulembe Omuggya
fields.body_html:
Twayingira omwaka gwa 2000 nga tuli mu maka ga muwala waffe mu Canberra, mu Australia. Olw’okuba olukoloboze lw’ennaku olw’ensi yonna (international dateline) luli mu bugwanjuba obw’okumpi ne Australia, ensi eyo yali ng’emu ku ez’olubereberye okwaniriza omulembe omuggya. Entiisa abantu bangi gye baalina, nti ebikangabwa ebinene byandibuutikidde ensi yonna olw’emikompyuta okulemererwa n’obutakwatibwa bulungi kw’amakolero, teyatuukirira n’akatono, era ebijaguzo ebinene okwetooloola ensi yonna byalabibwa ku tterevi. Australia yeewaana ng’ensi ennene eyasooka okulangirira okwaniriza kwayo eri ensi yonna.

Omwalo gwa Sydney (Sydney harbour) gwe gwalagibwa ng’essaawa ez’ekiro eky’omu ttumbi zisembera. Amangwago, byonna byazikira nga tewannaba mmuli za muliro ezitangaala (fireworks) okumasamasa eggulu ery’ekiro, nga bikoma n’okumasamasa okw’ekitalo ku buwanvu bwonna obw’olutindo lwa Sydney harbour olwatutumufu. Ekigambo kimu kyeeyoleka – OBUTAGGWAAWO. AbanaAustralia abasinga obungi baalitegeera amakulu g’ekigambo ekyo, wadde ng’abalala abasinga baali tebagategeera.

Okumala emyaka mingi, omuntu bwe yayitanga mu nguudo za Sydney, wandisanze ku bibangirizi nga kiwandiikiddwa n’ecoloki, ekigambo kino kimu. Kyali mulimu gwa musajja mukadde, eyali edda omutamiivu eyabeeranga mu nguudo, eyayingira mu Mission Hall n’awulira omwogezi ng’alangirira nti, “Singa waaliwo ekigambo kimu kyokka kye nnandiyinzizza okuwandiika mu ggulu abantu bonna balyoke bakirowoozeeko, kyandibadde kigambo ‘obutaggwaawo’ – olibumaliza wa?”

Obulamu bwe bwakyusibwa olw’okulowooza ku kibuuzo ekyo, bw’atyo ne yeewaayo okuwandiika ekigambo ‘obutaggwaawo’ buli gy’agenda ng’obujulizi eri abalala. Kyali kya kitalo nti gavumenti ya Australia yeeyambisa ekigambo kye kimu okwaniriza omulembe omuggya, nga bamanyi amakulu gaakyo eri abantu baabwe bangi nnyo!

Bwe ntunula emabega ku myaka amakumi ana egy’olugendo lwange olw’Ekikristaayo, bulijjo nsanyuka nnyo olw’obwesigwa bwa Katonda gy’ndi. Antutte ku nsozi empanvu nnyingi awamu naye, era yankozesa mu buweereza bwe sandirootedde bwe nnali omukkiriza omuto. Buli myaka kkumi gwabanga n’obuweereza bwagwo obw’enjawulo, kyennava neebuuza ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri mu kimu kye kyalinnina.

Mu myaka gya ’60s’, nnalina omukisa okuweereza abaserikale ba Ghurka mu Hong Kong; mu ’70s’, Mukama yatukozesa mu ekyo abangi kye bajja okuyita ‘okuzuukusibwa’ (revival) mu bavubuka b’e Bridgend, mu Wales; mu ’80s’ nnayigiriza mu Jewish Academy mu Toronto, nga nnina omukisa omulungi ennyo okubuulira Enjiri abayizi ne Rabbi Saknovich; mu ’90s’, nnali ku kyombo M/V Anastasis nga nnina essanyu ery’enjawulo ery’okukubiriza enkuŋŋaana z’abasumba (pastors’ conferences) mu Afirika ey’Ebugwanjuba, na ddala mu Sierra Leone. Bino byonna byali ‘ntikko za nsozi’ mu lusozi oluwanvu. ’00s’ ez’omulembe omuggya zandireese ki?

Mu 2000, nnali mu buweereza obuggya obwatandikibwawo Ade Ajala, mukwano gwange omwagalwa okuva mu Nigeria eyali kati asumba ekkanisa mu Denver, Colorado, mu Amerika. Bwatuumibwa “Hands On” era bwalina ekigendererwa okusimba amakanisa mu Nigeria.

Nze nnali ntekwa okukola enteekateeka y’okuyigiriza ey’obuweereza buno, bwe ntyo ne mmala wiiki ntono mu Denver nga nkola ku bumu ku buno. Ku lukyala lwange olwokubiri mu 2001, nnayitibwa okuyingira mu bakozi b’e YWAM base mu Colorado Springs nga omusumba w’ekifo (base pastor). Kino kyalabika ng’omukisa omulungi ennyo naye, bwe nnalowooza ku bino byonna ebyandivuddemu, ne ntegeera nti ebirooto by’abakulembeze abo tebyali bya mazima, era nga nnina akakwakkulizo mu mwoyo gwange, ne ngaana okuyitibwa. Tekyayinzika n’akatono okuddukanya obuweereza buno bwombi mu kiseera kye kimu.

Eky’ennaku, ebirooto bya “Hands On” nabyo tebyatuukirira, wadde nga Ade akyalina ekkanisa ennamu mu Denver. Enkyala endala ez’e Baja California ne Brazil zajja mu myaka ebiri egyaddirira, buli emu ng’egumya nga bwe zaali enkyala zange ezaakulembera.

Naye ekintu ekyasingira ddala mu 2001, kyali olugendo olwokubiri mu India, ku mulundi guno mu Chennai mu bukiikaddyo, okuweereza mu YWAM base endala. Lowooza ku kwewuunya kwange bwe nnasanga nti abayizi bataano mu ssomero baava ku Vancouver Island, ate nga tebeemanyanga nga tebannajja! Nnakwatibwako nnyo abayizi Abayindi, abamu okuva mu mpya ez’ekitiibwa ekya waggulu (high caste) n’abalala okuva mu mpya eza wansi (low caste), abaatuula ne bassaawamu ne bassekimu wamu.

Omuwala omu omuto baali bamuteeseeko omuwendo ku mutwe gwe olw’okukyuka okudda eri Kristo ng’ava mu bulombolombo obw’obu-Hindu obw’omu maka ge. Omusaalaba gwa Yesu bulijjo gusoomooza ebiziyiza eby’obuwangwa ebibi ng’ebyo. Nnakwatibwako n’okusingawo olw’okuyimba okugenderako (harmonic) okw’abavubuka Abayindi abamu, bwe ntyo ne mbabuuza gye baayigira okuyimba bwe batyo – kyali kumpi kuwulikika ng’abantu b’e Wales! Ne bangamba nti baava mu Nagaland mu bukiikakkono, era nti abakkiriza ab’eyo baayigirizibwa okuyimba bwe batyo ababaka b’enjiri Abapuratesitanti Abawelsi (Welsh Presbyterian missionaries) abaabaleetera Enjiri oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukusibwa okwa Wales okwa 1904/5.

Nnaweereza mu masomero ga YWAM abiri ag’enjawulo mu kiseera ky’olukyala lwange olwa wiiki ssatu, nnayogera n’abakulembeze ba YWAM mu ssemunali eri ku St Thomas’ Hill, ekifo omutume Toomasi we yattirwa olw’okukkiriza, nnakyalira ebitundu eby’obwavu ennyo (slum) gye bakolera nnyo, era nnafuna omukisa okukyalira n’okumala akaseera katono e Ebenezer Home. Amaka gano ag’abaana abatalina bazadde ge gamu ku ago Martin, muganda wa Anne, g’awagira n’okwenyumiriza, era gakulemberwa omusajja omulungi Pastor VeeJay.

Abaana abato nga 100 baankuŋŋaanirako nga bagezaako Olungereza lwabwe olutono, ne bampa essanyu lingi. Nnazannya nabo cricket naye ssaabakwatako. Ekintu ekimu ekitaampa ssanyu lingi kyali emmere eya buli lunaku ey’omuceere n’omusalaawo gwa curry. Njagala curry naye guno gwali ‘gwokya nnyo’ – ate olw’okuba nnalabulwa obutanywa mazzi ga wano, bulijjo gwaweebwanga ne Coca Cola, ekitali kirungi ku curry!

Mu makanisa mwe nnayogerera mwalimu Maranatha, ekkanisa ey’abantu Abatamil. Omusumba w’eno yali musajja mulungi naye nga alina ebyafaayo. Yali agezezzaako emirundi ebiri okwetta olw’okuba mukyala we n’oluvannyuma mutabani we omukulu baali balwadde kookolo era nga bombi baaweebwa akaseera katono okuba abalamu. Buli mulundi teyayinza kutuukiriza kye yali ayagala, ng’asangibwa baliraanwa nga tannamaliriza kye yali agezaako. Olw’okuwona okwo okw’akatono, yakyuka n’adda eri Kristo ng’ava mu bu-Hindu bwe, ng’akaaba ng’ayagala okulaba oba Mukama ayinza okumuyamba. Mukama teyamulokola kyokka wabula ne mukyala we ne mutabani we bombi baawona kookolo waabwe. Yatandika okuggulawo amakanisa buli gy’ayinza, mu bantu abo be yali akulembera eri Mukama, era mu kiseera kye nnaliyo, yali atandiseewo amakanisa agasukka mu kkumi. Mutabani we omukulu kati yali muvangeri mu India ey’obukiikaddyo, ate mutabani we omuto ye yali omuvvuunuzi wange. Ku nkomerero y’obubaka bwange obwali ku The Upper Room, nnakola okuyita, abantu abamu ne baddamu. Awo omusumba n’ayimirira okwogera eri abantu be.

Abakazi nga munaana n’abasajja kkumi ne bayimirira ne bajja mu maaso. Nnabuuza omuvvuunuzi wange kitaawe kye yali agambye n’ensonga lwaki abantu bano bazze mu maaso, n’anziramu nti, “Kitange agambye nti kiseera baleke okuba abasagaasagana, nga banyeenyeenya wakati wa bakatonda baabwe Abahindu ne Kristo. Kaakati lwe lunaku lwe basaana okusalawo gwe banaaweereza.” “Bano bonna bazze mu maaso okwewaayo eri Yesu Kristo nga Mukama waabwe era Omulokozi waabwe.” Omutima gwange ne gubuuka olw’essanyu olw’omukisa okwogerera mu kkanisa ng’eyo.

Mu Novemba 2001, nnafuna okuyitibwa okwogerera mu University of Victoria Intervarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF) ku Lwakutaano akawungeezi. Nnatuuka ku ssaawa naye eyantyaba, omukozi, yansanga n’ensonyi kubanga abayizi baali bayise omuyizi omulala okuva mu koleji endala okuweereza akawungeezi ako. “Mmusabye yeekugire ku ddakiika abiri,” omukozi bwe yagamba, “olyoke ofune ekiseera kimala obubaka bwo.” Nnamukakasa nti kyandisinze aleke omuyizi omwogezi ayogere ky’ayagala okwogera, era nti tekyandinkwaseeko n’akatono nti nze ssaali ŋŋenda kwogera akawungeezi ako. Nnandisanyuse okuwuliriza omuvubuka oyo.

Nga bwe kyandibadde, olw’ekyo, nnayitibwa okukomawo oluvannyuma lwa kaseera katono, nga guno gwe gwasooka ku kuyitibwa okungi bwe kutyo okwogerera ekibiina ky’abayizi ekyo eky’ekitalo.

Ne wagoberera okuyitibwa okwogerera ku mbaga za Ssekukkulu eza IVCF, emyaka ena mu egy’omukaaga egyaddirira. Neebuuza oba nnandifunye ekisa ekifaanana bwe kityo mu bayizi abo singa nnali nkakatidde okwogera akawungeezi ako akasooka aka Lwakutaano! Ssaategeera nti ekisa ng’ekyo kyandikoze kinene mu kutuuka kwange ku ntikko y’olusozi Katonda gye yali antegekedde mu myaka kino ekkumi!

Nnakwatibwako n’okusingawo olw’okuyimba okugenderako (harmonic) okw’abavubuka Abayindi abamu, bwe ntyo ne mbabuuza gye baayigira okuyimba bwe batyo – kyali kumpi kuwulikika ng’abantu b’e Wales! Ne bangamba nti baava mu Nagaland mu bukiikakkono, era nti abakkiriza ab’eyo baayigirizibwa okuyimba bwe batyo ababaka b’enjiri Abapuratesitanti Abawelsi (Welsh Presbyterian missionaries) abaabaleetera Enjiri oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukusibwa okwa Wales okwa 1904/5. Nnaweereza mu masomero ga YWAM abiri ag’enjawulo mu kiseera ky’olukyala lwange olwa wiiki ssatu, nnayogera n’abakulembeze ba YWAM mu ssemunali eri ku St Thomas’ Hill, ekifo omutume Toomasi we yattirwa olw’okukkiriza, nnakyalira ebitundu eby’obwavu ennyo (slum) gye bakolera nnyo, era nnafuna omukisa okukyalira n’okumala akaseera katono e Ebenezer Home. Amaka gano ag’abaana abatalina bazadde ge gamu ku ago Martin, muganda wa Anne, g’awagira n’okwenyumiriza, era gakulemberwa omusajja omulungi Pastor VeeJay. Abaana abato nga 100 baankuŋŋaanirako nga bagezaako Olungereza lwabwe olutono, ne bampa essanyu lingi. Nnazannya nabo cricket naye ssaabakwatako. Ekintu ekimu ekitaampa ssanyu lingi kyali emmere eya buli lunaku ey’omuceere n’omusalaawo gwa curry. Njagala curry naye guno gwali ‘gwokya nnyo’ – ate olw’okuba nnalabulwa obutanywa mazzi ga wano, bulijjo gwaweebwanga ne Coca Cola, ekitali kirungi ku curry! Mu makanisa mwe nnayogerera mwalimu Maranatha, ekkanisa ey’abantu Abatamil. Omusumba w’eno yali musajja mulungi naye nga alina ebyafaayo. Yali agezezzaako emirundi ebiri okwetta olw’okuba mukyala we n’oluvannyuma mutabani we omukulu baali balwadde kookolo era nga bombi baaweebwa akaseera katono okuba abalamu. Buli mulundi teyayinza kutuukiriza kye yali ayagala, ng’asangibwa baliraanwa nga tannamaliriza kye yali agezaako. Olw’okuwona okwo okw’akatono, yakyuka n’adda eri Kristo ng’ava mu bu-Hindu bwe, ng’akaaba ng’ayagala okulaba oba Mukama ayinza okumuyamba. Mukama teyamulokola kyokka wabula ne mukyala we ne mutabani we bombi baawona kookolo waabwe. Yatandika okuggulawo amakanisa buli gy’ayinza, mu bantu abo be yali akulembera eri Mukama, era mu kiseera kye nnaliyo, yali atandiseewo amakanisa agasukka mu kkumi. Mutabani we omukulu kati yali muvangeri mu India ey’obukiikaddyo, ate mutabani we omuto ye yali omuvvuunuzi wange. Ku nkomerero y’obubaka bwange obwali ku The Upper Room, nnakola okuyita, abantu abamu ne baddamu. Awo omusumba n’ayimirira okwogera eri abantu be. Abakazi nga munaana n’abasajja kkumi ne bayimirira ne bajja mu maaso. Nnabuuza omuvvuunuzi wange kitaawe kye yali agambye n’ensonga lwaki abantu bano bazze mu maaso, n’anziramu nti, “Kitange agambye nti kiseera baleke okuba abasagaasagana, nga banyeenyeenya wakati wa bakatonda baabwe Abahindu ne Kristo. Kaakati lwe lunaku lwe basaana okusalawo gwe banaaweereza.” “Bano bonna bazze mu maaso okwewaayo eri Yesu Kristo nga Mukama waabwe era Omulokozi waabwe.” Omutima gwange ne gubuuka olw’essanyu olw’omukisa okwogerera mu kkanisa ng’eyo. Mu Novemba 2001, nnafuna okuyitibwa okwogerera mu University of Victoria Intervarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF) ku Lwakutaano akawungeezi. Nnatuuka ku ssaawa naye eyantyaba, omukozi, yansanga n’ensonyi kubanga abayizi baali bayise omuyizi omulala okuva mu koleji endala okuweereza akawungeezi ako. “Mmusabye yeekugire ku ddakiika abiri,” omukozi bwe yagamba, “olyoke ofune ekiseera kimala obubaka bwo.” Nnamukakasa nti kyandisinze aleke omuyizi omwogezi ayogere ky’ayagala okwogera, era nti tekyandinkwaseeko n’akatono nti nze ssaali ŋŋenda kwogera akawungeezi ako. Nnandisanyuse okuwuliriza omuvubuka oyo. Nga bwe kyandibadde, olw’ekyo, nnayitibwa okukomawo oluvannyuma lwa kaseera katono, nga guno gwe gwasooka ku kuyitibwa okungi bwe kutyo okwogerera ekibiina ky’abayizi ekyo eky’ekitalo. Ne wagoberera okuyitibwa okwogerera ku mbaga za Ssekukkulu eza IVCF, emyaka ena mu egy’omukaaga egyaddirira. Neebuuza oba nnandifunye ekisa ekifaanana bwe kityo mu bayizi abo singa nnali nkakatidde okwogera akawungeezi ako akasooka aka Lwakutaano! Ssaategeera nti ekisa ng’ekyo kyandikoze kinene mu kutuuka kwange ku ntikko y’olusozi Katonda gye yali antegekedde mu myaka kino ekkumi!

fields.title: Mukama Ayongera Okukulembera
fields.body_html:
Mu mwaka gwa 2002 nnalina obuweereza bungi, awaka ne mu nsi endala, nga ngenda e Haiti, Manitoba, UK, Portland, Fortaleza ne nkomawo e Australia. Mu Haiti, nze ne munnange omulungi Dave Knippel ow’e Portland USA, twali bagenyi ba Kevin ne Karen Hull abaali batumbula omulimu gw’abaana mu bugwanjuba bw’ekizinga ekyo. Nnali nteekeddwa okuyigiriza ebyava mu Circuit Teaching International mu nkuŋŋaana z’abasumba ez’enjawulo, naye waaliwo n’emikisa emirala mingi egy’okubuulira. Emu ey’enjawulo neeyawula kubanga yali mu kkanisa esinga obunene ey’aboogera Olungereza mu Haiti, Quisqueya Chapel mu Port au Prince, ekibuga ekikulu. Twatuuka nga twakerezza katono kubanga Kevin yalina obuzibu n’emmotoka ye, bwe ntyo saafuna kiseera kingi kya kusisinkana Pastor Olsen ng’okusinza tekunnatandika.

Waaliwo abantu ebikumi ebiwerako abaali bajjudde mu kkanisa nga bantwala okutuula okumpi ne ye ne mukyala we mu nnyiriri ntono okuva mu maaso. Oluvannyuma lw’ennyimba z’okusinza ez’okusooka, n’ayimuka okwaniriza abagenyi mu kukuŋŋaana, ng’abasaba okuyimirira balyoke bamanyibwe. Bwe nnali mpuliriza amannya n’obuweereza bw’abantu abangi abaali abagenyi, naddala okuva mu USA, nnatandika okwewuunya engeri gye nnalondebwamu okuba omwogezi waabwe ku makya ago. Nnayogera ku by’okwesittaza ne mpulira okusaabibwa okw’amaanyi nga mmanyi nti Mukama yali ayogera ng’ayita mu nze eri abangi abaaliwo ku lunaku olwo.

Ku nkomerero y’okusinza, nnyeebaza Pastor Olsen olw’omukisa guno ne mmuwa ekimu ku bitabo byange, The Key in My Hand, kye yalaba nga mukisa, kubanga oluvannyuma yampandiikira e Victoria, ng’asaba kkopi endala kkumi na bbiri, kubanga yayagala okuziwa abakulembeze bonna ab’olukiiko olw’ekkanisa eno ey’ensi yonna, abaali mu Atlanta, Ga.

Nga tudda ku kifo kyaffe eky’omu bugwanjuba, Kevin, Dave ne nze twayimirira okulya emmere ey’omu ttuntu n’okukuŋŋaana mu kifo ekitono eky’obuweereza. Eyo twawulira olugero olw’ekitalo. Omu ku baweereza yalina enteekateeka ey’okuleeta abasawo basatu buli wiiki okuva mu USA. Baali batwalibwa mu kyalo eky’ewala okujjanjaba abantu abaliyo, ne bawandiika alipoota zaabwe ku lwa musawo omuweereza eyabeeranga eyo, ne balyoka baddayo eka. Yakolanga kino buli wiiki, ng’alina olukuŋŋaana lw’ebyalo kkumi na bisatu gye baweererezanga. Ku lunaku luno yali yaakava ku kisaawe ky’ennyonyi okuwaanyisa abasawo ku nteekateeka eno, bwe yatubuulira ekintu eky’ekitalo ekyali kyaakabaawo.

Abasajja abasatu baali bamaze omulimu gwabwe nga bawandiika alipoota zaabwe, bwe baalaba omuliro waggulu ku lusozi olwali kumpi. Ne bakizuula nti gwali mu kyalo mwe baali baakava. Bwe batyo, ne balinnya mu mmotoka yaabwe ey’amagulu ana, ne baddayo ne basanga omusawo w’eddogo ow’omu kyalo ng’ayimiridde okumpi n’amatongo g’amaka ge agaali gaaka. Ne batandika okumusaasira okutuusa lwe yagamba nti, “Nedda! Naakawa obulamu bwange eri Kristo, kyenavudde nsalawo okukuŋŋaanya ebintu byange byonna eby’eddogo mu nnyumba yange n’okubyokya byonna. Tebikyandifuga!” Nga kye kyokulabirako eky’ekitalo eky’okwenenya!

Okukyala kwange e Manitoba, Canada, kwali kwa kwogera ku kijjulo eky’omwaka ekya Manitoba Bible Society. Eyo twaddamu okukuŋŋaana ne John ne Eileen Wiebe be twamanya e Hamm, bwe nnali njigiriza mu Germany mu 1967-67. John mu kiseera ekyo yali mu magye ga Canada naye kati yali muvikadde mu Anglican Church of Canada. Ate era, ku kijjulo ng’abagenyi, kwaliwo abakyala babiri abaali baakabeera mu Kuzuukuka okw’Omwoyo okwali kubaawo mu kitundu kya Canada ekiggya ekya Nunavut. Nga baali basobola okubuulira olugero olw’ekitalo – omuntu asobola okufuna vidiyo ekiraga ku kukyalira kwa Katonda kuno, eyitibwa Transformations #2. Emikisa emirala egy’okwogera nnagiweebwa, nga tusanyukira okukuŋŋaana okw’omukwano n’abakkiriza abaliyo, wadde ng’obunnyogovu bwali bungi nnyo mu mwezi gwa Apuli!

Olugendo e UK n’emirimu emirala mingi egy’okwogera mu BC byatwala ekitundu kinene eky’omwaka, naye mu Okitobba, twagenda e Portland okukyalira Dave ne mukyala we Ellen. Kino era kyali kiseera kya kuyigiriza mu kibiina ky’omu nnyumba ekitono kye baalina. Mu 1982, baali bammemba ba kkanisa yaffe e Kitchener nga bayizi ku ttuŋŋuulira ya YWAM ey’omu kitundu e Cambridge, Ontario. Eyo, Ellen yali yeenyigidde nnyo mu kuzina, naye akabenje ak’entiisa kaamuleka ng’alina obulemu mu mubiri ne mu bwongo, kale kati yali afugibwa mu maka era yasobolanga kutambula mpola ng’ayambibwa ‘walker.’ Kyali kya ssanyu okumala nabo ekiseera, okulaba essanyu okukyala kwaffe kwe kwaleetera Ellen, n’okumuwulira ng’atusabira.

Mu Novemba, nnaddayo e Fortaleza mu Brazil, ku okwali kunaakuba okukyala kwange okusembayo eri Tony ne Christine, Marcello ne Aline, n’eri emikwano emingi gye nnali nfunye mu kukyala kwange okwayita. Nga bwe nnawandiise emabega, kino era kyali kiseera kya mukisa okulaba nti buli kkanisa mwe nnaweererereza yalina abagoberezi bangi nnyo okusinga bwe kyali ng’olutalo lw’okubuulira enjiri olwa 1998 terunnabaawo.

Omwaka gwaggwa n’okukyala kwaffe okwa buli myaka esatu e Australia okulaba Lynette, Philip n’abaana baabwe abasatu, Michael, Chloe ne Emma. Nga bwe kyali kifuuka empisa yaffe, twabeeranga emyezi mukaaga okuyita mu butiti bwa Canada, nga tulina emirimu mingi egy’okwogera. Mu bintu ebyali bisukkuluma kwaliyo enkuŋŋaana z’okuwummulamu bbiri e Jindabyne mu Snowy Mountains, n’abakozi n’abayizi ba sseminaali ya The Christian & Missionary Alliance, ne olusiisira lw’amaka olwa kkanisa ya Woden (Canberra) C&MA. Ate ekyali eky’enjawulo ennyo, kwali nkuŋŋaana zange eza buli wiiki ez’okusaba ne Ron Williams omusumba Omuzaaliranwa, ku kifo eky’ekijjukizo kye yali asimbye okuwa ekitiibwa abasajja bonna Abazaaliranwa abaafiira mu ntalo, abasajja abataamanyibwa gavumenti ya Australia wadde nga baali basukka mu lukumi!

Bwe twali twawukana, Ron yaŋŋamba nti, “Omulundi oguddako bw’olijja, nnaakutwala okusisinkana abantu bange!” Tetwamanya nti yandifudde kookolo nga sinnadda, era nti yandifunye ekitiibwa kinene okuva mu gavumenti, ng’aweebwa okusinza kwe okw’ekijjukizo mu kizimbe ky’olukiiko olusala amateeka e Canberra. Nga kyali kitiibwa kinene okuyitibwa munne! Yali antadde n’ekitiibwa ng’ateeka mu kyuma kye eky’okuyigiriza, ekisumuluzo ekikiikirira ekitabo kyange The Key in My Hand.

Ekyuma kino eky’okuyigiriza kyali lubaawo olwaliko ekifaananyi ‘eky’ekkubo ly’emu,’ ekya kabonero kinene eri abantu Abazaaliranwa, nga kiraga olugendo lwabwe okuva mu biseera eby’edda ennyo, okuyita mu kujja kw’omuzungu, okutuuka ku lunaku lwa leero. Kyalina ebyafaayo bingi ‘eby’omusaayi ogwayiibwa’ nga Ron tannalaga ku musaayi ogw’omusaalaba ogwayiibwa nga gwe ddagala lyokka ery’ekibi ky’omuntu, n’obwetaavu bw’okutabagana wakati w’omuzungu n’Omuzaaliranwa. Wakati mu lubaawo waaliwo ekisumuluzo, ekyabajjibwa mu muti gw’ewala, nga kikiikirira okutabagana okwo.

Twadda eka e Canada mu 2003 nga tuyimiriza mu New Zealand okulaba emikwano gyaffe emirungi, John ne Marion Brignall – John eyali edda yinjini ku M/V Anastasis. Twabuuka ennyonyi okutuuka e Wellington, Dave Knipell gye yatusisinkana, ne tulyoka tuvuga okutuuka e Masterton mwannyina we gye yabeeranga. Nancy yali nnamwandu wa Wycliffe Bible Translator, kyenava mmubuuza oba naye yategeera Oluyonaani. Nnali naakakola ekifunze kyange eky’ekitabo ekirungi ennyo Christ’s Paralysed Church X-rayed, ekitabo ekyali kimaze ebbanga ddene nga tekikyakubibwa, ekyawandiikibwa omuyivu w’Oluyonaani McCrossan, era nnayagala okumuwa kkopi.

Nnaweereza mu kkanisa ye ku Lwakutaano Olutukuvu (Good Friday) ne ku Ssande ya Pasika nga tannatutwala mailo eziwerako mu bukiikakkono ku nnyanja Taupo gye twali tusisinkanira ba Brignall abaali bavudde mu bukiikaddyo okuva e Tauranga. Nga tuli mu kkubo, Nancy yakyalira mukwano gwe eyali kati alina eddduuka ettono ery’ebirabo, nga mulimu n’ebisenge ebitono eby’ebitabo ebikozeseddwa. Lowooza ku kwewuunya kwange bwe yazuula kkopi y’ekitabo ekyasooka nga kikyali kirungi ddala! Mukama ayongera okunneewuunyisa n’‘okwesanga’ kwe!
