Bwe kityo ne nsaba omusawo wange oba nnandisobodde okusigala mu Britain okutuusa mu wiiki esooka eya Agusito, Karys, muwala wa muganda wa Anne, bw’anaajaguza amazaalibwa ge amakumi ataano, wiiki ssatu okusukka olukyaalo lwange olulala olwali luteekereddwawo. Yakkiriza mangu ng’agamba nti, “Gareth, endowooza yo n’engeri gy’obeeramu binkakasa nti kookolo tajja kudda, naye ne bwe yandidda, tunaaba tulina ebbanga eggi ery’okumujjanjaba. Genda mwesanyuse.” Nze ne Anne twatuuka e Cardigan mu wiiki esooka eya Maayi 2009, nga tetumanyi nti oluvannyuma, ffembi twandirowoozezza emyezi gino esatu nga ‘ekiwummulo ekisinga obulungi kye tutuuseeko!’ Okuva ku ntandikwa, ‘twagala nnyo’ abantu b’ekkanisa ya Mt Zion Baptist, gye nnawulira nti ‘okuzuukusa kuli kumpi nnyo.’ Nnayogerayo emirundi mingi naye nnasingira ddala okuweebwa omukisa Steve Evans bwe yabuulira obubaka buna ku ‘ekiwonvu ky’amagumba amakalu.’ Nga kwaliko okufukibwa amafuta okunene ku kubuulira kwe! (Osobola okuwuliriza obubaka buno ku lupapula lwange olwa yintaneeti - ‘links’ www.garethevansministries.org) Enkuŋŋaana z’okusaba zaali zizzaamu nnyo amaanyi nga abantu abasukka mu 25 baabaanga baliwo buli wiiki (nga bava mu kkanisa ey’abantu nga 100) ate ng’okuyimba kwali... weewaawo, Oluwelisi! - okw’omutima gwonna, okusisimula, okukwatagana obulungi, okw’omukwano ogungi. Nnali mu kifo kyange ekituufu! Amaka ga Dick gaali kayumba kalungi akatunuulira ekiwonvu omwayitanga omugga River Teifi ogwakkakkamu, ogw’obuziba, nga gugenda ku nnyanja nga guyita ku ludda lw’ekibuga Cardigan. Embiriizi z’ekiwonvu zaali zibisiddwa emiti era akabonero akalala kokka akalaga nti wabaddewo abantu kaali kkasulo eya Kilgerran eya kera ku ntikko y’olusozi. Dick ne mukyala we Omugwatemala, Gladys, baali babiri ba njawulo nnyo. Baali bazze okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe mu kusaba olw’ensi, nga bombi tebalina misi mu yo, naye Mukama gye yassa ku mitima gyabwe, okutuusa okuzuukusa lwe kunaddamu. Mu kiseera we mpandiikira kino, osobola okugoberera byonna bye bakola ku lupapula lwabwe olwa yintaneeti, www.walesawakening.org . Mingi ebintu ebyajjukirwa eby’ekiseera ekyo eky’ekitalo – okutambulira ku njazi eziriraanye olubalama lw’ennyanja olw’amayinja, okukyalira Doreen omuzibe w’amaaso, omutukuvu asaba, okuketta enguudo z’ekibuga eky’akatale ekyewuunyisa – n’okwogera Oluwelisi! Weewaawo, nnasobola okwemenya ku byonna bye nnali njize okuyita mu masomo g’Oluwelisi ku BBC Wales, nga nnyambibwa Steve ne Sulwen ate n’okuyita mu kusomera mu kibiina ky’abayizi ‘abali wakati.’ Eyo nnatuuka n’okwolesa ekitundu mu maaso g’ekibiina, nga njogera Oluwelisi lwokka, era kirabika nga nnina eddoboozi ery’obulungi nnyo ng’omusomesa bwe yagamba. Omutwe gwange gwali ku by’anyumirwa okukola mu kiseera kino – okuyiga ennimi. Dick & Gladys bwe baakomawo okuva mu USA, twasembezebwa mu B&B ennungi okwesuŋŋa ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, okumala wiiki emu, ku muwendo mutono nnyo ku ogwa bulijjo, nga tetunnakuuma ennyumba ‘ey’ekitiibwa’ ey’omu kitundu okumala wiiki bbiri – ennyumba ennungi ennyo eya omu ku bantu b’ekkanisa. Twaweebwa nnyo omukisa abantu bano abaagalwa bonna! Olunaku lumu, omwami ne mukyala baali bayimiridde ebweru wa Mt Zion nga batunuulira olubaawo lw’amawulire, Arlene, omu ku bantu b’ekkanisa, n’ava mu kkanisa, era bwe yalaba nga baaliko obwegombe obungi, n’atandika okwogera nabo. Baali bayita mu Cardigan nga bali ku lugendo okwambuka olubalama lw’ennyanja ne mutabani waabwe abeera mu UK. Baagattako nti baava mu Canada, kale Arlene bwe yasisinkana Anne oluvannyuma, n’amutegeeza ku kunyumya kwabwe era n’amugamba nti baali baakayingira mu dduuka ly’ebitabo eby’Ekikristaayo ery’omu kitundu, eriri okwolekera ekkanisa. Anne n’ayingira mu dduuka era n’atandika okwogera nabo. Baava mu Brentwood Bay, ntambi nga ntono okuva mu maka gaffe mu Victoria! Bwe baawulira erinnya lyange, omukazi n’aleekaana ng’asanyuse, “Tubadde tumusabira mu myezi ena egiyise!” Kirabika baali bawulidde ku kookolo wange era ne beeyama okunsabira wadde nga tebaali bammanyi bwe kannyini. Nga kya mukisa okuba mu maka ga Katonda, nga tumanyi nti mu maka gano temuli bagwira, wabula baganda be tutalabangako. Nga tetunnadda e Loughor mu kiseera eky’amazaalibwa ga Karys, twasalawo okutambula okuyita mu UK okukyalira muganda wange Christopher ne mukyala we (Dame) Elsbeth Thomas. Elsbeth yali aweereddwa ekitiibwa (Dame) Kabaka omukazi olw’obuweereza bwe eri ekibiina ky’e British Red Cross kye yali akulembeddemu nga Pulezidenti. Yali amanyi bulungi nnyo ne Princess Diana nga tannafa olumbe olwamujjako amangu. Christopher ne Elsbeth baali bayise Anne ne nze okusigala nabo mu Cambridgeshire okumala ennaku ntono, okuyitibwa kwe twali twegomba nnyo okukkiriza. Ku lugendo twakyalira Ivor ne May Sherwood, abasomi b’Ebyawandiikibwa abaali bawummudde be twasooka okusisinkana nga tuli mu Bugirimaani mu 1964, Marion (ne John) Palmer, mukwano gwa Anne ow’oku ssomero, ne muganda wange omulala Cynthia (ne Bill Brown), awamu ne muganda wa Anne Gwilym (ne Sue) Edwards. Nga lwali lugendo lwa kitalo, olujjudde ebijjukizo era enkomerero entuufu ey’ekiwummulo kyaffe eky’omu Wales! Waaliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekyasigala – okwesanyusa ku mazaalibwa ga Karys amakumi ataano ge twajaguza ne mikwano gye emingi ku kijjulo eky’ekitalo. Twadda eka ku mawulire amalungi nti kookolo teyalaga bubonero bwa kudda.

fields.title: Enkolagana n'Ebyedda
fields.body_html:
Emyaka 2009/2010 gyali mirembe okusinga, era mu biseera ebyo nnali nteekwa okwekebejjebwa buli myezi esatu – buli lumu ne kizuulibwa nti sirina kookolo, omusawo wange ow'endwadde z'omusulo n'ayogera nti, “Ssebo Evans, kookolo tajja kudda – endowooza yo n'engeri gy'obeeramu bya maanyi nnyo.” Nnafuna omukisa okwogera emirundi mitono mu 2009 era nnasanyukira nnyo Sidney Pentecostal Church, gye nnawaayo olukalala lw'obubaka ku ‘Okuzuukuka.’

Ku nkomerero ya 2009, twadda e Brisbane, Australia okukyalira Lynette n'ab'omu maka ge – bulijjo nga kya ssanyu nnyo gye tuli. Eyo nnalina obwa mukwano obugimu n'omusumba omukadde eyava e Wales eyali awummudde ku mulimu. Twakuŋŋaananga buli wiiki okwogera ku byayita, okugabana n'okuyimba ffenna ennyimba ez'edda ez'e Wales. Era nnayogera emirundi mingi mu Wynnum-Manley Alliance Church.

Mu Okitobba 2010, nnayitibwa okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana e Baltimore, USA. Olukuŋŋaana, Broken Before The Throne, lwamala wiiki yonna era lwalimu n'aboogezi abalala bangi ku mulamwa gw'okusaba. Nnawaayo enjigiriza ezisooka ku Lwomukaaga akawungeezi ne ku Ssande ku makya.

Buli lukuŋŋaana, nnaweebwanga essaawa ssatu okukozesa nga bwe nnawulira nkulemberwa, buli lumu nga mmalirizza n'‘okusaba awamu’ mwe nnakulembera abaali bazze mu kusaba okw'awamu. Nnasiimwa nnyo Dan Biser, eyategeka olukuŋŋaana, n'obunyiikivu bwe okulaba amakanisa nga gadda ku maviivi gaago nga ganoonya amaaso ga Katonda. Ebintu bibiri eby'ekitalo byava mu lugendo luno olw'e Baltimore, ebyabeera ensulo ya mikisa mingi gye ndi.

Nga wayiseewo ennaku ntono, Deb Crum ow'e Idaho yampandiikira email. Yalina obuweereza bwa leediyo obwali bulafuubana mu by'ensimbi, kale ye n'abo be yakolanga nabo mu kkomanda baali banoonyereza engeri y'okugenda mu maaso. Bwe yamala okulaba obubaka bwange obw'e Baltimore ku yintaneeti, yakubirizibwa okukyusa ekkubo n'okumala ebiseera bingi mu kusaba, ng'anoonya obulagirizi bwe ku buweereza obw'omu maaso. Ba kkomanda be baagaana ekiteeso eky'okukyusa olukuŋŋaana lwabwe olwa kkomanda okulufuula ‘olukuŋŋaana lw'okusaba’ era abamu ne bava mu. Naye ye, yali amaliridde okunoonya amaaso ga Katonda era ne tutandika okuwandiikiragananga bulijjo.

Ebiseera bikakasizza nga Mukama waffe bw'ali omwesigwa, kubanga Deb kaakano awa obujulirwa ku ky'ekitalo Katonda kye yakola mu bulamu bwe n'obuweereza obugimu eri abakazi mu Idaho n'ebitundu ebiriraanyewo. Osobola okugoberera blog ye ku Grace Tapestries.

Ku lugendo lwange olw'okudda okuva e Baltimore, mwe nnasisinkana Rami ne Nesibah. Bo, wamu n'abaana baabwe ababiri abato, baali ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi e Toronto nga batudde okumpi nange. Nnasaba okukuba ekifaananyi Nesibah, ab'omu maka bonna basobole okulimu. Bwe twalinnya ennyonyi okugenda e Victoria, ne nzuula nga ntudde okumpi ne Rami n'omwana we omu, ate mukyala we n'omwana we omulala nga bali mu lunyiriri olw'emabega. Twalina emboozi ennungi ennyo mu ssaawa nnya ezaddirira. Baava e Mecca, Saudi Arabia, era baali bajja e Canada Nesibah alyoke ayingire yunivasite Rami mukoddomi we, Hani, gye yali asomera dokita we (PhD).

Twayogera ku kukkiriza, ku Buyisiraamu obwa Sunni n'obwa Shiite, ku Mohammed, ne ku Yesu – awatali bbugwe wa mpaka wakati waffe. Nnabategeeza engeri Canada gy'etali nsi ya Bakristaayo naye eno ng'eddiini enkulu ye kwe kutwala omuntu okuba ekintu ekisingira ddala obukulu awatali Katonda. Rami yasanyuka nnyo okusisinkana Omukristaayo ow'amazima kubanga yali tannaba kukikola. Kimala okugamba nti mu kiseera we mpandiikira essuula eno, Rami ne Nesibah, Hani ne mukyala we, Zainab, bafuuse ng'abaana baffe ffennyini era tusanyukira ebiseera bye tusobola okubeera nabo, bulijjo nga twogera ku kwegomba kwaffe okumanya (okumanyiira) Katonda. Bonna balina enjala ey'obutuukirivu obw'amazima kale okusaba kwaffe kwe kuti Mukama yeeraga gye bali.

Ku nkomerero ya 2010, nnafuna essimu okuva mu Boundary Community Church, Midway, BC. Sasooka kuwulira ku Midway, BC, wadde nga nteekwa okuba nga nnayitamu emyaka mingi emabega ku lugendo lwange olwokka olw'e Alberta nga mpita ku luguudo #3. Omusumba waabwe yali yeetaaga okuwummula okw'ekiseera (sabbatical) naye teyandiwummudde okutuusa ekkanisa lwe yandizudde omuntu, atali agenda kulabirira kkanisa okumala emyezi ebiri kyokka, naye era ne yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa okutendeka omuvubuka omukozi omupya eyali mu kutendekebwa.

Baali bagezezzaako mu ddiini yaabwe, naye tewali eyakkiriza kujja – mpozzi nga baggyibwako amawulire ag'okumala ekiseera ky'obutiti nga bawugudde mu kitundu ekitono ennyo! Mike, omukozi omupya eyali mu kutendekebwa, ne mukyala we Netta, baali bammanyi era baali bagambye nti mpozzi nnandibadde omuwewuufu. Bwe nnalaga nti nnali mwetegefu, nnayitibwa okujja e Midway ‘ku wiikendi eddako’ okwogera (era n'ekkanisa okunkeberako).

Bwe kityo ne tukkiriziganya nti nnaba omusumba waabwe okumala emyezi ebiri okutandika wakati mu Febwali 2011. Baayagala tujje wiiki ntono okusooka, naye kino kyali tekisoboka kubanga emikisa emirala ebiri egisanyusa gyava mu kaseeragezi oluvannyuma lw'emyezi mingi egy'obusirifu. Mu Novemba, nnafuna email okuva e Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Nnali omusumba w'abayizi Abamalaysia mu za yunivasite ez'e Canada (okusinga mu Ontario) mu 1980/2 era nnali nfunye omukisa okukyalira abamu ku bo emirundi esatu okuva olwo.

Kaakano baali bagenda okukuza olukuŋŋaana lw'okwegatta oluvannyuma lw'emyaka 30 mu Janwali 2011 era baayagala nze ne Anne twegatte ku bo okumala wiiki bbiri – ensaasaanya yonna nga basasudde! Twandiyinza tutya okugaana obuyita ng'obwo obwava mu bavubuka aba njawulo ng'abo abaatuwa ebijjukizo ebyo eby'omukwano? Twateekateeka ennyonyi zaffe n'essanyu lingi, naddala kubanga twali tugenda n'okuyimirira ennaku nnya mu Hong Kong, awaka waffe mu 1967-69 (laba Essuula 5).

Mu Hong Kong, twasula ku YWAM base (ku ddoola 10 buli kiro!!) era ne tusobola okukyalira ebifo byaffe eby'edda bingi, wadde ng'ekitundu ekyali ekya Bungereza kaakano kirimu abantu okuwera emirundi ebiri n'ebizimbe ebiwanvu ennyo ebyeyongedde okuwera. Twafuna omukisa okusisinkana nate Jackie Pullinger n'okulaba omulimu ogw'ekitalo gw'akyeyongera okukulembera mu bo abaali baddikidde eddagala, ebibinja by'abamenyi b'amateeka, n'abamalaaya. Buli omu asaanidde okusoma ekitabo kye Chasing the Dragon okutegeera obunyiikivu bwa Jackie eri ekibuga kino. Asaanidde nnyo okuweebwa ekitiibwa kye yaweebwa, ng'ekiraga ekyo ye jjinja eryayimirizibwa okumuwa ekitiibwa mu kifo eky'ekibuga eky'edda ‘ekiriko bbugwe’, ekifo ekyayatiikirira eky'omulimu gwe. Waliwo ebingi ebiwandiikiddwa ku ye ku yintaneeti.

Okuva e Hong Kong, twabuuka okugenda e Kuala Lumpur ne twanirizibwa Vincent ne Shirley Cheah, abaatusembeza mu wiiki bbiri ezaddirira ez'ekitalo. Essanyu nga lyagira okusisinkana nate abayizi baffe ‘Aba Canada’ bangi n'okulaba nga bwe baakulaakulana bulungi. Kyali mukisa gwange nange okwogera mu kkanisa ey'ekitundu ne mu lukuŋŋaana olw'omu maka e Penang. Twakyalira Alliance Missionary School e Penang era ne tumala wiikendi mu Singapore ku kkondo lya Cheah eriyo, nga tufunye n'omukisa okumala ekiseera ne Prudence, mukwano gwa Anne ow'oku ssomero.

Vincent alina eby'okuliirwamu bibiri, kale twalya bulungi nnyo! Nga tetunnagenda, yatuyita twegatte ku ye ne Shirley mu China, nga tuli ku lugendo lwaffe olulala olw'e Australia. Yandituusisse e Hong Kong n'atutwala ku lulaga olumpi olw'ensi eyo enkulu. Ekyo kyali kiteekateekeddwa okubaawo ku nkomerero ya 2012, naye kookolo yandidde okutaataaganya enteekateeka ezo – si mu nze naye mu Anne.

Okuva e Malaysia, twadda e Vancouver, Anne gye yava n'atwala ennyonyi empimpi okugenda e Victoria - naye nze nnali ŋŋenda mu maaso e Haiti, nga mpita e Toronto ne Montreal – olugendo olw'essaawa 42! Mu Desemba, nnali nfunye obuyita okutambula okugenda e Port au Prince okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw'okuwummulako olw'abakozi ba Quisqueya Christian School. Olukuŋŋaana, olwalimu abantu nga nsanvu, lwabeera ku kifo eky'okuwummuliramu ekirungi ekiri ku lubalama lw'ennyanja, akabanga okuva ku kuzikirira kw'e Port au Prince okwaleetebwa musisi eyabaawo omwaka gumu emabega. Ekibuga kyali kikyali mu matongo kubanga ebyuma ebizito ebyandiyambye okuggyawo enguuli ennene ez'ssimenti ezaali amaka, amaduuka, n'apaatimenti, n'ebirala, byali bitono nnyo.

Emirambo mingi gyali gikyaziikiddwa wansi w'amatongo era ebyafaayo by'abo abaawonawo byali binyolola omutima. Waaliwo eweema enzirugavu nkumi na nkumi buli wantu okusuza abo abaali bafiiriddwa amaka gaabwe – oba abaali batidde nnyo okuddamu okugayingiramu. Nnasula mu maka ga Shane ne Kristie Mattenley, ababaka b'enjiri be twali tumanyi bulungi mu biseera bye twabakyalira mu Lorraine, Oregon. Nnina ebijjukizo eby'omukwano ku ngeri gye baatusembezaamu n'ebiseera bye nnasobola okwogeramu mu Haiti.

Oluvannyuma lw'olukuŋŋaana lw'okuwummulako, nnayitibwa okwogera eri abayizi bonna ku lukuŋŋaana olw'oku makya olwamalanga ng'essaawa emu buli lunaku. Era nnayitibwa okwogera nate mu Quisqueya Chapel, ekkanisa ey'ensi yonna ey'e Port au Prince – gwali mukisa munene ddala! Ku lukuŋŋaana luno olw'oku makya, ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo kyabaawo. Bwe nnayimirira okwogera, enkola ya sipiika (PA system) n'esirika! Kikwetaagisa okusuubira okuzikira kw'amasannyalaze okw'engeri eyo mu nsi ezaavu.

Waaliwo abantu abasukka mu 400 mu kkanisa ennene, kale nnali nteekwa okuyimirira ku madaala ag'omu maaso ag'oluggya n'okwogera n'eddoboozi ery'omwanguka era nga ndaga bulungi. Kyokka, oboolyawo kyali mukisa ogwekwese kubanga buli omu yafuba nnyo okuwulira buli kigambo kyange, era nga kiwanguddwa nga bwe kiraga okusinziira ku bye baayogera. Bwe nnamaliriza, enkola ya sipiika n'ekomawo!

Wakati mu kuzikirira kwonna, omuntu yasanyuka okulaba omukono gwa Katonda nga gukola mu bulamu bw'abavubuka Abahaiti bangi – abantu abaliba abakulembeze b'ensi eno olunaku olumu. Nnatuuka eka wakati mu Febwali era ku lunaku olwaddirira, ne tuva ku lubalama lw'ennyanja okutandika olugendo oluwanvu okugenda e Midway, BC. Nga tusomoka n'eryato okugenda ku lukalu, twasisinkana Mark, omusumba wa Boundary Community Church, n'ab'omu maka ge. Baali bagenda okugenda okuwummulako (sabbatical) okwalimu ekiseera mu New Zealand n'oluvannyuma awaka waffe mu Victoria. Kyokka, muwala waabwe Lena yandyegasse ku ffe ku lugendo olw'e Midway era yandituyambye okutereera mu maka gaffe amapya.

Wiiki zaffe ekkumi mu Boundary Community Church zaali mukisa munene. Twasanyukira nnyo obulamu obw'omu byalo obusirifu n'obwa mukwano bw'abantu bano abaagalwa. Twalinnya amakubo ag'ensozi ez'omu kitundu ekyo era ne tukyalira ebifo bingi eby'obulungi eby'ebyafaayo eby'omu kitundu. Obuweereza bwange bwakkirizibwa bulungi, era twagenda nga tufunye emikwano emipya mingi. Nsanyukira nnyo ebiseera bino eby'okulabirira ekkanisa empya, kuno nga kwe kuluulu okwokusatu okw'ekiseera ekyo ekiwanvu.

Obanga 2009/2010 gyali biseera ebya kasirise, ebintu byali bikyusizza ddala ku nkomerero y'ekiseera ekyo – era waaliwo n'ebirala ebyali bijja ebyafuula 2011 omwaka ogusinga okusanyusa.

Ebiseera bikakasizza nga Mukama waffe bw'ali omwesigwa, kubanga Deb kaakano awa obujulirwa ku ky'ekitalo Katonda kye yakola mu bulamu bwe n'obuweereza obugimu eri abakazi mu Idaho n'ebitundu ebiriraanyewo. Osobola okugoberera blog ye ku Grace Tapestries. Ku lugendo lwange olw'okudda okuva e Baltimore, mwe nnasisinkana Rami ne Nesibah. Bo, wamu n'abaana baabwe ababiri abato, baali ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi e Toronto nga batudde okumpi nange. Nnasaba okukuba ekifaananyi Nesibah, ab'omu maka bonna basobole okulimu. Bwe twalinnya ennyonyi okugenda e Victoria, ne nzuula nga ntudde okumpi ne Rami n'omwana we omu, ate mukyala we n'omwana we omulala nga bali mu lunyiriri olw'emabega. Twalina emboozi ennungi ennyo mu ssaawa nnya ezaddirira. Baava e Mecca, Saudi Arabia, era baali bajja e Canada Nesibah alyoke ayingire yunivasite Rami mukoddomi we, Hani, gye yali asomera dokita we (PhD). Twayogera ku kukkiriza, ku Buyisiraamu obwa Sunni n'obwa Shiite, ku Mohammed, ne ku Yesu – awatali bbugwe wa mpaka wakati waffe. Nnabategeeza engeri Canada gy'etali nsi ya Bakristaayo naye eno ng'eddiini enkulu ye kwe kutwala omuntu okuba ekintu ekisingira ddala obukulu awatali Katonda. Rami yasanyuka nnyo okusisinkana Omukristaayo ow'amazima kubanga yali tannaba kukikola. Kimala okugamba nti mu kiseera we mpandiikira essuula eno, Rami ne Nesibah, Hani ne mukyala we, Zainab, bafuuse ng'abaana baffe ffennyini era tusanyukira ebiseera bye tusobola okubeera nabo, bulijjo nga twogera ku kwegomba kwaffe okumanya (okumanyiira) Katonda. Bonna balina enjala ey'obutuukirivu obw'amazima kale okusaba kwaffe kwe kuti Mukama yeeraga gye bali. Ku nkomerero ya 2010, nnafuna essimu okuva mu Boundary Community Church, Midway, BC. Sasooka kuwulira ku Midway, BC, wadde nga nteekwa okuba nga nnayitamu emyaka mingi emabega ku lugendo lwange olwokka olw'e Alberta nga mpita ku luguudo #3. Omusumba waabwe yali yeetaaga okuwummula okw'ekiseera (sabbatical) naye teyandiwummudde okutuusa ekkanisa lwe yandizudde omuntu, atali agenda kulabirira kkanisa okumala emyezi ebiri kyokka, naye era ne yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa okutendeka omuvubuka omukozi omupya eyali mu kutendekebwa. Baali bagezezzaako mu ddiini yaabwe, naye tewali eyakkiriza kujja – mpozzi nga baggyibwako amawulire ag'okumala ekiseera ky'obutiti nga bawugudde mu kitundu ekitono ennyo! Mike, omukozi omupya eyali mu kutendekebwa, ne mukyala we Netta, baali bammanyi era baali bagambye nti mpozzi nnandibadde omuwewuufu. Bwe nnalaga nti nnali mwetegefu, nnayitibwa okujja e Midway ‘ku wiikendi eddako’ okwogera (era n'ekkanisa okunkeberako). Bwe kityo ne tukkiriziganya nti nnaba omusumba waabwe okumala emyezi ebiri okutandika wakati mu Febwali 2011. Baayagala tujje wiiki ntono okusooka, naye kino kyali tekisoboka kubanga emikisa emirala ebiri egisanyusa gyava mu kaseeragezi oluvannyuma lw'emyezi mingi egy'obusirifu. Mu Novemba, nnafuna email okuva e Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Nnali omusumba w'abayizi Abamalaysia mu za yunivasite ez'e Canada (okusinga mu Ontario) mu 1980/2 era nnali nfunye omukisa okukyalira abamu ku bo emirundi esatu okuva olwo. Kaakano baali bagenda okukuza olukuŋŋaana lw'okwegatta oluvannyuma lw'emyaka 30 mu Janwali 2011 era baayagala nze ne Anne twegatte ku bo okumala wiiki bbiri – ensaasaanya yonna nga basasudde! Twandiyinza tutya okugaana obuyita ng'obwo obwava mu bavubuka aba njawulo ng'abo abaatuwa ebijjukizo ebyo eby'omukwano? Twateekateeka ennyonyi zaffe n'essanyu lingi, naddala kubanga twali tugenda n'okuyimirira ennaku nnya mu Hong Kong, awaka waffe mu 1967-69 (laba Essuula 5). Mu Hong Kong, twasula ku YWAM base (ku ddoola 10 buli kiro!!) era ne tusobola okukyalira ebifo byaffe eby'edda bingi, wadde ng'ekitundu ekyali ekya Bungereza kaakano kirimu abantu okuwera emirundi ebiri n'ebizimbe ebiwanvu ennyo ebyeyongedde okuwera. Twafuna omukisa okusisinkana nate Jackie Pullinger n'okulaba omulimu ogw'ekitalo gw'akyeyongera okukulembera mu bo abaali baddikidde eddagala, ebibinja by'abamenyi b'amateeka, n'abamalaaya. Buli omu asaanidde okusoma ekitabo kye Chasing the Dragon okutegeera obunyiikivu bwa Jackie eri ekibuga kino. Asaanidde nnyo okuweebwa ekitiibwa kye yaweebwa, ng'ekiraga ekyo ye jjinja eryayimirizibwa okumuwa ekitiibwa mu kifo eky'ekibuga eky'edda ‘ekiriko bbugwe’, ekifo ekyayatiikirira eky'omulimu gwe. Waliwo ebingi ebiwandiikiddwa ku ye ku yintaneeti. Okuva e Hong Kong, twabuuka okugenda e Kuala Lumpur ne twanirizibwa Vincent ne Shirley Cheah, abaatusembeza mu wiiki bbiri ezaddirira ez'ekitalo. Essanyu nga lyagira okusisinkana nate abayizi baffe ‘Aba Canada’ bangi n'okulaba nga bwe baakulaakulana bulungi. Kyali mukisa gwange nange okwogera mu kkanisa ey'ekitundu ne mu lukuŋŋaana olw'omu maka e Penang. Twakyalira Alliance Missionary School e Penang era ne tumala wiikendi mu Singapore ku kkondo lya Cheah eriyo, nga tufunye n'omukisa okumala ekiseera ne Prudence, mukwano gwa Anne ow'oku ssomero. Vincent alina eby'okuliirwamu bibiri, kale twalya bulungi nnyo! Nga tetunnagenda, yatuyita twegatte ku ye ne Shirley mu China, nga tuli ku lugendo lwaffe olulala olw'e Australia. Yandituusisse e Hong Kong n'atutwala ku lulaga olumpi olw'ensi eyo enkulu. Ekyo kyali kiteekateekeddwa okubaawo ku nkomerero ya 2012, naye kookolo yandidde okutaataaganya enteekateeka ezo – si mu nze naye mu Anne. Okuva e Malaysia, twadda e Vancouver, Anne gye yava n'atwala ennyonyi empimpi okugenda e Victoria - naye nze nnali ŋŋenda mu maaso e Haiti, nga mpita e Toronto ne Montreal – olugendo olw'essaawa 42! Mu Desemba, nnali nfunye obuyita okutambula okugenda e Port au Prince okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw'okuwummulako olw'abakozi ba Quisqueya Christian School. Olukuŋŋaana, olwalimu abantu nga nsanvu, lwabeera ku kifo eky'okuwummuliramu ekirungi ekiri ku lubalama lw'ennyanja, akabanga okuva ku kuzikirira kw'e Port au Prince okwaleetebwa musisi eyabaawo omwaka gumu emabega. Ekibuga kyali kikyali mu matongo kubanga ebyuma ebizito ebyandiyambye okuggyawo enguuli ennene ez'ssimenti ezaali amaka, amaduuka, n'apaatimenti, n'ebirala, byali bitono nnyo. Emirambo mingi gyali gikyaziikiddwa wansi w'amatongo era ebyafaayo by'abo abaawonawo byali binyolola omutima. Waaliwo eweema enzirugavu nkumi na nkumi buli wantu okusuza abo abaali bafiiriddwa amaka gaabwe – oba abaali batidde nnyo okuddamu okugayingiramu. Nnasula mu maka ga Shane ne Kristie Mattenley, ababaka b'enjiri be twali tumanyi bulungi mu biseera bye twabakyalira mu Lorraine, Oregon. Nnina ebijjukizo eby'omukwano ku ngeri gye baatusembezaamu n'ebiseera bye nnasobola okwogeramu mu Haiti. Oluvannyuma lw'olukuŋŋaana lw'okuwummulako, nnayitibwa okwogera eri abayizi bonna ku lukuŋŋaana olw'oku makya olwamalanga ng'essaawa emu buli lunaku. Era nnayitibwa okwogera nate mu Quisqueya Chapel, ekkanisa ey'ensi yonna ey'e Port au Prince – gwali mukisa munene ddala! Ku lukuŋŋaana luno olw'oku makya, ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo kyabaawo. Bwe nnayimirira okwogera, enkola ya sipiika (PA system) n'esirika! Kikwetaagisa okusuubira okuzikira kw'amasannyalaze okw'engeri eyo mu nsi ezaavu. Waaliwo abantu abasukka mu 400 mu kkanisa ennene, kale nnali nteekwa okuyimirira ku madaala ag'omu maaso ag'oluggya n'okwogera n'eddoboozi ery'omwanguka era nga ndaga bulungi. Kyokka, oboolyawo kyali mukisa ogwekwese kubanga buli omu yafuba nnyo okuwulira buli kigambo kyange, era nga kiwanguddwa nga bwe kiraga okusinziira ku bye baayogera. Bwe nnamaliriza, enkola ya sipiika n'ekomawo! Wakati mu kuzikirira kwonna, omuntu yasanyuka okulaba omukono gwa Katonda nga gukola mu bulamu bw'abavubuka Abahaiti bangi – abantu abaliba abakulembeze b'ensi eno olunaku olumu. Nnatuuka eka wakati mu Febwali era ku lunaku olwaddirira, ne tuva ku lubalama lw'ennyanja okutandika olugendo oluwanvu okugenda e Midway, BC. Nga tusomoka n'eryato okugenda ku lukalu, twasisinkana Mark, omusumba wa Boundary Community Church, n'ab'omu maka ge. Baali bagenda okugenda okuwummulako (sabbatical) okwalimu ekiseera mu New Zealand n'oluvannyuma awaka waffe mu Victoria. Kyokka, muwala waabwe Lena yandyegasse ku ffe ku lugendo olw'e Midway era yandituyambye okutereera mu maka gaffe amapya. Wiiki zaffe ekkumi mu Boundary Community Church zaali mukisa munene. Twasanyukira nnyo obulamu obw'omu byalo obusirifu n'obwa mukwano bw'abantu bano abaagalwa. Twalinnya amakubo ag'ensozi ez'omu kitundu ekyo era ne tukyalira ebifo bingi eby'obulungi eby'ebyafaayo eby'omu kitundu. Obuweereza bwange bwakkirizibwa bulungi, era twagenda nga tufunye emikwano emipya mingi. Nsanyukira nnyo ebiseera bino eby'okulabirira ekkanisa empya, kuno nga kwe kuluulu okwokusatu okw'ekiseera ekyo ekiwanvu. Obanga 2009/2010 gyali biseera ebya kasirise, ebintu byali bikyusizza ddala ku nkomerero y'ekiseera ekyo – era waaliwo n'ebirala ebyali bijja ebyafuula 2011 omwaka ogusinga okusanyusa.

fields.title: Okujaguza kwaffe okw'Emyaka Amakumi Ataano
fields.body_html:
Anne yali munnange omwesigwa era omuwagizi wange mu lugendo lwonna oluwandiikiddwa wano. Nga bwe twali tumaze ebiseera bingi mu Wales mu myaka egiyise, nga nkola ku kwegomba kwange okweddiza obuwangwa n'olulimi olw'Ekiweegi, nnasalawo nti ku mbaga yaffe eya zaabu ey'obufumbo, twandissizza ekitiibwa ku kwegomba kwe okumala ebbanga nga akwata ku nsibuko ze mu Norway.

Bwe kityo, ne nteesa nti tumale ekiwummulo mu nsi ya kitaawe. Twamanya nti kino kyandibadde kya bbeeyi, naye nnali nnamalirivu nti ‘tewali nsimbi ze twandisagalidde’ (mu bintu byaffe ebitono) Anne alyoke afune ebiseera by'aakujjukira. Twatandika okuteekateeka okumala omwezi mu Norway, nga tubeera n'ab'omu maka bwe kya kisoboka mu bbanga eryo lyonna, naye ate nga tuvuga okwetooloola okulaba ku baganda be ne mikwano gyaffe. Olunaku olumu, twafuna abagenyi babiri – Jon-Kore ne Helene abaali mikwano gy'edda egy'omu maka, nga babeera mu Stavanger. Mutabani waabwe yali akolera mu bifo eby'amafuta e Alberta, kyebaava bajja okumukyalira – era n'okutukyalira.

Bwe baawulira ku nteekateeka zaffe, amangwago ne batuwa akayumba kaabwe ak'ekyeya ku kizinga kya Flekkeroy, okumpi n'olubalama lw'ennyanja e Kristiansand, Norway. Twandikawereza bwereere okumala ekiseera kyonna kye twagala oluvannyuma lw'okukakozesa mu biseera byabwe eby'ekyeya! Twakyusa enteekateeka zaffe tusobole okumala emyezi nga esatu mu Norway n'omwezi gumu mu Wales.

Mu Julaayi, twajaguza olw'essanyu ery'olujaguzo lwaffe olwa zaabu, olwateekebwateekebwa bawala baffe era nga lubadde mu kkanisa yange ey'edda. Ebintu bingi ebirungi byayogerwako, era mikwano mingi ne bajja okujaguza naffe. Nnasobola okuwandiikira Anne oluyimba nga nnyoleka okwebaza olw'okwagala kwe n'obuwagizi bwe okumala emyaka 50 – era n'okumuwa ‘omudaali’ gwe (ogwali gugamba nti “Owa 1 – asinga obulungi!”). Bulijjo yali agamba nti agwanira omudaali olw'okubeera nange ebbanga ery'ewala ennyo!! Ennaku ssatu oluvannyuma, twapakira emigugu gyaffe ne tusimbula okugenda e UK ne Norway nga tugenderera okumala wiiki bbiri ez'olubereberye ne muzukulu wa Anne nga bw'ali alabirira kitaawe mu biseera eby'enkomerero eby'obulwadde bw'okwerabira.

Eky'ennaku, yafa ennaku ntono nga tumaze okutuuka mu Norway, kyetwava twetaaga okuddayo mu Wales olw'omukolo gw'okuziika n'okusanyusa muwala we. Twandiddeyo nate mu Wales oluvannyuma lw'emyezi gyaffe esatu mu Norway, nga tukyalira mikwano okwetooloola obukiikaddyo, era, ddala, ‘amaka’ gaffe amaggya ag'ekkanisa e Cardigan.

Ryan Air y'emu ku makampuni ag'ennyonyi agali mu Bulaaya agawa ebbeeyi entono ennyo ku ntambula wakati w'ebisaawe by'ennyonyi ebitonotono. Twatuuka ku kisaawe eky'engeri eyo okumpi ne Oslo, okumpi n'ewa mutabani wa Jon-Kore ne Helene omulala, gye baali babeera. Batusanga ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi, ne batutwala ewaabwe okulya, ate ne batuvuza okutuusa e Flekkeroy. Ekifo ekirungi nga bwe kityo!

Ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma, twavuga okutuuka e Stavanger okunyumirwa ekiwummulo ekimpi mu kibuga ekyo ekirungi, nga tujjukira ebiseera Anastasis lwe yakyalira eyo mu 1993. Awo omukisa omulala omunene – twaweebwa emmotoka n'essimu ey'omu ngalo okukozesa mu biseera byaffe mu Norway!!

Mazima ddala, Mukama waffe atuumibwa bulungi Jehovah Jireh (Mukama Omuwi waffe). Amangwago ne tutereera mu maka gaffe amaggya nga tulaba obulungi ng'amaaso getunula ku mazzi okutuuka ku maka amalala ku kizinga ekyo.

Ennaku twazimalanga nga tutambula mu makubo amangi era nga twambuka ku mayinja okutuuka ku bifo eby'ebibunga eby'ekyama. Ku nnaku endala, twagendanga mu mmotoka okutuuka mu bifo ebirabika obulungi ebiri ewala. Ku by'okussekimu, twagendanga mu kkanisa ku lukalu, ekkuŋŋaaniro ery'abantu nga 150 lye baakuŋŋaananga mu ssomero, abasinga nga mmaka amato ag'abaana abato. Twanyumirwa ennyo ebiseera ebyo wadde nga twali tumanyi katono ku ekyo ekyayogerwanga. Oluusi baatuweanga omutafusi waffe ku bwaffe.

Mu mikwano gye twasisinkana mwalimu Mike ne Eve-Greta, ye nga Munnakanada, ne mukyala we nga Munnanorway. Baali bazimba enju ey'enjawulo okumpi naffe, kyetwava tusobola okumala ekiseera nga tubayamba mu pulojekiti yaabwe. Mu bbanga eryo lyonna, Anne yali yeenonyereza ku Lunnorway olw'ekiseera eky'enkomerero eky'ekiwummulo kyaffe bwe twandibadde mu Oslo n'ab'omu maka, abamu ku bo nga tebamanyi Lungereza n'akatono.

Ku wiikendi emu, twavuga okutuuka ku kayumba k'obutiti aka Jon-Kore ne Helene, akaali mu makkati g'ekitundu ekinene eky'ebitosi. Mazima ddala, mu butiti kyonna kibeera wansi w'omuzira wa mita, naye ku kukyala kwaffe twetaaga okwambala engatto ez'omupiira okuyita mu bitosi. Amayumba gazimbibwa mu ngeri ya butiti nga galina akasolya k'omuddo, agamu nga galiko ebimera n'ebisaka ebinene nga bimeramu!

Ettaka lyonna eryetoolodde lisaanira nnyo okukuza obuwuka bw'obulublueberi, era kyali ssanyu lyaffe okunoga lita nnyingi n'okubinyumirwa ku mmere yaffe. Waffulo eziriko akatuka akakube n'obublueberi tezyangu kusinga, naddala nga zirriddwa mu kibiina ky'emikwano emirungi.

Ku wiiki yaffe ey'enkomerero mu Flekkeroy ne wiiki zaffe bbiri mu Oslo mu maka ga Svein ne Mae, mwannyina wa Anne, muwala waffe Corinne yatuuka mu nnyonyi okwegatta naffe. Alina omwoyo omunene ku by'olulyo, naye yali alina ebbanga ttono ku lulyo lwa kitaawe wa Anne okusukka emirembe ebiri. Yali amanyi nti Peder Olsen, jjajja wa Anne, yali abeera mu ffaamu e Nordalen, mayiro ntono mu bukiikakkono bwa Oslo, kyetwava lumu twawola emmotoka ya Mae ne tuvuga okutuuka mu kitundu ekyo. Corinne yatandika okwogera n'omusajja mu kifo ky'ekitundu, era, mu saawa bbiri, yali afunye olulyo lwa Anne okudda emabega okutuuka mu 1150AD – emirembe 17!! Mama, yasanyuka nnyo!! Nnali mmanyi nti Anne alina omusaayi gw'Abaviking mu ye!!

Svein ne Mae baali basembeza abagenyi abalungi ennyo era gye twasobola okuba n'obussekimu obuwoomu. Sisobola kulowooza nti entambula zaffe ez'omu maaso mu Bulaaya teziibeeremu kukyala kudda okubalaba, naddala ng'ennyonyi wakati wa UK ne Norway za bbeeyi ntono ennyo, bwe zigeraageranyizibwa n'ez'amakampuni g'ennyonyi aga Kanada/Amerika.

Twadda mu Wales ku ntandikwa ya Novemba, ogutali mwezi mulungi kumaliramu biseera bya kiwummulo, naddala nga munnaffe omwagalwa Jenna yali atusabye obanga ayinza okwegatta naffe mu kitundu ekyo eky'ebiseera byaffe ebweru w'eggwanga. Twamukakasa nti bulijjo anaabanga wa kwanirizibwa naffe naye ne tumulabula nti obudde mu UK mu Novemba butera kuba obusinga obubi mu mwaka, nga bulimu olufu, enkuba entono, n'empewo ennyogovu.

Yagamba nti teyali afaayo nnyo ku kulaba ebbugwe oba okutambula amakubo naye yali ayagala okusisinkana mikwano gyaffe, okulaba ensibuko zaffe n'okunyumirwa okubeera naffe.

Bwe kityo ne kikkirizibwa, nga tukitegeera nti twandyetaaze okupangisa emmotoka mu bimu ku biseera byaffe ‘eka’ tusobole okutwala Jenna okwetooloola. Lowooza ku ssanyu lyaffe olunaku olwaddirira, bwe nnafuna email okuva ewa Steve ne Sulwen, ab'e Mt Zion Cardigan, nga bagamba nga bwe baali banakuwavu nti tebandituulabye mu Novemba kubanga baali bamala omwezi ogwo ne mutabani waabwe mu Thailand. Kyokka, twali twanirizibwa okukozesa emmotoka n'amaka gaabwe omwezi gwonna! Okutya kwaffe ku budde tekwaliimu makulu, kubanga Novemba oyo ateekwa okuba nga y'asinga okubugumu n'okukala mu byawandiikibwa – twatuula n'ebweru olw'ekyayi kyaffe eky'oku makya, ne tusobola okutambula amakubo mangi ag'oku lubalama amalungi n'okulaga Jenna ebirungi bingi eby'eggwanga lyaffe – talyerabira kiwummulo ekyo, naddala ekyennyanja n'obumonde n'obukeeke bw'omuzigo!

Twasobola okulaba Steve ne Sulwen mu myezi mitono kubanga baawaanyisiganya amaka n'emmotoka n'omusumba w'ekitundu okumala emyezi ena ku ntandikwa ya 2012, naye ogwo lugero lulala, era ntuuse ku nkomerero ya luno. Oboolyawo nnaayongerako ebitundu ebirala singa Mukama ampa emyaka mingi egirala, naye nnayagala okuwandiika ekitabo kino, si kutegeeza lugero kyokka naye n'okuwa ekitiibwa Mukama atukulembedde mu lugendo luno olw'ekyewuunyo ennyo. Tutuuse okumumanya n'okumwagala okusingawo era tumwebaza nti “omugabo gwaffe gugudde mu bifo ebisanyusa.”

Sisobola okulema okulowooza nti ensonga yokka lwaki nnina olugero olw'engeri eyo kwe bintu bisatu: • Omutima gwange gwegomba okumanyako Mukama ng'okuddamu okusaba kwa Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1:17.

• Okusaba kw'Omutima gwange kusigala nti nsobole okukuumibwa mu kwagala kwe.

• Asanyuka okumpa okusingawo ku mikisa gye kubanga nyanguwa okubuulira abalala ku gyo.

Obulamu bwange bubeere bulijjo ‘olw'ettendo ery'ekitiibwa kye’ – Abaefeso 1:14.

Gareth – Okitobba 2012

Mu Julaayi, twajaguza olw'essanyu ery'olujaguzo lwaffe olwa zaabu, olwateekebwateekebwa bawala baffe era nga lubadde mu kkanisa yange ey'edda. Ebintu bingi ebirungi byayogerwako, era mikwano mingi ne bajja okujaguza naffe. Nnasobola okuwandiikira Anne oluyimba nga nnyoleka okwebaza olw'okwagala kwe n'obuwagizi bwe okumala emyaka 50 – era n'okumuwa ‘omudaali’ gwe (ogwali gugamba nti “Owa 1 – asinga obulungi!”). Bulijjo yali agamba nti agwanira omudaali olw'okubeera nange ebbanga ery'ewala ennyo!! Ennaku ssatu oluvannyuma, twapakira emigugu gyaffe ne tusimbula okugenda e UK ne Norway nga tugenderera okumala wiiki bbiri ez'olubereberye ne muzukulu wa Anne nga bw'ali alabirira kitaawe mu biseera eby'enkomerero eby'obulwadde bw'okwerabira. Eky'ennaku, yafa ennaku ntono nga tumaze okutuuka mu Norway, kyetwava twetaaga okuddayo mu Wales olw'omukolo gw'okuziika n'okusanyusa muwala we. Twandiddeyo nate mu Wales oluvannyuma lw'emyezi gyaffe esatu mu Norway, nga tukyalira mikwano okwetooloola obukiikaddyo, era, ddala, ‘amaka’ gaffe amaggya ag'ekkanisa e Cardigan. Ryan Air y'emu ku makampuni ag'ennyonyi agali mu Bulaaya agawa ebbeeyi entono ennyo ku ntambula wakati w'ebisaawe by'ennyonyi ebitonotono. Twatuuka ku kisaawe eky'engeri eyo okumpi ne Oslo, okumpi n'ewa mutabani wa Jon-Kore ne Helene omulala, gye baali babeera. Batusanga ku kisaawe ky'ennyonyi, ne batutwala ewaabwe okulya, ate ne batuvuza okutuusa e Flekkeroy. Ekifo ekirungi nga bwe kityo! Ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma, twavuga okutuuka e Stavanger okunyumirwa ekiwummulo ekimpi mu kibuga ekyo ekirungi, nga tujjukira ebiseera Anastasis lwe yakyalira eyo mu 1993. Awo omukisa omulala omunene – twaweebwa emmotoka n'essimu ey'omu ngalo okukozesa mu biseera byaffe mu Norway!! Mazima ddala, Mukama waffe atuumibwa bulungi Jehovah Jireh (Mukama Omuwi waffe). Amangwago ne tutereera mu maka gaffe amaggya nga tulaba obulungi ng'amaaso getunula ku mazzi okutuuka ku maka amalala ku kizinga ekyo. Ennaku twazimalanga nga tutambula mu makubo amangi era nga twambuka ku mayinja okutuuka ku bifo eby'ebibunga eby'ekyama. Ku nnaku endala, twagendanga mu mmotoka okutuuka mu bifo ebirabika obulungi ebiri ewala. Ku by'okussekimu, twagendanga mu kkanisa ku lukalu, ekkuŋŋaaniro ery'abantu nga 150 lye baakuŋŋaananga mu ssomero, abasinga nga mmaka amato ag'abaana abato. Twanyumirwa ennyo ebiseera ebyo wadde nga twali tumanyi katono ku ekyo ekyayogerwanga. Oluusi baatuweanga omutafusi waffe ku bwaffe. Mu mikwano gye twasisinkana mwalimu Mike ne Eve-Greta, ye nga Munnakanada, ne mukyala we nga Munnanorway. Baali bazimba enju ey'enjawulo okumpi naffe, kyetwava tusobola okumala ekiseera nga tubayamba mu pulojekiti yaabwe. Mu bbanga eryo lyonna, Anne yali yeenonyereza ku Lunnorway olw'ekiseera eky'enkomerero eky'ekiwummulo kyaffe bwe twandibadde mu Oslo n'ab'omu maka, abamu ku bo nga tebamanyi Lungereza n'akatono. Ku wiikendi emu, twavuga okutuuka ku kayumba k'obutiti aka Jon-Kore ne Helene, akaali mu makkati g'ekitundu ekinene eky'ebitosi. Mazima ddala, mu butiti kyonna kibeera wansi w'omuzira wa mita, naye ku kukyala kwaffe twetaaga okwambala engatto ez'omupiira okuyita mu bitosi. Amayumba gazimbibwa mu ngeri ya butiti nga galina akasolya k'omuddo, agamu nga galiko ebimera n'ebisaka ebinene nga bimeramu! Ettaka lyonna eryetoolodde lisaanira nnyo okukuza obuwuka bw'obulublueberi, era kyali ssanyu lyaffe okunoga lita nnyingi n'okubinyumirwa ku mmere yaffe. Waffulo eziriko akatuka akakube n'obublueberi tezyangu kusinga, naddala nga zirriddwa mu kibiina ky'emikwano emirungi. Ku wiiki yaffe ey'enkomerero mu Flekkeroy ne wiiki zaffe bbiri mu Oslo mu maka ga Svein ne Mae, mwannyina wa Anne, muwala waffe Corinne yatuuka mu nnyonyi okwegatta naffe. Alina omwoyo omunene ku by'olulyo, naye yali alina ebbanga ttono ku lulyo lwa kitaawe wa Anne okusukka emirembe ebiri. Yali amanyi nti Peder Olsen, jjajja wa Anne, yali abeera mu ffaamu e Nordalen, mayiro ntono mu bukiikakkono bwa Oslo, kyetwava lumu twawola emmotoka ya Mae ne tuvuga okutuuka mu kitundu ekyo. Corinne yatandika okwogera n'omusajja mu kifo ky'ekitundu, era, mu saawa bbiri, yali afunye olulyo lwa Anne okudda emabega okutuuka mu 1150AD – emirembe 17!! Mama, yasanyuka nnyo!! Nnali mmanyi nti Anne alina omusaayi gw'Abaviking mu ye!! Svein ne Mae baali basembeza abagenyi abalungi ennyo era gye twasobola okuba n'obussekimu obuwoomu. Sisobola kulowooza nti entambula zaffe ez'omu maaso mu Bulaaya teziibeeremu kukyala kudda okubalaba, naddala ng'ennyonyi wakati wa UK ne Norway za bbeeyi ntono ennyo, bwe zigeraageranyizibwa n'ez'amakampuni g'ennyonyi aga Kanada/Amerika. Twadda mu Wales ku ntandikwa ya Novemba, ogutali mwezi mulungi kumaliramu biseera bya kiwummulo, naddala nga munnaffe omwagalwa Jenna yali atusabye obanga ayinza okwegatta naffe mu kitundu ekyo eky'ebiseera byaffe ebweru w'eggwanga. Twamukakasa nti bulijjo anaabanga wa kwanirizibwa naffe naye ne tumulabula nti obudde mu UK mu Novemba butera kuba obusinga obubi mu mwaka, nga bulimu olufu, enkuba entono, n'empewo ennyogovu. Yagamba nti teyali afaayo nnyo ku kulaba ebbugwe oba okutambula amakubo naye yali ayagala okusisinkana mikwano gyaffe, okulaba ensibuko zaffe n'okunyumirwa okubeera naffe. Bwe kityo ne kikkirizibwa, nga tukitegeera nti twandyetaaze okupangisa emmotoka mu bimu ku biseera byaffe ‘eka’ tusobole okutwala Jenna okwetooloola. Lowooza ku ssanyu lyaffe olunaku olwaddirira, bwe nnafuna email okuva ewa Steve ne Sulwen, ab'e Mt Zion Cardigan, nga bagamba nga bwe baali banakuwavu nti tebandituulabye mu Novemba kubanga baali bamala omwezi ogwo ne mutabani waabwe mu Thailand. Kyokka, twali twanirizibwa okukozesa emmotoka n'amaka gaabwe omwezi gwonna! Okutya kwaffe ku budde tekwaliimu makulu, kubanga Novemba oyo ateekwa okuba nga y'asinga okubugumu n'okukala mu byawandiikibwa – twatuula n'ebweru olw'ekyayi kyaffe eky'oku makya, ne tusobola okutambula amakubo mangi ag'oku lubalama amalungi n'okulaga Jenna ebirungi bingi eby'eggwanga lyaffe – talyerabira kiwummulo ekyo, naddala ekyennyanja n'obumonde n'obukeeke bw'omuzigo! Twasobola okulaba Steve ne Sulwen mu myezi mitono kubanga baawaanyisiganya amaka n'emmotoka n'omusumba w'ekitundu okumala emyezi ena ku ntandikwa ya 2012, naye ogwo lugero lulala, era ntuuse ku nkomerero ya luno. Oboolyawo nnaayongerako ebitundu ebirala singa Mukama ampa emyaka mingi egirala, naye nnayagala okuwandiika ekitabo kino, si kutegeeza lugero kyokka naye n'okuwa ekitiibwa Mukama atukulembedde mu lugendo luno olw'ekyewuunyo ennyo. Tutuuse okumumanya n'okumwagala okusingawo era tumwebaza nti “omugabo gwaffe gugudde mu bifo ebisanyusa.” Sisobola okulema okulowooza nti ensonga yokka lwaki nnina olugero olw'engeri eyo kwe bintu bisatu: • Omutima gwange gwegomba okumanyako Mukama ng'okuddamu okusaba kwa Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1:17. • Okusaba kw'Omutima gwange kusigala nti nsobole okukuumibwa mu kwagala kwe. • Asanyuka okumpa okusingawo ku mikisa gye kubanga nyanguwa okubuulira abalala ku gyo. Obulamu bwange bubeere bulijjo ‘olw'ettendo ery'ekitiibwa kye’ – Abaefeso 1:14. Gareth – Okitobba 2012

fields.title: Okujjukira Anne
fields.body_html:
Kati mwaka 2026, era nzizibwamu amaanyi okuwandiika essuula endala ku lugendo lwange. Mukama akyanneewuunyisa olw'enzigi z'anzigulidde, bbiri ku zo nga ziyimiridde ng'olwo olwanzigulirwa mu Ssomero ly'Abayudaaya (Hebrew School), olutera okuyitibwa “Everest” ey'obulamu bwange. Wabula, nandibadde nsobya singa sisooka na kitiibwa eri munnange gwe twamala naye emyaka 65 era gwe twatambula naye olugendo luno – mukyala wange omwagalwa ennyo, Anne.

Anne yayingira mu maaso g'Omulokozi we nga 17 Ddesemba 2025, mu mirembe, awaka, oluvannyuma lw'okulwanagana ne kookolo okumala emyaka 14.

Gwali mwaka ogwaddirira oluwummulo lwaffe olw'ekitalo mu Norway, bwe twali tujaguza emyaka 50 egy'obufumbo bwaffe, bwe twafuna okuyitibwa okuva ewa Vincent ne Shirley Cheah mu Malaysia okubeera abagenyi baabwe mu kulambula China. Twasanyuka nnyo, naddala nze, kubanga ekisooka ku ‘lukalala lw'ebintu bye nnali njagala okukola nga sinnava ku nsi’ kwali kulaba abaserikale ab'ebbumba abamanyiddwa ennyo (terracotta soldiers) ne Bbugwe Omunene (Great Wall). Twali tumaze okugula tikiti okugenda e Hong Kong, gye twandibeegatteko okuyingira China, bwe twafuna amawulire nti Anne bamusanzeemu kookolo w'amabeere. Amawulire gano yagakkiriza n'obugumu, ng'amanyi nti Mukama yali akyali mu buyinza. Yali yeeraze ku ntikko z'ensozi; kaakano twali tugenda kumwetaaga okutambula naffe mu kiwonvu kino ekiwanvu. Ennyonyi zaasazibwamu (ne tuddizibwa ssente zonna) Anne n'atandika eddagala lya kemo (chemotherapy). Kyali kintu kizibu ddala, naye yakiyitamu n'obukkakkamu, wadde nga yali munafu nnyo.

Emyaka ebiri egy'‘okuwona okw'ekiseera’ gyaddirira, oluvannyuma kookolo n'addamu omulundi ogwokubiri, ne kivaamu okumusalako ebbeere. Emyaka emirala mitono gyayitawo ng'agenda kwekebeza buli kiseera, byonna ng'abigumiikiriza n'obukkakkamu – olwo kookolo n'addamu omulundi ogwokusatu mu nsigo z'omu bulago (lymph nodes), ne yeetaaga okujjanjabibwa n'obusannyalazo (radiation). Yagezaako okubeera n'obulamu obuwa obujulirwa bw'obulungi bwa Mukama eri abayizi baffe, nga teyeemulugunya n'akatono, wabula bulijjo ng'abeera maama gye bali – era ne gye ndi.

Mu Ssebutemba 2025 nnalina okumutwala mu kitongole ky'abalwadde ab'amangu (Emergency) mu ddwaliro lyaffe ery'okumpi kubanga yali assa bubi. Baazuula nti amawuggwe ge gaali gazingamye, erya kkono lyonna n'erya ddyo ekitundu. Amazzi agasukka mu liita nnya gaamuggyibwamu okwetooloola amawuggwe, era, nga bwe twali tutya, kookolo n'azuulibwa mu mazzi ago. Omusawo waffe wa kookolo yatunnyonnyola nti tewaali kirala kye basobola kumukolera, naye n'addamu nti, “Kale. Mmanyi gye ŋŋenda era ndi mu mirembe mingi ku nsonga eyo. Nja kubeera mu bulamu lunaku ku lunaku okutuusa Mukama lw'alintwala eka.” Yabeera nange awaka okumala omwezi ogwasembayo, nga talina kigambo kirala okuggyako ebirungi ku basawo bonna, abalabirira abalwadde, n'abakozi abajjanjaba abali ku nkomerero y'obulamu abaamuweereza.

Oluvannyuma lw'okugenda kwe “okulungi”, omusawo wa kookolo yatugamba nti Anne yali kyamagero, kubanga omuntu alina kookolo ow'ekika kye atera kuwangaala emyaka 5 oba obutassa awo. Anne yabeera nange emyaka 14. Oba ng'okugenda kwe kwali “kulungi”, obulamu bwe nange bwali bugagga, era nkitegedde buto nti nnalina eky'obugagga ekinene ennyo okutambula nange ku mabbali mu lugendo luno.

Twasisinkana nga ndi mu yunivasite, era nga yeetaba mu nkungaana z'abavubuka mu kkanisa y'emu gye nnasabirangamu. Yalina ensonyi nnyo, ng'alina mikwano mitono, era ng'ebiseera by'obuto bwe ebisinga yabimala alabirira kitaawe eyali omulwadde. Nze nnali ‘muganzi’ we eyasooka era nnalina okukola ebisinga okusobola okugatta enjawulo ennene wakati w'engeri zaffe, ensonyi ze nga za njawulo nnyo ku kwemalirira kwange (olw'okufiirwa maama nga nkyali muto). Emirundi mingi nnamuswazanga, naye n'asigala nange, kubanga omulundi gwe yasooka okundaba, nga nnyimiridde mu kizikiza ku mulyango gw'ekkanisa nga beeraga firimu ya Billy Graham mu kkanisa yaffe, Mukama yali amugambye nti, “Oyo ye musajja gw'ogenda okufumbirwa!” Kyatwala emyaka ng'ebiri nga tannaŋŋamba nze ekintu kye kimu!

Twafumbiriganwa mu 1961 ne tusenguka e Kenfig Hill gye nnasomesezanga mu ssomero lya Comprehensive ery'omu kitundu. Emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma ‘nnamusikambula’ okuva mu bukuumi bw'ab'ewaabwe ne mmutwala emitala w'ennyanja e Germany, gye twali tetulina muntu mulala wabula buli omu ku munne mu nsi ey'ebweru ng'erina olulimi olutamanyiddwa. Nze nnali musomesa asinga obuto eyali akoledde Amagye ga Bungereza, nga nsinga abalala emyaka etaano, nga nnina obumanyirivu bw'emyaka ebiri gyokka, mu kifo ky'emyaka etaano egy'‘etaagibwa’, era nga sisoose kuweereza mu magye nga bwe kyali kiragiro (National Service) nga sinnalondebwa.

Anne yali asemberera nnyo emyaka gy'abayizi bange okusinga omusomesa omulala yenna oba mukyala w'omusomesa yenna. Wadde nga kyali kizibu nnyo gy'ali, teyeemulugunya n'akatono – mu butuufu, ffembi twamanya nti Germany ye “yatuzimba” ng'amaka kubanga twalina buli omu ku munne bokka – ne Mukama. Guno tegwali gwa mulundi gwokka gwe nnandimuggye mu bukuumi bwe. Twagenda e Hong Kong, gye yasembayo okwemalamu ensonyi ze bwe yatandika okutunda ebintu bya Tupperware mu maka g'abantu.

Bwe twakomawo mu Bungereza (UK) mu 1969, ye yatandika omulimu gw'abavubuka mu maka gaffe ng'ayita abawala bana abali mu myaka egy'obuvubuka okwegatta naye mu kusoma Bayibuli buli wiiki. Omulimu ogwo gwakula ne gufuuka omulimu gw'Abavubuka gwe nnakulembera e Bridgend, ekiseera abangi kye bayita “okuzuukuka” (revival). Nze nnatenderezebwa, naye ye yali omutandisi.

Twasenguka ne tugenda e Canada mu 1975 era emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma nnamala ne “ntuuka” bwe nnalondebwa okuba Omukulu w'Ekitongole kya Fizikisi ku Toronto Hebrew Academy. Kaakano twali tusobola okubeera n'obulamu obulungi kubanga nze nnali musomesa asinga okusasulwa mu Canada, okuggyako Abakulu b'Amassomero. Bawala bange abaali mu myaka egy'obuvubuka baatandika okunoonya amayumba agalina ebidiba eby'okuwugiramu n'ebirala, mu bukiikakkono bwa Toronto, ffe ne tutandika okulongoosa ebintu byaffe eby'omu nnyumba n'engeri gye twali tubeeramu, bulijjo nga tuwa obujulirwa ku “bulungi” bwa Katonda gye tuli.

Awo, ne mbwatukira Anne n'amawulire agaali ng'ebomu. Oluvannyuma lw'emyezi nga nneegugunga, nnamutegeeza nti, “Anne, nzikiriza nti Mukama ampita mu Buweereza!” Buli kimu munda mu ye kiteekwa okuba nga kyali kiwoggana nti, “Nedda! Nedda!” oluvannyuma lw'obuto obw'obwavu, kitaawe bwe yali omubuulizi w'enjiri atambula mu Norway, ng'aleeta awaka akasente katono nnyo. Wabula, okuddamu kwe kwalaga empisa ze n'obwesige bwe mu Katonda. “Katonda bw'aba ng'akuyita, kirungi ogondere!”

Kyandiwezezza emyaka emirala 10 nga tetunnakka ‘wansi’ omulundi omulala. Yanyumirwanga okubeera ku Anastasis nga kiri ku mwalo e Victoria, naye teyalina kwagala kwonna kwa “kubeera mu bantu ababeerera awamu mu ssanduuko ey'ekyuma mu bbugumu lya Afirika nga tewali kyuma kiwoza mpewo.” Nedda, webale! Awo ne nfuna essimu enjita “okulinnya ku kyombo” okuwummuzaamu omusumba w'oku kyombo (chaplain) eyaliwo. Nnagamba Don Stevens nti nnandyetaaze okwogera ne Anne ku kumuleka okumala emyezi mitono okukkiriza okuyita kwe. Nnamukubira essimu era, nga kyewuunyisa nze naye, n'ayoleka nti ayagala okugenda okumala ebbanga eddene (okusalawo kwe tetwejjusa n'akatono). Yafuuka mukozi munnange ow'amaanyi era “maama” w'abakozi bonna Abafirika ku kyombo, era yayagalibwa nnyo abantu bonna.

Emyaka ena oluvannyuma twava ku kyombo ne tugenda okulaba muwala waffe Lynette n'ab'omu maka ge e Australia. Emyezi mukaaga oluvannyuma, bwe twali tupakira okuddayo, nnayitibwa okukomawo oluvannyuma lw'emyezi kkumi n'ebiri okukulembera omusomo (seminar) ogw'abasumba n'abakulembeze ne The Christian & Missionary Alliance. Bwe nnayoleka nga bwe kyali “tekisoboka” kubanga nnali nsuubira okutwala ekkanisa empya mu Canada era nga sisobola kusaba luwummula mwaka gumu oluvannyuma, ye Anne eyagamba nti, “Tosaanye kutwala kkanisa mpya. Oli mugolokofu nnyo okugumiikiriza ‘ebisiraani’ ebitera okubeera mu makanisa. Olina okufuuka omutambuze, ng'oyigiriza era ng'otendeka abasumba n'abalala. Nze nsobola okusuza abayizi mu maka gaffe okukusobozesa okutambula gy'onoobanga Mukama akuyise!”

Bwe ntyo bwe nnava ku Hebrew Academy nga nfuna omusaala omunene n'akasiimo k'obukadde (pension) akanene, ne ngenda mu busumba nga nfuna kitundu kya musaala na kitundu kya kasiimo k'obukadde, ne ngenda mu mulimu gw'obuminsani ogutaalina musaala wadde akasiimo k'obukadde, ne ngenda mu kutambula nga nneesasulira ssente zange!! Ekkubo eryo teryali lya kutuuka ku buwanguzi n'akatono!! Naye ekitabo kino kiraga nti ekirowoozo ekyo kya bulimba, kubanga Katonda atutambuzza mu lugendo olw'ekitalo.

Wabula, tewali kimu ku ebyo kyandisobose singa Anne teyawulira ddoboozi lye n'agondera. Njogera mazima bwe ŋŋamba nti singa yagamba nti “Nedda” mu kiseera kyonna, sandikoze kintu kikontana na by'ayagala, kubanga nnayiga dda nti Mukama ayogera nange mu ngeri esinga okutegeerekeka ng'ayita mu bigambo bya mukyala atya Katonda – era ddala nnali naye! Webale, Mukama, olwa munnange omulungi ennyo gwe wampa! Nfunye okutenderezebwa kungi, naye mmanyi nti ddala kwali kwa ye – era nti kaakano afuna ettendo lye yatatera kufuna mu lwatu ng'ali ku nsi – okuva eri Oyo asinga obukulu.

Amazzi agasukka mu liita nnya gaamuggyibwamu okwetooloola amawuggwe, era, nga bwe twali tutya, kookolo n'azuulibwa mu mazzi ago. Omusawo waffe wa kookolo yatunnyonnyola nti tewaali kirala kye basobola kumukolera, naye n'addamu nti, “Kale. Mmanyi gye ŋŋenda era ndi mu mirembe mingi ku nsonga eyo. Nja kubeera mu bulamu lunaku ku lunaku okutuusa Mukama lw'alintwala eka.” Yabeera nange awaka okumala omwezi ogwasembayo, nga talina kigambo kirala okuggyako ebirungi ku basawo bonna, abalabirira abalwadde, n'abakozi abajjanjaba abali ku nkomerero y'obulamu abaamuweereza. Oluvannyuma lw'okugenda kwe “okulungi”, omusawo wa kookolo yatugamba nti Anne yali kyamagero, kubanga omuntu alina kookolo ow'ekika kye atera kuwangaala emyaka 5 oba obutassa awo. Anne yabeera nange emyaka 14. Oba ng'okugenda kwe kwali “kulungi”, obulamu bwe nange bwali bugagga, era nkitegedde buto nti nnalina eky'obugagga ekinene ennyo okutambula nange ku mabbali mu lugendo luno. Twasisinkana nga ndi mu yunivasite, era nga yeetaba mu nkungaana z'abavubuka mu kkanisa y'emu gye nnasabirangamu. Yalina ensonyi nnyo, ng'alina mikwano mitono, era ng'ebiseera by'obuto bwe ebisinga yabimala alabirira kitaawe eyali omulwadde. Nze nnali ‘muganzi’ we eyasooka era nnalina okukola ebisinga okusobola okugatta enjawulo ennene wakati w'engeri zaffe, ensonyi ze nga za njawulo nnyo ku kwemalirira kwange (olw'okufiirwa maama nga nkyali muto). Emirundi mingi nnamuswazanga, naye n'asigala nange, kubanga omulundi gwe yasooka okundaba, nga nnyimiridde mu kizikiza ku mulyango gw'ekkanisa nga beeraga firimu ya Billy Graham mu kkanisa yaffe, Mukama yali amugambye nti, “Oyo ye musajja gw'ogenda okufumbirwa!” Kyatwala emyaka ng'ebiri nga tannaŋŋamba nze ekintu kye kimu! Twafumbiriganwa mu 1961 ne tusenguka e Kenfig Hill gye nnasomesezanga mu ssomero lya Comprehensive ery'omu kitundu. Emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma ‘nnamusikambula’ okuva mu bukuumi bw'ab'ewaabwe ne mmutwala emitala w'ennyanja e Germany, gye twali tetulina muntu mulala wabula buli omu ku munne mu nsi ey'ebweru ng'erina olulimi olutamanyiddwa. Nze nnali musomesa asinga obuto eyali akoledde Amagye ga Bungereza, nga nsinga abalala emyaka etaano, nga nnina obumanyirivu bw'emyaka ebiri gyokka, mu kifo ky'emyaka etaano egy'‘etaagibwa’, era nga sisoose kuweereza mu magye nga bwe kyali kiragiro (National Service) nga sinnalondebwa. Anne yali asemberera nnyo emyaka gy'abayizi bange okusinga omusomesa omulala yenna oba mukyala w'omusomesa yenna. Wadde nga kyali kizibu nnyo gy'ali, teyeemulugunya n'akatono – mu butuufu, ffembi twamanya nti Germany ye “yatuzimba” ng'amaka kubanga twalina buli omu ku munne bokka – ne Mukama. Guno tegwali gwa mulundi gwokka gwe nnandimuggye mu bukuumi bwe. Twagenda e Hong Kong, gye yasembayo okwemalamu ensonyi ze bwe yatandika okutunda ebintu bya Tupperware mu maka g'abantu. Bwe twakomawo mu Bungereza (UK) mu 1969, ye yatandika omulimu gw'abavubuka mu maka gaffe ng'ayita abawala bana abali mu myaka egy'obuvubuka okwegatta naye mu kusoma Bayibuli buli wiiki. Omulimu ogwo gwakula ne gufuuka omulimu gw'Abavubuka gwe nnakulembera e Bridgend, ekiseera abangi kye bayita “okuzuukuka” (revival). Nze nnatenderezebwa, naye ye yali omutandisi. Twasenguka ne tugenda e Canada mu 1975 era emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma nnamala ne “ntuuka” bwe nnalondebwa okuba Omukulu w'Ekitongole kya Fizikisi ku Toronto Hebrew Academy. Kaakano twali tusobola okubeera n'obulamu obulungi kubanga nze nnali musomesa asinga okusasulwa mu Canada, okuggyako Abakulu b'Amassomero. Bawala bange abaali mu myaka egy'obuvubuka baatandika okunoonya amayumba agalina ebidiba eby'okuwugiramu n'ebirala, mu bukiikakkono bwa Toronto, ffe ne tutandika okulongoosa ebintu byaffe eby'omu nnyumba n'engeri gye twali tubeeramu, bulijjo nga tuwa obujulirwa ku “bulungi” bwa Katonda gye tuli. Awo, ne mbwatukira Anne n'amawulire agaali ng'ebomu. Oluvannyuma lw'emyezi nga nneegugunga, nnamutegeeza nti, “Anne, nzikiriza nti Mukama ampita mu Buweereza!” Buli kimu munda mu ye kiteekwa okuba nga kyali kiwoggana nti, “Nedda! Nedda!” oluvannyuma lw'obuto obw'obwavu, kitaawe bwe yali omubuulizi w'enjiri atambula mu Norway, ng'aleeta awaka akasente katono nnyo. Wabula, okuddamu kwe kwalaga empisa ze n'obwesige bwe mu Katonda. “Katonda bw'aba ng'akuyita, kirungi ogondere!” Kyandiwezezza emyaka emirala 10 nga tetunnakka ‘wansi’ omulundi omulala. Yanyumirwanga okubeera ku Anastasis nga kiri ku mwalo e Victoria, naye teyalina kwagala kwonna kwa “kubeera mu bantu ababeerera awamu mu ssanduuko ey'ekyuma mu bbugumu lya Afirika nga tewali kyuma kiwoza mpewo.” Nedda, webale! Awo ne nfuna essimu enjita “okulinnya ku kyombo” okuwummuzaamu omusumba w'oku kyombo (chaplain) eyaliwo. Nnagamba Don Stevens nti nnandyetaaze okwogera ne Anne ku kumuleka okumala emyezi mitono okukkiriza okuyita kwe. Nnamukubira essimu era, nga kyewuunyisa nze naye, n'ayoleka nti ayagala okugenda okumala ebbanga eddene (okusalawo kwe tetwejjusa n'akatono). Yafuuka mukozi munnange ow'amaanyi era “maama” w'abakozi bonna Abafirika ku kyombo, era yayagalibwa nnyo abantu bonna. Emyaka ena oluvannyuma twava ku kyombo ne tugenda okulaba muwala waffe Lynette n'ab'omu maka ge e Australia. Emyezi mukaaga oluvannyuma, bwe twali tupakira okuddayo, nnayitibwa okukomawo oluvannyuma lw'emyezi kkumi n'ebiri okukulembera omusomo (seminar) ogw'abasumba n'abakulembeze ne The Christian & Missionary Alliance. Bwe nnayoleka nga bwe kyali “tekisoboka” kubanga nnali nsuubira okutwala ekkanisa empya mu Canada era nga sisobola kusaba luwummula mwaka gumu oluvannyuma, ye Anne eyagamba nti, “Tosaanye kutwala kkanisa mpya. Oli mugolokofu nnyo okugumiikiriza ‘ebisiraani’ ebitera okubeera mu makanisa. Olina okufuuka omutambuze, ng'oyigiriza era ng'otendeka abasumba n'abalala. Nze nsobola okusuza abayizi mu maka gaffe okukusobozesa okutambula gy'onoobanga Mukama akuyise!” Bwe ntyo bwe nnava ku Hebrew Academy nga nfuna omusaala omunene n'akasiimo k'obukadde (pension) akanene, ne ngenda mu busumba nga nfuna kitundu kya musaala na kitundu kya kasiimo k'obukadde, ne ngenda mu mulimu gw'obuminsani ogutaalina musaala wadde akasiimo k'obukadde, ne ngenda mu kutambula nga nneesasulira ssente zange!! Ekkubo eryo teryali lya kutuuka ku buwanguzi n'akatono!! Naye ekitabo kino kiraga nti ekirowoozo ekyo kya bulimba, kubanga Katonda atutambuzza mu lugendo olw'ekitalo. Wabula, tewali kimu ku ebyo kyandisobose singa Anne teyawulira ddoboozi lye n'agondera. Njogera mazima bwe ŋŋamba nti singa yagamba nti “Nedda” mu kiseera kyonna, sandikoze kintu kikontana na by'ayagala, kubanga nnayiga dda nti Mukama ayogera nange mu ngeri esinga okutegeerekeka ng'ayita mu bigambo bya mukyala atya Katonda – era ddala nnali naye! Webale, Mukama, olwa munnange omulungi ennyo gwe wampa! Nfunye okutenderezebwa kungi, naye mmanyi nti ddala kwali kwa ye – era nti kaakano afuna ettendo lye yatatera kufuna mu lwatu ng'ali ku nsi – okuva eri Oyo asinga obukulu.

fields.title: Yunivasite y'e Victoria, UVIC
fields.body_html:
Okuva mu 1983, bwe twasenguka ne tujja mu kibuga ekirungi Victoria, BC, mbadde n'okwagala okw'amaanyi eri abayizi ba yunivasite ey'omu kitundu kino. Ku kisaawe kya yunivasite waliyo obuweereza bw'Ekikristaayo obw'enjawulo obuwerako, era nzenyigidde mu bungi bwabwo: nga njogera mu nkuŋŋaana z'abayizi, nga neetaba mu bibinja by'okusaba, era okumala emyaka egiwerako nga nkyaza enkuŋŋaana za buli wiiki mu maka gange.

Nayitibwa okwogera mu lumu ku nkuŋŋaana za buli wiiki eza Intervarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF). Nnasanyuka okukkiriza okuyitibwa okwo, era bwe nnamala okutegeka obubaka bwange, ne ntuuka ku kizimbe kya Yunivasite ekkuŋŋaana mwe lwali lugenda okubeera. Omuyizi omu yannyaniriza, n'oluvannyuma, ng'akwatiddwa ensonyi, n'ambuuza obanga nnandisobodde okukozesa eddakiika amakumi asatu zokka, kubanga waaliwo okutabulwa: omuyizi omulala yali atuuse okuva ku kisaawe kya yunivasite ekirala “waggulu ku kizinga”, ng'alowooza nti ye yali agenda okubeera omwogezi akawungeezi ako. Ne mmuddamu nti nnali mwetegefu ddala okumuleka akozese obudde bwonna, era nti tekyandinnyiizizza n'akatono. Nnanyumirwa nnyo okutuula mu kibinja kino eky'abayizi abaali abanyiikivu, nga bassa kimu nga beetoolodde Mukama n'Ekigambo kye.

Nga bwe kyali mu mboozi zange nnyingi ze mmaze okubuulira, okuggwamu essuubi kuno kwali kugenda kufuuka ejjinja ery'okulinnyirako eryantuusa mu biseera eby'ekitalo ebyali bijja ne IVCF. Nkiteebereza nti bayinza okuba nga baawulira nga balina ebbanja gyendi, kubanga waayita ekiseera kitono ne nfuna essimu ekiro kinene, nga nnaakakomawo awaka okuva mu lukuŋŋaana lw'ekkanisa. “Pasita Evans, oyinza okujja n'oyogera ku kijjulo kyaffe ekya Ssekukkulu ku Lwokutaano akawungeezi (oluvannyuma lw'ennaku bbiri)? Omwogezi gwe twali tutegese mulwadde ali Toronto, era omukulembeze waffe ali naye mu lukuŋŋaana olumu. Yankubidde essimu olwa leero ku makya ng'ansaba nkukubire, naye bwe nnakukubira emabegako, mukyala wo yaŋŋambye nti tonnaba kukomawo. Ngezezzaako ne basumba abalala bangi, naye bonna bagamba nti obudde bufunze nnyo. Nkwegayiridde, oyinza okujja?” Bwe nnamuddamu nti yee (“naye mu mitima gyammwe mutukuze Kristo okuba Mukama, nga mweteeseteese bulijjo okuwoza eri buli muntu abasaba ensonga y'essuubi eriri mu mmwe, naye n'obuwombeefu n'okussaamu ekitiibwa;” – 1 Peetero 3:15 NASB), n'asanyuka nnyo, era ne mpulira nga assa ekikkowe ekinene eky'okuweera. Ogwo gwali mukolo gwa kitalo nnyo, nga guliko abayizi abasoba mu 100. Bwe ntyo ne ntandika omukwano ogw'okwagalana ne IVCF (Intervarsity Christian Fellowship) n'omukulembeze waayo, Jack D. Buli lwe nnabanga ndi waka nga sitambudde mu mulimu gwange ogw'okutambula, nnabanga mpagira Jack mu mulimu gwe.

Waakabaawo “okukwatagana” okunyuvu. Emyaka mingi gyali giyiseewo nga siraba Jack, naye bwe nnali nkyawandiika ebyo waggulu, essimu yange n'evuga. Yali Jack! Yali mu Victoria olweggulo olwo, era n'abuuza obanga tuyinza okunywa kaawa ffembi! Nga twafuna ekiseera kirungi nnyo nga tujjukira ebiseera ebyo eby'edda! Kwali kukwatagana kwa bwereere? Nedda, sikirowooza. Njagala okukkiriza nti yali “Katonda ye yakikoze”, nga Kitaffe alaga essanyu lye olw'ebyo bye nnali mpandiise.

Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, Jack bwe yamala okugenda mu buweereza obulala ne mu ssaza eddala, ne nneenyigira mu mulimu omulala ku kisaawe kya yunivasite – UCM (University Christian Ministries) ogwali gukulemberwa Tony J. Nate waaliwo omukwano ogw'oku lusegere ogwazimbibwa, era nze ne Anne ne tukyazanga ekibinja ky'abayizi 10–12 mu maka gaffe buli wiiki okumala emyaka egiwerako.

Okwagala kwange eri abayizi kwafuna n'ekifaananyi ekirala. Nnatandika okutambula nga nsaba buli wiiki, emirundi egisinga ku Balaza, nga neetooloola oluguudo olwekulungirivu olwa kilomita 2 olwetoolodde ekisaawe kya yunivasite. Oluusi abayizi baatambulanga nange, naye emirundi egisinga nnabanga nzekka. Kino nnakikola okumala emyaka nga amakumi abiri, nga kumpi sirabangako muntu mulala yenna atambula ng'asaba. Mazima, nnawandiika ne email eri amakanisa gonna mu Victoria, nga nkubiriza bammemba baabwe okwawula essaawa emu buli wiiki bakole nga nze bwe nnali nkola – naye tewaali kuddamu kwe nnamanya kungi (nga kya nnaku!) – okutuusa obulumi obwagenda bweyongera mu magulu gange olw'endwadde y'ennyingo (arthritis) bwe bwakikomya. Nnali nnyimiridde nga nkutamye omutwe, mita 200 nga sinnatuuka ku siteegi ya bbaasi yange ey'enkomerero, eddoboozi ery'emabega wange bwe lyampita erinnya lyange. Yali Terri, omukulembeze wa IVCF. Bwe ntyo ne ntandika omukwano omupya, nga tusisinkana buli wiiki mu maka gange okusabira wamu, okutuusa lwe yagenda okufumbirwa Mike, omu ku abo abajjanga bulijjo mu lukuŋŋaana lwaffe olwa buli wiiki.

Nga waakayita ekiseera kitono oluvannyuma lw'olugendo lwange olw'enkomerero, omuvubuka omu yajja mu kkanisa yaffe. Ne mmulamusa ne mmubuuza nti, “Kiki ekikuleese wano?” N'anziramu nti, “Ggwe!” N'annyonnyola nti, “Nnaakatandika okutambula nga nsaba nga neetooloola ekisaawe kya UVIC, wamu n'abayizi abalala abasoma diguli ez'okuntikko n'abasomesa. Twawulira ku musajja eyatambulanga eyo buli wiiki, kyenvudde nzija okukulaba n'amaaso gange.” Omutima gwange nga gwayimba nnyo olw'okuba nti omugugu gwange kaakano gwali gusituddwa abalala! Katonda alina abakozi be buli wamu.

Anne bwe yamala okufa, ne mpulira nti ekiseera kyali kituuse okutunda ennyumba yange gye nnabeeramu emyaka 40. Nga bwe mpandiika essuula eno, mpulira okuwuuma kw'ebyuma ebiwummula n'emisumeeno egy'amasannyalaze, ng'abakozi balongoosa ennyumba yange ku lwa bannannyini yo abapya, abagenda okugiyingiramu mu mwezi gumu. Be James ne mukyala we Josie, b'ogenda okusisinkana mu ssuula eddako, era abafuuse mikwano gyange egy'omuwendo ennyo. Oyinza okuteebereza essanyu lyange bwe nnamanya nti bagenderera okupangisa ennyumba yaabwe eri abayizi ba IVCF abakulemberwa Terri! Erinnya lya Mukama lijja kweyongera okutenderezebwa wano, era bangi bajja kumumanya mu bisenge mwe nnasabira okumala ebbanga eddene bwe liti! Weebale, Mukama Yesu!

Be James ne mukyala we Josie, b'ogenda okusisinkana mu ssuula eddako, era abafuuse mikwano gyange egy'omuwendo ennyo. Oyinza okuteebereza essanyu lyange bwe nnamanya nti bagenderera okupangisa ennyumba yaabwe eri abayizi ba IVCF abakulemberwa Terri! Erinnya lya Mukama lijja kweyongera okutenderezebwa wano, era bangi bajja kumumanya mu bisenge mwe nnasabira okumala ebbanga eddene bwe liti! Weebale, Mukama Yesu!

fields.title: Ebitabo Byeyongera Obungi
fields.body_html:
Kye nsinga okukola, naddala mu Kiseera kyange eky'Okusirika n'Okusaba ku Lwokutaano ku makya, kwe kujjukira olugendo Mukama lw'atutambuzza. Bwe ntuula ku ntebe yange eya La-Z-Boy, nga nneebisse bulangiti yange (‘ekifo kyange eky'okusisinkana’) okufumiitiriza, ndowooza ku ‘mayinja ag'okulinnyirako’ – ekibuuzo kya Betty, Don Evans, Yunivasite y'e Swansea, n'ebirala – era emirundi mingi njogera nti “Mukama, Ggwe wakikola ekyo!” Ku nkomerero y'‘olugendo lwange olw'okujjukira’ oluwanvu, nnyongerako ebigambo bino n'okusaba: “Mukama, ngezezzaako okusiga ensigo Yo buli wantu w'onkulembedde. Oluusi nnakikola bulungi, naye emirundi mingi nnakikola bubi. Naye Mukama, ensigo eyo yiyo, era Wagamba nti tejja kukomawo gy'oli nga tetuukirizza kigendererwa kyayo. Nkwegayiridde Mukama, leero, wonna wonna mu nsi, leeta ebibala okuva mu ebyo bye nsize. Amiina.” Ku makya agamu ag'ekitalo, Yayingira mu kifo kyange eky'okusirika n'andaga ennimiro y'omuceere ennene ennyo, eyali egolooba nga tolaba nkomerero yaayo. Amangu ago, ebimera ebibisi ne bimera buli wamu. Nnasanyuka nnyo era ne neetoowaza bwe nnafumiitiriza ku ekyo kye ndowooza nti yali andaga. Okufuba kwange tekwali kwa bwereere.

Nnayogedde mu ssuula eyasooka ku mikisa eminene gye nnafuna bwe nnasuza era ne nkulembera, okumala akaseera katono, Greg Gordon, eyatandikawo www.sermonindex.net (laba essuula “Sermonindex.net”) – mazima ‘ejjinja ery'okulinnyirako’ Katonda lye yateekawo. Nnali mmanyi nti yali atadde ku mukutu ogwo ezimu ku bubaka bwange, naye nnali ntera obutafaayo kulaba nga bwe bwali butwalibwa. Ekyo kyabaddewo okutuusa emyaka ng'ebiri egiyise. Nnali nnoonya obubaka obulala (bwa Stephen Evans) ne ndaba erinnya lyange okumpi awo. Nnanyiga ne nzijukizibwa nti obubaka bwange 39 bwali bwatuuka ‘ku mukutu’. Kya bulijjo, nnatunuulira okulaba oba nga waliwo abaali babuwanulidde. Nandibadde mpeebwa omukisa okulaba nga buwanuliddwa emirundi ebikumi bitono, oboolyawo lukumi. Nneewuunya nnyo bwe nnalaba emiwendo – egyali emirundi egiwerako okusinga kye nnali nsuubira kyonna – mazima ‘omuceere’ gwali gumera! Naye okweyongera obungi okulala kwali kukyali mu maaso.

Emyaka mukaaga egiyise, nnafuna essimu okuva eri omuvubuka gwe nnali mmanyi mu maaso naye nga tetunnamanyagana. James yambuuza oba nga tusobola okutambula ffembi kubanga yali ayagala omuntu gw'anaavunaanyizibwangako era gw'anaasabanga naye. Bw'atyo n'atandika omukwano ogw'amaanyi ogukyagenda mu maaso n'okutuusa leero. Ab'omu maka ge bonna bafuuse kitundu ku bulamu bwange, era nkitwala nga kya muwendo nnyo buli lwe tukwatagana.

Twamala essaawa nnyingi nga tutambula, nga twogera era nga tusaba ffembi, ku lw'ekkanisa mu Victoria ne ku lw'ebyetaago byaffe ebyaffe. Tulina bingi bye twagala ebifaanagana, naye mu ngeri nnyingi twawukana nnyo. Musuubuzi omututumufu, naddala mu by'tekinologiya (IT), era atandiseewo kkampuni nnyingi. Era ayamba Pastor Dan Muwanguzi n'omulimu gwe mu Uganda. (https://christianmodelministries.com/). Mu emu ku ngendo ze e Uganda, James yatandikawo kkampuni ya IT ekulemberwa mutabani wa mwannyina Dan, Isaac (www.odyssey.com), era mu gimu ku mirimu gyabwe egyasooka baddamu okukola omukutu gwange ogw'omu kiseera kino (www.garethevansministries.org). Nga guno mukisa! Omukisa ogwo gweyongera obungi, kubanga okumala emyezi egiwerako, buli wiiki nnayigirizanga bingi ku Baibuli ku Zoom eri abakozi bonna. Omukisa omulala omutono gwajja mukyala wa Isaac bwe yazaala omwana waabwe ow'okuna n'amutuuma Gareth!!

Ebitabo byange byonna byaddamu okulongoosebwa ne biteekebwa ku Amazon abantu basobole okubigula. Muwala wa James, Jaimee, ow'emyaka 14, ye yakola ebibikka byabyo byonna, nga mw'otwalidde n'ekitabo kino. Olw'okusiima byonna bye baali bakoze, nnawa ttiimu mu Uganda olukusa okukozesa ebitabo byange n'ensimbi zonna ezinaabivaamu, okugaziya obuweereza bwabwe.

Mu 2024 nnali ntegeka okwegatta ku James mu Uganda okuyigiriza mu gumu ku Nkiiko z'Abasumba ennyingi eza Pr Dan. Enteekateeka y'olugendo bwe yagenda ng'erabika bulungi, ne kinneeyoleka nti emyaka gyange n'omubiri gwange omunafu byali bifuuka ekiziyiza ekinene ennyo obutakifaako. Kyandibadde kwetulinkiriza okusuubira omubiri gwange okugumira obukoowu bw'okuvuga essaawa eziwerako ku makubo agamu mu Uganda. Kyokka obutabaawo bwange tebwandiziyizza buweereza mu basumba abo, kubanga Odyssey yakulembera okukuba ebitabo byange eyo mu ggwanga n'okubigabira abasumba bonna abaaliwo ku bwereere. Ntegeera nti kati bivvuunuddwa mu nnimi nnya – Olungereza, Olusipanya n'ennimi bbiri ez'omu Afrika. Nneewuunya nnyo era nfunye omukisa munene okumanya nti ebiwandiiko byange kati bibunyisibwa buli wamu nga obubaka bwange bwe buli. Mazima, omuceere “gumera” mu nnimiro.

Mukama, Oli mulungi nnyo gye ndi! Ka byombi, okuwandiika n'okwogera, bigende mu maaso okuba ebya ttendo ly'Ekitiibwa Kyo. (Abef. 1:6, 12, 14).

fields.title: Lion’s Pride
fields.body_html:
Ebiseera byange eby’okusaba ne James byafuuka omugugu ku mutima gwange olw’abasumba n’amakanisa ga Victoria, ekimu ku “bibuga mu Canada ebisinga obutaba na bantu bagenda mu kkanisa”. Nnawandiika olukalala lw’amakanisa n’abasumba baago abaaliwo mu kiseera ekyo, ne ntandika okusaba n’obunyiikivu olunaku lumu buli wiiki, nga mmala ekiseera ku buli limu.

Okuva lwe nnajja e Victoria, mpulidde nga Kalebu ne Yoswa bwe bateekwa okuba nga baawulira, nga batudde mu weema zaabwe mu ddungu, nga bajjukira bye baalaba mu Kanani. Baali baagala okuyingira Kanani, naye obutakkiriza bw’abakessi abalala abaatumibwa okuketta ensi bwaviirako abaana ba Isirayiri okutaataaganira mu ddungu okumala emyaka amakumi ana. Katonda yali akyabaagala era ng’abawa emmere, naye teyali musanyufu gye bali, kubanga yali abaggye mu Misiri ng’ekigendererwa kwe kuyingira Kanani, ensi yaabwe ey’ekisuubizo.

Victoria yafuuka ‘eddungu’ lyange oluvannyuma lw’ebyamagero bya Hazelglen Fellowship, M/V Anastasis, n’essanyu lye nnafuna mu buweereza obw’okutambula nga mbuulira. Yee, waaliwo ebiseera lwe nnasanyukiranga okulega ku “bugubi n’emmaanu” ebyaweebwanga n’ekisa kingi bwe kityo, naye nnali nnalega ku mubisi gw’enjuki n’emizabbibu gya Kanani, era tewaali kintu kirala kyonna kitono ku ekyo ekyali kisobola okukkusa enjala yange. Ekkanisa gye nnasinzizangamu yafuuka ensulo mu ddungu gye ndi, naye ensulo ng’ezo zisangibwa mu bifo eby’eddungu, ate okwolesebwa kwange kwali kutunudde ku nsozi za Kanani.

Mu Novemba 2024, nnawulira ku basumba abalala bana abaali, nga nze, baweerezza ekkanisa okumala emyaka mingi mu Victoria, naye kaakano nga bakuŋŋaana buli wiiki okusaba. Nga nze, tewali n’omu ku bo eyali ayagala ‘okuwummula’, wabula baawulira omugugu okweyongera okuweereza ekkanisa nga beewaayo mu kusaba okw’amaanyi.

Mu kiseera kye kimu ekyo, waaliwo okukubaganya ebirowoozo okw’amaanyi mu bakulembeze b’ebyobufuzi ku “bantu b’oku nguudo”. Olw’okuba Victoria erina embeera y’obudde esinga obukkakkamu mu Canada yonna, esikiriza abatalina mayumba, abaddukira ku biragalalagala, bamalaaya, abaalumizibwa ku bwongo, n’abalala abeetisse ebiwundu eby’enjawulo ebiva mu bulumi obw’amaanyi. Ka mbayite “abantu bange”, kubanga neetikka obwakabona ku lwabwe mu maaso g’entebe ya Katonda (1 Peetero 2:9). Bazze okufuula Victoria amaka gaabwe, era abatuuze n’abasuubuzi be babeera nabo ne babakwatako mu ngeri eya bulijjo. Okukubaganya ebirowoozo okwaliwo kwali ku kukozesa ebiragalalagala by’oku nguudo eri abalwadde abaayingizibwanga mu malwaliro gaffe oluvannyuma lw’okumira ebiragalalagala ebisukkiridde oba olw’obutabanguko ku nguudo. Byandikkiriziddwa oba nedda? Gavumenti ya Ssaza yalina endowooza emu; Gavumenti ey’Awamu yalina endala ey’enjawulo ddala.

Mu lukuŋŋaana lwange olwasooka ne mikwano gyange egy’edda, Neil B yayogera ekigambo ekyankwatako ennyo. “Gavumenti eritegeera ddi nti teririna ky’eyinza kukola ku buzibu bw’oku nguudo? Yesu yekka y’ekyanukula.” Ekyo nnakitwala ng’akabonero kange, era ku Bbalaza eyaddirira nneetanira mu kizikiza kya Pandora Ave, oluguudo olujjula abantu b’oku nguudo bangi. Nnayingira mu Our Place, ekyali kyatandikibwawo ng’obuweereza obw’Ekikristaayo naye kaakano nga kyaleka omulimu ogwo okusobola okukkirizibwa Gavumenti n’okufuna ensimbi za gavumenti. Nnasiimye nnyo obuyonjo bwakyo n’obulungi bwa kaawa waakyo.

Nnasala oluguudo okulaba ekibinja ky’abavubuka, abaali bambadde mu ngeri y’emu bajaketi ez’amaliba, abaali baweereza abaddukira ku biragalalagala nga babawa ekifo eky’okwotera – kubanga, ddala, gwali mwezi gwa Novemba. Bwe nnali ntandika okubuuza ebibuuzo, omuntu n’aleekaana. Omuwala omu yali yakamira ebiragalalagala ebisukkiridde. Bwe baali banguwa okumukuba empiso ya Narcan okulwanyisa fentanyl (era ne kisobola), nnasanga amaaso ku maaso n’omukulembeze waabwe, omusajja omunene ng’ajjudde ebifaananyi ebyasiigibwa ku mubiri, ng’alina empeta mu matu ne ku buli lugalo, ng’alina ekimuli ekiwanikiddwa mu bulago bwe, era ng’asaze enviiri mu ngeri ya mohawk – yali buli kimu nze kye siri!

Oboolyawo nnagotaagota katono bwe nnatandika okwogera. “Gyebale, Jimmy, erinnya lyange nze Gareth, era ndi musumba mu kibuga kino. Omutima gwange gunnuma olw’abantu bano, era awamu n’abalala batono, ndi n’omugugu gw’okubasabira – naye tetumanyi ngeri ya kusaba. Oyinza okutulagako engeri gye tuyinza okusabamu, kubanga tukkiriza nti Yesu yekka y’ekyanukula eri ‘obuzibu’ bw’oku nguudo?” Jimmy yangwa mu kifuba n’alaya nti, “Yesu y’ekyanukula!” Bwe nnamubuuza ebisingawo, yaŋŋamba engeri ye ne mukyala we Megan gye baasisinkana Yesu emyaka nga ebiri emabega, era nti kaakano baali bakomyewo gye baagabiranga edda ebiragalalagala, okuleeta obubaka bwa Yesu eri abali mu bwetaavu. “Edda twaleetanga ebiragalalagala, kaakano tuleeta essuubi!”

Twasenguka ne tugenda mu McDonald’s eyali okumpi, era nga tunywa chocolate ayokya, ye ne Megan ne bannyumiza olugero lwabwe. Jimmy yali abadde n’obulamu obw’obutabanguko n’obumenyi bw’amateeka, yali amaze emyaka mingi mu kkomera ery’amaanyi, ng’akyusakyusa n’obulamu ku nguudo. Baazaala abaana babiri, era amangu ddala ne babaggyibwako ab’obuyinza abakola ku by’embeera z’abantu ne babatwala okukuzibwa amaka amalala. Bwe yava mu kkomera omulundi ogwasembayo, Jimmy yamalirira okubeera omuntu atakozesa biragalalagala wadde omwenge alyoke asobole okuddizibwa abaana be – ekintu ekyalabika ng’ekitasoboka mu kiseera ekyo.

Yagenda ewa Rev Al Tysick, Omukristaayo yekka eyali abeera ku nguudo buli kiseera, n’amusaba nti: “Al, njagala abaana bange bankomezebwe. Nkwegayiridde nnyamba ntereeze obulamu bwange.” Al yabakolera enteekateeka bombi okugenda e Vancouver mu kifo eky’okuwonyezaamu abaddukira ku biragalalagala okumala ekiseera, era okuva eyo ne bagenda mu kifo ekirala ekyesigamiziddwa ku kukkiriza, gye baasisinkanira bombi Mukama eyazuukira. Baamalirira okuddayo ku nguudo z’“ewaabwe” okuyamba abalala okuzuula ekkubo lino ery’okuva mu buddu bw’ebiragalalagala n’obutaba na ssuubi.

Obulamu bwabwe bwakyuka nnyo ddala, ne kiba nti n’ab’obuyinza baalaba enjawulo, ne babaddiza abaana baabwe oluvannyuma lw’emyaka egiwerako nga baawukanye. Kirabika guno gwe gwali omulundi ogusoose ekyamagero kino okubaawo ku nguudo.

Njagala okuyingizaamu wano akafaananyi katono ku Rev Al Tysick. Ye yakolanga mu Our Place, ekyali kiyitibwa edda The Upper Room – obuweereza obw’Ekikristaayo. Saamusisinkana, naye bulijjo nnamussangamu ekitiibwa kingi, kubanga, newakubadde nga yali tamanyiddwa kuba wa ndowooza yange ey’Enjiri, waakiri yali akola Yesu kye yandikoze ng’aweereza abantu b’oku nguudo.

Bwe nnasisinkana Jimmy, Al yali yawummula dda era yali yakawandiika ekitabo ku bye yayitamu, Muddy Waters (“Amazzi Ag’ebitosi”). Nnagula ekitabo ne ntuula akawungeezi kamu ku ntebe yange ennungi nga njagala okumala akawungeezi akalungi ak’okuwummula. Mangu ddala obuwummuze bwange ne bumpabuka, akawungeezi ne kafuuka akazito. Nneesanga nga nkaaba nnyo, si lwa ngero ezikwata ku mutima ze nnali nsoma, wabula nga nkaaba olw’ensonyi. Nnali mmaze emyaka amakumi ana mu kibuga kino, era, ne baganda bange Abakristaayo ab’Enjiri, twali tuzibirira amaaso abalumwa ku nguudo zaffe, ng’ate “Omusamaliya” ono, atamanyiddwa kuba wa kibinja kyange eky’eby’eddiini, yali akola Yesu kye yandikoze – ng’anaaza ebigere, ng’aliisa abalumwa enjala era ng’ajjanjaba ebiwundu byabwe. Ekiro ekyo nnakyuka. Ono ow’emyaka 85, nga Kalebu ow’edda, yasaba olusozi abakirimaanyi kwe babeera. Yoswa 14. Sikyasobola nate kumatira na bulamu mu nsulo z’eddungu.

Akawungeezi kamu bwe nnali ntudde ku kompyuta yange, nnaggulawo ekifo ekitereka fayiro ekyali kiyitibwa “Okusaba”. Emu ku fayiro ezaali omwo yawandiikibwa mu kiseera ky’obuzibu bwa COVID mu 2021, enkuŋŋaana z’okusaba bwe zaali zikolebwa ku Zoom. Omusumba wange yawandiika fayiro eno ng’eddamu ku lukuŋŋaana lw’akawungeezi ako. Bwe twali tulindirira Mukama okutulungamya (ekintu Ron Smith kye yanjigiriza mu nnaku za Hazelglen), nnalaba “ekimuli ekyeru ekirungi ekiyitibwa lily nga kimera okuva mu mazzi ag’ebitosi” – era ekitabo kya Al kiyitibwa Muddy Waters. Mukama yali andaga ebyali bigenda okubaawo mu biseera eby’omu maaso? Jimmy ne Megan be kimuli ekyo ekyeru ekirungi?

Nnafuuka “taata” wa Jimmy ne Megan, era nnina enkizo ey’okubalung’amya n’okubakuza mu by’omwoyo. Era bampita “Kryptonite” kubanga Jimmy atandika okukaaba buli lwe tugwaŋŋana mu kifuba! Baali tebamanyi nnyo Kigambo, naye kyali kyeyoleka nti baalina “okufukibwako amafuta” okw’amaanyi okuva eri Katonda. Nnabayigiriza emisingi gy’Ebyawandiikibwa, ne ntandika okukuŋŋaanya abakulembeze Abakristaayo abalala okubeetooloola. Lumu nnabuuza Jimmy Bakristaayo ki abalala be yali asisinkanye nga bakola ku nguudo. Mmanyi nti waliwo abalala, naye eky’okuddamu kye kyali kya mazima: “Taata, ggwe Mukristaayo asoose gwe nnali nsisinkanye!”

Nnafuna enkizo ey’okubabatiza mu maaso g’abaana baabwe abaali bamasamasa nga basanyufu. Nnatambuza Megan mu kkanisa okumutuusa ku mwami we, era ne njogera ku mbaga yaabwe. Ntambula nabo nga tusaba, era sirina kutya bwe ngwaŋŋana mu kifuba ne mikwano gyabwe. Mbatizza abalala basatu mu kidiba ku nguudo mu budde bwa Novemba! Olw’okuba beesigibwa nnyo mu bantu baabwe, nkkirizibwa buli gye ndaga, era mpeereddwa ekitiibwa eky’erinnya “taata ow’omu batisimu” (“godfather”)! Katonda akola ekintu eky’enjawulo ku nguudo zaffe, era ndi mwesiimu nnyo okubeera akatundu akatono ku kyo.

Ndowooza nti buno bwe bujja okuba obuweereza bwange obusembayo – naye tewali amanyi. Katonda bw’aba ayinza okunzigulirawo enzigi ng’ezo nga ndi wa myaka 85, kiki ekisingawo ky’ayinza okukola nga ndi wa myaka 90? Emirundi mingi mmugamba nti, “Ai Mukama, obadde mulungi nnyo gye ndi okumala emyaka mingi. Lwaki nnandibuusabuusa nti ojja kweyongera okuba omulungi gye ndi? Ndi mwetegefu okukomawo eka, naye mu kiseera kino, nkwegayiridde weeyongere okukola mu nze, ndyoke mbeerenga bulijjo ‘olw’okutenderezebwa kw’Ekitiibwa kyo’.”
